31337.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act (Wet milieubeheer) on waste rules, removing the mandatory delegation to ministerial regulation on curbside household waste collection near every property and the duty to notify VROM-Inspectie of municipal deviations, while expanding municipal discretion on separate green waste collection. It also aligns the waste chapter with the Feed Act (Kaderwet diervoeders) and drops several redundant provisions and cross-references.
31337.j: The memorandum justifies removing the delegation on grounds of decentralisation and because the inspectorate has other means of information, and aligns the rules with the Feed Act to reduce overlapping regulation.
q: It is proposed to abolish the mandatory delegation power laid down in article 10.26, fourth paragraph, of the Environmental Management Act.
Voorgesteld wordt de dwingend voorgeschreven delegatiebevoegdheid (neergelegd in artikel 10.26, vierde lid, Wm) te laten vervallen
d: Artikel I, H (10.26, vierde lid, Wm)
conditions for collection near every property (Regeling voorwaarden inzamelen)
p: Municipalities gain wider discretion to deviate from the collection duty and the notification to the inspectorate is removed, while the ministerial conditions lapse with the delegation.
Artikel I, A (1.1) and Artikel I, O (21.6)
References to removed delegations under the former article 8.35 are deleted as redundant cleanup.

parties: Supports greater municipal discretion and reduced administrative burden, and asks how the plastics packaging agreement and litter funding arrangements are reflected in the bill.
They support the bill's aims of increasing municipal policy space, removing overlapping regulation, codifying earlier agreements and reducing administrative and governance burdens.

Zij ondersteunen de doelstellingen van het wetsvoorstel om de beleidsruimte voor gemeenten te vergroten, de overlappende regelgeving ongedaan te maken, eerder gemaakte afspraken vast te leggen en administratieve en bestuurlijke lasten te verminderen.
Asks how the VROM-Inspectie will supervise environmental standards once municipalities no longer must notify it, and what measures apply if municipalities fall short.
To what extent will the VROM-Inspectie supervise this now that the municipalities' duty to inform it lapses?
In hoeverre zal de VROM-Inspectie, nu de informatieplicht van de gemeenten vervalt, hier op toezien?
Objects to abolishing mandatory separate green-waste collection and fixed collection distances, and to passing litter costs to households; asks for guarantees and cost-benefit analysis.
Nationally fixing collection distances for household waste appears to the SP to be excessive regulatory burden.
Het landelijk vastleggen van afstanden voor inzameling van huishoudelijk afval lijkt volgens de leden van de SP-fractie overdreven regeldruk.

Welcomes efficiency gains and lower local charges but wants environmental and reuse frameworks protected, low-threshold collection ensured without rigid delegation, and detailed monitoring of cost and environmental effects.
However, they believe certain environmental and beneficial-reuse frameworks must not be undermined.
Echter, zij zijn van mening dat enkele kaders ten aanzien van milieu en het nuttig hergebruik van afval niet mogen worden ondermijnd.
Worries flexibility could become non-committal, asks for undefined terms such as 'substantial quantity' to be clarified and for the bill itself to define 'doelmatig beheer'.
Does this flexibility not lead to non-committal behaviour?
Leidt deze flexibiliteit niet tot vrijblijvendheid?
Raises incineration capacity limits and compost quality risks, and asks how the reduced VROM-Inspectie notification duty is offset by other supervisory tools.
The members hope these instruments provide sufficient guarantee for timely intervention, since some municipalities are fairly backsliding on separate collection.
De leden hopen dat deze instrumenten voldoende waarborg bieden voor bijtijds ingrijpen, aangezien sommige gemeenten aardig op hun retour zijn wat betreft stevige inzet op gescheiden inzameling.

31382.s: The bill amends the Kaderwet financiële verstrekkingen Financiën so the Minister of Finance may insure or guarantee trade and investment risks of Dutch businesses abroad, in agreement with the Minister of Economic Affairs, and sets rules for risk management and reporting to parliament. It also transfers existing reinsurance portfolios from insurers to the State and removes Article 5 of the Kaderwet.
31382.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to let the State act as insurer for trade risks and to improve risk management, and it explains that disputes will be left to the civil court rather than administrative review.
q: Disputes between the insured (or financier) and the insurer (the State) can therefore under the new system be assessed (exclusively) by the civil court.
Eventuele geschillen tussen verzekerde (financier) en de verzekeraar (de Staat) kunnen in het nieuwe stelsel dan ook (uitsluitend) door de civiele rechter worden beoordeeld
d: further rules for implementing the insurance and guarantee powers
p: The Minister of Finance gains discretion to issue insurance and guarantees for export and investment risks, with only a reporting duty to the Tweede Kamer in the Financieel Jaarverslag.
Existing insurance portfolios transfer to the State by general title without the consent of policyholders, who cannot object to the transfer.

parties: Asks for clear criteria on which credit risks the State takes over and oversight of complex products, and worries that the reduced role of De Nederlandsche Bank may weaken risk-management quality.
It cannot be that the State then simply has to take on every remaining risk.
Het kan niet zo zijn dat de Staat dan maar elk resterend risico op zich moet nemen.
Broadly welcomes lower costs and more export, but asks about beneficiaries, supervision of risk-prone countries and the budgetary impact on development aid.
It seems to these members that this amendment may lead to lower costs of export credit insurance and possibly more exports and employment in the Netherlands.
Het komt de leden voor dat deze wetswijziging kan leiden tot lagere kosten van exportkredietverzekeringen en mogelijk meer export en werkgelegenheid in Nederland.

Has serious doubts about objectivity, transparency and knowledge at the ministries, which would make parliament's controlling role harder, and questions the risk-reducing claim of complex credit derivatives.
For the House too, its controlling task is certainly not made simpler this way, which the SP members find undesirable.
Ook voor de Kamer wordt haar controlerende taak er op deze manier bepaald niet eenvoudiger op, hetgeen de leden van de SP-fractie onwenselijk vinden.

Shares the Raad van State's criticism, finds the government's response inadequate, and asks for transparency on eligibility criteria, a clearer line between market and State responsibility, and a financial section.
To the members' disappointment, the government does too little with the advice of the Raad van State.
Tot teleurstelling van de leden doet de regering te weinig met het advies van de Raad van State.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises revising the bill amending the Kaderwet financiële verstrekkingen Financiën, which moves export credit insurance from reinsurance to direct State insurance, because it lacks a legal basis for EU directive implementation, objective acceptance criteria, state aid safeguards, risk-management expertise, legal protection clarity, procurement compliance, and correct representation of the State. The government's nader rapport rejects most objections as unfounded but adopts several clarifications in the explanatory memorandum and a provision allowing further rules.
concerns: The bill fails to ensure correct and complete implementation of EU export credit directives 98/29/EC and 84/568/EEC; the government adds a provision allowing implementing rules but states the Toelatingsbesluit will be withdrawn later.

Lack of objective criteria for granting export credit insurance may cause legal uncertainty and litigation; the government argues the discretionary room is necessary and the criteria are sufficiently transparent.

State aid aspects are not addressed in the explanatory memorandum and notification to the European Commission is unclear; the government states the risks are uninsurable and will be notified as implementation.

Removing De Nederlandsche Bank's expertise and expanding active risk management may increase State risk and dependence on private parties; the government argues risks are reduced and expertise is used internally.

The explanatory memorandum should address the consequences for legal protection of the shift from reinsurance to direct State insurance; the government adds clarification that disputes go to the civil court.

Service contracts with Atradius DSB may be subject to EU procurement obligations or transparency requirements; the government confirms relevant procurement rules will be observed and clarifies this in the memorandum.

Ministers lack legal personality, so the bill should refer to the State rather than the Minister; the government retains the existing terminology for consistency and states the State is the insurer in the explanatory memorandum.

31391.s: The bill makes a series of partial technical amendments to the Dutch Criminal Code, Code of Criminal Procedure and related laws, extending jurisdiction for certain offences, adjusting data-retrieval and surveillance powers, and correcting outdated cross-references such as the replacement of the Wet politieregisters by the Wet politiegegevens. It also adds disqualification from profession as a sanction for bribery and related offences and reclassifies fines for certain offences.
31391.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly as technical corrections, international treaty compliance and fixing drafting errors, rather than as new executive powers.
q: The proposed amendment of the sixth and seventh paragraphs of this provision is technical in nature and is necessary due to the replacement of the Wet politieregisters by the Wet politiegegevens.
De voorgestelde wijziging van het zesde en zevende lid van deze bepaling is van technische aard en is noodzakelijk in verband met vervanging van de Wet politieregisters door de Wet politiegegevens.
d: processing of municipal camera footage data under the Wet politiegegevens
p: Requires prior written authorisation by the rechter-commissaris for extensions and changes to orders for future data, tightening rather than expanding prosecutorial discretion.
Artikel II, onderdelen E en I (Sv art. 126ue, 126ii)
Extends the period for future-data orders in organised-crime cases by up to four weeks per extension and aligns the scope with the regime for ordinary offences.
Artikel II, onderdeel C en D (Sv art. 126t, 126ta)

Extends the reasonable-suspicion basis for telecommunications interception in organised-crime cases to persons involved in planning offences, and adds treaty conditions for interception in another state.
Artikel II, onderdeel J and L (Sv art. 126nd, 126ng, 126ug, 272)

Allows urgent oral authorisation by the rechter-commissaris, later confirmed in writing within three days, and lets the chair of the court order questions to be put through him on pressing grounds, on request of the accused or prosecutor.
Artikel XIII, onderdeel E (Wet politiegegevens art. 32)
Adds to the reporting duties for automated comparison and reprocessing of police data, which is a documentation safeguard for police use of personal data.

parties: Warns that expanded extraterritorial jurisdiction risks duplicate jurisdiction and asks how a judge can objectively judge whether an offence is political under the depoliticisation clause.
These members ask how a judge can assess this objectively when the defendant claims to be a freedom fighter while the prosecutor considers him a terrorist.
Deze leden vragen hoe een rechter dit objectief kan beoordelen wanneer de gedaagde stelt een vrijheidsstrijder te zijn terwijl de aanklager meent dat het gaat om een terrorist.

Supports the amendments and technical improvements, especially extending Dutch jurisdiction, and asks whether the International Crimes Act should be given retroactive effect and whether Criminal Code article 4a should be adjusted for suspects in The Hague tribunals.
The VVD members are positive about the amendments, adjustments and technical improvements, particularly where they extend the jurisdiction of the Netherlands.

De leden van de VVD-fractie staan positief tegenover de wijzigingen, aanpassingen en technische verbeteringen, met name daar waar het aanpassingen betreft ter uitbreiding van de rechtsmacht van Nederland.

31418.s: The bill creates a statutory basis in the Civil Code, General Administrative Law Act and General State Taxes Act to recover state aid following a European Commission decision or a court ruling, including interest, and overrides national limitation and procedural rules that would block recovery. It also changes the procedure for setting the statutory interest rate from an general administrative order to a ministerial regulation.
31418.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to comply with binding EU Commission recovery decisions and Dutch Council of State rulings requiring a statutory basis for recovery.
p: Artikel I C, art. 6:212a; Artikel II F, art. 4:80b Awb
Administrative bodies may recover aid and set aside statutory limitation periods and standard procedural rules, while the recipient retains ordinary appeal rights against the recovery decision.

parties: Worries that recovering state aid may force firms into financial difficulty and dismissals, and that companies' legitimate expectations should not be ignored; asks whether firms have adequate legal remedies.
Do companies have sufficient legal means to resist the withdrawal of state aid?
Hebben ondernemingen voldoende juridische middelen om zich te verzetten tegen intrekking van staatssteun?
Asks whether sectors exempt from corporate tax risk retrospective recovery, whether DAEB designations should precede the bill, and how the bill relates to the Market and Government Act.
Do these sectors run the risk that this exemption will be reclaimed as unlawful state aid now or in the future?
Lopen deze sectoren het risico dat deze vrijstelling nu of in de toekomst als ongeoorloofde staatssteun teruggevorderd zal gaan worden?

Objects that the risk of wrongly granted state aid is placed on beneficiaries rather than the government, questions legal certainty and the trust principle, and criticises the ten-year period and retroactive application.
It appears this bill has chosen to place all (mainly financial) negative consequences on the state-aid recipient party.
Het lijkt er op dat er in dit wetsvoorstel voor is gekozen alle (en voornamelijk financiële) negatieve gevolgen bij de staatssteunontvangende partij te leggen.

Questions the retroactive reach over up to ten years, the legal basis for revision of decisions by the inspector, the legal remedies available, and the administrative burden on decentralised governments and firms.
The entry into force of a general basis for recovering state aid granted in breach of EC law will likely have very far-reaching consequences for, among others, Dutch companies.

Het inwerkingtreden van een algemene grondslag voor terugvordering van in strijd met het EG-recht verstrekte staatssteun heeft waarschijnlijk zeer verstrekkende gevolgen voor onder andere Nederlandse ondernemingen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill on recovery of state aid should also cover national court rulings ordering recovery of unlawfully granted aid, that recovery grounds should be mandatory, that subsidy refusal grounds be extended, that tax aid recovery run through the tax system, that the tax-payment waiver be justified, and that entry into force not depend on the Vierde Tranche Awb. The minister followed several points (scope, subsidy refusal, tax recovery) but rejected the mandatory wording and the decoupling from the Vierde Tranche, and defended the tax-waiver provision.
concerns: The Raad argued that national courts must order recovery of unlawful state aid, so the bill should cover that situation; the minister added the regulation.
The Raad wanted recovery grounds in the BW and Awb phrased imperatively rather than facultatively; the minister declined, citing private law systematics and harmonisation.
The Raad advised adding a subsidy refusal ground for prohibited state aid to Awb article 4:35; the minister followed this.
The Raad advised that recovery of tax state aid take place through the fiscal instruments and that tax litigation be concentrated before the tax judge; the minister agreed and clarified the text.

The Raad advised that the tax-payment waiver under Iw 1990 article 26 may frustrate effective recovery and should be justified or excluded; the minister defended retaining it as consistent with recovery.
The Raad advised decoupling the entry into force of article II from the Vierde Tranche Awb; the minister rejected this as practically necessary.
Redactional remarks on the wording of article III were partly adopted by the minister.

31436.s: The bill amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, the Criminal Code and several detention and treatment laws to strengthen identity verification of suspects, convicts and witnesses, including photographs and fingerprints, a mandatory identification duty before judicial officials, and a criminal justice chain number with a central database. It also extends identity checks to supervision and treatment settings and revises data retention periods for judicial records.
31436.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded identification powers by the documented problem of identity fraud and incorrect personal data in the criminal justice chain, and by the need for reliable verification at key moments.
q: If one wants to act effectively against (possible) identity fraud in the criminal justice chain, identity must be properly established at the start of each process and then verified (or be verifiable) at set moments in the process.

Wil er dus effectief opgetreden worden tegen (mogelijke) identiteitsfraude in de strafrechtsketen, dan zal de identiteit aan het begin van ieder traject deugdelijk vastgesteld en vervolgens op gezette momenten in het traject geverifieerd moeten (kunnen) worden.
d: Artikel I, D (art. 27b, lid 2 en 4 Sv)
use of chain number and data recorded in the criminal justice chain database
rules for processing photographs and fingerprints
criteria for institutions providing support to persons placed at the government's disposal
p: Artikel I, D (art. 27a and 29a Sv), Artikel I, E
Gives judicial officials and police power to require identity documents and take fingerprints and photographs from suspects, with a duty to comply enforced by criminal sanction.
Artikel I, D (art. 27b) and Artikel IX
Creates a criminal justice chain number and central database linking personal data of suspects and convicts across agencies."}],

parties: Welcomes the bill as filling a gap against identity fraud, but asks practical questions on the SKN number, security of the databank and implementation in detention and prisons.
It pleases them greatly that this proposal provides for strengthening careful and reliable identity determination of suspects, convicted persons and witnesses in the criminal justice chain.

Het stemt hen zeer tevreden dat met onderhavig voorstel wordt voorzien in een versterking van een zorgvuldige en betrouwbare vaststelling van de identiteit van verdachten, veroordeelden en getuigen in de strafrechtsketen.
Questions whether the bill is really about identification or also about investigation, and whether the measures, especially for minors, are proportionate to the problem and costs.

Although they also share the need to prevent identity fraud in general and within the criminal justice chain in particular, they nevertheless have several questions about what the government puts forward in this bill.

Hoewel ook zij de noodzaak van het voorkomen van identiteitsfraude in het algemeen en binnen de strafrechtketen in het bijzonder delen, hebben zij toch meerdere vragen bij hetgeen door de regering in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel naar voren wordt gebracht.
Doubts subsidiarity and proportionality, questions implementation risks raised by the Raad van State, and asks for safeguards on biometric data and limits on the use of fingerprints and photos.
The SP members endorse the doubt the Council of State expressed about the consequences of applying the proposed measures.
De leden van de SP-fractie onderschrijven de twijfel die de Raad van State uit over gevolgen in de toepassing van de voorgestelde maatregelen.
Supports the bill but asks for clarification of when verification is 'necessary', who decides, and of the judge's ability to verify identity and the scope of the identification duty.
However, they ask when one can speak of 'necessary' and who decides this.
Wel vragen zij wanneer men kan spreken van «nodig» en wie daartoe besluit.
Supports the aim of clear identity determination but questions the added value of the measures without technical capability and the need for a separate SKN next to the BSN.
Does the government share the view of these members that if those technical capabilities are lacking, the proposed statutory measures will have hardly any added value in practice?
Deelt de regering de opvatting van deze leden dat als die technische mogelijkheden ontbreken de voorgestelde wettelijke maatregelen in de praktijk nauwelijks meerwaarde zullen hebben?

Supports the bill's direction but asks whether the Raad van State's concern about two ministers being responsible for the same data is addressed and whether the same consultation procedure applies to the general administrative measures.
These members ask whether the same procedure (prior submission to parliament) is provided for the intended general administrative measures as for the Decree on DNA research in criminal cases.
Deze leden stellen de vraag of voor de bedoelde algemene maatregelen van bestuur dezelfde procedure (voorhang) is voorzien als bij het Besluit DNA-onderzoek in strafzaken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet identiteitsvaststelling verdachten, veroordeelden en getuigen, supporting its aim but raising concerns on necessity, justification of identification methods, retention periods for suspects not convicted, and the regulation of the strafrechtsketendatabank. The government's nader rapport accepted several points (retention, purpose limitation, databank responsibility, drafting) and rejected others such as the need to legislate database security and details at statutory level.
concerns: The Raad asked for justification of which identification method applies in which situation and how repeated identification of the same person was weighed for proportionality; the government added a first paragraph to art. 55c Sv and explained its criteria.

The Raad asked that use of stored fingerprints and photos for prevention, investigation and prosecution of any offence be shown necessary; the government agreed and will require deletion when a person can no longer be treated as a suspect.

The Raad asked to reconsider retention periods for persons wrongly treated as suspects under art. 8 ECHR; the government reconsidered and will destroy fingerprints and photos once a person is no longer a suspect.

The Raad asked that the distinction between convicted and non-convicted suspects in the databank be made workable and clear; the government kept the proposal and explained the handling in the explanatory memorandum.

The Raad asked that the main elements of data processing be set out in the statute with concretely bounded delegations; the government considered the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens sufficient and kept detail for lower regulations.

The Raad asked that the databank's establishment, its controller, the data processed and security be regulated in the statute; the government designated the minister of Justice in the statute but left data content and security to general rules and an AMvB.

The Raad asked the explanatory memorandum to address whether the measures would cause remands or delays in criminal proceedings; the government pointed to fall-back procedures and phased introduction and added an article XIII on phased entry into force.
The Raad made several drafting and cross-reference corrections in the annex, which the government incorporated, except one point about the paragraph numbering of art. 77f Sv.

31508.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code to implement EU Directive 2006/46/EC on annual accounts, adding disclosure duties on off-balance-sheet arrangements and related-party transactions and requiring a corporate governance statement for listed companies. It also makes directors and supervisory board members collectively liable for financial reporting and raises size thresholds for small and medium-sized entities.
31508.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of corporate governance detail to a general administrative order as implementation of the directive's requirements, without further explanation of safeguards.
q: These rules may in particular relate to compliance with a code of conduct to be designated in the general administrative order and to the content, disclosure and audit of a corporate governance statement.

Deze voorschriften kunnen in het bijzonder betrekking hebben op naleving van een in de algemene maatregel van bestuur aan te wijzen gedragscode en op de inhoud, de openbaarmaking en het accountantsonderzoek van een verklaring inzake corporate governance.
d: content, publication and audit of corporate governance statement, code of conduct

parties: Asks whether implementing corporate governance rules by decree offers enough certainty and democratic control, and whether the auditor's review scope of the governance statement is consistent with the Directive.
Changing or adjusting the rules largely escapes democratic control.
Wijziging of aanpassing van de regels onttrekt zich immers voor een belangrijk deel aan de democratische controle.
Asks questions on the origin of the directive, the corporate governance statement content, the choice to omit full fair value and retroactive application.
Why was the unusual retroactive effect to 1 January 2008 chosen?
Waarom is er gekozen voor de ongebruikelijke terugwerkende kracht tot 1 januari 2008?
Asks whether the vague notions of 'significant' transactions and 'related parties' are clear enough and how omissions would be sanctioned.
How can wrongly omitting an arrangement of significance be sanctioned?
Op welke wijze kan het ten onrechte niet opnemen van een regeling die van betekenis is worden gesanctioneerd?
Questions the burden estimates, enforcement capacity and priorities of supervisors, and asks for a pre-consultation procedure for the amending decree on corporate governance.
These members ask the government to submit this decree to the House via a light pre-consultation procedure.
Deze leden vragen de regering dit besluit middels een lichte voorhangprocedure aan de Kamer kenbaar te maken.

v.summary: The Council of State supports the bill implementing Directive 2006/46/EC on annual accounts but flags that the Dutch wording of 'van enige betekenis' diverges from the English, French and German versions, and that the 100% subsidiary exemption should not be read more broadly. The government reply changes the term to 'van betekenis', keeps 'dochtermaatschappij', and accepts the redactional remarks.
concerns: The Dutch translation 'van enige betekenis' does not match the other language versions of the Directive, so the wording should be corrected in implementation and pursued with the EU legislator.

The economic notion 'groepsmaatschappij' is broader than the legal notion 'dochtermaatschappij', which could widen the transaction exemption beyond what the Directive intends; the government keeps 'dochtermaatschappij' but does not otherwise adopt the proposed term.
Several minor redactional remarks on articles 2:381, 2:391 and 2:393 and the explanatory memorandum are taken into account.

31562.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to modernise and simplify vehicle regulation and implement EU Directive 2007/46/EC on vehicle type approval. It shifts many delegation grounds from general administrative orders (AMvB) to ministerial regulations, and gives the RDW new powers over component permits and recall supervision.
31562.j: The memorandum justifies the shift to ministerial regulation by the low political sensitivity, technical detail and need for flexibility and speed in implementing EU rules.
q: This is problematic for vehicle regulation, on the one hand because given the relatively low policy sensitivity, the high ordering character and the degree of detail of the provisions concerned, regulation at ministerial regulation level may be appropriate.

Dit is in het geval van de voertuigregelgeving bezwaarlijk, enerzijds omdat gelet op de relatief geringe beleidsgevoeligheid, het hoge ordeningskarakter en de mate van detaillering van de betrokken bepalingen regeling op het niveau van de ministeriële regeling aangewezen kan zijn
d: Artikel I, onderdeel F (art. 21 lid 1 and 3 Wvw1994)
categories of vehicles and production processes requiring approval before road use
Artikel I, onderdeel G (art. 22 lid 4 and 5 Wvw1994)
type approval procedure obligations of RDW and manufacturers; marks and data on approved vehicles
obligations of manufacturers when recalling vehicles already on the market
Artikel I, onderdeel P (art. 25e lid 4 Wvw1994)
Artikel I, onderdeel U (art. 30 lid 3 and 4 Wvw1994)
requirements and organisation for component and equipment sales permits; marks
Artikel I, onderdeel V (art. 34 lid 4 Wvw1994)
further rules on banned categories of vehicles and equipment, actions banned and exemptions
measuring equipment for periodic inspection, certification and recognition of testers
Artikel I, onderdeel Aj (art. 99 lid 2 Wvw1994)
inspection of damaged vehicles after registration invalidation
Artikel II, onderdeel D (art. 34 lid 1-4 Wvw1994)
designation of categories banned from manufacture, import or sale, and exceptions
p: Gives the RDW discretionary power to grant, monitor and withdraw permits for the sale of vehicle parts and equipment.
Gives the RDW supervisory power over manufacturers' recall of vehicles already on the market.

parties: Questions whether the justification for linking Beter Geregeld to the directive implementation is convincing and whether the approval of damaged vehicles by repair firms risks a conflict of interest.
Asks how enforcement of vehicle characteristics is divided between the police and the RDW, so that no characteristics go unchecked, including how noise standards will be tested.
It must be prevented that some characteristics are always checked while others are not checked at all.
Voorkomen moet worden dat sommige kenmerken steeds gecontroleerd worden en anderen helemaal niet.
Questions the necessity of the wider ministerial powers beyond what EU implementation requires and asks for the motivation, cost-benefit balance and the Actal advice.
The VVD members note that the proposed amendment to the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 expands the powers of the Minister of Transport to set rules on vehicle regulation.

De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat de voorgestelde wijziging van de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 de bevoegdheden van de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat tot het stellen van regels op het gebied van voertuigregelgeving vergroot.

Asks whether quality of inspections by repair firms is safeguarded, who performs follow-up checks, and whether the burden-reduction estimates are substantiated, including review of the regulation by Actal.
Can you indicate to what extent the quality of inspection remains assured here? Who carries out any follow-up checks and under what conditions must the accreditation scheme comply?
Kunt u aangeven in hoeverre hier kwaliteit van keuring geborgd blijft? Wie voert eventuele na-controles uit en aan welke voorwaarden moet de erkenningsregeling voldoen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to revise vehicle regulations and implement Directive 2007/46/EC, raising concerns about implementation method, enforcement and feasibility, and administrative burden justification. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, adding a delegation basis for several obligations, adding a fabrikant definition, clarifying enforcement via feitcodes, and quantifying a 9.6 million euro burden reduction.
concerns: The Afdeling advised implementing directive articles 5, 16, 37 and 38 in the statute because they impose rights and obligations on private parties, and the government added a new paragraph to article 22 Wvw1994.
The Afdeling advised a reasoned justification for combining Beter Geregeld reforms with directive implementation; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum but kept the combined approach.
The Afdeling advised moving general definitions such as fabrikant into the formal statute; the government added the fabrikant definition but kept technical definitions in lower regulation.
The Afdeling asked for analysis of enforceability and feasibility by RDW, prosecutors and police; the memorandum was supplemented on consultation and on adjusting feitcodes in the enforcement act.
The Afdeling found the administrative burden reasoning inadequate and asked for an estimated reduction; the government quantified a 9.6 million euro reduction and committed to submission for review.
Redactional comments were followed except the definition of aanhangwagen, which cannot be aligned because definitions differ across directives.

31706.s: The bill creates a statutory allowance (tegemoetkoming) for chronically ill and disabled people with high health-related costs, administered by the CAK under ministerial oversight, and replaces the fiscal extraordinary-expenses scheme with a new deduction rule for specific care costs. It also makes related amendments to tax, housing allowance, benefits and supervisory provisions.
31706.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to avoid a uniform income scheme under the Wmo, to handle implementation technicalities, and to keep benefit rules flexible for the CAK, which it says has no room beyond statutory criteria.
q: In carrying out this allowance, the CAK will have to work strictly according to the rules set by or under the law and therefore has no room to take into account criteria other than the statutory ones in decisions on allowances.

In dit verband zij allereerst opgemerkt dat het CAK bij de uitvoering van de onderhavige tegemoetkoming strikt volgens de bij of krachtens de wet gestelde regels zal moeten werken en daardoor geen ruimte heeft om bij beslissingen inzake tegemoetkomingen andere dan de wettelijke criteria een rol te doen spelen.
d: eligibility groups and allowance amounts for chronically ill and disabled persons
supplementing criteria for eligibility on short notice
data the CAK may process from insurers and assessment bodies
technical standards, security requirements and insurer compensation for data
structure of CAK budget and budget-setting conditions
form of annual accounts, audit reports and related rules
ministerial policy rules on CAK task execution
target group, amount and payment of allowance for disability benefit recipients
who counts as seriously disabled or care-dependent for specific care cost deduction
amounts and rules for diet costs, clothing and travel cost deductions
alternative non-fiscal allowance for people who cannot use the tax deduction
p: Gives the minister power to set policy rules for the CAK and to step in directly if the CAK neglects its tasks, subject to notification to parliament and a prior opportunity for the CAK to act.
Allows general administrative orders and ministerial rules to widen the health data flows and processing used to determine entitlement.
Allows the executive to set eligibility criteria by general administrative order, with a bill required to follow if the criteria are supplemented under urgency.

parties: Asks the government to send the criteria AMvB and ministerial regulation to parliament and questions whether the CAK can implement the scheme reliably.
These members request the government to send these matters to the Chamber together with the memorandum in response to the report.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering deze zaken samen met de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag aan de Kamer te sturen.
Asks whether the AMvB and the policy rules will be submitted to the Chamber before final decision-making on the bill.
The PvdA members ask whether this AMvB and the policy rules will be submitted to the Chamber before final decision-making on this bill takes place.
De leden van de fractie van de PvdA vragen of deze AMvB en de beleidsregels aan de Kamer worden voorgelegd voordat de definitieve besluitvorming over dit wetsvoorstel plaatsvindt.

Criticises stricter indication rules restricting access to AWBZ and Wmo support and doubts the bill reaches its target group; asks whether the bill should wait until the target group is properly defined.
These members ask why the introduction of this bill is not postponed until the optimal delineation of the target group has taken place.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom niet wordt gewacht met het invoeren van deze wet totdat de optimale afbakening van de doelgroep heeft plaatsgevonden.
Calls the financing unsound, the scheme overly complex and the decision rushed, and asks the government to restore the existing allowance in the Belastingplan 2009.
The VVD faction therefore requests the government to reinstate the current buitengewone uitgavenregeling in the Belastingplan 2009.
De VVD-fractie verzoekt daarom de regering de huidige buitengewone uitgavenregeling weer op te nemen in het Belastingplan 2009.
Objects that the law takes effect before the target group is defined, risking people with real extra costs being excluded, and asks how this will be prevented.
It must be prevented that people who demonstrably have extra costs receive no allowance because they wrongly fall outside the delineation.
Voorkomen moet worden dat mensen, die wel aantoonbaar meerkosten hebben, geen toeslag krijgen omdat ze ten onrechte buiten de afbakening vallen.
Asks about complexity, target group delineation and timing of data registration, without a clear check-related demand.
The bill therefore gives these members reason to pose a number of questions.
Het wetsvoorstel vormt voor deze leden daarom aanleiding tot het stellen van een aantal vragen.
Asks why the scheme is not merged with the compensation for the mandatory deductible and how the target group and income effects were calculated.
Furthermore they would like to know when the bill on adoption costs will be submitted to the Chamber.
Verder vernemen zij graag wanneer het wetsvoorstel inzake adoptiekosten bij de Kamer wordt ingediend.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on the draft Wet tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten, raising major objections on the scope of the generic income measures, the fiscal specific care cost scheme, the forfait's efficiency, the attribution of public-law powers to the private CAK, data protection under the Wbp/Art. 42, and supervision by the NZa. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted several points (CAK competence attribution, ministerial control, extra justification, data-protection explanations) and rejected others, such as moving the disability allowance and the Art. 42 objection.
concerns: The Council required clear legal attribution of a public-law power to the CAK and statutory ministerial control provisions, which the government adopted in new articles 3 and 7.
The Council argued that automated decision-making on sensitive personal data needed safeguards under Art. 42 Wbp, which the government rejected as not applicable.
The Council questioned the necessity and proportionality of processing sensitive personal data of about three million insured persons; the government added motivation but kept the approach.

The Council doubted the efficiency of the forfait system and the fiscal specific care costs scheme given administrative burden and non-take-up; the government justified the design and added a transitional measure.
The Council argued that the disability allowance for arbeidsongeschikten belongs in the relevant benefit laws rather than this Act; the government kept it in this Act.
The Council raised implementation concerns about tax-based care cost claims and interaction with allowances; the government responded that effects would be limited.

The Council asked that supervision of CAK's new tasks not automatically go to the NZa; the government explained its reasons for assigning this supervision to the NZa and added an explanation in the memorandum.

31724.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht so that, in exceptional circumstances, DNB and the AFM may adopt temporary binding general rules to support orderly financial markets and sector stability, without the normal consultation requirement. It also lets the Minister withdraw such rules that conflict with law or impose unreasonable burdens, and extends sanctions to these rules.
31724.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need for rapid action to curb serious market unrest, which makes the normal consultation procedure too slow, and says the minister will evaluate use afterwards.
q: It has become clear that swift action by the supervisor may be necessary to curb serious unrest.
Gebleken is dat snel optreden van de toezichthouder noodzakelijk kan zijn om ernstige onrust te beteugelen.
d: temporary binding general rules by DNB for financial sector stability
temporary binding general rules by AFM for orderly financial market processes
designating transaction categories exempt from market manipulation bans
p: Supervisory bodies may issue temporary binding rules in exceptional circumstances, with the general consultation requirement and ordinary procedure disapplied for speed.
The Minister may withdraw supervisory rules that conflict with law or impose unreasonable burdens, after prior consultation with the supervisor.
The AFM may designate transaction categories as falling under the market manipulation prohibition.

31751.s: The bill amends the General Administrative Law Act, the Government Information (Public Access) Act and about thirty special social-security and education statutes to align them with the Penalty Payments and Appeal for Failure to Decide in Time Act. It extends decision deadlines for objections (six to twelve weeks, with commission cases at twelve) and administrative appeals, and allows a first postponement of six weeks instead of four, with further postponement possible.
31751.j: The memorandum justifies the longer deadlines by the need for supplementary investigation after oral hearings and the complexity of information requests, and expects fewer appeals against non-decision overall.
q: This bill is expected to have hardly any consequences for the administrative judge.
Dit wetsvoorstel heeft naar verwachting nauwelijks gevolgen voor de bestuursrechter.
p: Lengthens the objection decision deadline and allows postponements by the administrative body, with written notice to parties required.
Extends the administrative appeal decision deadline and permits the appeal body to postpone decisions up to ten weeks, with notice to parties.
Excludes postponement and suspension decisions on objections and appeals from objection and appeal, though the court may still review their use through an appeal against non-decision.
Lengthens the Wob information request deadline to four weeks with a further four-week postponement and suspends the deadline during third-party consultation.

parties: Stresses that objection procedures need careful reconsideration and asks whether the full extended period is always needed and why the Council of State objects to a uniform starting point.
It is important that in the objection phase under the General Administrative Law Act a careful reconsideration of the contested decision takes place.
Het is van belang dat in de bezwaarfase ex Awb een zorgvuldige heroverweging van het bestreden besluit plaatsvindt.
Questions whether longer Wob deadlines undermine transparency and democratic decision-making and whether the proposal is sufficiently substantiated.
How does democratic decision-making and the transparency of government information to be respected relate to the intention to extend the Wob decision deadlines?
Hoe verhoudt de democratische besluitvorming en de daarbij in acht te nemen transparantie van overheidsinformatie zich tot het voornemen om de beslistermijnen inzake de Wob te verlengen?
Objects to extending deadlines and argues that administrative quality should be improved instead of postponing the problem.
It is not the deadlines that should be extended, but the quality of handling requests that should be improved.
Niet de termijnen moeten worden verlengd, maar de kwaliteit van de afhandeling van verzoeken moet worden verbeterd.
Asks for justification of the 12-week period, how long further postponement may last, and how indefinite delay is prevented.
How long may that further postponement last? What is a reasonable period?
Hoe lang mag dat verdere uitstel duren? Wat is een redelijke termijn?
Worries the broad postponement ground could let municipal authorities too easily escape deadlines and asks for evidence supporting the two-week extension.
Is the risk not high that municipal authorities will too easily want to escape the deadlines by invoking the required care?
Is het risico niet groot dat gemeentebesturen te gemakkelijk met een beroep op de vereiste zorgvuldigheid onder de termijnen uit zullen willen komen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, in its opinion of 19 September 2008, on a bill amending the Awb and Wob to align decision periods with the Wet dwangsom, making several points on decision terms, start of objection periods, further postponement and Wob information release. The government's reply largely accepted the advice on extending the objection decision term, limiting further postponement to procedural provisions, and was partly followed on Wob term lengthening, while rejecting the Council's proposed two-week term for environmental information and differentiation of complex requests.
concerns: The Council objected that the proposed further postponement ground in Art. 7:10(4)(c) Awb was too broad, and the government limited it to procedural provisions.

The Council questioned the justification for doubling the Wob decision term without data, and the government responded with practice-based reasoning and deferred the Council's differentiated-procedure proposal to a later evaluation.
The Council advised a two-week decision term for all environmental information requests, which the government declined, arguing the term should be flexible when third-party objections are unlikely.
The Council asked for clarification of why a separate term for non-environmental information is no longer needed, and the government explained the distinction is retained in the new Wob structure.
The Council advised motivating the uniform start date of the objection decision term, and the government explained the rationale of certainty and planning.

31814.s: The bill adds a chapter to the Animal Health and Welfare Act giving the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality power to impose administrative fines for specified violations concerning disease prevention and transport and slaughter of livestock. It sets fine ceilings, procedural safeguards (right to be heard, no self-incrimination, appeal to courts) and a debt-collection route by enforcement order.
31814.j: The memorandum justifies the fining power by the need for swift, lik-op-stuk enforcement of disease-prevention rules where fact-finding is simple and appeals are unlikely.
q: This is desirable in view of the on-the-spot enforcement character of administrative fines.
Dit is wenselijk met het oog op het lik-op-stuk-karakter van de handhaving door middel van bestuurlijke boetes.
p: The minister may impose administrative fines directly, bypassing criminal prosecution, subject to proportionality, appeal to the courts and procedural safeguards.
Unpaid fines may be collected by enforcement order that becomes an executory title without involvement of a civil judge.

parties: Asks who falls under the 'houder' definition, including transporters, and whether fines are proportionate to company size, preferring an AMvB over a ministerial regulation for fine amounts.
The CDA prefers to regulate these matters in an AMvB rather than the ministerial regulation now proposed.
Voorkeur van de leden van de CDA-fractie is om deze zaken te regelen in een AMvB in plaats van de nu voorgestelde ministeriële regeling.
Asks whether VWA capacity is sufficient, who decides whether a case goes to the prosecutor, and whether the rule barring prosecution after a fine is too rigid.
Would it not be a better solution to remove this restriction from the law so that prosecution remains possible?
Is het geen betere oplossing om ervoor te kiezen dat deze beperking uit de wet wordt gehaald, zodat vervolging nog mogelijk is
Has no substantive questions and declines to participate in the report.
These members decline to participate in the input for the report on this bill.
Deze leden zien verder af van deelname aan de inbreng voor hat verslag over het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Sees no reason yet to ask further questions.
For now they see no reason to ask further questions.
Vooralsnog zien zij geen aanleiding voor het stellen van nadere vragen.
Sees no reason yet to ask further questions.
For now they see no reason to ask further questions.
Vooralsnog zien zij geen aanleiding voor het stellen van nadere vragen.

Warns that administrative fines may replace prosecution of serious animal cruelty, questions the official acting as both enforcer and adjudicator, and asks about risks of arbitrariness and whether jurisprudence should first be built.
Care must be taken not to dispose of serious cases of animal welfare violations or even crimes against animals with an administrative fine.
Er moet worden gewaakt voor het met een bestuurlijke boete afdoen van gevallen van ernstige aantastingen van dierenwelzijn of zelfs misdrijven tegen dieren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill introducing administrative fines into the Animal Health and Welfare Act is acceptable in substance but that the delegation to the minister to set fine rules by ministerial regulation is too broad and should be limited to fine amounts, and that the fixed fine amounts and the lack of a mitigation duty need adjustment. The minister's reply accepts the narrowing of the delegation to fine levels, explains that fine amounts will be set by ministerial regulation with a provision allowing adjustment for circumstances and culpability, and adds a reference to article 23 of the Criminal Code for maximum fines.
concerns: The delegation in article 120b(2) was too broad and the designation of punishable conduct should not be left to a ministerial regulation; the minister narrowed the delegation to setting fine levels only.

Fixing exact fine amounts by ministerial regulation conflicts with the mitigation-oriented wording of article 120i; the minister accepts the point and adds a provision in the regulation allowing fines to be raised or lowered for circumstances and culpability, though not a statutory mitigation duty.
Redactional remarks on the wording of articles 120e and 120f were adopted in the revised text.

31823.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code and Code of Criminal Procedure to extend the maximum term of the conditional hospital order (tbs met voorwaarden) and allow judges to order immediate enforcement, and to permit a seven-week temporary crisis admission ordered by the court on prosecutorial request. It also obliges psychiatric institutions to admit persons subject to such conditions and adds a related admission provision to the Wet bijzondere opnemingen.
31823.j: The memorandum justifies the court-ordered crisis admission and immediate enforcement as closing the supervision gap and ensuring effective, tailored conditional tbs, while stressing that the court decides and that the presumption of innocence is respected.
q: The choice whether immediate enforcement is justified in the specific case is placed in the hands of the judge.
De keuze of in het concrete geval een onmiddellijke tenuitvoerlegging gerechtvaardigd is, wordt in handen gelegd van de rechter.
d: further rules on conditions and the prosecutor's application before release from detention
p: Allows the public prosecutor to request a court-ordered temporary admission of up to seven weken, extendable by another seven weeks, without the offender's consent, decided by the court within three days with immediate effect.

Allows a judge, on prosecutorial request or ex officio, to order immediate enforcement of conditional tbs despite a non-final judgment."},{"article":"ARTIKEL I, C (art. 38e Sr.)","directions":[],"mechanisms":[],"constraints":["sunset_clause"],"severity":"routine","towards":"checks","description_en":"Caps the total duration of tbs at nine years except in specified cases, limiting the duration of state-imposed measures."},{"article":"ARTIKEL III and IV","directions":["subnational"],"mechanisms":["bypass"],"constraints":[],"severity":"minor","towards":"executive","description_en":"Obliges psychiatric and GGz institutions to admit persons on whom the court has imposed an admission condition, overriding their acceptance discretion."}],
Transitional rule: the bill does not apply to persons whose conditional tbs has become final before entry into force."}],

parties: Welcomes the reform but warns against turning the judge into a treatment provider and wants limits on how concretely the judge sets conditions.
These members believe the judge's ruling should be limited to whether or not to impose tbs with conditions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vinden dat de uitspraak van de rechter zich moet beperken tot het al dan niet opleggen van tbs met voorwaarden.
Asks for justification of the nine-year maximum, whether a fixed maximum hinders tailored treatment, and how cooperation and control after tbs will be ensured.
Is it not the case that precisely for offering tailored treatment a maximum term can be an obstacle?
Is het niet zo dat juist voor het bieden van maatwerk een maximale termijn een obstakel kan zijn?
Supports the nine-year extension but asks the government to reconsider whether a statutory maximum belongs in the law, so the judge could review longer supervision in exceptional cases.
The members support the proposed extension from four to nine years, but ask the government to reconsider whether a maximum term belongs in the law.
De leden steunen dan ook de voorgestelde verlenging van vier naar negen jaar, maar vragen de regering te heroverwegen of er wel een maximale termijn in de wet thuis hoort.
Asks why the measure should not be of unlimited duration, what happens after nine years if doubts remain, and why the seriousness of conditions outweighs easier modification.
The VVD members continue to wonder whether a placement with conditions should not be of unlimited duration.
De leden van de VVD-fractie blijven zich afvragen of een maatregel van terbeschikkingstelling met voorwaarden niet van onbeperkte duur moet zijn.
Criticises immediate enforcement before a final judgment as a serious infringement on the presumption of innocence and right to appeal, and questions whether the defendant truly has a free choice.
These members consider this exception a major infringement on the rights of the defendant.
Deze leden achten deze uitzondering een grote inbreuk op de rechten van verdachte.
Asks what difficulties delay hearings in serious cases and how the judiciary consultation will remove this bottleneck, and whether immediate enforcement implies passing the presumption of innocence.
These members ask what difficulty arises in this context and what results the consultation with the judiciary has led or will lead to.
Deze leden vragen welke moeilijkheid zich in dit verband voordoet en tot welke resultaten het overleg met de rechterlijke macht heeft geleid of zal leiden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill's decision on temporary forced crisis admission under tbs with conditions should rest with the district court rather than the rechter-commissaris, and that the transitional law be clarified. The government's reply accepted the advice, reassigned the decision to the court, and narrowed the transitional provision to cases where the measure is final.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that a far-reaching decision on forced crisis admission should be taken by the court rather than the rechter-commissaris, and the government adopted this.
The transitional provision did not clearly exclude cases where the measure was requested but not yet imposed, and the government clarified the scope by adding a finality requirement.
Editorial remarks on article I, subsection A were incorporated into the bill.

31832.s: The bill amends the definitions of direct and indirect discrimination in the General Equal Treatment Act, the Civil Code Book 7, and three related equal-treatment statutes so that they follow the terminology of EU equal-treatment directives. It makes no change to the substantive scope of protection or to any executive powers.
31832.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as bringing national definitions in line with EU directive terminology, as requested by the European Commission and the Council of State.
q: In the cabinet's view, the current wording of the definitions in these laws already substantively complies with the framework directive and other European directives.
Naar de mening van het kabinet is de huidige tekst van de begripsomschrijvingen in de genoemde wetten materieel reeds in overeenstemming met de kaderrichtlijn en andere Europese richtlijnen

parties: Asks whether the alternative definitions give a higher protection level than the directives and whether they extend the directive's scope; reserves its position on a future principled debate.
To what extent does the proposed definition of direct and indirect distinction offer a higher level of protection than the directives prescribe?
In hoeverre biedt de voorgestelde definitie van «direct» onderscheid en «indirect» onderscheid een hoger beschermingsniveau dan de richtlijnen voorschrijven?
Asks whether replacing 'onderscheid' with 'discriminatie' is necessary and whether the bill suffices to avoid infringement proceedings, citing legal protection for victims.

Furthermore, the PvdA members ask whether the government shares the Council of State's view that for legal protection within the EU it is of great importance that victims of discrimination can rely on clear prohibitions.

Voorts vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie of de regering de mening van de Raad van State deelt dat het voor het bieden van rechtsbescherming binnen de EU het van groot belang is dat, als slachtoffers willen opkomen tegen discriminatie, zij zich op duidelijke verbodsbepalingen moeten kunnen baseren.
Finds the proposed amendment acceptable but asks for clarification of the difference between direct and indirect discrimination.
The PVV members can well agree with the proposed amendment of the Awgb.
De leden van de PVV fractie kunnen zich prima vinden in de voorgestelde wijziging van de Awgb.
Asks whether the definitional deviations give more protection than the directive and risk renewed friction with the European Commission, noting the directive may not be extended via definitions.
The Council points out, however, that such supplementation and raising of the protection level may not extend the scope of the directive through a deviating definition provision.
De Raad wijst er echter ook op dat een dergelijke aanvulling en verhoging van het beschermingsniveau het bereik van de richtlijn niet mag uitbreiden via een afwijkende definitiebepaling.
Regrets that the bill does not amend the 'enkele feit' construction, which lets bijzondere scholen dismiss teachers for sexual orientation, and asks when such an amendment will come.
They regret that this bill does not amend the 'enkele feit' construction so as to exclude that special schools may dismiss teachers based on their sexual orientation or expressions thereof.

Zij betreuren het dat met dit wetsvoorstel de «enkele feit constructie» niet dusdanig wordt gewijzigd dat het voor bijzondere scholen is uitgesloten docenten te ontslaan op basis van hun seksuele geaardheid of uitingen daarvan.
Considers the incomplete alignment with directive terminology a shortcoming, calls for full and immediate implementation, and objects to a gradual approach.
Nevertheless, the D66 members consider it a shortcoming that the adjustment does not fully align with the directive's terminology regarding the term discrimination.
Niettemin beschouwen de leden van de D66-fractie het als een tekortkoming dat de aanpassing niet volledig aansluit bij de terminologie van de richtlijn als het gaat om de term discriminatie.
Stresses the need for a good balance between fundamental rights and asks whether the changes follow literally from the directives and whether they have material effects.
They attach importance to a good balance between the various fundamental rights at stake.
Zij hechten aan een goede balans tussen de verschillende in het geding zijnde grondrechten.
Asks whether the changes will produce material effects in practice and whether the European Commission will accept the non-identical terminology 'bijzonder treft' versus 'benadeelt'.
Is it to be expected that the European Commission will accept terminology in the law that does not fully correspond with that of the directive?
Is te verwachten dat de Europese Commissie genoegen zal nemen met terminologie in de wet die niet geheel overeenstemt met die van de richtlijn?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill aligning the definitions of direct and indirect distinction with the EU framework directive does not go far enough, since it keeps the term 'onderscheid' instead of 'discriminatie' and omits the disadvantage requirement, and urges full alignment with the directive's wording. The government's reply states that the Dutch law already materially complies, that the definitions are adjusted to bring them closer to the directive, and that full terminology alignment will be considered in the second evaluation of the Awgb while keeping the balance between fundamental rights.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the bill's definitions still do not fully match the framework directive's terminology, notably retaining 'onderscheid' and the 'bijzonder treft' wording instead of 'discriminatie' and 'bijzonder benadeeld'.
The Afdeling asks that the definitions be aligned fully with the directive's wording in Dutch and other Community languages, in a single step.

The Afdeling notes the Commission's objection to the general exception for private employment and religious communities and advises revisiting it, while the government maintains that the existing exceptions correctly implement the directive.

31841.s: The bill amends the Dutch Personal Data Protection Act to reduce administrative burdens, fix legislative drafting defects, and make other changes, including exemptions for processing criminal data by public-law cooperation bodies and by the Ombudsman and the Data Protection Authority (College), shortened response deadlines, and higher fines for unreported processing. It also adjusts rules on transfers of personal data to third countries and the reporting obligation.
31841.j: The memorandum justifies the exemptions for the Ombudsman and the Data Protection Authority by arguing they cannot fulfil their statutory tasks without authority to process the relevant data.
q: The ombudsman cannot fulfil his statutory tasks if he lacks the authority to process the data on which he must partly base his judgment.
De ombudsman kan zijn wettelijke taken niet vervullen wanneer hij niet over de bevoegdheid beschikt om de gegevens op basis waarvan hij mede zijn oordeel moet baseren kan verwerken.
p: Allows the Data Protection Authority and the Ombudsman to process sensitive personal data where necessary for a weighty public interest, subject to safeguards against disproportionate harm to privacy.
Raises the maximum fine for violations of the Act's provisions to the fourth category and extends criminal liability to violations of article 79(1).

parties: Questions whether dropping the direct-marketing objection notice in art. 41 Wbp weakens citizens' protection and conflicts with the directive, and asks for justification of new exemptions for the ombudsman and CBP.
The CBP is of the view that dropping the fourth paragraph of article 41 would conflict with the directive.
Het CBP is van mening dat er sprake is van strijdigheid met de richtlijn indien het vierde lid van artikel 41 zou vervallen.
Asks whether weakening the notice of objection in direct marketing lowers consumer protection and whether it is consistent with the directive.
The PvdA asks whether the proposed amendment of article 41 Wbp means a lower level of consumer protection.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering of met de voorgestelde aanpassing van artikel 41Wbp hier sprake van een minder hoge bescherming van de consument.
Worries about direct mail nuisance and the trade in sensitive personal data, asks for clearer notice of objection rights and stronger protection of citizens.
Reducing the regulatory burden must not lead to greater nuisance for citizens.
Vermindering van de lastendruk mag niet leiden tot een grotere overlast voor burgers.
Asks how discretion in fines is limited, the purpose of the ombudsman and CBP exemption, and safeguards for transfers to third countries.
The VVD asks how the height of the fine under article 75 Wbp is reasonably determined.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe in redelijkheid wordt bepaald hoe hoog de boete van artikel 75 Wbp zal zijn.
Argues the changes to article 41 lower the protection level for citizens and asks why reduced compliance costs are prioritised over that protection.
With the proposed amendment the level of protection for the citizen is lowered further.
Met de voorgestelde wijziging wordt het beschermingsniveau voor de burger verder naar beneden gebracht.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Dutch data protection act (Wbp) to reduce administrative burdens, raising objections on the general exemption for processing sensitive data by ombudsmen, supervisors and accountants, the health data sharing after accidents, criminal data via general administrative order, the right of objection, and fine levels. The government's nader rapport accepts most points: it drops the supervisors and accountants exemption, adds safeguards, removes the delegation, but keeps the objection-notice reduction with a cost argument, and clarifies the fine scope.
concerns: The Afdeling found the unqualified delegation to issue general administrative orders exempting criminal data processing too open-ended and advised clearer criteria in the law itself; the government dropped the delegation and inserted specific exemptions.

The Afdeling objected that the general exemption for ombudsmen, supervisors and accountants to process sensitive data lacked justification for a serious public interest and adequate safeguards; the government dropped it for supervisors and accountants and added safeguards for the ombudsmen and the Cbp.

The Afdeling objected that dropping the obligation to inform data subjects of the right to object at least yearly and in direct marketing contacts does not meet article 14 of the Directive and the cost reduction was not shown to be burdensome; the government kept the reduced obligation, citing cost reduction.
The Afdeling advised aligning the health data disclosure after accidents with the explicit consent rule of article 23; the government dropped the proposed change.
The Afdeling noted the start of the six-week objection period was unclear because of the undefined term 'gestelde termijn'; the government set a four-week period.
The Afdeling noted the fine increase concerned criminal penalties rather than the Cbp's administrative fines and that the explanatory memorandum did not match the bill; the memorandum was clarified.
The Afdeling pointed out that the duty to notify non-automated processing before the Act's entry into force was omitted; the bill was amended to include it.

31904.s: The bill amends the Gas Act and the Electricity Act 1998 to strengthen gas market functioning, improve supply security and infrastructure, prioritise renewable electricity through congestion management, and tighten network operator duties on quality, safety, investment notification and tariffs. It transfers several detailed rule-making and procedural matters to ministerial regulations, general administrative orders and the NMa's own policy rules, while routing some investment and calamity-plan decisions through ministerial approval.
31904.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that technical detail (quality, safety, calamity plan contents, investment rules) is better regulated by ministerial regulation or general administrative order, and that the new tariff power needs ministerial consent because of its effect on the methodology.
q: To prevent such an over-return situation from carrying over into a following regulatory period, the bill gives the NMa a new power.
Om te voorkomen dat een dergelijke «overrendementsituatie» doorwerkt in een volgende reguleringsperiode, wordt in het wetsvoorstel een nieuwe bevoegdheid aan de NMa toegekend.
d: safety and reliability measures for gas networks
reporting duty for incidents on gas networks
rules on notification of investment plans
policy rule on efficiency of investments
instructions on programme submissions by grid operator
setting of regulation method and tariffs for national grid tasks
rules on congestion management and priority of generation types
threshold for import capacity on cross-border networks
rules on notification of electricity network investments
p: Minister may instruct a network operator to take measures to ensure adequate or efficient gas transport after notification, enforceable by administrative coercion.
I, AD (art. 82 Gaswet) and II, AC (art. 81c-type tariff powers)
Regulator may reset tariffs to efficient cost level at the start of a regulatory period, subject to the minister's consent.
Congestion management is imposed on consumers and generators, with priority rules and proportionality test to be set by general administrative order.
Minister decides whether investments by the national grid operator in gas extraction are necessary, with a deemed release from duties if not.

parties: Asks whether implementing AMvBs will be in place and subject to a pre-consultation (voorhang) clause, and whether the bill should be split, so Parliament can scrutinise the detailed rules.
Is the government willing to commit that the AMvBs will be provided with a pre-consultation provision?
Is de regering bereid toe te zeggen dat de AMvB’s voorzien worden van een voorhangbepaling?
Questions the independence of the balancing regime design, since GTS develops it while being an interested party, and asks for independent review of its conformity with EU rules.
Can the government indicate whether GTS's final report will also be adequately tested by an independent party against the five preconditions set by the minister?

Kan de regering aangeven of de eindrapportage van GTS, naast de minister van Economische Zaken, ook door een onafhankelijke partij (adequaat) zal worden getoetst op de vijf door de minister gestelde randvoorwaarden?
Wants the NMa to be sharper on gas price formation and asks what framework the NMa uses and whether the wider market monitoring is sufficient.
Does the government agree with the SP's conclusion that in this new phase of liberalisation the NMa should be extra sharp on price formation, at least in the coming years?

Is de regering het eens met de conclusie van de leden van de SP-fractie dat in deze nieuwe fase van de liberalisering de NMa extra scherp zou moeten zijn op de prijsvorming, in ieder geval de komende jaren?

Flags a conflict of interest in having GTS, which is also the grid operator, design and run the balancing regime, and asks how the regime will avoid favouring the grid operator's own balancing obligations.
Does the government share the VVD's view that this creates a conflict of interest with the grid operator's balancing responsibility?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de VVD-fractie dat dit een «conflict of interest» oplevert met de balansverantwoordelijkheid van de netbeheerder?
Supports congestion management giving priority to sustainable energy and asks several technical questions.
These members are strongly in favour of congestion management giving priority to sustainable energy.
Deze leden zijn groot voorstander van congestiemanagement waarbij voorrang wordt gegeven aan duurzame energie.
Asks about gas quality conversion, the socialisation of costs in transport tariffs, and the clarity of the rules for new entrants.
Does the bill provide sufficient clarity on the various aspects of gas quality to remove competitive advantages?
Biedt het wetsvoorstel voldoende duidelijkheid over de verschillende aspecten van gaskwaliteit, om concurrentievoordelen weg te nemen?
Welcomes the statutory priority for sustainably generated power in congestion and asks questions about its implementation.
They welcome that priority for sustainably produced power in case of congestion is finally laid down in law.
Zij waarderen het positief dat voorrang voor duurzaam geproduceerde stroom in het geval van congestie eindelijk bij wet vastgelegd wordt.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on the draft bill amending the Gas Act and Electricity Act 1998 to strengthen the gas market and security of supply, mainly raising European law concerns (missing systematic EU framework, state aid on gas investment guarantees, monopoly on small gas connections, hybrid renewable priority definition, and delegation of congestion management rules to a ministerial regulation). The minister's reply largely accepted the remarks: added a European section, clarified state aid and balancing regime, motivated the connection monopoly, adopted the broader renewable definition and moved key congestion rules to an AMvB.
concerns: Advice to add a systematic assessment of the European aspects of the bill, which the government added as a new section 1.3.
Question whether investment guarantees in the gas hub constitute state aid under Article 87 EC; the explanatory memorandum was expanded accordingly.

Need for a well-reasoned justification for turning small gas connections into a network operator monopoly, and for considering alternatives such as tariff regulation; the government gave a fuller motivation but kept the monopoly.
Hybrid renewable installations should not be excluded from priority in congestion management merely for technical reasons; the definition is aligned with Directive 2001/77/EC.
Key congestion management rules should be laid down in an algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than a ministerial regulation; the government adopted this and broadened the delegation.
Unclear expectations about how the new balancing regime will work; the explanatory memorandum now gives a forward-looking outline and the basis for expectations.
Separation of the investment cost rules for national versus regional projects and of the roles of NMa, minister and network operators needed clarification; the explanatory memorandum was expanded.

31931.s: The bill designates the Stichting Raad voor Accreditatie as the Netherlands' national accreditation body under EU Regulation 765/2008 and makes its board the administrative organ carrying out those tasks. It requires ministerial approval for board appointments and statute changes, sets accreditation decision timelines, allows the RvA to set fees, applies the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen oversight rules, and channels appeals to the College van beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.
31931.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial approval and oversight powers by the EU requirement that member states supervise their national accreditation body and take corrective measures where needed.
q: To ensure that the national accreditation body complies with the requirements and obligations of the regulation, a member state must supervise it and, where necessary, take appropriate corrective measures within a reasonable period.

Om ervoor te zorgen dat de nationale accreditatie-instantie aan de eisen en verplichtingen uit de verordening voldoet, moet een lidstaat toezicht houden op de nationale accreditatie-instantie en zo nodig binnen een redelijke termijn passende corrigerende maatregelen nemen.
d: approval of board appointments and statute changes of the RvA
setting fees for accreditation and information services
p: The minister may refuse approval of board appointments or statute changes where independence or proper task performance is not sufficiently guaranteed, a discretionary power over the body's governance.
Applies the budget, management and accountability rules of the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen to the RvA, strengthening rather than removing oversight.

parties: Asks how the independence of the Raad voor Accreditatie as a ZBO is guaranteed and what government can do if it fails its statutory tasks.
In what way is the independence of the Raad guaranteed?
Op welke wijze is de onafhankelijkheid van de Raad gewaarborgd?
Asks how government ensures a level playing field between the public RvA and commercial accreditors and how public funds are kept from subsidising the private part of the RvA.
These members ask how to check that money flows within the public part of the RvA will not and cannot be used to fund the private-law part of the RvA
Deze leden vragen hoe te controleren of de geldstromen binnen het publieke gedeelte van de RvA niet zullen en kunnen worden gebruikt voor de uitvoering van het privaatrechtelijke gedeelte van de RvA
Asks why the decision period is six months and whether government will reconsider it to give businesses faster certainty.
This seems rather long to the CDA members; it would be good if we could give businesses certainty faster.
Dit lijkt de leden van de CDA-fractie wat lang, het zou goed zijn als we bedrijven sneller zekerheid kunnen geven.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that designating the Raad voor Accreditatie (or one of its bodies) as national accreditation body with public-law powers, which amounts to a zelfstandig bestuursorgaan, should be done by statute rather than ministerial designation, and asked for clarification of the transition to the new legal regime and the implementation of Article 42 of Regulation 765/2008.
