The government's reply (nader rapport) states it amended the bill to designate the Stichting Raad voor Accreditatie directly in the law, added transitional provisions, clarified the explanatory memorandum, and addressed the implementation of Article 42.
concerns: Designation of the national accreditation body by ministerial decision lacks sufficient justification; the designation should be laid down in the law itself, which the government followed.
The transition to a public-law legal relationship for activities previously under private law was not addressed; transitional rules and an expanded explanation were added.
Implementation of the amendment to Article 8(3) of Directive 2001/95/EC by Article 42 of the Regulation was unclear; the explanatory memorandum now addresses it.
Editorial remark on the title, correcting the regulation reference to EG-verordening nr. 765/2008.

32039.s: The bill removes Schiedam as a secondary court location (nevenvestigingsplaats) of the Rotterdam district court by amending the annex to the Judiciary Organisation Act so that only Brielle remains listed for that court. The bill enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
32039.j: The memorandum justifies closing Schiedam by its proximity to Rotterdam, its small staff, low caseload and few sittings, following a request from the judiciary's council.
q: At the request of the Council for the Judiciary, on behalf of the court management of the Rotterdam district court, this bill aims to remove Schiedam as a secondary location of the Rotterdam district court.

Op verzoek van de Raad voor de rechtspraak, mede namens het gerechtsbestuur van de rechtbank Rotterdam, beoogt dit wetsvoorstel Schiedam als nevenvestigingsplaats van de rechtbank Rotterdam te schrappen.
d: setting the date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Closing the Schiedam court location conflicts with the goal of justice being accessible and close to people; the party asks the government not to make the closure definitive and to find a temporary alternative location.
The members speaking ask the government not to make the closure definitive and to designate a temporary alternative location.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen de regering de sluiting niet definitief te maken en een tijdelijk ander locatie aan te wijzen.
Asks what will happen to the 2.11 fte judicial officials and 10.28 fte court clerks, and whether the Rotterdam court has enough capacity for 12% more cases.
Finally they want to know whether the Rotterdam court has sufficient capacity to handle 12% more cases per year.
Tot slot willen zij weten of de rechtbank Rotterdam voldoende capaciteit heeft om 12% meer zaken per jaar te behandelen.

32048.s: The bill extends the term of municipal councils in municipalities scheduled for merger from 1 January 2011, cancelling the planned January 2010 candidacy and extending existing councillors' terms to 1 January 2011. It sets a shortened timetable for a later council election in those merged municipalities and provides that the law expires on 1 January 2015.
32048.j: The memorandum justifies the shortened election timetable as avoiding two elections within a short period, mirroring existing practice for by-elections caused by municipal mergers.
q: In the case of merger elections, the power to shorten the time limits rests with the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten).
In het geval van herindelingsverkiezingen komt de bevoegdheid tot verkorting van de termijnen toe aan gedeputeerde staten

parties: Asks whether the municipalities affected are uncertain since they are not named in the bill text, and whether elections should be held in November 2010 instead.
This makes it uncertain whether all municipalities named in the explanatory memorandum will actually face postponement of the municipal council elections.
Dat maakt dat het onzeker is of alle gemeenten die in de memorie van toelichting (blz. 3) zijn genoemd ook daadwerkelijk met uitstel van de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen te maken zullen krijgen.
Asks the government for its view and timing for submitting the merger bills, wanting quick clarity for municipalities and residents.
They attach great value to giving the municipalities concerned and their residents clarity as soon as possible about the planned merger and its consequences for municipal governance.

Zij hechten er veel waarde aan de betrokken gemeenten en hun inwoners zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid te verschaffen over de vaststelling van de beoogde herindeling en de gevolgen voor het bestuur van de gemeente.

Asks why the bill was not submitted earlier, requests the planning of forthcoming merger bills, and suggests a general regulation in the Wet algemene regels herindeling rather than naming municipalities in the bill; questions the proximity of merger dates to elections.
These members further ask why the municipalities mentioned in the explanatory memorandum are not explicitly named in the statutory text.
Deze leden vragen voorts waarom de gemeenten die in de toelichting vermeld staan, niet uitdrukkelijk in de wettekst worden genoemd.

Objects that the bill removes voters' chance to decide on a merger through elections, prioritising speed over care, and proposes holding elections and letting the new council decide, with the merger two years later.
With this bill the government puts speed of merger above care.
De regering stelt met dit wetsvoorstel snelheid van herindeling boven zorgvuldigheid.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill extending council terms for municipalities facing 1 January 2011 mergers would be better placed as a general rule in the Wet Arhi rather than a one-off bill, and asks for the explanatory memorandum to justify the choice. The government reply accepts that a general regeling in the Wet Arhi is preferable, adds the explanatory memorandum, adopts the editorial remarks and adds Maarssen to the bill.
concerns: The Raad asks why a general regeling in the Wet Arhi was not chosen over this one-off bill, and the government agrees such a general regulation is preferable and plans to provide for it.
The Raad gives several editorial remarks on the title, article 1 numbering and wording, which the government adopts.

32129.s: The bill amends several Dutch tax laws for the 2010 fiscal policy package, including the income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, dividend tax, transfer tax, vehicle tax, excise and environmental taxes. Its main changes concern rules for family business succession and holding companies, pension arrangements for directors, VAT exemptions, vehicle tax, excise on tobacco, and environmental tax reductions.
32129.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as technical necessity to handle unforeseen implementation complexities and to set detailed conditions by ministerial regulation.
q: Further rules concerning the application of this article may be set by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de toepassing van dit artikel.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel S (art. 4.21 Wet IB 2001)
valuation and reduction of conservatory assessments for cross-border share transfers
Artikel I, onderdeel S (art. 4.25, zesde lid Wet IB 2001)
acquisition price and reduction of assessments when a holder moves to the Netherlands
Artikel I, onderdeel Q / art. 4.17a, tiende lid Wet IB 2001
further rules on succession exemption and holding company attribution
Artikel I, onderdeel P (art. 4.17b, vierde lid; art. 4.17c, vierde lid Wet IB 2001)
procedure and exceptions to the two-year and three-year time limits for transfer exemptions
Artikel III, onderdeel A / art. 4 Wet LB 1964, art. 19a Wet LB 1964
rules for pension-in-own-management providers established in EU/EEA states
Artikel IV, onderdeel B (art. 13 Wet Vpb 1969)
designation of EEA states for qualifying investment participations
Artikel V, onderdeel A (art. 4 Wet DB 1965)
designation of EEA states for dividend withholding exemption
Artikel V, onderdeel B (art. 4e Wet DB 1965)
rules for omitting dividend withholding on substantial-interest shares in inheritance cases
conditions and restrictions on the electricity tax reduction
Artikel VI, onderdeel B (art. 10a Wet BPM 1992)
depreciation table for vehicles re-imported after temporary export
Artikel XII (art. 95b Wet op de accijns)
determination of average stock turnover for tobacco products during transition period
p: Artikel XII (art. 102a Wet op de accijns)

Introduces an administrative fine imposed by the inspector for selling tobacco products with outdated excise stamps, set at a fixed amount or twice the excise due, with a reference to the statutory fine rules.
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 2.17 Wet IB 2001)
Modifies residence and emigration rules affecting when taxpayers are treated as domestic taxpayers for the full year.

parties: Questions whether the large number of measures can be scrutinised carefully within the usual tight timetable and asks for alternative procedures with more safeguards.
Asks detailed technical questions on the DGA and business succession rules and on the legal basis of cross-border liability, without taking a clear position.
Can the government explain this last point further? How does this relate to domestic situations? And is this tenable under European law?
Kan de regering dit laatste nader toelichten? Hoe verhoudt dit zich tot binnenlandse situaties? En is een en ander Europeesrechtelijk houdbaar.
Asks whether the widened navordering power for obviously wrong assessments excludes arguable positions and warns against sloppiness by the tax authority affecting legal certainty.
In that sense, is the term 'reasonably recognisable error' a sufficient indication that it must be a real error?
Is in die zin de term «redelijkerwijs kenbare fout» een voldoende aanduiding dat het om een echte fout moet gaan?
Doubts the need for widened navordering, criticises the vague 'kenbaar' standard and the rebuttable-in-practice 30% presumption, arguing taxpayers cannot be expected to spot errors in one glance.
Since the legal certainty of taxpayers is already heavily undermined by the proposed amendment, according to the SP it is not appropriate to add a vague concept such as 'kenbaar' on top of that.

Aangezien de rechtszekerheid van belastingplichtigen met de voorgenomen wijziging al sterk wordt ingedamd, past het volgens de leden van de SP-fractie niet om daar bovenop nog met een vaag begrip als kenbaar te werken.
Argues the widened navordering power harms legal certainty and gives the tax authority extra powers, and that the bill's inclusion in an omnibus law undermines careful lawmaking.
The D66 members are of the view that the amendment undermines the legal certainty of taxpayers.
De leden van de fractie van D66 zijn van mening dat de wijziging de rechtszekerheid van belastingplichtigen aantast.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that several measures in the Overige fiscale maatregelen 2010 bill should be split off, particularly changes to the substantial-interest regime and the participation exemption, and raised objections on inheritance deferral, pension, dividend withholding, excise, late assessment and WOZ data disclosure. The government's reply accepted some points (splitting off the participation exemption change, dividend exemption after death, drafting fixes) and rejected others, including the objection to the inheritance deferral limitation and the pension retroactivity point.
concerns: The Raad advised splitting off changes to core elements of the tax law (substantial-interest regime and participation exemption) into separate bills; the government split the participation exemption change in part but kept the substantial-interest changes in the bill.

The Raad objected that limiting the inheritance deferral to real business assets creates a disproportionate cumulative tax burden and a forced settlement, including for pension holding companies; the government disagreed and kept the limitation.

The Raad found that removing the pre-1995 pension exemption (article 38 Wet LB 1964) amounts to retroactive tax increase without special justification; the government rejected this, arguing the exemption leads to an unjustifiable double exemption.

The Raad objected that the 30% threshold for late assessment (navordering) is unclear and that the mechanism is aimed at symptoms rather than the Belastingdienst's mass-process working; the government adjusted the explanation but kept the threshold and rejected the broader critique.
The Raad asked for explanation of the public interest in disclosing WOZ values to insurers and mortgage lenders; the memorandum was supplemented but the proposal was retained.

The Raad noted that the requirement of an information exchange treaty for dividend withholding exemption may not apply to EEA states such as Liechtenstein; the government explained the exclusion in the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad made several drafting suggestions, including on the excise and WOZ provisions, most of which the government adopted.

32165.s: The bill creates a temporary legal basis for a pilot in participating municipalities that uses wage dispensation (loondispensatie) so that people with a work disability can take up paid work below the statutory minimum wage, supplemented by an income top-up. The pilot runs until 1 January 2013, with a government evaluation to Parliament and the possibility of early termination by the minister.
32165.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to test whether wage dispensation raises labour market participation of people with work disabilities before a nationwide decision, and it notes that objections and appeals remain open against municipal decisions.
q: Applying the eligibility test at the request of the person concerned is not appropriate where re-integration activities aimed at moving into regular work are still ongoing.
Het toepassen van de toegangstoets op verzoek van betrokkene ligt niet in de rede als er bijvoorbeeld nog re-integratieactiviteiten gaande zijn gericht op uitstroom naar geheel reguliere arbeid
d: designation of participating municipalities based on criteria
municipal obligation to require cooperation in eligibility test
intervals for reassessing earnings capacity and determining wage value
calculation of municipal reimbursement for pilot costs
general implementing rules for the pilot, incl. eligibility test, wage value and reimbursement
p: Municipal authorities may set a person's wage entitlement below the statutory minimum wage based on a determined wage value, departing from the Minimum Wage Act for the pilot period.
Municipalities may compel residents to cooperate with an examination of whether they have a work disability.
Re-integration obligations are disapplied for the target group and unpaid work placements of up to three months may be required while benefits continue.
The act expires on 1 January 2013 unless a structural bill is submitted before then.

parties: Asks for explicit evaluation criteria fixed in advance, following the Raad van State advice, before any decision on national introduction.
Together with the Raad van State, the CDA members are of the opinion that the evaluation criteria must be made explicit.
Met de Raad van State zijn de leden van de CDA-fractie van oordeel dat de evaluatiecriteria moeten worden geëxpliciteerd.
Asks how the pilot's targeting, verification of earning capacity and municipal incentives are designed and how the Chamber will be informed of evaluations.

Strongly opposes paying people with disabilities below the minimum wage, fears discrimination, displacement and unclear evaluation, and asks for rights, independent wage-value assessment and clear appeal options.
This bill makes it possible to oblige people with a handicap to perform work that is paid below the statutory minimum wage.
Dit wetsvoorstel maakt het mogelijk om mensen met een handicap te verplichten tot arbeid die wordt beloond onder het wettelijk minimumloon.
Supports the goal but asks how displacement of unsubsidised workers and the mandatory participation in the eligibility test will be handled.
Asks about criteria for municipal participation, representativeness of pilot municipalities and the basis for compensation.
How does the government ensure that the participating municipalities are representative of all municipalities in the Netherlands?
Hoe waarborgt de regering dat de deelnemende gemeenten representatief zijn voor alle gemeenten in Nederland?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the pilot bill allowing wage-dispensation (loondispensatie) in selected municipalities to employ people with work disabilities below the minimum wage, but asks for a clearer goal definition, evaluation criteria, reconsideration of periodic reassessment of wage value, and more information on implementation. The government's reply accepts most points: it broadened the goal clause, aligned the evaluation article, limited the pilot to 32 municipalities and clarified the relation with other pilots, but maintains periodic reassessment as essential to the instrument.
concerns: The Raad asks that the goal in article 2 be aligned with the more specific goals in the explanatory memorandum; the government broadened the goal clause accordingly.
The evaluation provision in article 13 should better match the goal definition and evaluation criteria should be made explicit.

The Raad doubts the necessity of periodic reassessment of wage value given the administrative burden; the government keeps periodic reassessment, while adding administrative burden as an assessment criterion.

The explanatory memorandum should give more information on implementation, including municipality selection criteria, number of participants, control groups and relation to the other pilots; the government added this information.

32246.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Wervershoof, Andijk and Medemblik into a new municipality of Medemblik with effect from the date of reorganisation, following the advice of the municipalities themselves. It also adjusts related rules on elections, court districts, police areas and the safety region act, with the Staatssecretaris of Interior and Kingdom Relations as the responsible minister.
32246.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by stating that the reorganisation advice of the three municipalities is adopted unchanged, and it notes the municipalities' existing power to change their name under the Municipalities Act.
q: With this proposal, the reorganisation advice of the municipalities Wervershoof, Andijk and Medemblik is adopted unchanged.
Met dit voorstel wordt het herindelingsadvies van de gemeenten Wervershoof, Andijk en Medemblik ongewijzigd overgenomen.

parties: Asks whether the timing so soon after the previous reorganisation is justified and how the regional vision and neighbouring municipalities' plans will proceed.
Is the problem in the municipalities of Wervershoof and Andijk so large that re-merger is now needed?
Is de problematiek in de gemeenten Wervershoof en Andijk zo groot dat er nu opnieuw heringedeeld moet worden?
Objects to the rapid succession of mergers in Medemblik and questions whether the organisation should be reshaped again so soon, and asks how the province will take the lead in the wider region.
Such rapidly successive mergers are undesirable for these members.
Zo snel elkaar opvolgende herindelingen zijn voor deze leden onwenselijk.
Not convinced the merger is wanted now; questions whether it can proceed without the population's consent and whether the municipal council truly represents residents, citing a survey in Andijk.
According to these members, this raises the question of whose local democracy it is.
Dat werpt volgens deze leden de vraag op van wie de lokale democratie is.

Has no objection to the three-way merger itself but asks whether the regional-wide approach and the position of neighbouring municipalities such as Hoorn, Enkhuizen and Stede Broec are adequately addressed under the policy framework.
They note that they have essentially no questions or comments regarding the merger of these three municipalities.
Zij merken op dat zij met betrekking tot het samengaan van deze drie gemeenten eigenlijk geen vragen en opmerkingen hebben.
Argues that a careful process requires majority support among residents, that unanimous local support is necessary, and that binding referendums should be held in such cases.
In the PVV's view, binding referendums should always be held in such situations.
In de visie van de PVV dienen er in zulke situaties altijd bindende referenda te worden ingesteld.

Notes the merger meets opposition from neighbouring municipalities and that the council decision was not unanimous, asking for clarification of the reduced administrative support and of the claimed remaining room for other municipalities.
The ChristenUnie members note that the reorganisation advice was not adopted unanimously by the three municipal councils involved.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie merken op dat het herindelingsadvies door de drie betrokken gemeenteraden niet unaniem is vastgesteld.

32264.s: The bill amends the Dutch Gambling Act to establish a Gambling Authority (Kansspelautoriteit) as an independent body that takes over licensing, supervision and enforcement of gambling, moving ministerial powers to its management board. It also adds administrative fines, administrative enforcement, criminal provisions, and a duty for licence holders to prevent gambling addiction and regulate advertising.
32264.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the lack of effective and proportionate enforcement tools and the need for an independent, credible regulator to avoid conflicts of interest.
q: The existing supervisory and enforcement instruments currently contain insufficient means to act effectively and proportionately.
Het bestaande toezicht- en handhavingsinstrumentarium bevat op dit moment onvoldoende middelen om effectief en proportioneel te kunnen optreden.
d: rules on addiction prevention and advertising by licence holders
further rules under the Gambling Act
Artikel I, B, F, G, I, L etc. (art. 3, 9, 10, 14b, 16, 24, 27b, 27h)
licensing and binding decisions transferred from ministers to the management board of the Gambling Authority
Artikel I, DD (art. 33f, lid 3 and 33f lid 9)
further rules on the gambling levy; amounts adjustable by ministerial regulation
designation of supervising officials by decision of the management board and mayor
p: Licensing, supervision and enforcement powers are moved from ministers to an externally positioned authority whose management board sets its own rules and levies a charge covering its costs.
The authority and municipalities may impose administrative fines up to high amounts, including 10% of turnover, without criminal procedure safeguards.
Supervisory officials gain access to electronic equipment and networks suspected of use in gambling and may share data across agencies.

parties: Questions the three-member board without supervisory board, the minister's oversight role, and the risk of self-monitoring by the authority.
However, these members ask whether they have understood correctly that the Minister of Justice supervises the Gambling Authority.
Wel vragen deze leden of zij goed hebben begrepen dat de minister van Justitie toezicht houdt op de Kansspelautoriteit.
Asks for a supervisory board as the Council of State advised, and questions exclusion of the authority's decisions from ministerial annulment power.
The PvdA members believe the advice of the Council of State should be followed by establishing a supervisory board above the board of management of the new Gambling Authority.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn van mening dat het advies van de Raad van State opgevolgd moet worden om een raad van toezicht in te stellen boven de raad van bestuur in de nieuwe kansspelautoriteit.
Demands guarantees that the authority will not deviate from the minister's restrictive policy and that the minister will intervene in undesirable developments.
The SP members want the government's guarantee that the board's latitude will not mean the Gambling Authority can deviate from the Minister of Justice's policy as it sees fit.

De leden van de SP-fractie willen van de regering de garantie dat de ruimte van de raad van bestuur van de kansspelautoriteit niet zal betekenen dat de kansspelautoriteit naar eigen inzicht van het beleid van de minister van Justitie af kan wijken.
Asks how the authority's supervision relates to other bodies such as De Nederlandsche Bank, the Finance Ministry and external auditors, and how the annual plan is adopted.
These members would like to know how the annual plan of the Gambling Authority is adopted.
Deze leden vernemen graag op welke wijze het jaarplan van de kansspelautoriteit wordt vastgesteld.
Asks why slot machine inspection stays with Verispect rather than the authority, seeking a single supervisory structure, and asks about the basis for visitor restrictions.
Asks for clarity on how the new rules relate to existing ones, the timeline for the overall revision, and whether sanctions for minor offences are sufficiently strong.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill establishing the Kansspelautoriteit but advises clarifying its task, adding a supervisory board, dropping a redundant dwangsom power, aligning sanction regimes and the boete procedure. The government's nader rapport accepts several points (task specification, abolishing article 35, heffing wording, boete procedure, staff) but rejects the supervisory board and the single-sanction-regime advice.
concerns: The Raad advises adding a raad van toezicht for internal oversight to reduce the appearance of conflicts of interest; the government sees insufficient need given the agency's limited size and task.

The Raad finds the agency's task description too general and advises specifying the tasks as set out in the explanatory memorandum; the government adopted an explicit list but kept the 'tenzij anders bepaald' qualifier.

The Raad objects that the choice between administrative and criminal sanctions based on open versus closed context is unclear and that one regime should apply to the same offence; the government keeps dual regimes for a few provisions.

The Raad notes that the dwangsom power in article 35a is already covered by article 5:32 Awb and advises deleting it; the government keeps article 35a but limits it to provisions without bestuursdwang.
The Raad advises that the bestemmingsheffing be capped at the agency's costs in one calendar year; the government adopted this wording.

The Raad advises that the administrative fine procedure be clarified, since the maximum fine would fall under the heavy procedure of article 5:53 Awb; the government now expressly deviates from that article.
The Raad asks the explanatory memorandum to address the consequences for staff of the abolished College van toezicht; the government added this and discussed options with the secretariat.

32273.s: The bill amends the Waterschapswet so that when a new water board (waterschap) is established, its general board does not hold elections within two years and eight days of establishment, instead sharing the term end of the other water boards' next regular elections. It also adds the word 'zittende' to the general board's term provision and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
32273.j: The memorandum explains the change as desirable so that a newly established water board's board does not step down within two years for regular elections, and notes the Kiesraad's concern about doubling the term to six years twice in a row.
q: it is desirable that after establishing a water board its general board does not step down within two years in connection with the regular water board elections
het wenselijk is dat na het instellen van een waterschap het algemeen bestuur niet binnen twee jaren zal aftreden in verband met de reguliere waterschapsverkiezingen

parties: Welcomes avoiding repeated elections for voters, citing continuity, credibility toward voters and lower administrative costs.
These members consider this a good proposal because it contributes to the credibility of governance toward voters, administrative continuity and a reduction in administrative burdens.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vinden dit een goed voorstel omdat het bijdraagt aan de geloofwaardigheid van het bestuur richting de kiezer, de bestuurlijke continuïteit en een vermindering van de bestuurlijke lasten.
Asks whether the bill will take effect before the Zeeland merger on 1 January 2011 so no new elections occur in 2012.
The PvdA members ask whether the intention is for this bill to take effect before the merger date so that no elections are held again in 2012 in the new water board.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of het de bedoeling is dat dit wetsvoorstel vóór die datum van fusie in werking treedt zodat in het nieuw te vormen waterschap niet al in 2012 weer verkiezingen worden gehouden.
Welcomes the bill and hopes it yields a practical solution.
The VVD members have noted the bill with pleasure and hope it will lead to a practical solution.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met genoegen kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hopen dat dit wetsvoorstel tot een praktische oplossing zal leiden.
Asks how the election-timing rules for water board mergers align with Kieswet rules for municipal mergers, given the Kiesraad's suggestion to avoid two consecutive six-year terms.
The ChristenUnie members ask to what extent the proposed rules on election timing for water board mergers run parallel to the rules on timing for municipal reorganisations.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen in hoeverre de voorgestelde regeling voor de termijnen waarop verkiezingen moeten worden gehouden bij fusies van waterschappen, parallel loopt met regels ten aanzien van de termijnen bij gemeentelijke herindelingen.

32282.s: The bill amends the Dutch Caribbean Admission and Expulsion Act (Wet toelating en uitzetting BES) to adapt it to the new public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, replacing the former Netherlands Antilles terminology and aligning it with the Dutch Aliens Act 2000. It introduces national visas, a new framework for residence permits, transfers admission and expulsion powers to the Minister of Justice and the police and Royal Marechaussee, and adds detention, movement restriction and special judicial remedies.
32282.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need for controllable migration flows and efficient border supervision after the constitutional reform of the Caribbean islands.
q: A well-functioning border control system, rapid processing of applications and rapid execution of enforced departure, where necessary, are instruments that must keep migration flows manageable.

Een goed functionerend grenstoezichtsysteem, snelle afdoening van aanvragen en snelle uitvoering van – indien nodig – gedwongen vertrek, zijn instrumenten die ervoor moeten zorgen dat de migratiestromen beheersbaar blijven.
d: rules on instructions to diplomatic posts for visa issuance
rules on application of visa refusal grounds
procedure for visa applications and notification
extend categories of persons admitted by right
conditions on spouse of admitted person
rules on stay without residence permit up to six months
application procedure, residence permit fees and conditions
designation of categories exempt from visa requirement for residence permit
rules on restriction of movement and detention
rules on departure and expulsion, cost recovery
measures and obligations for border control and supervision
individual instructions to police and marechaussee officers
detailed rules on stop, questioning and search powers
reporting, registration and medical examination obligations for foreigners
rules implementing treaties or binding decisions of international organisations, may deviate in favour of foreigners
p: Minister may attach new conditions, shorten validity or withdraw an issued visa on several grounds, including after the fact.
Minister may place a foreigner in detention for expulsion purposes when public order or national security requires, for up to four weeks.
Minister may assign asylum applicants to a designated place and restrict their freedom of movement, including in secured locations.
Minister may declare a foreigner undesirable on broad grounds including national security and international relations, with exclusion from admission.
Officers may stop, detain for up to six hours (extendable to 48), search persons and vehicles, and enter homes without consent on reasonable suspicion of illegal stay.
Special court procedure for detention challenges with very short deadlines, no court fee and limited hearing rights, though judicial review is guaranteed.
Appeals against detention decisions are not subject to any time limit, which favours the individual, but the general rule is departed from.
Other administrative bodies must share residence-status data with the Minister or police, subject to a proportionality limit on privacy.

parties: Asks about capacity for border control and expulsion, the registers used for checks, and the practical reasons for dropping the criminal offence of illegal residence.
They ask this partly with a view to implementing Article 3 ECHR in the BES legislation.
Zij vragen dit mede met het oog op de implementatie van artikel 3 EVRM in de BES-wetgeving.
Supports a strict but humane admission policy and asks whether principles on children in detention and asylum procedures will apply on the islands.
The PvdA members have a soft spot for children.
Voor kinderen hebben de leden van de PvdA-fractie een zwak.
Asks how the reference procedure will be controlled, whether detention will be limited to cases with prospect of removal, and how legal protection against deprivation of liberty is strengthened.
Will it also apply to the public bodies that immigration detention can only be carried out where there is a prospect of removal?
Zal ook voor de openbare lichamen gelden dat vreemdelingenbewaring alleen zal kunnen worden geëffectueerd als sprake is van zicht op uitzetting?

Questions the transitional arrangement that keeps the existing regime, its compatibility with the Statute's non-discrimination rule, and the choice not to pair entry with the Rijkswet personenverkeer.
The VVD members understand that the starting point of the Rijkswet personenverkeer is that Dutch nationals should in principle be free to enter and be admitted to the different parts of the Kingdom.

De leden van de VVD-fractie begrijpen dat het uitgangspunt van de Rijkswet personenverkeer is dat de toegang en de toelating van Nederlanders tot de verschillende delen van het Koninkrijk in beginsel vrij moeten zijn.
Asks how protection and the possibility of appeal are equivalently arranged despite deviations, and how unauthorised entry outside border posts is handled.
The ChristenUnie members ask how, despite the deviations, protection and the possibility of appeal are regulated in an equivalent way.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen hoe, ondanks de afwijkingen, de bescherming en de mogelijkheid van beroepszaken op een gelijkwaardige wijze zijn geregeld.
Asks whether international treaties such as the Refugee Convention may require a less restrictive residence policy than the government intends, which bears on rights protection against the state.
To what extent can the relevant international treaties nonetheless require a less restrictive policy than the government envisages?
In hoeverre kunnen de relevante internationale verdragen echter toch nopen tot een minder restrictief beleid dan de regering voor ogen staat?

Is not reassured by the delayed Rijkswet personenverkeer and its transitional regime, and asks why the government agreed to proceed without waiting for that law, which weakens parliamentary control over the outcome.
are not at all reassured by what the memorandum states regarding the proposal for the Rijkswet personenverkeer and the duration of the transitional regime proposed in the amendment memorandum

zijn bepaald niet gerustgesteld door hetgeen in de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag wordt gesteld inzake het voorstel voor de Rijkswet personenverkeer en de duur van het bij nota van wijziging voorgestelde overgangsregime

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a government amendment introducing a transitional regime for Dutch nationals' access to and residence on Bonaire, Sint-Eustatius and Saba until the Rijkswet personenverkeer takes effect. The Raad objected that the one-year uninterrupted residence condition and the notion of residence on the public bodies are undefined and lack exceptions, and the government's reply accepted the advice, adding the transitional regime and clarifying the text.
concerns: The one-year uninterrupted residence condition for Dutch nationals is undefined as to what counts as residence on the public bodies and whether exceptions (medical, family, study) apply; the Raad advised defining it and clarifying exceptions.
Multiple redactional comments on wording, cross-references and terms such as 'ouders' and 'kinderen', which the government adopted.
The declaration on the Fourth Protocol to the ECHR and the reservation to article 12 ICCPR need adjustment to reflect changed constitutional relations, which the government accepted.
The Raad advised that the transitional regime for Dutch nationals be included in the bill until the Rijkswet personenverkeer takes effect, which the government did.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill amending the Wet toelating en uitzetting BES but advises aligning it with the pending Rijkswet personenverkeer and Rijksvisumwet, providing a transitional rule for Dutch nationals, strengthening the explanatory memorandum on migration control, and adjusting the Dutch territorial reservations under the Fourth Protocol ECHR and ICCPR. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adds a transitional regulation for Dutch nationals, supplements the explanation on border capacity and on migrants without valid residence titles, and commits to amending the reservations.
concerns: Advice to avoid a legal gap for Dutch nationals if the Rijkswet personenverkeer is not in force simultaneously, by adding a transitional regulation, which the government adopts.
Advice to adjust the territorial declaration under the Fourth Protocol ECHR and the reservation to article 12 ICCPR on freedom of movement, which the government agrees to revise.
Request to explain in the memorandum how immigration flows to the BES will be controlled, including border capacity, which the government addresses in the supplemented explanation.
Request for a clearer explanation of articles 22p to 22x and for technical and editorial corrections, which were incorporated.

32291.s: The bill gives municipalities a statutory responsibility for debt assistance, requiring the municipal council to adopt a plan and the mayor and aldermen to carry it out, with waiting-time limits and duties for applicants to disclose information and cooperate. It also sets rules on data exchange and information supply to the minister, and amends the WWB-related structure law to cover debt assistance.
32291.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as allowing technical detail on data exchange and information supply to be set later, and states that objections and appeals against municipal decisions remain available under the General Administrative Law Act.
q: A decision by the mayor and aldermen to offer or refuse debt assistance is a decision within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act.
Een beslissing van het college van B en W tot het doen van een aanbod of tot het weigeren van schuldhulpverlening is een besluit in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht.
d: conditions and rules for data exchange with agencies
information the municipality must supply to the minister
p: Applicants must volunteer information on their own initiative about facts that may affect debt assistance, widening the duties placed on citizens toward the municipal authority.
Applicants must cooperate on request and anyone may be required to show identity documents immediately, extending state inspection powers over individuals.
Public bodies must supply data to the municipality, and data exchange may be governed by general administrative order, enabling broader information sharing about persons.

parties: Asks how the municipal coordinating role can be made concrete and enforceable, and why there is no sanction for exceeding maximum waiting times.
Does the government not think this is too non-committal towards municipalities?
Denkt de regering niet dat dit te vrijblijvend is naar gemeenten toe?
Asks about appeal options if the four-week deadline is missed, and whether creditors should face an information and cooperation duty.
What are the options for applicants to object if the four-week period is not met?
Wat zijn de mogelijkheden voor hulpvragers om bezwaar te maken als de termijn van vier weken niet gehaald wordt?
Argues the bill lacks quality requirements, certification, toezicht and enforcement against malafide debt-assistance agencies, and asks for an independent inspection.
Does the government find it desirable that by not including quality requirements for debt counsellors, abuses and malafide agencies can continue in the Netherlands?
Vindt de regering het wenselijk dat met het niet opnemen van kwaliteitseisen voor schuldhulpverleners de wantoestanden en malafide schuldhulpverleningsbureaus in Nederland kunnen doorgaan?
Fears the bill is largely symbolic because municipalities underperforming cannot be sanctioned, and asks which instruments municipalities receive and whether decisions are subject to appeal.
The VVD members fear that the bill will therefore be mainly symbolic in nature.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vrezen dat het wetsvoorstel daarmee vooral symbolisch van aard zal zijn.
Asks about rights, appeal and complaint mechanisms, the absence of a complaints system, and whether Parliament will be informed of implementation problems before the four-year evaluation.
The ChristenUnie members also would like an explanation of why the bill itself does not provide for a complaints system.
Tevens ontvangen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie graag een toelichting waarom het wetsvoorstel zelf niet in een klachtensysteem voorziet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised the Dutch cabinet on the draft Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening, which makes municipalities responsible for integrated debt assistance and requires a council plan; the Council found the necessity insufficiently justified, raised concerns on the vagueness of the municipal responsibility, the plan obligation, financial consequences, and procedure, and advised partial reconsideration. The government's nader rapport accepted many drafting and clarifying points, partly followed the advice on the financial and legal-protection sections, but rejected the proposal to delete the plan content requirements in article 3(4) and the call to further justify necessity.
concerns: The Council was not convinced of the bill's necessity given existing law and unclear how the two core provisions would improve effectiveness; the government added necessity explanation but did not fundamentally change the bill.
The term 'verantwoordelijk' in article 2 was vague and inconsistent with the heading; the bill was reworded to place the council plan first and clarify the college's responsibility.

The regulatory basis for information provision in article 8(2) should be limited to an algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than including ministerial regulations; the government adopted an approach consistent with the Gemeentewet.
The Council advised deleting article 3(4) listing mandatory plan content as unnecessarily detailed; the government kept the list as essential to the intended floor in debt assistance.

The Council raised concerns about the financial consequences for municipalities, inconsistency with the Fv-wet and the interim specific grant, and inadequate prior consultation with the VNG; the government clarified the financial reasoning but did not compensate municipalities.
Legal protection was unclear for decisions on debt assistance; the memorie van toelichting was amended to state that objection and appeal under the Awb are open against college decisions.
Several redactional remarks in the annex were adopted, while others such as deleting article headings and changing the wording of article 6 were not.
The Council advised aligning the entry-into-force date with the Code's three-month period and the plan timing; the government made the whole bill enter into force simultaneously.
The Council asked for co-signature by the Minister of Binnenlandse Zaken; the government declined, arguing the bill concerns the social affairs policy field.

32360-V.s: This budget-adjustment bill (Slotwet) fixes the final 2009 budget changes for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and deviates from two articles of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for the 2009 annual report, as part of a pilot. The deviations let the ministry present reporting information per policy priority rather than per policy article.
32360-V.j: The memorandum justifies the departure from statutory reporting rules as necessary for a pilot on the structure of the departmental annual report.
q: For the purposes of the pilot, it is necessary to deviate for those years from a number of provisions of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 concerning the structure of the departmental annual report.
Ten behoeve van de pilot is het noodzakelijk voor die jaren af te wijken van een aantal bepalingen in de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 met betrekking tot de inrichting van het departementale jaarverslag.

32363.s: The bill broadens who can claim compensation from the violent crimes compensation fund and in which cases, replaces the special court petition procedure with the general administrative objection and appeal procedure, and makes the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies applicable to the fund's commission. It also adds a provision on victim-offender mediation in the Code of Criminal Procedure and amends legal aid rules for bereaved relatives.
32363.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation delegation by the need to adjust maximum amounts regularly for inflation without the heavier general administrative order procedure.
q: By making it possible to adjust the amounts by ministerial regulation, the amounts can in future be brought up to date more regularly.
door aanpassing van de bedragen bij ministeriële regeling mogelijk te maken, kunnen de bedragen in de toekomst met grotere regelmaat bij de tijd worden gebracht
d: Artikel I D.2 (amending art. 4(2) Wet schadefonds geweldsmisdrijven)
maximum compensation amounts adjusted for inflation
further rules on mediation between victim and suspect or convicted person
p: Artikel I G (art. 8 Wet schadefonds, Kaderwet applicability)

Appointment, suspension and dismissal of commission members shifts from royal decree to the minister under the Framework Act for independent administrative bodies, with the minister's supervision applying to the commission.
The fund may offset compensation against damages received and may pay advances, with the state subrogated to the claimant's rights against third parties.

parties: Supports broadening the scope of relatives and eligibility under the fund and welcomes the implementation of the Teeven motion on mediation.
These members endorse the proposal to widen the concept of relatives as well as the cases in which one can claim a payment under the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven Act.

Deze leden onderschrijven het voorstel om de reikwijdte van het begrip nabestaanden alsmede de gevallen waarin men aanspraak kan maken op een uitkering in de Wet schadefonds geweldsmisdrijven te verruimen.

Asks why review is moved to administrative law, whether late decisions trigger automatic compensation, and whether the fund has recourse against offenders; questions the adequacy of the government's response to the Council of State.
They consider the government's response to the Council of State's criticism on this point too thin.
Zij menen dat de reactie van de regering op de kritiek van de Raad van State op dit punt te mager is.
Asks for justification of administrative-law handling in light of the Council of State's call for a specialised judge, and how the fund's discretion to pay when the offender cannot pay is applied.
The CDA members note that the Council of State criticised the bill, stating that these cases should continue to be handled by a specialised judge.

De leden van de CDA-fractie merken op dat de Raad van State als kritiekpunt op het onderliggende wetsvoorstel uit dat de behandeling van dit soort zaken door een gespecialiseerde rechter zou moeten blijven plaatsvinden.
Asks why the fund pays out without recovering from offenders, how mediation differs from restorative dialogue, and what is done to raise the fund's public awareness given low take-up.
As many as 72% of the target group (people who in principle qualify for a payment) turned out not to know the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven.
Maar liefst 72% van de doelgroep (mensen die in principe in aanmerking komen voor een uitkering) bleek het Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven niet te kennen.
Asks about the legal status of civil mediation agreements in criminal proceedings and the cost of compensation payments and recovery.
These members ask what the status of the civil-law mediation agreement will be in criminal proceedings.
Deze leden vragen wat de status gaat worden van de civielrechtelijke bemiddelingsovereenkomst in het strafproces.
Asks for the motive for abolishing the special petition procedure at the Hague Court of Appeal and whether specialised judges and adequate expertise will be available.
The SGP members ask what the precise motive is for abolishing the special petition procedure at the Hague Court of Appeal and replacing it with the objection and appeal procedure under the Awb.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen wat nu het precieze motief is om de speciale verzoekschriftenprocedure bij het Gerechtshof in ‘s Gravenhage af te schaffen en in plaats daarvan te kiezen voor de bezwaar- en beroepsprocedure van de Awb.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill extending the Wet schadefonds geweldsmisdrijven but advises against replacing the civil court procedure with Awb objection and appeal, and raises concerns on subrogation, mediation rules and transitional law. The minister accepts the subrogation and mediation remarks and adds explanation, but rejects the Raad's advice on Awb alignment and transitional law.
concerns: The Raad advises reconsidering alignment with Awb objection and appeal, arguing a civil-law specialised court is better suited; the minister disagrees and keeps the Awb procedure.
Article 6(3) as drafted would conflict with subrogation; the minister adopts the Raad's suggestion to make the benefit payable on condition of repayment up to the amount received.
The explanatory memorandum on mediation should clarify that the court-taken-into-account rule concerns compensation agreements, not restorative talks, and address non-agreement.
The Raad questions the restrictive transitional rule excluding offences committed before entry into force; the minister keeps the rule for legal clarity and budget reasons.
Redactional remarks in the annex are adopted.

32372.s: The bill amends the Dutch Plant Protection Products and Biocides Act to implement EU Regulation 1107/2009 and Directive 2009/128/EC on sustainable pesticide use, moving toelating and registration procedures to the EU framework and the college. It adds duty-of-care rules, certification and advertising requirements, periodic equipment inspection, a national action plan, and expanded ministerial and administrative rule-making powers.
32372.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as a technical implementation of EU regulation and directive requirements and as necessary to keep existing policy while adapting to the new framework.
q: The starting point in drafting the bill has been to maintain existing policy unless the regulation or directive requires a different choice.
Het uitgangspunt bij het maken van het wetsvoorstel is geweest om staand beleid te handhaven, tenzij de verordening of de richtlijn een andere keuze vereisen.
d: nadere regels on afbouwplan, testing recognition, national risk measures, labelling, adjuvants
rules on non-professional use, label adaptation and conditions for authorisation
conditions for experiment exemptions and emergency authorisations, fees
rules for the public electronic register of decisions
training requirements, certificate of competence, fees and validity
distributor information duties and rules on advertising, storage, transport and sale
application methods, equipment inspection, restricted or prohibited use in specific areas
national action plan on sustainable pesticide use, revised every five years
changing the data protection period for biocides
rules on biocide authorisation for organic production
p: Removes the formal co-responsibility of three other ministers when imposing enforcement orders, concentrating enforcement power in the agriculture and environment ministers.
Artikel I, onderdeel CC and DD (art. 90, 97)
Allows the minister to impose administrative fines for a wide range of violations, with maxima set by general administrative order and up to 10 percent of turnover for companies.
Introduces broad prohibitions on use of non-approved substances and on possession of non-authorised products, with few exemptions beyond the College's own discretion.
Artikel I, onderdeel M and O (art. 37-40)
Gives the College and the minister power to grant exemptions, emergency authorisations and temporary bans, with the decisions published in the Staatscourant.

parties: Asks how the level playing field and national rules under Article 28 will be interpreted, whether national derogations are temporary, and what the 'negative list' referred to in the memorandum is, requesting clarification from government.
To what extent has a level playing field remained intact?
In hoeverre is een gelijk speelveld overeind blijven staan?

Demands safeguards on the independence and transparency of the Ctgb and its members against industry lobbying, a check on drinking-water impacts, a ban on national authorisation where Dutch conditions require it, and reporting to parliament after two to three years.
The SP members would like to hear what guarantees the government will build in for the Netherlands, how it will raise this in Europe, and how it thinks other member states will build in guarantees.

Graag horen de leden van de SP-fractie welke garanties de regering gaat inbouwen in Nederland, hoe zij dit onderwerp in Europa gaat aankaarten en hoe zij denkt dat de andere lidstaten hier garanties voor inbouwen.

Argues the Netherlands must retain power to prohibit authorisation based on Dutch water, soil and health conditions, requests monitoring of reduction targets and public involvement in the national action plan, and calls for protection zones around surface water used for drinking water to be set nationally.
Does the government agree with the PvdA members that the rules for protecting surface water used for drinking water should be set nationally?
Is de regering het met de leden van de PvdA-fractie eens dat de regels voor bescherming van oppervlaktewater dat voor drinkwater wordt gebruikt nationaal moeten worden vastgesteld?

Seeks assurance that the Netherlands will not deviate from the EU regulation, asks about substances that will be banned, costs for farmers, administrative burden and whether the act applies to non-professional users.
The VVD members want the government to make crystal clear that the Netherlands will not deviate from the EU plant protection products regulation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag van de regering klip en klaar duidelijk hebben dat Nederland niet zal afwijken van de EU-gewasbeschermingsmiddelenverordening.

Asks the government to reconsider national assessment methods that create 'national heads' beyond the zone, to keep the authorisation fee level in line with other member states, and to clarify the interpretation of Article 6(2) of the directive on certification of distributors.
The SGP members consider it important in a zonal authorisation procedure that the national assessment methods of the different member states in a zone do not diverge too far.
De leden van de SGP-fractie achten het bij een zonale toelatingsprocedure van belang dat de nationale beoordelingsmethodieken van de verschillende lidstaten in een zone niet te ver uiteenlopen.

Criticises the failure to meet the 95% reduction target, urges binding regulation rather than voluntary agreements, asks that Netherlands keep power to ban products, and calls for designation of protected areas and independent national checks on water impacts.
Does the government intend to introduce new regulation in the short term to ensure that the environmental burden on surface water is indeed reduced by at least 95%?
Is de regering voornemens om op korte termijn met nieuwe regelgeving te komen om zeker te stellen dat de milieubelasting van het oppervlaktewater inderdaad met ten minste 95% gereduceerd wordt?

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a bill implementing EU regulation 1107/2009 and directive 2009/128 on plant protection products, raising mainly implementation-technical points such as the legal basis for prepaying fees, transitional law, the standalone ban on unauthorised products, and criminal enforcement. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, partly followed some, and justified others, such as retaining dual sanctions and removing ministerial co-involvement.
concerns: The Council questioned whether requiring prepayment of fees before processing applications fits EU regulation 1107/2009, which speaks of recovering costs, and the government justified it under EU law with cost-related, non-discriminatory tariffs.
The Council advised making the standalone ban on holding unauthorised products a self-standing prohibition rather than one defined by reference to EU rules, and the government followed this.
The Council advised a transitional provision covering the other paragraphs of chapter 4, and the government extended the transitional clause to the whole Act.

The Council advised motivating the removal of criminal enforcement for some articles and of ministerial co-involvement, and the government explained these changes in the memorie van toelichting, restoring dual sanctions for the listed articles.
The Council made several redactional remarks, which the government incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

32426.s: The bill implements the Wet vereenvoudiging en flexibilisering bv-recht, amending Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code to simplify and flexibilise the private limited company (bv), including shareholder meetings, share registers, mergers, splits, and transitional rules. It also makes consequential amendments to the Civil Code, Criminal Code-related provisions, the financial supervision act, pension and works council laws, and sets commencement by royal decree.
32426.j: The memorandum justifies the commencement delegation only implicitly through the need to stage entry into force of linked bills; no explicit justification for the delegation is given.
q: This act and the Act simplifying and flexibilising bv law take effect on a date to be set by royal decree.
Deze wet en de wet vereenvoudiging en flexibilisering bv-recht treden in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: commencement of the act and parts of it by royal decree

parties: Asks whether the valuation procedures via the Ondernemingskamer and the shareholder-protection rules for non-voting shares create excessive delay and legal uncertainty, and questions the mandatory nature of the new provisions.
Through the involvement of the Ondernemingskamer – in the current bill possibly even twice in a cross-border merger – this could cause significant delay with a cost-increasing effect.

Door tussenkomst van de Ondernemingskamer – in de constellatie van het huidige wetsvoorstel bij grensoverschrijdende fusie mogelijk zelfs tweemaal – zou dit kunnen betekenen dat er grote vertraging zou kunnen optreden met een kostenverhogend effect.
Regrets the removal of the Tang/Irrgang amendment preventing directors with a financial interest from deciding on mergers or takeovers, and asks about deviations from the rules for public companies.
The members still believe that the amendment could unambiguously and objectively prevent directors/shareholders from deciding on a merger or takeover because of a financial self-interest.

De aan het woord zijnde leden blijven van mening dat met het genoemde amendement op een eenduidige en objectieve wijze voorkomen kan worden dat bestuurders/aandeelhouders vanwege een financieel eigenbelang zullen besluiten tot een fusie of overname.
Asks for clarification of the government's claims about cost savings, the economic crisis, pledge rights on certified shares and the fiscal consequences of the bill.
They read that the government states the bill on simplification and flexibilisation of bv law plays a role in combating the current economic crisis.
Zij lezen dat de regering stelt dat het wetsvoorstel vereenvoudiging en flexibilisering bv-recht (Kamerstuk 31 058 ) een rol speelt in de bestrijding van de huidige economische crisis.

Objects that the government removed an amendment adopted by the Tweede Kamer without submitting the change to the Raad van State or consulting the initiators, and asks for an overview of such cases over ten years.
These members ask why the government did not submit the removal of an amendment adopted by the Tweede Kamer to the Raad van State for advice.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering het verwijderen van een door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen amendement niet ter advisering heeft voorgelegd aan de Raad van State.

32435.s: The bill is a technical repair act (Reparatiewet SZW 2011) that corrects cross-references, outdated names and minor drafting errors across social security and employment laws under the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment. It introduces no substantive new powers, but adds a provision requiring the Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen to investigate and judge employee compliance obligations on request.
32435.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as correcting technical errors, outdated references and abolished provisions, without new delegations of power.
q: the reference in the second paragraph of article 51 of the General Old Age Act to the fourth paragraph is deleted, because the fourth paragraph has lapsed
de verwijzing in het tweede lid van artikel 51 van de Algemene Ouderdomswet naar het vierde lid wordt geschrapt, omdat het vierde lid vervallen is

parties: Asks whether the proposed amendments could affect the right to, height and duration of a benefit, without raising a check-related point.
The members of the SP faction ask whether the proposed legislative amendments could have consequences for the right to, the amount of, and the duration of a benefit.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de voorliggende wetswijzigingen gevolgen kunnen hebben voor het recht op, de hoogte van en duur van een uitkering?

32444.s: The bill modernises Dutch civil registry procedures by allowing births, deaths, marriages and registered partnerships to be reported and recorded electronically, and by replacing many document requirements with verification against the municipal personal records database. It also tightens the sham-marriage regime by requiring spouses to declare their residence status and by making verification mandatory before marriage.
32444.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and expanded registrar powers by reduced administrative burden for citizens, efficiency gains, and the need to keep sham-marriage prevention effective after the chief-of-police statement is removed.
q: From now on, submission of documents will only be required if data are missing from the GBA, in exceptional circumstances.
Voortaan zal de overlegging van stukken alleen aan de orde zijn als gegevens in de GBA ontbreken, in bijzondere omstandigheden
d: further rules on electronic civil registry systems and requirements
Boek 1 BW art. 19e lid 4 (identification of registrant)
alternative identification methods for birth registration
Boek 1 BW art. 19h lid 3 (identification of registrant, death)
alternative identification methods for death registration
Boek 1 BW art. 44 (declaration of intent to marry)
requirements for notification of intended marriage or partnership
storage of declarations on residence status for the IND
electronic certification of extracts by civil registrar
royal decree setting municipal start dates for electronic services
p: Boek 1 BW art. 18 lid 3 (civil registrar may require any documents or appear in person)
Civil registrar gains explicit power to summon parties in person and demand any documents deemed necessary.
Boek 1 BW art. 1:58 lid 2 (refusal of marriage on public-order grounds)
Civil registrar may refuse marriage on residence-status and sham-marriage grounds after mandatory verification, with appeal to court available under art. 1:27 BW.
Boek 1 BW art. 24a (correction of clerical errors)
Civil registrar may correct obvious errors ex officio without prosecutor authorisation, with notice to other municipalities.
Boek 1 BW art. 1:44 lid 1 sub j and art. 1:25 lid 4 (sham-marriage declaration)
Replaces the chief-of-police residence-status statement with a self-declaration by the parties, shifting verification burden onto citizens and the registrar.
Wet GBA art. 36a (no data from marriage documents until sham-marriage declaration)
Marriage records involving non-nationals are withheld from the population register until spouses declare the marriage is not for residence purposes.
Boek 1 BW art. 1:25 lid 4 (Den Haag registrar, foreign marriage registration)
Registrar of The Hague may require residence declarations for foreign marriages, exempted after ten years.

parties: Asks how privacy, reliability and fraud are safeguarded, and what protocols and remedies exist if citizens become victims of fraud via electronic communication.
For the VVD members it is essential that reliability is in order and citizens' privacy is safeguarded.
Voor de leden van de VVD-fractie is het essentieel dat de betrouwbaarheid in orde is en de privacy van burgers wordt gewaarborgd.

Asks whether mandatory digitisation of civil registry administration should be imposed on municipalities, questions fraud and identity-fraud levels, and raises concern about the quality of GBA data and the dependence on delayed ICT projects.
These members wonder whether the government expects electronic services to increase the number of fraud cases.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen zich echter af of de regering verwacht dat er door elektronische dienstverlening een vergroting op zal treden van het aantal fraudegevallen.

Asks how the division of responsibility between sender and recipient of official documents is guaranteed, how verification of births works electronically, and whether municipalities keep choice and what safeguards apply before electronic registration is opened.
The CDA members ask the government to explain how the division of responsibility between sender and recipient of official documents is guaranteed.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven hoe de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling tussen zender en ontvanger van officiële documenten gewaarborgd wordt.

Warns that without reliable GBA data the bill cannot be implemented, questions how fraud and misuse of sent documents are prevented, and supports a binding end date so that municipalities cannot drift on their own systems.
In the view of these members, without a reliable and current GBA this bill cannot be implemented.
Zonder een betrouwbare en actuele GBA kan dit wetsvoorstel in de ogen van deze leden niet worden uitgevoerd.
Endorses the starting point of the bill and has no questions.
They endorse the starting point of the bill.
Zij onderschrijven het uitgangs-punt van het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill enabling electronic civil-registry services (birth, marriage, partnership and death registration) be adapted, mainly on the optional nature of electronic services and the wording of the statutory provisions. The government's reply accepts several points, such as clarifying the optional character in the text and limiting electronic death registration to funeral undertakers, but rejects others, such as mandatory medical birth confirmation for paper applications and a fixed timetable for mandatory electronic services.
concerns: The optional nature of electronic services should be expressed more clearly in the statutory text, which the government adopted by inserting 'als deze weg is geopend'.

The Raad asks the bill to specify when and under what conditions a mandatory obligation for electronic services will apply; the government added a three-year interim review but did not set a timetable.

The Raad questions making medical birth confirmation mandatory for electronic registration, and asks whether the same requirement should apply to in-person registration; the government rejected extending it to in-person registration on regulatory-burden grounds.

The Raad asks for justification of removing the public prosecutor's involvement in correcting obvious errors in registers; the government explained the rationale and added clarification but kept the change.
The Raad questions whether restricting electronic death registration to funeral undertakers is justified; the government kept the restriction but supplemented the explanation.
The Raad proposes several drafting changes to articles 1:19e, 1:19h, 1:23b, 1:25, 1:43, 1:49a and related provisions, which the government largely adopted.

The Raad notes that removing the verification of lawful residence before marriage registration interacts with the sham-marriage rules; the government revised the text and added safeguards, including a new paragraph in article 1:58.

32453.s: The bill abolishes the specific interbestuurlijk (inter-governmental) oversight arrangements that the Minister of Social Affairs exercises over municipalities' implementation of income and work provisions under the WWB, IOAW, IOAZ, WWIK and Wsw, leaving only the directive power (aanwijzing) and a budget reduction for serious shortcomings. It also amends the Inspectie Werk en Inkomen's tasks, removing its supervisory duties over municipalities and replacing mandatory supervisory information provision with a general duty to provide information on request.
32453.j: The memorandum justifies removing specific supervision by the Oosting commission's view that general instruments suffice, reduced ministerial responsibility, and the principle of less central control over decentralised governments.
q: The bill therefore abolishes the specific supervisory provisions (article 52 IOAW/IOAZ and article 45, first and second paragraph, WWIK), while retaining the directive power and budget reduction.

Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel behelst derhalve het afschaffen van de specifieke toezichtsbepalingen (artikel 52 IOAW/IOAZ en artikel 45, eerste en tweede lid, WWIK), en het handhaven van de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid
d: rules for distribution of the municipal benefit allocation
composition and procedure of the toetsingscommissie Wet werk en bijstand
grounds, calculation and conditions for supplementary benefit grants
deadlines for applying for and deciding on supplementary grant requests
types of information municipalities must provide and collection methods
additional tasks assigned to the Inspectie Werk en Inkomen
detailed rules on data provision to the Minister and IWI
p: Artikel I, E and J (art. 72 and art. 76 WWB)
Removes the Minister's specific supervisory power over municipal legal compliance and effectiveness, leaving only a directive power for serious shortcomings, with a budget reduction as sanction.
Removes the Inspectie Werk en Inkomen's supervisory tasks over municipalities and the duty to notify parliament of policy plans on additional tasks is also narrowed.
Fixes the total budget by statute but leaves distribution rules to ministerial-level decrees, giving the Minister discretion over allocation.

parties: Asks whether generic measures and indeplaatsstelling can substitute for specific supervision of municipalities and whether results and central goals remain monitored after the IWI's tasks lapse.
Can the government indicate to what extent it is ensured that oversight is maintained of the results of municipal efforts and the centrally set goals.
Kan de regering aangeven in hoeverre wordt gewaarborgd dat zicht wordt gehouden op het resultaat van de gemeentelijke inspanningen en de centraal gestelde doelen.

Questions how often specific supervision instruments were used since 2004 and whether past aanwijzingen and financial measures could be imposed under the generic instruments, implying concern about weakened oversight of municipalities.
Could the aanwijzingen and financial measures imposed in the past also be imposed with the generic instruments?
Kunnen de in het verleden opgelegde aanwijzingen en financiële maatregelen ook met de generieke instrumenten worden opgelegd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised reconsidering the retention of the Minister's specific instruction power (aanwijzing) over municipalities under the WWB and related acts, arguing that the generic step-in power already suffices and that retention requires stronger justification. The government's nader rapport largely maintained the aanwijzing for WWB, dropped it for the WSW, and adopted the Raad's advice on article 7 and several redactional points.
concerns: The Raad doubted the necessity of retaining the specific aanwijzing power alongside the generic step-in power and asked for stronger justification; the government kept the aanwijzing for WWB but dropped it for WSW.
The Raad advised rewording article 7 WWB so responsibility for lawful execution follows from the statutory task, not as a separate formulation; the government adopted this change.
The Raad asked how free provision of information under articles 78 WWB and 42 WSUWI relates to article 119 Gemeentewet; the government clarified the information arrangements but kept the wording.
The Raad gave a list of redactional comments; most were adopted, but the citeertitel was retained.

32480.s: The bill amends Book 8 of the Dutch Civil Code to replace fixed liability limits for air carriers (per kilogram of cargo and per passenger) with amounts to be set by general administrative order (AMvB), following revisions under the Montreal Convention. It also takes effect on a date fixed by royal decree.
32480.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the accessibility, clarity and legal certainty of following the new treaty limits, which already apply directly.
q: Reference will from now on be made to a general administrative order (hereafter: amvb).
Er wordt voortaan verwezen naar een algemene maatregel van bestuur (hierna te noemen: amvb).
d: air cargo carrier liability limit amount
passenger liability limit amount for damage to baggage/other
p: Liability amounts that were fixed in statute are replaced by figures the government sets by AMvB without parliamentary involvement, though the amounts track an international treaty revision.

32534.s: The bill implements the ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006 and EU Directive 2009/13/EC into Dutch law, mainly by amending the Zeevaartbemanningswet (renamed Wet zeevarenden) and moving seafarers' employment rules into Book 7 of the Burgerlijk Wetboek. It introduces a certificate and declaration of maritime labour compliance, complaint procedures, accommodation and food standards, and exclusive jurisdiction of the Rotterdam cantonal court for maritime employment disputes.
32534.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for detailed, largely technical rules that follow directly from the ILO convention and the need to act quickly on exceptions.
q: It is proposed to lay down the requirements on accommodation, recreational facilities and food in a ministerial regulation because they are detailed, largely technical rules that follow directly from the MLC.

Voorgesteld wordt om de eisen ten aanzien van huisvesting, recreatievoorzieningen en voeding vast te leggen in een ministeriële regeling omdat het om gedetailleerde voorschriften van overwegend technische aard gaat die rechtstreeks voortkomen uit het MAV.
d: further rules on ship categories excluded from the Act
categories of persons not regarded as seafarers
accommodation, recreational facilities and food/drinking water standards
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel U (art. 48a, lid 2 and 4)
maximum spirits quantity and qualification requirements for cook
surveys, certificate validity and model certificates for maritime labour
designation and recognition of legal persons to carry out surveys
handling of complaints by Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel L (art. 40, lid 2) and onderdeel P (art. 44)
medical fitness requirements and model/validity of medical certificates
categories of seafarers excluded from the employment-contract rules
p: Captain must follow orders from the ship operator, subject to legal obligations, and seek orders before financial measures.
Captain is given disciplinary authority over all persons aboard and may take measures reasonably necessary to enforce it.

Ships must carry valid maritime labour certificates and declarations; captain must record refusals of shore leave and give written confirmation within twelve hours.','directions':[],'mechanisms':[],'constraints':[],'severity':'routine','towards':'checks','description_en':'Adds enforcement and certification obligations that strengthen inspection of ship operators.'}, {

parties: Asks whether a ministerial regulation rather than an AMvB is the right instrument to designate categories of persons, and whether the government will close a legal gap for fishing crew partnerships and explicit shore medical access.
Does the government believe a ministerial regulation is the right instrument for designating categories of persons, rather than for example an General Administrative Order (AMvB)?
Is de regering van mening dat een ministeriele regeling het juiste instrument is voor aanwijzing van categorieën van personen (in plaats van bijvoorbeeld een Algemene maatregel van Bestuur?)

Asks about the guaranteed quality of housing, food and facilities, clarity on who counts as a seafarer, social security for Dutch nationals sailing under non-participating flags, and administrative burdens.
Can the government indicate whether the quality of housing, food and other facilities is now sufficiently guaranteed?
Kan het regering aangeven of de kwaliteit van de huisvesting, voeding en overige voorzieningen nu voldoende wordt gegarandeerd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill implementing the 2006 Maritime Labour Convention, mainly raising points on the EU directive, the choice of implementing in existing legislation rather than one new act, medical care for sick seafarers, the definition of seafarer, and the inclusion of accommodation rules in a ministerial regulation.
