The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most remarks, including EU-directive transposition, justification of implementation structure and definitions, but rejects the request to add an explicit port-medical-consultation provision for sick seafarers and the request for a separate seafarer definition in the Civil Code.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to show that the bill also implements the EU directive and to state when the implementation deadline runs; the government added this in the memorandum.
The Afdeling asked for justification of choosing to implement in existing legislation rather than a single new act, which the government added to the memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for a fuller overview of planned changes to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations; the government included an overview in chapter 9 but did not reproduce information on Dutch compliance from the accompanying bill.

The Afdeling asked that the bill expressly provide that sick seafarers may consult a doctor or dentist in port as required by MAV Norm 4.1; the government rejected this, saying the right falls under treatment of sick seafarers and for healthy seafarers applies through the employer's duty of good employership.

The Afdeling asked for a separate definition of seafarer in the Civil Code or a reference to the Wet zeevarenden; the government rejected this, arguing the definition of the seafarers' employment contract already makes clear who is a seafarer.

The Afdeling accepted delegation of accommodation rules to a ministerial regulation but asked for a basis in an AMvB for the detailed rules; the government kept the delegation to ministerial level with a verdragsconformiteit requirement.
Multiple minor drafting remarks on article references, punctuation and cross-references were incorporated into the bill and memorandum.

32543.s: The bill establishes the CAK (Centrum voor Administratie en Kwaliteit, formerly a private BV) as a public-law independent administrative body with its own budget, governance and accountability to the minister, and assigns it tasks under the AWBZ, Wmo, Zvw and Wtcg. It also amends the supervisory roles of the NZa, the minister and the CVZ over the CAK and transfers existing rights and obligations from the BV to the new body.
32543.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and budget powers by the need for transparency and ministerial control over CAK management costs, and by the need for good service to clients, since the BV had grown in public tasks without adequate steering by the minister.
q: As a result, the undesirable situation has arisen that the minister, and therefore also parliament, has relatively little control over the implementation of essential public tasks.
Hierdoor is de ongewenste situatie ontstaan dat de minister en daarmee ook het parlement relatief weinig zeggenschap heeft over de uitvoering van wezenlijke publieke taken
d: content and format of work programme, budget, annual report, audit and budget conditions
minister may issue binding instructions to insurers and providers on data provision and impose penalty orders
minister may change the budget amount for management costs
minister may issue instructions on data provision and impose penalty orders on insurers and providers
CAK adopts its own governance regulation (bestuursreglement)
p: The minister sets the annual CAK budget, may alter the management-cost amount, and CAK variations up to five percent need no ministerial approval, shifting budget control toward the executive while parliament's involvement is limited to the regular budget process.
The minister is excluded from issuing policy rules that the CVZ is competent to issue, removing one ministerial steering instrument in that domain."
The NZa's supervisory powers are extended to direct binding instructions and penalty orders at the CAK, strengthening oversight of the body.

parties: Raises complaints about late income assessment, unanswered objections and poor information on the new co-payment, asking how the government will improve client protection.
In the complaints procedure initiated, the CAK did not respond substantively to the points raised in the objection letter.
In de ingezette klachtenprocedure reageerde het CAK niet inhoudelijk op de aanmerkingen opgenomen in het bezwaarschrift.
Welcomes public steering and accountability but asks about staff terms, budget transition costs, and whether the Algemene Rekenkamer has audit powers over the new zbo.

These members also ask why the management costs of the CAK's task of paying care providers on behalf of health insurers or the College voor zorgverzekeringen are also part of the budget the minister provides.

Deze leden vragen tevens waarom de beheerskosten van de taak van het CAK om namens de zorgverzekeraars of het College voor zorgverzekeringen zorgaanbieders te betalen ook deel uitmaken van het door de minister te verstrekken budget.

Supports conversion so the minister gains more control via instruction powers, while asking why a baten-lasten agency under direct ministerial responsibility was not chosen and how improvement points will be secured.
These members favour converting the CAK into a public-law zbo so that the minister, with instruction powers, gains more grip on the growing number of public tasks of the CAK.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van omvorming van het CAK tot publiekrechtelijk zbo, zodat de minister met aanwijzingsbevoegdheid meer greep krijgt op het toegenomen aantal publieke taken van het CAK.
Welcomes the step toward public control but argues citizens are rights-holders rather than clients and asks whether an agency under the ministry would be more democratic and efficient.
The people who deal with the CAK are not customers who voluntarily buy a product, but citizens who have a special relationship of rights and duties with the government above them.

De mensen die te maken krijgen met het CAK zijn geen klanten die vrijwillig een product afnemen, maar burgers die een speciale verhouding van rechten en plichten hebben met de boven hen gestelde overheid.
Insists the Chamber must be fully and correctly informed to carry out its legislative and oversight role, and asks about the budget, transition costs and the minister's cost-setting criteria.
The members of the D66 group believe the Chamber must always be correctly and fully informed so that it can properly carry out its legislative and supervisory duties.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat de Kamer altijd juist en volledig geïnformeerd moet zijn, teneinde haar medewetgevende en controlerende taak goed te kunnen uitvoeren.

32705.s: The bill amends the Dutch Act on European Works Councils to implement Directive 2009/38/EC, redefining information and consultation to cover transnational matters, adjusting composition, procedures and transitional rules. It makes no notable shift of power toward the executive and leaves enforcement under private law unchanged.
32705.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as necessary to implement Directive 2009/38/EC, without new executive powers.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and enacted
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

parties: Asks whether the European social partners' compromise is preserved in national implementation and stresses that no national additions should be made to the directive.
Can the government indicate how the compromise reached by the European social partners is maintained in the implementation into Dutch legislation?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe het door de Europese sociale partners bereikte compromis in stand blijft bij de implementatie in de Nederlandse wetgeving?

Welcomes the revision as strengthening works councils and asks about the status of the earlier motion-Hamer aimed at strengthening works councils and about defining the training obligations more precisely.
They believe the revision of the EWC directive as now proposed would be advantageous for the position of the works councils concerned and welcome this.
Zij menen dat de herziening van de EOR-richtlijn zoals nu voorgesteld, voordelig zou zijn voor de positie van de ondernemingsraden waarop het voorstel betrekking heeft en juichen zulks toe.

Wants exemptions for Dutch multinationals with existing cross-border consultation, limits on EWC competence, and asks whether a statutory rule on selecting Dutch members is necessary to preserve Dutch co-determination; also asks that Stichting van de Arbeid's wording comments be considered.
They consider, together with the Stichting van de Arbeid, that the distinctiveness of Dutch co-determination must be preserved.
Zij vinden immers samen met de Stichting van de Arbeid dat de eigenheid van de Nederlandse medezeggenschap moet worden bewaard.
Prefers minimal additional rules beyond EU law, questions whether the 5 June deadline is feasible and why implementation took so long.
As is known, the CDA members aim to set as few extra rules as possible on top of European regulation.
Zoals bekend streven de leden van de CDA-fractie ernaar om zo min mogelijk extra regels te stellen, bovenop de Europese regelgeving.

Asks why a general obligation to establish an EWC is not in the law, how the adviesrecht differs from a Dutch OR, and whether concerns must respond substantively and with reasons to EWC advice; asks for names of non-compliant firms.
The SP members ask whether the minister will consider including in the law that a concern is obliged to respond substantively and with reasons to advice issued by the EWC.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de minister in overweging wil nemen om in de wet op te nemen dat een concern verplicht is om inhoudelijk en met redenen omkleed te reageren op een uitgebracht advies van de EOR.
Asks how 'rekening houden met' (taking into account) is defined and whether management must under conditions adopt works council advice, and asks whether firms under the old regime will be informed.
The members wonder how the government defines the concept of 'taking into account'.
De leden vragen zich af hoe de regering het begrip «rekening houden met» definieert?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill implementing Directive 2009/38/EC on European works councils but advises adjustments: it considers the directive a new recast rather than an amendment, recommends adding the word 'uitdrukkelijk' to Article 4(4) WEOR, clarifying the term 'lidstaat' versus 'betrokken staat', and expanding the transposition table. The government's reply declines to add 'uitdrukkelijk' for consistency with the Works Councils Act, but accepts the other points and adjusts the bill and transposition table accordingly.
concerns: The Council advises adding 'uitdrukkelijk' to Article 4(4) WEOR to avoid divergent interpretation of confidentiality across member states; the government declines, arguing explicitness already follows from the requirement that secrecy be imposed.
The Council advises using 'lidstaat' only for EU member states and 'betrokken staat' where EEA countries are included, and amending Article 1(a) WEOR accordingly; the government adopted this.
The Council advises a transposition table that includes all directive provisions, including already implemented ones, with explanation of choices; the government revised the table as advised.

The Council notes the directive is a new recast rather than an amended directive as the explanatory memorandum states, requiring review of WEOR provisions; the government accepted this and added procedural definitions to Article 1(g) and (h) WEOR.

32723.s: The bill raises the age at which bailiffs (gerechtsdeurwaarders) are automatically dismissed by law from 65 to 70 years, making the change permanent for all bailiffs. It also clarifies that the transitional arrangement under article 92 only deviates from the now-amended article 52(1).
32723.j: The memorandum justifies the change by a felt need within the profession to keep working past 65 and by government policy to remove barriers to working beyond age 65, aligning with other public officials' retirement ages.
q: It is proposed to amend the Bailiffs Act so that, permanently and for all bailiffs, they are dismissed by law only upon reaching the age of seventy.

Voorgesteld wordt om nu de Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet zodanig te wijzigen, dat permanent en voor alle gerechtsdeurwaarders komt te gelden dat zij eerst bij het bereiken van de leeftijd van zeventig jaar van rechtswege worden ontslagen.

32840.s: The bill amends the Dutch Criminal Code, Code of Criminal Procedure and the Caribbean Netherlands Criminal Code to broaden criminal prosecution of forced marriage, polygamy and female genital mutilation, including extraterritorial jurisdiction and higher maximum penalties. It also extends pre-trial detention and certain investigative powers to forced marriage and related coercion offences.
32840.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded detention and investigative powers by the need for more effective action against coercion, including honour-related forms, and by the aim of allowing the prosecution and judge to weigh the seriousness of each case within a higher maximum.
q: This concerns the possibility of applying pre-trial detention and the use of certain investigative powers.
Het gaat daarbij om de mogelijkheid tot toepassing van voorlopige hechtenis en de inzet van bepaalde opsporingsbevoegdheden.
p: Artikel II (Sv art. 67 lid 1 onder b)
Adds the forced marriage offence to the list of offences for which pre-trial detention may be applied, expanding prosecutorial and judicial detention powers over suspects.

parties: Asks how the bill relates to the announced tightening of the sliding scale and how enforcement and checks such as controls can be strengthened.
Will enforcement and monitoring also be tightened?
Zullen de handhaving en controle ook worden aangescherpt?
Questions whether the bill is effective enough to protect victims, the evidentiary difficulty abroad, and whether the extended jurisdiction complies with the nulla poena principle.
At the same time these members ask whether the choices made in the bill are effective enough for the necessary protection of victims.
Tegelijkertijd vragen deze leden of de keuzes die in het wetsvoorstel zijn gemaakt, effectief genoeg zijn voor de benodigde bescherming van slachtoffers.
Asks about the absence of a full picture of the scale of forced marriage and about existing police registration.
These members ask whether this may also have to do with registration, for example by the police.
Voornoemde leden vragen of een en ander wellicht tevens iets te maken heeft met de registratie bijvoorbeeld bij de politie.
Supports the bill but warns that criminal law is not a panacea, that proof is complex, and stresses prevention and information for women facing religious divorce.
Criminal law is no panacea for combating forced marriage and genital mutilation.
Het strafrecht is geen panacee voor de bestrijding van huwelijksdwang en genitale verminking.
Questions whether a generic increase in penalties and pre-trial detention for all forms of coercion is justified and sufficiently substantiated.
These members ask the government whether a generic increase in penalties for all forms of coercion is justified and whether this can be better substantiated.
Deze leden vragen de regering of nu een generieke strafverhoging voor alle vormen van dwang gerechtvaardigd is en of dit beter kan worden onderbouwd.
Supports the aim in principle but asks for evaluation of prevention measures, cross-country evidence, and a match between jurisdiction and enforcement capacity as advised by WODC.
These members support the view of the Public Prosecution Service, the Dutch judiciary association and the bar that expectations of criminal law should not be set too high.
Voornoemde leden ondersteunen de gedachte van het OM, de NVvR en de NOvA dat van het strafrecht geen al te hoge verwachtingen gekoesterd mogen worden.
Supports broader criminal law but questions the scope of pre-trial detention for all forms of coercion, the definition of coercion, and the basis for distinguishing genital mutilation by age.
These members ask how this is delimited in the law.
Voornoemde leden vragen hoe dit in de wet afgebakend wordt.
Supports strict criminal enforcement but questions the breadth of the coercion article, evidentiary requirements abroad, and the reason for the limited extraterritorial reach of the offence.
These members ask the government to clarify more precisely how far the scope of article 284 of the Criminal Code extends.
Deze leden vragen de regering om wat meer te verduidelijken hoe ver de reikwijdte van artikel 284 Wetboek van Strafrecht precies strekt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill extending Dutch jurisdiction over forced marriage, polygamy and female genital mutilation committed abroad, raising the maximum penalty for coercion and allowing pre-trial detention; it raised nulla poena, effectiveness, proportionality and consistency concerns. The government's reply defended the extension, accepted adjusting the penalty and detention provisions, and accepted amending the Caribbean Netherlands penal code.
concerns: The Afdeling doubted that extending jurisdiction over forced marriage abroad is compatible with the nulla poena principle under ECHR Article 7, and the government argued the exception in Article 7(2) applies, adding explanation to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling was not convinced the extended jurisdiction will be effective given evidentiary difficulties abroad and risks undermining its signalling effect; the government disagreed but added a fuller justification.

The Afdeling advised limiting the higher maximum penalty for coercion and pre-trial detention to forced marriage only, as other forms of coercion were not shown to need it; the government did not follow this and kept the general coercion provision.

The Afdeling questioned why the distinction between active nationality and active domicile jurisdiction in Articles 5 and 5a of the Criminal Code is maintained; the government referred to a WODC study and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The Afdeling advised amending the Criminal Code of the BES islands rather than leaving it unchanged; the government followed this advice and amended the bill.
The Afdeling made editorial corrections to the explanatory memorandum, which the government adopted.

33065.s: The bill abolishes the Raad voor werk en inkomen (RWI) and ends UWV's use of the WW re-integration budget and wage-cost subsidies, with transitional rules for existing cases. It also makes digital-only communication with UWV the default for WW and IOW beneficiaries and gives ministers and agencies delegated power to set further rules by ministerial regulation or AMvB.
33065.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as promoting an efficient labour market, a small service-oriented government, and better participation of the most vulnerable groups.
q: to abolish the Raad voor werk en inkomen as a public-law legal person with a statutory task
de Raad voor werk en inkomen op te heffen als publiekrechtelijk rechtspersoon met een wettelijke taak
d: form and geographic spread of UWV-municipal cooperation
arrangement of electronic service delivery by UWV
transitional references to earlier statutory versions
designating other legal persons to take over RWI assets
rules on winding up RWI and financial contribution from state budget
p: Derogates from Awb 2:14 so that communication with UWV is electronic only unless UWV judges circumstances oppose it, narrowing citizens' default protection of written communication from the state.
Abolishes the RWI, an advisory and supervisory body, and dismisses its members, removing an independent oversight body from the employment-insurance system.</description_en

parties: Asks government to inform the House progressively during implementation and questions whether the website and job-seeker conditions will work in practice.
Can the government indicate how it will improve the system in future so that service delivery becomes more efficient?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe zij het systeem in de toekomst goed zal verbeteren opdat de dienstverlening nog efficiënter zal worden?
Says the bill is poorly substantiated, questions the abolition of re-integration funds and subsidies, and warns digitisation and fraud risks will hurt vulnerable groups.
The PvdA members find the bill insufficiently substantiated and have several questions and comments.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden de wetswijziging ondermaats onderbouwd en heeft meerdere vragen en opmerkingen.
Asks how regional divisions will be agreed with municipalities and what happens when job-seekers fail to register sollicitation activities or are found non-compliant.
The PVV members ask whether there is now more clarity on agreements with municipalities on regional divisions best suited to inter-local implementation of municipal tasks.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of er op dit moment al meer duidelijkheid is over afspraak met de gemeenten om te komen met regio-indelingen die het beste past bij bovenlokale en gemeenschappelijke uitvoering van gemeentelijke werkzaamheden.
Recognises the heavy cuts but insists the bill be continuously tested for feasibility, given organisations' doubts about implementation.
They consider it very important that the bill is continuously tested for feasibility.
Zij vinden het wel van groot belang dat het wetsvoorstel voortdurend wordt getoetst op de uitvoerbaarheid.
Argues the government has not justified departing from the General Administrative Law Act's electronic-service rules and asks how privacy and security are guaranteed after Digi-D failures.
They are of the view that the government has put forward insufficient reasons to deviate from the General Administrative Law Act.
Zij zijn van mening dat de regering onvoldoende redenen heeft aangedragen om van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht af te wijken.
Questions the lack of an impact analysis advised by VNG and Divosa and asks why intake responsibility is not given to municipalities, plus how the Landelijke Cliëntenraad's complaints are answered.
The ChristenUnie members ask for further explanation of why the government does not want an impact analysis of the bill's consequences, as advised by VNG and Divosa.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen om een nadere toelichting waarom de regering geen impactanalyse wil laten uitvoeren naar de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel zoals VNG en Divosa dit adviseren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill's aim of restructuring UWV's WERKbedrijf services, but raises objections on exclusive digital service delivery, financing of the national digital system, WWB intake by UWV rather than municipalities, WW-to-WWB inflow risks, and the abolition of the Raad voor werk en inkomen without securing expertise. The minister's nader rapport largely accepts the points by supplementing the explanatory memorandum and narrowing the digital exception to decisions, while defending the UWV intake and the budget cut.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the national digital registration system can be ready in time and asks for justification of its reliability; the government added a development programme and pilot implementations but gave no full guarantee.

The Afdeling asks for clarity on who finances maintaining and expanding the digital data system and whether municipal investments in work squares are undone; the government answered with a budget explanation but with uncertainty on post-2012 costs.

Exclusive digital service delivery could disadvantage less digitally skilled and distant-from-labour-market groups, reducing UWV's effectiveness for them; the government added face-to-face support in the short term and attention to vulnerable groups.

The explanatory memorandum suggested automatic sanctions for refusing matched vacancies; the government clarified that sanctions require case-by-case investigation and narrowed the digital-only exception to decisions on benefits.

The Afdeling asks for reasoned justification why WWB intake should be by UWV rather than municipalities, given municipal policy freedom; the government rejected this, citing data integration and continuity of intake.

Removing re-integration budget for WW claimants risks higher inflow into WWB; the Afdeling asks the explanation to address this and how informing municipalities would reduce inflow, and the government added passages on monitoring and early referral.
The Afdeling asks that the expertise of the Raad voor werk en inkomen be secured before its abolition; the government said talks will conclude in late 2011, before the abolition.
A redactional correction to a cross-reference in article 30a of the Wet SUWI was made.

33137.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Harenkarspel, Schagen and Zijpe into a new municipality of Schagen with effect from the date of reorganisation. It sets transitional arrangements for elections, tax and utilities, and amends the court districts, police and safety region annexes accordingly.
q: With effect from the date of reorganisation, the municipalities of Harenkarspel, Schagen and Zijpe are dissolved.
Met ingang van de datum van herindeling worden de gemeenten Harenkarspel, Schagen en Zijpe opgeheven.

parties: Supports the merger and asks the government to respond quickly so Parliament can finish the bill; also asks what lessons bottom-up mergers hold for future procedures.
They therefore ask the government to act quickly in issuing the memorandum in response to the report, so that Parliament can conclude this bill swiftly.
Zij verzoeken de regering dan ook snelheid te betrachten met het uitbrengen van de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag, opdat het parlement dit wetsvoorstel spoedig tot een afronding kan brengen.
Argues public support must be decisive for municipal mergers and asks why no second referendum was held in Zijpe after the compromise between councils.
The PVV members hold that public support must always be decisive when municipalities are merged.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zijn van mening dat bij de samenvoeging van gemeenten altijd het maatschappelijk draagvlak bepalend dient te zijn.

Welcomes the consent of all three councils and the attention to liveability, but asks how the twelve commitments from the draft handreiking are being implemented to keep support, and questions restrictive contour policy for housing.
The CDA members want to know how the implementation of those twelve topics stands, with a view to maintaining solid public support.
De leden van de CDA-fractie willen graag weten hoe het met de uitvoering van die twaalf onderwerpen staat met het oog op het behoud van een stevig draagvlak.

Questions the province's role in pushing the merger after the Zijpe referendum rejected it, doubts the bottom-up principle was met, questions the claimed internal cohesion and whether the government's stated conclusions on public support are justified.
These members are therefore surprised that after the referendum and the clear verdict of Zijpe's residents, the province nonetheless pushed through a possible merger.
Het verbaast deze leden daarom dat na het referendum en de duidelijke uitspraak van de inwoners van Zijpe, de provincie een mogelijke herindeling toch heeft doorgedrukt.

33146.s: The bill amends the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs so that adult secondary general education (vavo) is funded directly from the national treasury rather than via municipalities, with a new funding title, a national allocation formula, and a transitional funding formula for 2013-2014. It also narrows other adult education to Dutch language and arithmetic and adjusts related laws on licensing, course fees, the participation budget and supervision data.
33146.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to develop the vavo funding model and to tailor funding details, with details to be set in the implementing decree and ministerial regulation.
q: For the funding of vavo a distribution model is being developed analogous to the model for vocational education.
Voor de bekostiging van het vavo wordt een verdeelmodel ontwikkeld analoog aan het model voor het beroepsonderwijs.
d: calculation method for vavo funding per institution
additional funding amounts and funding ceiling for vavo
detailed rules on implementing vavo funding and data
date by which ROCs must provide basic education courses
final attainment targets for education programmes
Artikel I, onderdeel P (artikel 7.3.3 WEB, second paragraph)
competent authority sets attainment targets where no ministerial rule exists
rules on contact hours for education
data provision differentiating vavo from other education
minister decides on institution applications to offer vavo
institutional vavo budgets for transitional years 2010-2011
Artikel IV, onderdeel C (artikel 6, eerste lid, LCW)
which publicly funded courses carry course fees
p: Artikel I, onderdeel H (artikelen 2.2a.2 tot 2.2a.4 WEB)
Vavo funding moves from municipalities to the national minister, who sets calculation rules, additional funding and ceilings largely by ministerial or general administrative order.
The minister decides on applications by institutions to be funded for vavo, assessing social need against provision by other institutions.
Artikel I, onderdeel E en onderdeel U (artikel 1.4a.1 en 7.4.11 WEB)
Licensing and examination rules are adjusted so that publicly funded vavo is exempt from separate diploma recognition and is governed by national programme and examination regulations.

parties: Asks how enrolment and budget overruns are regulated and whether municipalities act as a brake, and objects to the preferential position of ROCs excluding private providers.
How is it prevented that there is a, whether or not justified, greater (financial) call on adult education, ask these members.
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat er een, al dan niet terecht, groter (financieel) beroep op volwassenenonderwijs wordt gedaan, zo vragen voornoemde leden.
Asks why certain courses are excluded from funding and why funding is participant-independent, and seeks a full overview and justification per course.
Can the government indicate why it chooses to no longer fund a number of courses from these resources?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom zij ervoor kiest om een aantal opleidingen voortaan niet meer te bekostigen uit deze middelen?

Supports national funding of vavo but asks about possible reconsideration of funding splits, the basis for ministerial regulations, and the timing for opening the education market to private providers.
Further rules are adopted by general administrative order, the explanatory memorandum states, to place more emphasis on the outcome component in vavo.
Nadere voorschriften worden bij algemene maatregel van bestuur genomen, zo wordt vermeld in de memorie van toelichting om meer nadruk te leggen op de resultaatcomponent bij het vavo.
Warns against market forces in education and perverse incentives of output funding, asking whether legislative changes are needed to revise input-output funding.
They ask how it is prevented that this brings perverse incentives.
Zij vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat dit perverse prikkels met zich meebrengt.
Asks about overhead spending, the fit of vavo within ROCs and mbo, separation of financial flows, and budget cuts in adult education.
Finally, they ask how it is prevented that money intended for mbo students ends up in vavo education.
Ten slotte vragen zij op welke manier wordt voorkomen dat geld dat bedoeld is voor mbo-leerlingen bij vavo-onderwijs terecht komt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports a bill moving adult secondary education funding directly to the central government, but asks that the bill allow direct appeal to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division for institutional funding decisions and that the VNG's formal advisory opinion be documented. The minister's reply accepts the appeal change, explains the VNG consultation, and makes several technical amendments.
concerns: Direct appeal to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division was missing for decisions on institutions' eligibility for funding; the minister added the provision to article 10.1.
The explanatory memorandum should address whether the VNG received the draft, gave a bestuurlijk advies, and how the government responded, as required by the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen.

33182.s: The bill amends the Pensioenwet and related acts to strengthen pension fund governance by raising director expertise and fitness tests, requiring permanent supervisory boards for industry-wide funds, and allowing an independent board model with a stakeholder body holding approval rights. It also abolishes the verantwoordingsorgaan, creates deelnemers- en pensioengerechtigdenraden, and streamlines governance bodies.
33182.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of detailed fitness and conversion rules by the need to strengthen expertise and governance of pension funds, with rules to be set by general administrative order.
q: This bill contains measures aimed at strengthening expertise and internal supervision and at adequate representation of all risk bearers within the pension fund's organisation.

Dit wetsvoorstel bevat maatregelen gericht op versterking van deskundigheid en het intern toezicht en op een adequate vertegenwoordiging van alle risicodragers binnen de organisatie van het pensioenfonds.
d: nadere regels on supervisory board and fitness/integrity rules via AMvB
further rules on fitness and reliability of policy makers and offences
further rules on conversion of pension fund legal form
p: Strengthens internal supervisory boards and stakeholder bodies that check fund boards, adding approval rights over key decisions, which shifts some power away from the fund board itself.
Allows fund boards to be composed of external professional directors, expanding discretion over board composition within statutory fitness tests.

parties: Asks how the government will monitor pension fund expertise and how the one-tier board model, the belanghebbendenorgaan and the supervisory board's approval powers will work in practice.
The VVD members point out that various studies (including by De Nederlandsche Bank and the Frijns committee) show it is important to strengthen expertise.

De leden van de VVD-fractie wijzen erop dat uit diverse onderzoeken (van onder andere De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) en de commissie Frijns) blijkt dat het belangrijk is om de deskundigheid te versterken.

Says the bill limits the employer's position too much and opposes deelbelangen, arguing the supervisory board's approval rights and extra review layers could undermine solidarity and social partners' room to negotiate.
The PvdA members believe the employer's position in this proposal is restricted too much, even though pensions are part of collective bargaining between employers and employees.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn van mening dat de positie van de werkgever in het onderhavige voorstel teveel wordt ingeperkt, terwijl het pensioen een onderdeel is van de arbeidsvoorwaardenbesprekingen tussen werkgevers en werknemers.
Argues the bill is premature given criticism from the sector and that the rigid two-model structure does not allow the diversity of pension funds; wants funds to choose their own governance modules.
Moreover, the present bill pays insufficient attention to the great diversity that, in these members' view, exists among pension funds.
Bovendien is in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel onvoldoende oog voor de grote diversiteit, die in de visie van deze leden er nu eenmaal heerst.

Sceptical about professionalisation and external experts from finance, questions why the one-tier board was dropped, and asks for stronger anchoring of appointment and dismissal powers and liability in law.
They ask the government to further justify this choice.
Zij vragen de regering deze keuze nader te motiveren.
Asks who decides the governance structure, why the act should take effect before the new pension contract, and seeks a maximum pay norm and minimum code requirements for supervisory board members.
The SP members ask the government who will determine which governance structure is chosen for a pension fund.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering wie er gaat bepalen welke bestuursstructuur er wordt gekozen voor een pensioenfonds.

Worries that paritair boards have a conflict of interest in drafting and reviewing pension schemes ('the butcher checking his own meat') and asks about independent oversight, diversity safeguards and the risk of adverse selection in oversight choices.
They are not reassured that a critical and independent review actually takes place.
Zij zijn er echter niet gerust op dat een kritische en onafhankelijke toetsing ook daadwerkelijk plaatsvindt.

Asks why the supervisory board lacks sanctioning powers such as enquiry rights, suspension and dismissal, how it can approve decisions without overlapping roles, and why the Raad van State's concerns on young people are not shared.
These members ask why powers such as enquiry rights, suspension and dismissal have not been provided for.
Deze leden vragen waarom er niet is voorzien in bevoegdheden zoals het enquêterecht, schorsing en ontslag.
Asks how the governance models are chosen, which tasks and powers are regulated by law versus left to statutes, and whether further AMvB regulation is planned.

The VVD members ask whether the government intends to submit to the House an Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur with rules on the composition of an inverted mixed board and on the division of tasks and organisation of this board, or of the independent chair.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering voornemens is om een Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur over nadere regels bij de samenstelling van een omgekeerd gemengd bestuur en over de taakverdeling en de organisatie van dit bestuur, of van de onafhankelijke voorzitter aan de Kamer voor te leggen.

Supports limiting the number of governance functions but asks that the employer be represented in all bodies, that the SER be involved in drafting the AMvB, and that supervision of balancing of interests be specified more explicitly.

These members share the view of the SER and the Pensioenfederatie that supervision of a balanced weighing of interests should be limited to whether a balanced weighing took place and should not concern how it was done.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie delen de mening van de SER en de Pensioenfederatie dat het toezicht op evenwichtige belangenafweging zich moet beperken tot of er een evenwichtige belangenafweging is geweest en zich niet bezig houdt met de vraag op welke wijze dat is gebeurd.

Asks why premium maximisation should no longer lead to a deviating seat allocation, why the government did not opt for an equal one-third split, and how the bill relates to the initiative bill and future pension contracts.

The SP members ask why the (new) government did not choose, by amendment note, to meet most wishes and objections by opting for a board division in which employers, employees and pensioners each hold one third of the seats.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom de (nieuwe) regering niet ervoor heeft gekozen om bij nota van wijziging aan de meeste wensen en bezwaren tegemoet te komen door te kiezen voor een verdeling in de besturen waarbij werkgevers, werknemers en gepensioneerden ieder een derde van de zetels bezetten.
Broadly positive on the amendments but asks how the position of stakeholders is secured in the new one-tier construction and raises concern about risks of professionalisation.
The CDA members ask how the position of stakeholders is secured in this new construction.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen hoe de positie van belanghebbenden in deze nieuwe constructie is geborgd.

Worried that appointment and dismissal procedures and key safeguards are left to a code rather than law, that DNB and AFM were not consulted, and that minorities in the stakeholder body lack a right of appeal.
These members have serious question marks about the failure to lay down these important conditions in law.
Deze leden hebben grote vraagtekens bij het niet wettelijk vastleggen van deze belangrijke randvoorwaarden.

Supports the one-tier board and removal of the deviating employer seat share, but asks why employers are not involved in the accountability function and on what criteria the government will judge the need for a separate monitoring committee.
These members ask for an explanation of why participants would thereby gain a stronger position in participation, since the participants and pensioners council no longer has a participation task.

Deze leden vragen om een toelichting waarom deelnemers hierdoor een sterkere positie in de medezeggenschap zouden krijgen, aangezien er in de deelnemers- en pensioengerechtigdenraad geen sprake meer is van een medezeggenschapstaak.

Argues the cap on pensioner seats unequally restricts their board participation, that the advisory and appeal rights of the former participants council are lost, and that the initiative Koşer Kaya/Blok should take effect retroactively on 1 January 2013.
These members are of the view that adequate representation exists only when all risk-bearers are proportionally represented on the pension fund board.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat er alleen sprake is van een adequate vertegenwoordiging wanneer alle risicodragers naar evenredigheid vertegenwoordigd zijn in het pensioenfondsbestuur.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Dutch pension fund governance bill (Wet versterking bestuur pensioenfondsen), raising concerns about the vision behind the governance structure, the role of employers, the representation of pensioners in the paritair board, the independence of experts, the advisory body's approval powers and the supply of qualified board members, and advised reconsidering the bill. The minister's reply largely accepted the points on expert nomination, the supervisory board's powers and the independent board model's approval rights, while defending retaining employer seats and pensioner representation and providing justification in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The advisory division found the bill lacked a coherent vision for a durable pension fund governance structure, and the minister responded by clarifying the vision in the explanatory memorandum.

The advisory division questioned the inclusion of pensioners in the paritair board as an arbitrary extension of the arbeidsvoorwaarden logic, but the minister defended pensioner representation as residual risk-bearers and a broad societal wish.

The advisory division asked for an express statutory ground allowing the board to refuse candidates not meeting expertise requirements, and the minister amended articles 100 and 101 Pensioenwet accordingly.

The advisory division found the supervisory board's powers in the independent model subordinate to the stakeholder body and asked for rebalancing, which the minister partly followed by moving several approval rights to the supervisory board and reducing the stakeholder body's approval rights.

The advisory division doubted the independent board model's workability given approval dependence on the stakeholder body, and the minister answered that the approval powers do not hinder board effectiveness.

The advisory division flagged the risk that a visitatiecommissie instead of a supervisory board for company pension funds gives weaker oversight, and the minister justified this on practical grounds with a planned evaluation after five years.

The advisory division asked whether enough qualified pension professionals would be available to meet the expertise requirements, and the minister responded that the sector and training institutes can adapt.

33191.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2010 treaty establishing the FABEC functional airspace block and amends the Aviation Act to cover FABEC air navigation services outside the Amsterdam FIR and to allow ministers to designate air traffic service providers and set unit rates. It also lets the FABEC Council's decisions take effect without parliamentary approval.
33191.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by describing FABEC Council decisions as technical implementing decisions and the unit-rate adjustments as following existing Eurocontrol practice.
q: The decisions the FABEC Council takes in implementation of Article 22, second paragraph, are after all of a technical nature.
De beslissingen die de FABEC-Raad neemt ter uitvoering van artikel 22, tweede lid, zijn immers van technische aard.
d: designation of air traffic service providers for Amsterdam FIR area
setting local air navigation service unit rate
p: Ministers may designate air traffic service providers in deviation from the normal statutory articles, with consultation of the competent foreign authority only.
Decisions of the FABEC Council take effect without approval of the States General, though the memorandum calls them technical in nature.

parties: Asks whether the treaty allows operation by the 4 December 2012 deadline and how remaining obstacles will be removed, and whether other states adopted a similar authorisation provision explaining the status of FABEC Council implementing decisions.

The VVD members want to know what implementing measures the other contracting states have taken, for example whether they too included an authorisation provision explaining the status and scope of FABEC Council implementing decisions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag weten welke eventuele inpassingsmaatregelen de overige verdragssluitende staten hebben genomen.
Has no questions on the bill.
The PvdA members have taken note of the bill and currently have no need to ask questions.
De leden van de Pvda-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen.
Has no questions on the bill.
The PVV members have taken note of the bill and currently have no need to ask questions.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen.

Asks why FABEC Council decisions are not submitted to the States General, why no prior-submission procedure (voorhang) is used, and how far the Council's binding decision-making power and possible derogation by states reach.
Can the government explain why not? And can the government state why it does not choose a prior-submission procedure (voorhang) for Council decisions?
Kan de regering uitleggen waarom niet? En kan de regering aangeven waarom zij niet kiest voor een voorhangprocedure inzake besluiten van de Raad?

Asks for the government's response to the Council of State's objections, including the qualification of FABEC Council decisions and delegation of regulatory power to the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Defence.
Can the government indicate why that choice for delegation was made and respond to the observations of the Council of State?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom die keuze voor delegatie is gemaakt en ingaan op de opmerkingen van de Raad van State?
Welcomes the airspace block and asks for a status update on the Single European Sky projects.
These members see great advantages in this part of further European integration.
Deze leden zien grote voordelen van dit onderdeel van verdere Europese integratie.
Has no questions on the bill.
The GroenLinks members have taken note of the bill and currently have no need to ask questions.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks hebben kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen.
Has no questions on the bill.
The ChristenUnie members have taken note of the bill and currently have no need to ask questions.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the FABEC treaty bill but raises objections on the qualification of FABEC Council decisions, the relation to SES regulations, a delegation clause and implementing provisions, and advises adjustments. The government reply reports that a authorisation clause was added, the explanatory memorandum was expanded on several points, the delegation clause was dropped and the implementing-regulation point was addressed by amending the transposition table.
concerns: Decisions of the FABEC Council are not treaty-like instruments and require an authorisation clause so that Parliament is not required to approve them.
The proposed delegation to the ministers on establishing and operating the functional airspace block lacked justification and was too broad; the government dropped it.

Implementing rules under Regulation 550/2004 article 15(2)(f) were said to require an adequate implementing regime; the government changed the transposition table instead, citing uncertainty about Commission measures.

Points on military aviation scope, the transition from Eurocontrol unit rate setting, designation of air navigation service providers, dispute settlement and transitional provisions were to be clarified in the explanatory memorandum.
Editorial remarks on the citation of the EU regulation, drafting of article 5.14a(2) and the currency of the unit rate were addressed.

33236.s: The bill places De Nederlandsche Bank and the Autoriteit Financiële Markten under the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies, and amends the Wft and related financial supervision laws on provision rules, bankers' oath, takeover and disclosure rules, and technical corrections. It also grants the executive new rule-making powers over financial product remuneration and information duties via general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
33236.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for detailed, technical rules that are best set at the level of general administrative order or ministerial regulation, with the statute setting the framework.
q: The precise extent of administrative burdens and compliance costs regarding the commission-rule changes depends on further elaboration by general administrative order.

De precieze omvang van de administratieve lasten en nalevingskosten ten aanzien van de wijzigingen die verband houden met de provisieregels hangt af van nadere uitwerking bij algemene maatregel van bestuur
d: ARTIKEL I, C (art. 1:25a, tweede lid Wft)
execution and enforcement of EU competition rules on financial markets by competition authority
ARTIKEL I, J (art. 3:8, tweede lid Wft)
rules on the oath or pledge for policymakers of financial institutions
ARTIKEL I, Q (art. 4:9, zesde lid Wft)
rules on the oath or pledge for staff of financial service providers
rules on product development and distribution process, extended to pension providers
ARTIKEL I, T (art. 4:24, vijfde lid Wft)
content, form and method of knowledge and experience test and warnings
remuneration of agents and ban on specified commissions for financial products
ARTIKEL I, U (art. 4:25a, tweede lid Wft)
AFM may grant exemptions from commission rules on application
content, form and timing of pre-service information to consumers and clients
ARTIKEL I, U (art. 4:25b, vierde lid Wft)
determining which party must provide information where several providers are involved
ARTIKEL I, Y (art. 5:4, tweede lid Wft)
AFM may disapply prospectus conversion exemption for certain shares
information sharing with the Minister on supervisory matters
supervisor may grant exemptions under SEPA regulation; ministerial regulation may apply SEPA provisions later
p: New general administrative order powers set remuneration and commission rules and information duties for financial service providers, with AFM exemption power.
ARTIKEL I, S and T (art. 4:15, 4:24 Wft)
Extends product-development and distribution supervision and widens the rule-making scope for knowledge and experience tests and warnings.
ARTIKEL I, E and F (art. 1:30, 1:38, 1:41 Wft)

Removes the minister's information right and duty-of-care provisions for supervisory bodies in favour of the Framework Act, while keeping a narrowed ministerial information power for confidential supervisory data.
Limits the minister's power to request confidential supervisory information to cases needed for oversight of the law.

parties: Asks for clarification on the improvements to the service document, the choice to limit the knowledge test to complex products, and the reasons for changing the bid rules.
Why has the government limited itself to complex financial products?
Waarom heeft de regering zich alleen beperkt tot complexe financiële producten?
Supports the provision ban and knowledge test but wants them extended to more products; asks for the legal consequences of the banker's oath and for a public register of advisers.
The oath must not become a mere symbol but must carry legal consequences for the banker or the financial institution where they work.
De eed moet niet louter verworden tot een symbool, maar moet juridische consequenties krijgen voor de bankier of de financiële onderneming waar deze werkt.
Argues the provision ban does not remove information asymmetry or the link between making and selling products, and asks about sanctions for violations such as licence withdrawal.
The PVV members ask what the consequences are of a violation of the provision ban.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen wat de consequenties zijn van een overtreding van het provisverbod.
Asks what the added value of placing DNB and AFM under the Kaderwet is and what it means for supervisors' powers, and how the bid-obligation exceptions are used.
What are the consequences for the powers of the supervisors?
Wat zijn de gevolgen voor de bevoegdheden van de toezichthouders?
Asks why the scope of the provision ban is set in lower rather than higher regulation, and how competence requirements and sanctions are enforced.
For what reason is the scope of the provision ban set in lower rather than higher regulation, the SP members ask.
Om welke reden wordt de reikwijdte van het provisieverbod in lagere en niet in hogere regelgeving bepaald, zo vragen de leden van de SP-fractie.
Welcomes consumer warnings and the service document but asks how consumers are steered to independent advisers and how advice costs are made transparent.
The D66 members believe separate invoicing is the most effective method to make the distinction between advice costs and other costs clear to the consumer.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat apart factureren de meest effectieve methode is om het onderscheid tussen advies-kosten en overige kosten duidelijk te maken richting de consument.
Asks for justification of placing the Kaderwet provision in the Wft rather than several laws, and for criteria on the many sub-delegation clauses.

33240-X.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Defence and three defence service agencies, updating appropriation and expenditure figures in thousands of euros. It does not delegate rule-making power, shift powers, or contain sunset, evaluation or oversight provisions.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie

33245.s: The bill amends multiple Dutch tax laws (income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, inheritance and transfer tax, VAT, excise, environmental taxes) with mostly technical and rate changes, plus targeted exemptions such as for foster-care allowances and car-benefit reductions. It largely sets tax parameters by statute and delegates little rule-making power to the executive.
33245.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly as technical corrections, administrative burden reduction and European alignment, and the excise measuring rules as practical given no international conversion tables exist.
q: No appeal may be lodged against the announcement of an examination referred to in the first paragraph, nor against the examination itself.
Geen beroep kan worden ingesteld tegen de aankondiging van een onderzoek als bedoeld in het eerste lid, alsmede tegen het onderzoek zelve.
d: Artikel XIII (Douane- en Accijnswet BES, art. 2.1)
Artikel IX/XIII (Douane- en Accijnswet BES, art. 4.14a)
rules on measuring quantities of fuel, beer, wine and spirits
authorisation of foreign officials to attend examinations on the BES islands
Artikel XVIII (Wet uniformering loonbegrip, art. 69 ZVW)
amount of employer contribution set by ministerial regulation
p: Bars any appeal against announcement or conduct of an examination by the Minister, removing a legal remedy for taxpayers.
Allows foreign tax officials to question persons and examine records on Dutch territory under bilateral agreements, subject to ministerial conditions.
Artikel I, onderdeel I (art. 10b.1 Wet IB 2001)
Adds a sunset provision to the foster-care allowance exemption, subject to a 2017 policy evaluation.

parties: Asks for clarification of effects on private investors in property funds, foreign legal forms and the reason for the timing of the change following the 2004 ruling.
The VVD members would like clarity on the possible consequences of the bill for this legal form and other foreign legal forms.
Graag zouden de leden van de VVD-fractie duidelijkheid krijgen over de eventuele gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel voor deze rechtsvorm en andere buitenlandse rechtsvormen.
Asks why the amendments took so long, the revenue effects for 2013, and the number of diesel cars affected and revenue loss.
The PvdA members ask why these legislative amendments have taken so long, since the government indicates the adjustment relates to a Supreme Court ruling of 15 October 2004.

De leden van de fractie van de PvdA vragen waarom deze wetswijzigingen zo lang op zich hebben laten wachten, aangezien de regering aangeeft dat de aanpassing verband houdt met een arrest van de Hoge Raad van 15 oktober 2004.

Questions the claim of no budgetary effects, asks the government to reconsider restricting article 4 to legal persons, and requests an evaluation criteria for the horizon clause on pleegvergoeding, citing the Raad van State advice.
The PVV members ask whether the government considers this consequence desirable in a real estate market with problems.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of de regering deze consequentie in een vastgoedmarkt met problemen wenselijk acht.
Asks why the repair was not included in an earlier fiscal bill, the effect of timing amid the property market slump, budgetary effects and the treatment of ANBIs and foreign residents.
How does the government view the entry into force of the amendment on 1 January 2013 given the poor state of the property market?
Hoe kijkt de regering aan tegen de inwerkingtreding van de wijziging per 1 januari 2013 gezien de slechte situatie op de vastgoedmarkt?
Asks which ANBI condition for the energy tax refund was wrongly dropped and what happens with the vitality package measures.
Which condition regarding the energy tax refund for ANBIs was wrongly dropped, ask the SP members.
Welke voorwaarde met betrekking tot de teruggaaf van energiebelasting aan ANBI's was ten onrechte vervallen, zo vragen de leden van de SP-fractie.

33254.s: The bill approves, under the Invoeringswet openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba, the 2011 ministerial regulation that amends several Netherlands Antillean economic laws (trademarks, chambers of commerce, business establishment, nature conservation) for the Caribbean Netherlands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33254.j: The memorandum explains that the IBES allows ministerial regulations to amend Netherlands Antillean laws up to one year after the 2010 transition date, and that parliamentary approval must follow as required by law.
q: The IBES provides for the possibility of amending laws of Netherlands Antillean origin by ministerial regulation up to one year after the transition date of 10 October 2010.
De IBES voorziet in de mogelijkheid om bij ministeriële regeling wetten van Nederlands-Antilliaanse oorsprong te wijzigen tot een jaar na de transitiedatum van 10 oktober 2010.

33280-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget statute for the other High Councils of State and the Governors' cabinets (IIB), adjusting expenditure and revenue lines such as the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer and Nationale ombudsman. It is a supplementary budget adjustment accompanying the Spring Memorandum, with the amended schedule attached and effect from 1 June 2012.
q: The budget statute for the other High Councils of State and the Governors' cabinets for 2012 is amended
De begrotingsstaat inzake de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd

33290.s: The bill gradually raises the state pension (AOW) age from 65 to 67 by 2023 and ties later increases to rising life expectancy, with future increases set by ministerial general administrative order (AMvB). It also adjusts the Wet werk en bijstand, the income tax act, the wage tax act and occupational pension rules accordingly, and grants the government a temporary power to amend related statutes by AMvB.
33290.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to adjust pension parameters to demographic change and to meet the 1 January 2013 timetable quickly, and presents the formula-based annual adjustments as predictable and tied to life expectancy.
q: The government realises that in this context it proposes to grant itself an exceptional power.
De regering realiseert zich dat zij in dit verband voorstelt haar een uitzonderlijke bevoegdheid te verstrekken.
d: annual further increase of pensionable age based on life expectancy formula
Artikel IV, K (Art. 18a lid 11 Wet LB 1964)
annual change of occupational pension retirement age based on life expectancy
Artikel III, A (Art. 3.68 lid 4 Wet IB 2001)
annual change of tax deduction percentage for pension accrual
Artikel III, B (Art. 3.127 lid 6 and 7 Wet IB 2001)
annual change of percentage and multiplier in pension tax rules
Artikel IV, Y (Art. 18e lid 6 Wet LB 1964)
conforming changes to pension rules when AOW age changes
temporary power to amend social security and other statutes needed for AOW age increase
deviation from AOW provisions by ministerial regulation for specified articles
p: Allows the government to amend formal statutes by general administrative order, bypassing parliament, with a duty to submit a parallel bill afterwards.
Future increases of the pension age are set annually by AMvB using a fixed formula, limiting parliamentary involvement in a core statutory parameter.
Artikel IV, K (Art. 18a lid 11 Wet LB 1964)
Occupational pension retirement age changes are made by AMvB following a formula, without parliamentary vote.

parties: Asks about the timing of the Witteveen framework, transition options, and whether the government has considered flexible AOW intake, while broadly supporting a higher pension age.
Has the government considered alternatives to the proposed transitional measures?
Heeft de regering alternatieven overwogen voor de voorgestelde overgangsmaatregelen?
Criticises the bill as a heavy intervention for limited budget gain, the breach of the pension accord, the lack of justification, and inadequate transition rules affecting low-income workers.
Does the government share the PvdA members' view that this bill is a very heavy intervention relative to the 2013 yield?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de PvdA-fractie dat het onderhavige wetsvoorstel een wel erg zware ingreep is ten opzichte van de opbrengst in 2013?
Declines written input because the time for scrutiny is insufficient and will save questions for the plenary debate, criticising the rushed procedure for a bill of major impact.
because the time available to carefully study the bill, hear experts, victims and elderly organisations, and formulate questions is in these members' view wholly insufficient.

omdat de tijdspanne, die beschikbaar is voor het zorgvuldig bestuderen van het wetsvoorstel, het horen van deskundigen, gedupeerden en ouderenorganisaties en het aan de hand daarvan formuleren van vragen en opmerkingen naar de mening van deze leden volstrekt onvoldoende is.
Accepts the need for a higher and linked pension age but asks detailed questions on feasibility, flexibility, income gaps, and the role of social partners and delegated regulation.
The CDA members have further questions and remarks on four areas: feasibility, flexibility, sustainable employability, and income effects and income gaps.

De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben in aanvulling hierop nog een aantal vragen/opmerkingen bij het onderhavige wetsvoorstel, die – naast een aantal algemene punten – liggen op een viertal terreinen: de uitvoerbaarheid, de flexibiliteit, duurzame inzetbaarheid en de inkomensgevolgen en inkomensgaten.
Foregoes written input due to the extremely short timeframe and announces questions for the plenary debate.
The SP members announce they will put their questions during the plenary debate of the bill.
De leden van de SP-fractie kondigen aan hun vragen tijdens de plenaire behandeling van het wetsvoorstel te stellen.
Considers a higher AOW age unavoidable given rising life expectancy and fiscal pressure, and asks about effects on labour participation and future steps.
These members consider raising the AOW age unavoidable in view of rising life expectancy.
Deze leden menen dat verhoging van de AOW-leeftijd onvermijdbaar is met oog op de gestegen levensverwachting.
Shares the need for faster increase but asks for an overview of measures to boost older workers' participation, and how general administrative orders will protect benefit recipients from income gaps.
These members want to know whether the government is considering additional agreements with the social partners to increase labour participation of older workers.
Deze leden willen weten of de regering aanvullende afspraken met de sociale partners overweegt om de arbeidsparticipatie van oudere werknemers te vergroten.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division supports the bill to accelerate raising the AOW pension age from 2013 but objects to its implementation, transitional income effects, the loan-type advance scheme lacking a legal basis, and the reliance on social assistance, and advises revision and a legal basis or alternatives. The government's reply largely rejects the objections on implementation and income effects, but accepts the need for a statutory basis for the advance scheme and adopts a delegation power for an emergency general administrative order to align other legislation.
concerns: The advisory division objected that the advance payment scheme is in substance an interest-free loan not covered by article 4:95 Awb and asked for an adequate statutory basis; the government accepted and moved the scheme into the AOW itself.

The advisory division raised serious implementation risks from the accelerated phased increase, including the need to align many arrangements by early 2013, and suggested alternatives; the government considers the timetable feasible and rejects postponement.

The advisory division argued that people with low incomes and little time to prepare face serious bridging problems that the transitional measures do not solve, and that the loan repayment terms are unrealistic.

The advisory division questioned relying on social assistance (bijstand) as a transitional measure, given its asset test and uncertain local implementation, and asked for reconsideration; the government clarified its position but kept the reference.
The advisory division proposed a strictly conditioned delegation power for an emergency general administrative order to adapt public schemes to the new AOW age, which the government adopted.

The advisory division asked for explanation of why the deelnemingsjarenpensioen is not adjusted in the same way as the Witteveen pension age, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.

33308.s: The bill amends the Copyright Act and the Neighbouring Rights Act to strengthen creators' and performers' contractual position toward exploiters, by introducing a new chapter on exploitation contracts with a right to fair remuneration, a disproportionality claim, a non-use termination right, a ban on unreasonably onerous clauses and a complaints committee. It also lets the Minister of Education, Culture and Science set fair remuneration rates for a branch on joint request from creator and exploiter associations, and requires a pre-agreed fee for unknown future exploitation methods.
33308.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial power to set rates by the need to protect creators' weak bargaining position and cultural diversity, and says the delegation does not amount to unlawful delegation of public power to market parties.
q: The Minister of Education, Culture and Science may, after hearing an advisory body designated by general administrative order, set the level of fair remuneration for a specific branch and a given period.

Onze Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap kan, een bij algemene maatregel van bestuur aan te wijzing adviesorgaan gehoord, de hoogte van een billijke vergoeding vaststellen voor een specifieke branche en voor een bepaalde periode.
d: advisory body designation and fair remuneration rates set by minister
rules on representativeness and remuneration procedure
designation of disputes committee by Minister of Justice and Security
financing, composition, procedures and supervision of disputes committee
p: Minister may set binding fair remuneration rates for a branch, based on a joint request from associations, after consulting an advisory body.

parties: Questions whether the bill is needed given contractual freedom, and warns that vague fairness standards leave judges to decide what is 'billijk' with major legal uncertainty.
That means that customary practice in general could be labelled unfair and the judge must determine, according to his own socio-economic political convictions, what the reasonable price is.

Dat betekent dan dat de gangbare praktijk in zijn algemeenheid als onbillijk kan worden bestempeld en de rechter naar eigen inzicht en dus eigen sociaaleconomisch politieke overtuiging moet gaan bepalen wat de redelijke prijs is.
Asks why the government chose a ministerial fee-setting model with advisory involvement rather than a competition-law exemption, and how the ACM would fit.
Why was no exception to competition law chosen, as has long been included in the German copyright act?
Deze leden vragen waarom niet is gekozen voor een uitzondering op het mededingingsrecht, zoals al jaren opgenomen in de Duitse auteurswet.
Asks about the criteria for setting fair fees and why there are no compulsory tools to force agreement, and about possible misuse of fee-inclusion clauses.
These members ask which criteria apply when determining the fair remuneration.
Voornoemde leden vragen welke criteria gelden bij het bepalen van de billijke vergoeding.
Asks for clearer statutory criteria for 'ernstige onevenredigheid' and non-usus so that judges and markets are not left with too much discretion.
Is it correct that the bill leaves it entirely to the judiciary to define this concept more precisely?
Klopt het dat het wetsvoorstel het geheel aan de rechterlijke macht laat om dit begrip nader in te kaderen?
Questions whether the bill truly strengthens makers given internet-driven self-exploitation and the diversity of makers, and asks about streaming availability.
They wonder whether this truly strengthens the position of the maker and improves the functioning of this market.
Zij vragen zich af of dit echt een versterking van de positie van de maker alsmede een verbetering van de werking in deze markt realiseert.
Worries the note leaves too many questions open and gives too few guidelines, likely leading to many legal proceedings; asks for handholds.
Too few handholds are given to provide parties in the negotiations with guidelines.
Er worden te weinig handvatten gegeven teneinde partijen in de onderhandelingen richtlijnen te verschaffen.
Asks government to reduce legal uncertainty from open norms by giving courts further guidance, and to justify not doing a specific economic impact study.
Is the government willing to increase consistency and reduce legal uncertainty by offering the courts further guidance to fill in these open norms as completely and carefully as possible?

Is de regering bereid de consistentie te vergroten en de rechtsonzekerheid te verminderen door de rechter nadere handvatten te bieden waarmee deze geïntroduceerde open normen zo compleet en zorgvuldig mogelijk kunnen worden ingevuld?
Supports the author-protection aim but criticises open provisions that force courts to decide after lengthy litigation; asks why sharper wording was not chosen.
Can the government explain why sharper worded articles or at least further clarification were not chosen?
Kan de regering uitleggen waarom er niet is gekozen voor scherper geformuleerde artikelen of in ieder geval een nadere duiding?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Dutch Copyright Contract Law bill, raising major concerns about the minister's power to set fair remuneration rates, their effectiveness, EU competition and free movement law, and the third-party claims and non-usus provisions. The government's reply accepted many points, including independent advice, narrowed exceptions, clarified third-party relations and a time limit, while rejecting the power to set rates on the minister's own initiative.
concerns: The Council questioned whether the minister's power to fix fair remuneration would be effective, since joint requests from creators and exploiters are unlikely and past experience in Germany was limited.
The Council held that the rate-setting scheme could conflict with EU competition law and the free movement rules, requiring stronger safeguards and a fuller justification.
The Council found the exception for special circumstances too open-ended and the general effect of the rate unclear, and asked for these to be clarified.
The Council asked for clarification of how creators can enforce rights against third-party licensees, given uncertainty about who is liable.
The Council asked for a fuller justification of the non-usus termination standard relative to general civil code rules.
The Council made several redactional remarks, including adding a citation title and fixing cross-references, which were adopted.

33335.s: The bill entrenches the position of the Frisian language alongside Dutch in administrative and legal dealings in the province of Fryslân, giving citizens rights to use Frisian with public bodies and courts and requiring public bodies to adopt language rules and policy plans. It also establishes an Orgaan voor de Friese taal, a five-member advisory body appointed by the minister on nomination of the provincial executive, and adds Frisian oath texts to several professional statutes.
33335.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to secure equal standing for Frisian and Dutch and to create conditions for language development, citing the Welsh Language Board as a model.
q: The Frisian Language Body can, through the tasks and powers laid down in this act, contribute to placing Frisian on an equal footing with Dutch in the province of Fryslân.
Het Orgaan voor de Friese taal kan door middel van taken en bevoegdheden neergelegd in deze wet bijdragen aan een gelijkstelling van de Friese taal aan de Nederlandse taal in de provincie Fryslân.
d: language rules and policy plans for Frisian use by non-central public bodies
rules on Frisian use by central government units in Fryslân
appointment, suspension and dismissal of members of the Frisian language body by the minister
appointment and dismissal of the body's secretary and staff by the minister
p: The minister appoints, suspends and dismisses members of the advisory body on nomination of the provincial executive, giving the national minister control over the body's composition.

parties: Asks about the status of the new Orgaan voor de Friese taal and which Kaderwet adviescolleges provisions apply to it.
They wonder what the status of the Orgaan voor de Friese taal is.
Zij vragen zich af wat de status is van het Orgaan voor de Friese taal.
Asks how the Rijk will fulfil its responsibility toward Frisian and whether new bestuursafspraken between Rijk and province are desirable.
The PvdA members want to know how the government intends to fulfil its duty of care regarding the Frisian language and whether it supports the desirability of new administrative agreements.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie willen graag van de regering weten hoe die invulling wil geven aan zijn zorgplicht ten aanzien van de Friese taal en of de regering de wenselijkheid van nieuwe bestuursafspraken onderschrijft.
Asks about practical consequences of Frisian in court records and cross-border dossiers for organisations.
These members therefore ask what the consequences are of drawing up a proces-verbaal in Frisian after a court case.
Sa freegje dizze leden har ôf wat de gefolgen binne fan it opstellen fan in proses-ferbaal nei in rjochtssaak yn it Frysk.

Supports the bill but objects that deletion of the bestuursafspraken provision on advice of the Raad van State leaves no binding framework for Rijk-provincie responsibilities; asks for a statutory provincial task.

How does the government assess the concern that the absence of that statutory anchoring means no new administrative agreements will be made if the Rijk chooses to interpret its responsibilities under the BFTC differently?

Hoe beoordeelt de regering de zorg, dat het ontbreken van die wettelijke verankering ertoe leidt dat er geen nieuwe bestuursafspraken meer gemaakt worden als het Rijk zijn verantwoor-delijkheden uit de BFTC, die gedurende meer dan twintig jaren meerdere malen herbevestigd zijn, anders wenst te gaan interpreteren?
Questions the Raad voor de rechtspraak's reasoning against recording Frisian court proceedings and asks for statistics on refused Frisian-language trials.
These members ask the government to further substantiate why a notation that the text spoken during the hearing was in Frisian would be insufficient.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader te onderbouwen waarom een aantekening dat de tijdens de zitting gesproken tekst in het Fries was, onvoldoende is.
Asks why the scope is limited to administrative and legal dealings and why the bestuursafspraken article was removed.
These members ask the government to state which substantive objections led to deleting this article after all.
Deze leden vragen de regering kenbaar te maken welke inhoudelijke bezwaren ertoe hebben geleid dit artikel alsnog te schrappen.
Asks why separate language legislation is preferred over integrating provisions into existing laws, and what the new elements are.
