They therefore would like to know why, in the government's view, it is not clearer to include the relevant provisions in the various laws.
Zij vernemen daarom graag waarom naar de mening van de regering het niet overzichtelijker is om de desbetreffende bepalingen in de verschillende wetten op te nemen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Frisian Language Act, questioning need, the transfer of Awb provisions to a separate law, the status of Frisian as official language, the Frisian-language record of proceedings, administrative burdens for local bodies, the bestuursafspraken provision and the powers of the Frisian Language Body. The government's reply largely accepted the criticisms, dropping the bestuursafspraken article and the mandatory elements, while defending the core approach and adding justifications.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the need for the law, as it mainly merges existing legislation with few new elements, and asked for a justification of the problem addressed.
The Afdeling asked for justification for moving Awb general administrative law provisions on Frisian into a separate law, undermining Awb codification.
The Afdeling objected that making Frisian an official language in Fryslân gives it a special position compared with other minority languages without justification.

The Afdeling agreed with the Raad voor de Rechtspraak that abolishing the option of a Dutch record of proceedings would overburden courts and appeal bodies, and advised retaining the existing provision.
The Afdeling advised making the duty for decentralised bodies to adopt language rules and policy plans optional and limiting it to municipalities, given added administrative burdens.
The Afdeling advised deleting the statutory bestuursafspraken requirement between the Rijk and the province, as it is not necessary for intergovernmental cooperation.
The Afdeling questioned the necessity and clarity of the Frisian Language Body's power to set binding-seeming frameworks, and asked for clarification of their legal status.

33362.s: The bill amends the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg to prohibit health insurers and related entities from providing care themselves or controlling care providers, with the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit empowered to grant time-limited exemptions for securing care provision. It also requires insurers to disclose their interests in care providers, amends the Zorgverzekeringswet on reimbursement of out-of-network care, and sets a five-yearly evaluation of the prohibition.
33362.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption power by the insurer's statutory duty to secure care provision (zorgplicht), which it says may otherwise be unattainable.
q: The NZa is obliged to grant an exemption if the health insurer demonstrates that holding control is necessary to meet its duty of care provision.
De NZa is verplicht een ontheffing af te geven indien de zorgverzekeraar aannemelijk maakt dat het hebben van zeggenschap nodig is om aan zijn zorgplicht te kunnen voldoen.
d: exemptions from vertical integration prohibition granted by care authority
insurer sets reimbursement calculation and exceptions in model contract
p: The Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit may grant exemptions from the prohibition on vertical integration for securing care provision or promoting innovation, subject to a maximum duration of four years.
Enforcement powers, including penalties and public naming, are extended to entities subject to the new prohibition and to controlling persons.

parties: Asks who determines when the care system is fully developed and how exemptions and the evaluation of blocked initiatives will work.
These members would like to know who determines, and on what criteria, when the care system is fully developed.
Deze leden willen graag weten wie en op basis van welke criteria bepaalt wanneer het zorgstelsel uitontwikkeld is.
Worries that the broad concept of 'innovation' and the vague exemption criteria could let insurers circumvent the ban on vertical integration.
The PvdA members ask the minister against which criteria it is tested whether innovations in care delivery contribute to improvements in quality and efficiency.
Deze leden vragen de minister tegen welke criteria wordt getoetst of vernieuwingen in de levering van zorg bijdragen aan verbeteringen in de kwaliteit en doelmatigheid van de geleverde zorg.
Opposes growing insurer power and the four-year exemptions, arguing they effectively become permanent and cede control to private insurers.
Objects to the proposed change to Zvw article 13, arguing it undermines citizens' right to choose their own doctor and that alternatives should be explored first.
The citizen's right to choose his own doctor is put at stake by this.
Het recht van de burger om zijn eigen arts te kiezen komt hiermee in het geding.
Questions the necessity of the ban given the Raad van State and the Baarsma commission's views, and asks how the NZa could act with a less far-reaching instrument.
The Council of State however indicates that the NZa could also act adequately and effectively with an instrument less far-reaching than the proposed ban.
De Raad van State geeft echter aan dat de NZa met een instrument dat minder ver gaat dan het voorgestelde verbod ook voldoende adequaat en effectief zou kunnen optreden.
Questions necessity and proportionality of the ban, notes the Raad van State's rejection, and asks for less far-reaching options.
They mainly question the extent to which the present bill is necessary or proportionate.
Zij zetten vooral vraagtekens bij de mate waarin het voorliggende wetsvoorstel noodzakelijk dan wel proportioneel is.
Asks what positive effects of vertical integration would be lost, requests an international comparison, and questions whether choice remains a core value.
Which positive effects can no longer be realised?
Welke positieve effecten kunnen niet meer gerealiseerd worden?
Asks whether the ban is too severe given existing instruments and whether the European Commission has actually approved it.
Has Europe, with that letter, given permission for enacting a statutory ban on vertical integration?
Heeft Europa met bedoelde brief toestemming gegeven voor het afkondigen van een wettelijk verbod op verticale integratie?
Asks how exemptions from the ban on vertical integration for innovation will be applied and how abuse by insurers will be prevented.
However, they ask how the Minister envisages this exemption in concrete terms.
Wel vragen zij hoe de Minister deze ontheffing concreet voor zich ziet.
Objects to reducing reimbursement of uncontracted emergency care to the Dutch market-conform level and asks for detailed data.
Worries that reduced reimbursement for uncontracted care harms patients' freedom of choice and exposes them to unaffordable costs, and asks how the NZa can be convinced to grant exemptions.
This restricts the freedom of choice of people who have taken out the 'wrong' policy, but also places major risks on care providers.
Dit belemmert de keuzevrijheid van mensen die een «verkeerde» polis hebben afgesloten, maar legt ook grote risico's op de zorgaanbieders.
Asks for clarification on the definition of control, the enforcement of disclosure duties, the treatment of existing vertical integration, and the compatibility of the reimbursement rule with EU law.
The CDA members thank the Minister for the extensive answers in the memorandum in response to the report.
De leden van de CDA -fractie danken de Minister voor de uitgebreide beantwoording in de nota naar aanleiding van verslag.
Asks whether the independent advisory body Actal should assess the increase in administrative burden and on what criteria the NZa decides on innovation exemptions.
Asks the Minister to instruct the NZa to actively detect and sanction abuse of market power by insurers and to report to parliament.

The ChristenUnie members ask the Minister to respond to the proposal to instruct the NZa to actively detect and sanction abuse of market power by health insurers in the context of Article 13, and to report on this to the House.

De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen de Minister te reageren op het voorstel om de NZa een aanwijzing te geven om misbruik van marktmacht door zorgverzekeraars in de context van artikel 13 actief op te sporen en te sanctioneren, en hierover aan de Kamer te rapporteren.

Questions whether the amended reimbursement rule complies with the EU patients' rights directive and case law of the EU Court of Justice, and warns of increased insurer market power under Article 24 of the Competition Act.
Asks how monitoring of the Zvw-pgb will work and whether criminal prosecution of fraud remains possible given insurers' freedom to set conditions.
Prosecuting fraud will be more complicated if it is found, because insurers themselves can fill in the conditions.
De uitvoering van strafrechtelijke vervolging zal in geval van geconstateerde fraude ingewikkelder zijn, omdat zorgverzekeraars zelf de mogelijkheid hebben om de voorwaarden in te vullen.
Welcomes the pgb but worries insurers' conditions could become so strict that few can still apply, and asks how insurers are stimulated to tackle fraud.

Regarding the additional conditions insurers may include in their policies, these members ask how it can be guaranteed that these conditions are not formulated so strictly that insured persons can hardly apply for a pgb.

Met betrekking tot de aanvullende voorwaarden die zorgverzekeraars in hun polissen op kunnen nemen vragen genoemde leden hoe er gegarandeerd kan worden dat deze voorwaarden niet zo stringent worden geformuleerd dat verzekerden niet of nauwelijks meer een pgb aan kunnen vragen.

Objects to the broad discretion given to insurers and to delegation to AMvB, asks how quickly government intervenes and what enforcement exists, and criticises the narrowing of free choice of care providers under article 13.
Why does the government give insurers so much freedom, while they mainly steer on price and volume rather than on quality of care?
Waarom geeft de regering zoveel vrijheid aan zorgverzekeraars, terwijl zij voornamelijk sturen op prijs en productie in plaats van op de kwaliteit van zorg?

Worries that insurers have very wide freedom relative to legal certainty for citizens, that they may have a financial interest in limiting costs, and that there is no clear route for challenging indication decisions.
In short, the CDA members find that freedom for health insurers is very large in relation to legal certainty for citizens.
Kortom de leden van de CDA-fractie vinden dat vrijheid voor de zorgverzekeraars erg groot is in verhouding tot de rechtszekerheid voor de burger.
Objects to the apparent removal of the legal right to a pgb from article 13 and asks whether affected parties are being misled; also questions whether insurers can further tighten access conditions.
Is this an error by the government, or are stakeholders simply being misled?
Is dit een foutje van de regering, of worden belanghebbenden hier gewoon in de maling genomen?
Welcomes the pgb and the agreement between government, ZN and Per Saldo, asking only for clarification of the terms 'langdurig' and the position of terminal care patients.
These members consider being able to exercise self-direction of great value.
Deze leden achten het kunnen voeren van eigen regie van grote waarde.
Supports a statutory basis but asks how continuity, annual changes to insurer conditions, and disputes decided by the SKGZ will be safeguarded for budget holders.
How is it prevented that the conditions for the Zvw-pgb in the policy change annually, creating much uncertainty for users and care providers and endangering continuity of care?

Hoe wordt voorkomen dat de voorwaarden bij het Zvw-pgb via de polis jaarlijks veranderen, waardoor voor de gebruikers en zorgverleners veel onzekerheid ontstaat en de continuïteit van zorg via het Zvw-pgb in gevaar komt?

Sees the proposal as a first step toward a full pgb in the Zvw but objects to the article 13 restriction and asks why it was not a separate bill; also worries about shopping between insurers and declaration-based payment.
The government's proposal on the pgb in the Zorgverzekeringswet is an important first step toward a full pgb in the Zorgverzekeringswet and thus toward more self-direction.
Het voorstel van de regering met betrekking tot het pgb in de Zorgverzekeringswet is een belangrijke eerste stap naar een volwaardig pgb in de Zorgverzekeringswet en dus juist naar meer eigen regie.
Asks how monitoring will be reported to parliament and whether the vague exclusion of 'normal ageing processes' gives insurers too much room to reject applications from older people.
Does this vague description not give the health insurer too much room to reject a Zvw-pgb application from an older person?
Biedt deze vage omschrijving de zorgverzekeraar niet te veel ruimte om de Zvw-pgb aanvraag van een oudere af te wijzen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 30 July 2012 advises reconsidering the proposed integral ban on vertical integration between health insurers and care providers, arguing it is disproportionate and that the NZa could use a less far-reaching permit mechanism. The government's nader rapport of 6 September 2012 maintains the ban as necessary during the transition phase, rejects the permit alternative, and adopts only partial changes such as clarifying the Zvw article and the transparency provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the integral ban is disproportionate given the limited scope of the problem and the availability of a less far-reaching NZa permit system; the government rejects the permit alternative as undesirable.
The Afdeling finds the EU free-movement justification insufficiently reasoned; the government expanded its motivation in the memorie van toelichting but maintained the ban.
The Afdeling is not convinced the existing instruments and NZa could not address the problem adequately with a less far-reaching instrument.
The Afdeling asks to define the term 'vernieuwing' and to justify the four-year maximum period for exemptions; the government declined the definition but justified the period.

The Afdeling asks that the disclosure duty for financial interests in article 40 be reasoned and that the scope of transparency obligations be clarified; the government partly adjusted the explanatory memorandum and rejected extension of disclosure to inkoopcontracten.

33407.s: The bill introduces a annual levy (verhuurderheffing) on landlords owning more than 10 rented homes in the regulated sector, based on the WOZ value of those homes minus ten times their average WOZ value, at a rate of 0.231%. It sets payment rules and temporarily reduces the rate and extends the payment term for 2013.
33407.j: The memorandum justifies the levy as part of measures to improve the functioning of the housing market for both rental and owner-occupied segments, and notes the expected 2013 revenue.
q: The taxable amount is the sum of the WOZ values of the rental homes of which the taxpayer has enjoyment on 1 January of the calendar year, reduced by ten times the average WOZ value of those rental homes.

Het belastbare bedrag is de som van de WOZ-waarden van de huurwoningen waarvan de belastingplichtige op 1 januari van het kalenderjaar het genot krachtens eigendom, bezit of beperkt recht heeft, verminderd met 10 maal de gemiddelde WOZ-waarde van die huurwoningen.

parties: Supports the levy as part of a balanced package of housing market measures covering the rental segment.
Underlying legislation can therefore count on the support of the VVD faction.
Onderliggende wetgeving kan daarom op steun van de leden van de VVD-fractie rekenen.
Asks why the threshold is 10 rather than 5 dwellings, whether the levy is deductible for corporate tax, and why the rate rises sharply in 2014 despite symmetry claims.
The PvdA members ask whether the symmetry apparently only applies to 2013, and if so, what the deeper intention behind it is.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de symmetrie dus blijkbaar alleen geldt voor 2013, en zo ja, wat is de diepere bedoeling daar achter.
Argues the levy is a tax rather than a levy and proposes renaming and simplifying its design, using a fixed per-dwelling rate and self-assessment.
Wonderfully clear: levy the landlord tax.
Questions the naming and grounds of the levy, citing Raad van State advice, and asks for explanation of how the rate and effects on investment and rents were calculated.
The CDA members also note that the Council of State's advice states the bill's naming causes confusion.
Ook de leden van de CDA-fractie merken op dat in het advies van de Raad van State staat dat de naamgeving van het wetsvoorstel tot verwarring leidt.
Fears tenants will be affected by pass-through of the levy into rents and asks about effects on investment and maintenance.
These members fear that tenants will be affected by this.
Deze leden vrezen dat huurders hierdoor worden geraakt.
Asks the government to rename the measure as a tax and asks about a broader revision of the tax system as advised by the Council of State.
The D66 members share the Council of State's view that this bill concerns a tax and request the government to amend the designation in article 13 of the bill.

De leden van de fractie van D66 delen de opinie van de Raad van State dat het onderhavige wetsvoorstel een «belasting» betreft en verzoeken de regering de benaming in artikel 13 van het onderhavig wetsvoorstel aan te passen.
Asks about the rationale for limiting the levy to the regulated sector and about how WOZ valuation objections and appeals feed into the levy.
Said members ask how objection and appeal against the determined WOZ value feeds through into the rental levy law and request an explanation with a numerical example.
Genoemde leden vragen op welke wijze bezwaar en beroep tegen de vastgestelde WOZ-waarde doorwerkt naar de Wet verhuurderheffing en vragen een toelichting met een cijfervoorbeeld.
Asks whether research into the levy's effects on residents' privacy has started and when its results will be shared.
The GroenLinks members recall that the House was promised research into the effects of the rental levy on the privacy of social housing residents.

De leden van de GroenLinks fractie herinneren zich dat de Kamer is toegezegd dat onderzoek zou plaatsvinden naar de gevolgen van de verhuurderheffing voor de privacy van bewoners van een sociale woning.
Asks questions about the amendment's effects without raising a check-related concern.
With this amendment it is arranged that rental homes with a rent above the liberalisation threshold (about 200,000 homes) also fall under the rental levy.
Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat ook huurwoningen met een huurprijs boven de liberalisatiegrens (circa 200 000 woningen) onder de verhuurderheffing vallen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet verhuurderheffing, raising concerns about its purpose, effects on housing corporations and other landlords, its characterization as a levy versus tax, the reduction mechanism, and foreign taxpayers, and recommended revisions. The government's reply accepted most points by supplementing the explanatory memorandum and changing terminology, while explaining why it keeps the term heffing.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the primary purpose of the landlord levy and its relation to earlier policy goals, and the government responded by pointing to budgetary and structural tax considerations without fully changing the stated aims.
The Afdeling found the explanatory memorandum lacked analysis of effects on housing corporations and other landlords, and the government added supplementary passages on these effects.

The Afdeling advised calling the levy a belasting instead of a heffing for consistent terminology, and the government kept heffing in most places while replacing standalone belasting with heffing in the bill text and retaining belastingplichtige and related compounds.
The Afdeling asked for justification of the reduction of ten times the average WOZ value given the exemption threshold, and the government amended the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the taxation of foreign landlords and possible double taxation, and the government expanded the memorandum on this point.
The Afdeling made several redactional remarks on definitions, article wording and cross-references, which the government largely adopted.

33416.s: The bill establishes a legal framework (Wet houdbare overheidsfinanciën) for trend-based budget policy and sustainable public finances across the collective sector, implementing EU fiscal rules at national and subnational level. It sets macro-level EMU balance norms for provinces, municipalities and water boards, and introduces sanctions including fund deductions, deposits and fines, plus powers for the Finance Minister to designate and restrict borrowing by other legal persons.
33416.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as necessary to meet binding EU fiscal obligations and to secure sustainable public finances, with the sanctions as an ultimum remedium after consultation.
q: The sanction instrument is intended as an ultimum remedium.
Het sanctie-instrument is bedoeld als een ultimum remedium.
d: determining equivalent effort required of subnational governments
rules on individual reference values for EMU balance
designating other legal persons subject to prior consent for borrowing
adopting adequate spending-reduction or revenue-raising measures
p: The Finance Minister may withhold consent to borrowing by designated legal persons and impose fines on them, based on his own judgement of equivalent effort.
Ministers may impose fund deductions and fines on provinces, municipalities and water boards on the Finance Minister's proposal after consultation.
Ministers must take spending or revenue measures when the Finance Minister finds norms unmet, documented in a recovery plan submitted to parliament.

parties: Welcomes codifying budget rules but asks how the individual reference values and sanction instrument for decentralised governments will work in practice and who decides whether negotiations have failed.
How should the agreement in the 18 January 2013 administrative consultation conclusions be viewed, that the calculated path is the ambition for subnational governments
Hoe moet in dit verband de afspraak worden bezien in de «Conclusies Bestuurlijk overleg 18 januari 2013» dat het pad van de doorrekening de ambitie is voor medeoverheden
Supports codification and a macro deficit norm for subnational governments, but asks how the tekortruimte is determined in administrative consultation and whether the space will become binding later.
Will the room allocated to lower governments not eventually become constraining in the longer term?
Gaat op de langere duur de aan de lagere overheden toebedeelde ruimte niet alsnog knellen?
Questions the need for the law and warns that the correction mechanism and EU recommendations amount to transfer of sovereignty that limits the Chamber's budget right.
Can the government confirm that the procedure described amounts to a transfer of sovereignty from the Netherlands to European institutions?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat de hierboven beschreven werkwijze neerkomt op een soevereiniteitsoverdracht van Nederland naar Europese instellingen?
Has serious reservations, questioning whether fixing cabinet budget policy in law amounts to ruling from beyond the grave and whether the law fragments regulation.
Is fixing the cabinet's budget policy vision in legislation not precisely ruling from beyond the grave?
Is met het vastleggen van de kabinetsvisie op het begrotingsbeleid in wetgeving niet juist sprake van over je graf heen regeren
Understands the rationale for legal anchoring but doubts the need for the decentralised part and opposes the proposed sanction as contrary to administrative tradition and possibly disproportionate.
The CDA members do not find this desirable; it strongly conflicts with the existing tradition regarding administrative relations.
De leden van de fractie van het CDA vinden dit niet wenselijk. Dit gaat sterk in tegen de bestaande traditie voor wat betreft de bestuurlijke verhoudingen.

Asks why the subnational deficit norm must be in legislation rather than administrative agreements and argues the setting of the norm should require Chamber approval, possibly via a voorhang procedure.
The D66 members believe this decision is of such importance that it requires approval of the House of Representatives
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening, dat dit besluit van een dusdanig groot belang is, dat dit instemming van de Tweede Kamer behoeft
Considers the law a disproportionate curtailment of subnational autonomy and investment room and objects to a new sanction mechanism imposed by the central government without an EU breach.
These members are of the opinion that the bill leads to a disproportionate restriction of the autonomy and investment room of subnational governments.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het wetsvoorstel leidt tot een disproportionele inperking van de autonomie en de investeringsruimte van decentrale overheden.
Expresses concern about the effect of the law's design on area development.
They do however have concerns about the design of the law in relation to the importance of area development.
Wel maken zij zich zorgen over de vormgeving van de wet in relatie tot het belang van gebiedsontwikkeling.
Supports solid public finances but asks whether the norms will push subnational governments toward leasing rather than investing, reducing democratic control.
Does the government see the risk that this will reduce democratic control over subnational governments?
Ziet de regering het risico dat daarmee de democratische controle op decentrale overheden zal verminderen?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory opinion on the draft Wet houdbare overheidsfinanciën supports the bill's aim of binding fiscal sustainability but raises concerns about its narrow focus on the EMU balance, the necessity of supervisory instruments for decentralised governments, the budgeting mismatch between the baten-lasten system and EMU accounting, and some procedural and dispute-resolution issues. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adds clarifications and box 2 on the correction mechanism, retains the sanction instrument as ultimum remedium, and defends its macro-norm approach while keeping the ministerraad wording and the general administrative-law dispute route.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether existing financial supervision of decentralised governments is insufficient and asks the government to justify the necessity of the new sanction instruments; the government defends them as ultimum remedium after bestuurlijk overleg.

The Afdeling notes the discrepancy between the baten-lasten system and EMU accounting and asks how this will be handled practically in bestuurlijk overleg; the government adds clarifications and reframes the norm at macro level.

The Afdeling objects that the Minister of Finance alone setting the equal effort conflicts with the coordinating roles of the Minister of BZK and the Minister of I&M; the government amends article 3(2) to require agreement with those ministers.

The Afdeling advises clarity on whether disputes between central and decentralised governments should go to the courts; the government defers the question pending separate research and applies the Algemene wet bestuursrecht for now.

Several redactional remarks on definitions and wording are adopted, except the deletion of the ministerraad phrasing in articles 2(4) and 3(2) and the restriction of regulation-making in article 5(2), which the government keeps for commitment and flexibility reasons.

The Afdeling asks the bill to reflect the broader EU budgetary framework rather than only the Stability Treaty and to justify the absence of a literal norm; the government adds explanation on the correction mechanism principles and the link to the broader economic policy.

33452.s: The bill abolishes the long-term student surcharge (langstudeerdersmaatregel) and the higher statutory tuition tier, retroactively resets tuition amounts for 2011-2013, and lets students repay surcharge loans interest-free until 1 March 2013. It also shifts several tuition amounts from the basic tariff structure into fixed statutory amounts set by law.
33452.j: The memorandum justifies the retroactive adjustment as a budget measure following a coalition agreement and states that repayment rules will be set in a ministerial regulation.
q: The detailed implementation, for those who used the long-term student credit and tuition credit to pay the surcharge, will be laid down in a ministerial regulation.
De nadere uitwerking wordt, voor degenen die gebruik hebben gemaakt van het langstudeerderskrediet en het collegegeldkrediet voor het betalen van de opslag, neergelegd in een ministeriële regeling.
d: minimum and maximum partial tuition amounts
indexation of tuition amounts by consumer price index
application, payment and implementation rules for tuition credit

parties: Welcomes the bill giving quick clarity to students, but asks about the Profileringsfonds funds for part-time students and how students were informed about repayment deadlines.
The members of the VVD group have taken note of this amendment with approval.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van deze wetswijziging.
Supports ending the surcharge and asks for agreed deadlines for restitution to students and parents and the basis for compensation to institutions.
The members attach importance to restitution of the amounts already paid taking place as soon as possible.
De leden hechten eraan dat restitutie van de reeds betaalde bedragen op zo kort mogelijk termijn plaatsvindt.
Criticises the hasty, insufficiently motivated amendment that undermines good, lasting legislation and disagrees with the funding for the bill.
The members are also of the view that the importance of good, stable legislation has been disregarded by the rapid and only limitedly motivated amendment, as well as the run-up to it.
De leden zijn bovendien van mening dat het belang van goede, bestendige wetgeving veronachtzaamd is door de snelle en beperkt gemotiveerde wetswijzing, alsmede de aanloop daartoe.
Welcomes removal of the boete but asks who bears the institutional correction, why DUO does not handle restitution, and how compensation of affected students is controlled.
How does the government check whether all affected students will be compensated by 1 December?
Hoe controleert de regering of alle gedupeerde studenten voor 1 december gecompenseerd zullen worden?
Asks when the required ministerial regulation will be published, how students will be informed, and whether all amounts have been repaid.
The members ask when the necessary ministerial regulation will be published.
De leden vragen op welke termijn de benodigde ministeriële regeling die hiervoor nodig is gepubliceerd wordt.
Requests a table of all statutory provisions added by the surcharge and whether each is removed, plus a budgetary overview of the related cuts.
The members would therefore like an overview in table form of all statutory rules and articles that were added to the law when the long-study measure was introduced.
Zo ontvangen de leden graag een overzicht in tabelvorm van alle wetsregels en -artikelen die bij het invoeren van de langstudeerdersmaatregel in de wet zijn toegevoegd.
Regrets the planned social loan system and OV-jaarkaart cuts, stresses orderly withdrawal given retroactive effect, and asks for clarity on the division of costs.
They point to the importance of an orderly withdrawal of the long-study measure, now that the measure is being undone with retroactive effect.
Zij wijzen op het belang van een ordentelijke intrekking van de langstudeerdersmaatregel, nu er sprake is van het ongedaan maken van de maatregel met terugwerkende kracht.

Welcomes ending the boete but is critical of politics creating uncertainty for students, questions interest and transaction cost compensation, and asks about the funding gap between 0.4 and 0.28 billion.
The members are also critical of the role of politics in creating uncertainty for students.
De leden zijn daarnaast kritisch over de rol van de politiek in het creëren van onzekerheid voor studenten.
Finds it undesirable to abolish a measure barely in force given trust in politics and careful policy, and asks why an effective measure is being scrapped.
Given trust in politics and the care taken in policy and legislation, they find it undesirable to abolish measures that have barely come into force.
Zij vinden het, gelet op het vertrouwen in de politiek en de zorgvuldigheid van beleid en wetgeving, onwenselijk om maatregelen af te schaffen die nog nauwelijks van kracht zijn geworden.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory opinion supports the bill retroactively abolishing the long-term student tuition surcharge but criticises the explanatory memorandum for not addressing the effects on the original education-efficiency and budget goals, stressing good legislation and stability. The government's reply accepts the request, adds the requested consequences to the explanatory memorandum, and argues that democratic majority support justifies the change.
concerns: Retroactive abolition of the long-term student tuition surcharge with a rapid, thinly motivated change of course conflicts with the principle of stable, good legislation.
The explanatory memorandum fails to explain the consequences of withdrawal for the original goals of improving higher-education efficiency and the financial target.
Several technical and redactional corrections to cross-references and article wording in the WHW and the Experimentenwet are recommended.

33515.s: The bill limits the rental housing levy (verhuurderheffing) to the year 2013 by amending the pending Wet verhuurderheffing, lowering the rate to 0.014% and extending a payment period from 3 to 9 months. It deletes articles 10 and 11 and makes the law expire on 1 January 2014, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2013.
q: Whereas We have considered that it is desirable for the time being to limit the statutory regulation of the rental housing levy to 2013
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is vooralsnog de wettelijke regeling van de verhuurderheffing te beperken tot 2013

parties: Asks the government to justify how the retroactive effect of the levy fits with its general policy on retroactivity.
these members ask the government to further justify how the retroactive effect in the bill relates to the general policy on retroactivity currently in force.
deze leden vragen de regering nader te motiveren hoe de terugwerkende kracht in het wetsvoorstel zich verhoudt tot het heden in het algemeen gevoerde beleid inzake terugwerkende kracht.
Supports the levy for 2013 only and endorses the motion's premises, raising no further objections.
These members are in favour of this levy, which relates only to the year 2013.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van deze heffing die alleen betrekking heeft op het jaar 2013.
Notes the Council of State's objection to retroactive burdensome measures and asks why an exception applies here; proposes scrapping the levy altogether.
The PVV members do not find in the explanatory memorandum why that applies in this case and want the government to explain this further.
De leden van de PVV-fractie lezen in de memorie van toelichting niet terug waarom dat in casu wel van toepassing is en willen dat de regering dit nader toelicht.
Questions the differences between the motion and amendment, the alternatives considered, the cost of collection and the impact on construction, and asks for the research underlying the levy.
What research has been carried out by or commissioned by the government on the effects of a rental levy on new construction and renovation?
Welk onderzoek is gedaan door of in opdracht van de regering naar de effecten van een verhuurderheffing op nieuwbouw en renovatie?
Argues the fixed 2.1 billion revenue target leaves the government too little room to balance tenant and landlord capacity, and asks for revenue projections and plans after 2013.

The D66 members find that by holding firmly to the 2.1 billion euro levy, the government has allowed itself very little room to manoeuvre toward a solution that does justice to the capacity of tenants and landlords.

De leden van de D66-fractie vinden dat de regering door zonder meer vast te houden aan de heffing van 2,1 miljard euro, zich wel erg weinig bewegingsvrijheid heeft gepermitteerd om tot een oplossing te komen die recht doet aan de draagkracht van huurders en verhuurders.
Welcomes the limitation to 2013 but asks for an independent test of the analysis planned for 2014 and asks whether alternative bases and differentiated rates were examined.
These members therefore ask what the exact research questions of the further analysis now to be carried out are, and whether an independent review will be applied to it.
Deze leden vragen daarom wat de exacte onderzoeksvragen zijn van de nadere analyse die nu zal worden uitgevoerd en of hier ook een onafhankelijke toets op wordt gedaan.

Asks why the government did not bundle the 2013 and 2014 measures in one package and seeks justification for retroactivity given the fundamental principle against retroactive burdens; also asks about the filing deadline.

these members ask to what extent the awareness among landlords that a levy by the government is a realistic expectation is sufficient to depart from the fundamental principle that burdensome measures are not imposed with retroactive effect.

Deze leden vragen in hoeverre het besef bij verhuurders dat een heffing door de overheid een reële verwachting is, volstaat om af te wijken van het fundamentele uitgangspunt dat belastende maatregelen niet met terugwerkende kracht worden genomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the novelle limiting the Wet verhuurderheffing to 2013, but objects to retroactive effect of a burdensome levy without justification in the explanatory memorandum, and gives drafting remarks. The minister followed the drafting remarks and the request to address the retroactivity, except for one redactional remark.
concerns: The Afdeling objects to giving retroactive effect to a burdensome levy absent special circumstances and asks the explanatory memorandum to justify it; the government adapted the memorandum to address this.
Drafting remarks on deleting the considerans amendment and renumbering articles 12 and 13 to 10 and 11 were adopted.
A second redactional remark was not followed, citing aanwijzing 238 of the Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving.

33533.s: The bill amends the 2013 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) to fund the state intervention in SNS Reaal N.V., raising the expenditure and commitment ceilings by 3.8 billion euro. It also sets the effective date of the amendment to 1 February 2013 and specifies that budget figures are in thousands of euros.
33533.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by the need to let SNS bank meet capital requirements set by the supervisor DNB, with the state contributing 1.9 billion euro.
q: In order to let SNS bank N.V. meet the capital requirements set by the supervisor DNB
Ten einde SNS bank N.V. aan de kapitaaleisen te laten voldoen, zoals vastgesteld door de toezichthouder DNB

33542.s: The bill adds a new title to the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure allowing investigating officers to record licence plate data of passing vehicles on public roads and keep it for four weeks. The stored data may be searched only for specified serious offences or to trace fugitives, with the detailed rules and technical requirements to be set by general administrative order and ministerial regulation.
33542.j: The memorandum justifies the power by its investigative value for serious crime and tracing fugitives, and limits it with necessity, proportionality and subsidiarity requirements, data-retention limits, and a three-year horizon with evaluation.
d: rules on deployment of ANPR devices, recording and consultation of data
Artikel I, 126jj lid 4 Sv (ministeriële regeling referred to in memorandum)
technical requirements for cameras, criteria for placement, data security and autorisation levels
p: Gives investigating officers a new power to record and store licence plates of all passing vehicles without suspicion, with searches limited to specified offences or fugitive tracing.
The power lapses three years after entry into force unless extended by royal decree, and the minister must report on effectiveness within three years.

parties: Supports effective investigation but worries about rights of innocent citizens because all passing vehicles would be registered, and asks about data retention and access safeguards.
In carrying out this task, these members keep an eye on the rights of innocent citizens.
Bij de uitvoering van deze taak houden de deze leden het oog op de rechten van onschuldige burgers.
Asks whether key safeguards such as deletion after four weeks and access logging should be in the statute rather than an AMvB, and what role parliament has in adopting the AMvB.
They would also like to hear the government's view on possible parliamentary involvement in the making of the AMvB.
Daarnaast zouden zij graag het standpunt van de regering vernemen over een eventuele betrokkenheid van het parlement bij de totstandkoming van de amvb.
Supports giving licence plate recording a legal basis and asks for wider deployment of the @migoboras system.
These members are positive about giving the police a legal basis for recording and retaining licence plate data.
Deze leden staan positief tegenover het voorstel om het vastleggen en bewaren van kentekengegevens door de politie van een wettelijke basis te voorzien.
Questions the evidence of effectiveness, notes the WODC and Raad van State found little proof, and doubts proportionality of retaining data on all passing vehicles.
In the view of these members, this conclusion is not supported by the facts.
Deze conclusie wordt naar de mening van deze leden niet gestaafd door de feiten.
Welcomes the bill, considers the safeguards and yearly monitoring sufficient, but asks about privacy harms in practice and the retention period.
The conditions on how the data must be handled, as well as yearly monitoring of their use, in their view form sufficient safeguards for careful application.

De voorwaarden die worden gesteld aan de wijze waarop met de gegevens moet worden omgegaan, alsook de jaarlijkse monitoring van het gebruik ervan, vormen naar hun mening voldoende waarborgen voor een zorgvuldige toepassing.
Opposes the bill as an infringement of privacy and the presumption of innocence, questions evidence and error margins, and warns of function creep and data leaks.
They are not convinced of the need for such a far-reaching bill and have fundamental objections to it.
Zij zijn niet overtuigd van de noodzaak van een dermate ingrijpend wetsvoorstel en hebben fundamentele bezwaren daartegen.
Acknowledges the need for good investigation but questions added value, and asks that the nationwide camera network criteria be set in statute and that parliament be involved.
They recognise the need for good investigation of offences and to increase the chance of catching fugitives, but have reservations about the added value of the proposal.
Zij erkennen de noodzaak om tot een goede opsporing van een misdrijf te komen en de pakkans van een voortvluchtige te vergroten, maar zetten kanttekeningen bij de meerwaarde van het voorstel.
Supports effective investigation within the rule of law, but asks why camera criteria are set by ministerial regulation rather than higher regulation or parliamentary involvement.
Why, given the privacy risks, is no use made of higher regulation or involvement of parliament?
Waarom wordt in verband met de risico's voor het terrein van de privacy geen gebruik gemaakt van hogere regelgeving of betrokkenheid van het parlement?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a draft bill creating a statutory power for police ANPR camera data retention for four weeks, for investigation and fugitive arrest, finding necessity, proportionality, camera-placement criteria, and rules on passenger images and evaluation insufficiently justified and advising the lower-level rules be set in a general administrative order. The minister's reply largely accepted the remarks, narrowing the offence scope, moving camera criteria to ministerial regulation and a camera plan, and adding evaluation and passenger-image safeguards, while keeping a ministerial rather than general administrative order for technical camera requirements.
concerns: The Afdeling found the effectiveness and necessity of retaining plate data insufficiently justified given few cases and limited research evidence; the government added explanation but argued the statute is needed to demonstrate value.

The Afdeling objected that minor traffic offences were included in the scope of retrieval; the government removed the separate Wegenverkeerswet reference, limiting use to offences carrying pretrial detention.

The Afdeling asked for criteria on the deployment of fixed and mobile cameras to prevent a nationwide net affecting innocent persons; the government committed to a camera plan and ministerial regulation with such criteria.

The Afdeling advised that rules on camera use and requirements, including privacy protection and not filming homes, belong in a general administrative order; the government added the home-viewing ban there but kept technical requirements in a ministerial regulation.
The Afdeling asked that images of recognisable drivers and passengers be addressed; the government stated they may not be consulted and added this to the general administrative order.
The Afdeling asked that the evaluation be made concrete and the horizon provision clarified; the government added a separate chapter on evaluation and the horizon clause.
The Afdeling made several redactional remarks on wording and placement of provisions, which the government adopted.

33605-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (House of Representatives and Senate), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across the parliamentary budget articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
33605-IIA.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by unplanned early elections in 2012 (higher severance payments) and delays in ICT projects, not by any delegation or new power.
q: Because of the unplanned early elections, there was in 2012 a greater call on, in particular, severance payments than in a non-election year.
Door de niet geplande tussentijdse verkiezingen is er in 2012 een groter beroep gedaan op, met name, de wachtgelden dan in een niet-verkiezingsjaar.

33623.s: The bill amends the Dutch minimum wage act so that persons performing paid work under a contract for services (opdracht), other than in the exercise of a profession or business, are treated as employees entitled to the statutory minimum wage and holiday allowance. It removes the requirement that the work be personal and the two-client limit, and adjusts the exemption for state employees and the delegation to adjust the scope of 'dienstbetrekking'.
33623.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to prevent circumvention of the minimum wage act through service contracts, and justifies the retained delegation by noting that new labour market developments may require further categories to be covered.
q: It cannot be ruled out that new developments in the labour market will arise that make it desirable to bring other categories of employment relationships within the scope of the Wml in the future.

Niet uit te sluiten valt immers dat zich weer nieuwe ontwikkelingen op de arbeidsmarkt voordoen die het wenselijk maken om in de toekomst ook andere categorieën arbeidsverhoudingen onder de werkingssfeer van de Wml te brengen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (art. 2, derde lid)
extending employment relationship to comparable work arrangements
Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 3, tweede lid)
designating categories excluded from employment relationship concept
p: Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 3, tweede lid)
Allows an administrative order to exclude categories of workers from the employment-relationship concept based on special circumstances, widening executive discretion over worker protection scope.

parties: Asks for clarification on scope, effects on employment and on childcare, and whether the amvb extending the definition of employment will be submitted to parliament.
Can the government indicate how often the Inspectie SZW imposes an administrative fine on an employer for failing to pay the statutory minimum wage?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe vaak de Inspectie SZW aan de werkgever een bestuurlijke boete oplegt wegens het niet voldoen aan het wettelijk minimumloon?
Supports the bill but asks whether the Raad van State's call for more intensive supervision against false self-employment is addressed by the planned measures.
The Council of State's advisory division pointed to the need to intensify supervision to effectively combat false self-employment.
De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State heeft gewezen op de noodzaak om het toezicht te intensiveren om schijnzelfstandigheid effectief te kunnen bestrijden.

Worried about delegation via amvb in both the employment definition and exclusions, and about loopholes via VAR-dga constructions and foreign legal entities; asks how discretion will be filled in and calls for codification.
Can the government give an indication of how it will fill in that room for manoeuvre?
Kan de regering een indicatie geven hoe zij die ruimte gaat invullen?
Asks for an overview of the sectors affected by the bill.
The SP fractie asks for an overview of the sectors in which the bill will lead to changes.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen om een overzicht van de sectoren waarin het wetsvoorstel tot veranderingen gaat leiden.
Supports tackling wage circumvention but asks how clients can be assessed as operating in a profession or business and whether amvb exclusions are planned.
Can the government further explain on the basis of which factors it can be assessed whether a contractor performs the work in the exercise of a profession or business?
Kan de regering nader toelichten aan de hand van welke factoren kan worden beoordeeld of een opdrachtnemer de arbeid verricht in de uitoefening van beroep of bedrijf?
Asks how clients can verify whether a contractor is a self-employed business operator, the sanctions for non-compliance, and how uncertainty about hours is handled.
How high can the fines go?
Tot hoe hoog kunnen de boetes oplopen?
Asks about private persons' contracts, possible exclusions via amvb, whether an implementation test was done, and the financial consequences for enforcement.
Can the government explain whether the bill also has consequences for contracts between private individuals where the work is paid but not performed professionally or commercially?
Kan de regering toelichten of het wetsvoorstel ook gevolgen heeft voor overeenkomsten tussen particulieren, indien de arbeid tegen beloning maar niet beroeps- of bedrijfsmatig wordt verricht?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised in January 2013 that the bill extending the minimum wage act to non-business service contracts (overeenkomsten van opdracht) needed reconsideration, citing insufficient motivation, lack of clarity on scope and side effects, and removal of the 'not incidental work' criterion. The minister's reply of April 2013 responds to each point, largely defending the bill while adding clarifications and reinstating a regulatory power.
concerns: The Council questioned whether the extension is adequately motivated given limited evidence of large-scale misuse of service contracts and the motion-Hamer request for twelve hours per week, which the government largely rejected.
The Council noted the relationship with the Temporary postal worker decree 2011 was not addressed; the government added motivation distinguishing the two measures.
The Council asked for clarification of how the hourly minimum wage is calculated for small jobs; the government explained the normal working hours rule.

The Council argued that possible unintended effects on employment for workers at the bottom of the labour market were insufficiently addressed; the government responded with a broader discussion of employment effects and income distribution.
The Council asked why the extension applies only to the minimum wage and not to related schemes such as dismissal protection and social insurance; the government pointed to a wider action plan.
The Council noted EU free-movement justification requirements for cross-border services; the government argued the measure is justified by overriding public interest and proportionate.
The Council objected that dropping the 'not incidental work' criterion was unmotivated and could be misused; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
The Council noted the removal of the power to set further rules by general administrative order; the government reinstated that provision.

33632.s: The bill places clearing and settlement firms (afwikkelondernemingen) that process Dutch giro payments under statutory supervision, requiring licences above a transaction threshold and conduct and prudential rules, and amends the Wft and Bankwet on DNB stability tasks, a systemic relevance capital buffer, a general duty of care for financial service providers, and the treatment of bank savings deposits for owner-occupied homes in deposit guarantee and transfer plans. The explanatory memorandum justifies it as replacing voluntary oversight with binding rules to protect the functioning of payments and financial stability.
33632.j: The memorandum justifies the new delegated rules by pointing to international standards (BIS PFMI, Bazel III, CRD IV) and the need for binding, enforceable supervision where voluntary oversight is insufficient.
q: That DNB, in an emergency, does not have the Wft enforcement instruments when they are truly needed leads to risks we cannot accept.
Dat DNB in een eventueel geval van nood niet beschikt over het handhavingsinstrumentarium van de Wft als het echt nodig is, leidt tot risico's die we niet mogen lopen.
d: number of giro transactions above which a licence is required
rules on designating third states for supervision
size and composition of systemic relevance capital buffer, with DNB setting parts individually
situations treated as distributions or capital reduction
further rules on cooperation between supervisors and on business conduct of settlement firms
further rules implementing EU acts on how AFM performs its conduct supervision task
Artikel I, Wft 4:76a, derde lid and 4:76b, tweede lid
rules on timely, efficient settlement services and information for payment service providers
rules on reporting events threatening orderly settlement business
amount of administrative fines for violations of banknote check rules
p: DNB may prohibit a settlement firm from operating if it fails to meet rules set by or under the Act, giving the supervisor a discretionary sanction power over market participants.
DNB may impose binding capital or distribution restrictions on banks whose capital conservation plan it does not approve.
Financial stability is added as an explicit supervisory objective alongside solvency, broadening the grounds on which supervisors act.
Artikel I, Wft 1:90 lid 5 en 1:93 lid f
Supervisors may share confidential information with other supervisors, the Minister and listed security and investigative bodies when relevant to their statutory tasks.

Savings deposits and linked mortgage debts for owner-occupied homes are automatically set off by operation of law when a resolution or bankruptcy is triggered, regardless of third-party rights to the deposit.
Issuers must publish timely notices of material changes between the drafting and adoption of annual financial reports, strengthening information for investors.
Financial service providers must act with due care for consumers' and beneficiaries' legitimate interests, with advisers acting in their interest.

parties: Supports the bill but asks about overlap between DNB and AFM on financial stability, the scope of settlement supervision, and the discretion over the systemic buffer level.
These members support the legislative package but wish to ask for further explanation or clarification from the government on several specific points.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie ondersteunen het voorliggende wetgevingspakket, maar willen op enkele specifieke punten wel vragen om een nadere toelichting of verheldering van de zijde van de regering.

Asks extensively about the scope of settlement enterprises, the delegation of thresholds and criteria to general administrative orders, and the risk of an unpredictable AFM using the general duty of care as a catch-all.
Can the government indicate whether the task load of DNB and AFM increases as a result of this bill and whether they are sufficiently equipped to carry out these tasks?
Kan de regering aangeven of het takenpakket van DNB en de AFM toeneemt als gevolg van dit wetsvoorstel en of zij voldoende toegerust is op deze taken uit te voeren?

Asks for justification of conduct supervision over settlement enterprises, the transparency and verifiability of DNB's systemic relevance methodology, and the possibility to object to DNB's assessment.
In the view of the D66 members it is important that the methodology by which DNB judges the systemic relevance of a bank is transparent, reliable and verifiable.
Naar de mening van de leden van de D66-fractie is het van belang dat de methodiek waarmee DNB oordeelt over de systeemrelevantie van een bank, transparant, betrouwbaar en controleerbaar is.
Questions the many delegation provisions, asks why the licensing criteria are not in the law itself, and how splitting of enterprises to stay under thresholds is prevented.
These members specifically ask the government why it chose not to include the criteria for the licensing requirement in the law.
Zij vragen de regering specifiek waarom de regering ervoor heeft gekozen om de criteria bij de vergunningplicht niet in de wet op te nemen.

Asks why the threshold for licensing is set by general administrative order rather than in the law, and whether the general duty of care will reduce use of execution-only services, a risk to consumers.
Can the government explain why it was chosen to regulate the threshold in a general administrative order rather than in the law?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom ervoor gekozen is de drempel in een algemene maatregel van bestuur te regelen en niet in de wet?
Asks whether the AFM gaining broad rule-making power via general duty of care undermines parliamentary control and legality, and about the possible credit-tightening effects.
Can the government guarantee that this proposal does not come at the expense of parliamentary control?
Kan de regering garanderen dat dit voorstel niet ten koste gaat van de parlementaire controle?
Not yet convinced of the desirability of a general public-law duty of care beyond existing civil and public-law duties, and asks what behavioural change is intended.
The CDA members are not yet convinced of the desirability of extending the existing civil-law and public-law duty of care.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn nog niet overtuigd van de wenselijkheid van de uitbreiding van de reeds bestaande civielrechtelijke en publiekrechtelijke zorgplicht.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2014, raising objections to the new general public-law duty of care, the new capital buffers and their delegation, supervision of settlement companies, information-sharing under the FEC, and the Accountantskamer's power to supplement complaints. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the remarks, revising the text and explanatory memorandum, though it kept the settlement-company supervision and the Accountantskamer power with clarifications.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the necessity of a separate public-law general duty of care given the existing civil-law special duty and Wft rules; the government justified it as a backstop enabling supervisory enforcement.
The open-ended delegation for further rules on the general duty of care was considered undesirable and was deleted.
The essential elements of the capital buffer should be set in the statute itself rather than left to lower regulation.
The capital conservation plan wording could be read as imposing a larger buffer restoration burden, requiring clarification.
Differentiation of the systemic relevance buffer by degree of systemic relevance was insufficiently explained.
The scope of the term settlement company was unclear and could cover telecom and SWIFT-type firms, requiring alignment of text and explanation.
The relationship to the Payment Services Directive and possible future EU amendments needed explanation.
Conduct supervision of settlement companies protecting professional counterparties needed a reasoned justification.
Exemption of settlement companies' supervision costs from cost recovery needed justification, with a later amendment for non-ESCB costs promised.

Sharing confidential supervisory information through the FEC was not legally possible under the one-to-one framework and the necessity criterion was too loose; the criterion was tightened and the recipient list limited.
Automatic set-off of savings deposits against mortgage debt needed explanation of third-party security rights and buyout financing.
The wording on qualified holdings in market operators was open to multiple readings and needed explanation of its scope and relation to MiFID.
Ex officio supplementing of complaint grounds by the Accountantskamer risks undermining legal certainty; the provision was amended to give the accountant a chance to respond in writing.

33640-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget for the other High Councils of State and the Governors' cabinets, raising total expenditure by about 5.3 million euros in the first supplementary budget. The increases mainly fund the Raad van State (DigiO project and additional asylum and detention appeal capacity) and the Algemene Rekenkamer, with smaller changes for the ombudsman and the Governors' offices.
33640-IIB.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget increases by project delays (DigiO) and expected growth in asylum and detention appeal cases requiring extra legal capacity.
q: Due to version control problems with the DigiO project pilot, a delay occurred in 2012.
Door problemen met het versiebeheer bij de pilot van het project DigiO is er in 2012 vertraging opgetreden.

33713.s: The bill introduces a compartmentalisation reserve in the corporate income tax (Vpb) for cases where a shareholding moves into or out of the participation exemption, so that gains are taxed or deferred consistently. It also backdates the rule to 14 June 2013 and allows further rules to be set by general administrative order (AMvB).
33713.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB power by saying such situations rarely occur in practice but that rules may be needed if they do, consistent with the statutory rule.
q: Nevertheless, the sixth paragraph opens the possibility, should such a transition occur, to set further rules by general administrative order.
Desondanks is in het zesde lid de mogelijkheid geopend om, in het geval zich een dergelijke sfeerovergang mocht voordoen, bij algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels te stellen.
d: further rules for cases where the substantial interest or participation rules change

parties: Asks whether the NOB's reading of retroactive effect is correct and whether the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive is compatible with the bill.
Is the conclusion the NOB draws from the statutory text and explanatory memorandum correct according to the government, ask the members of the VVD fractie?
Is de conclusie die de NOB trekt uit de wetstekst en memorie van toelichting juist volgens de regering, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie?
Agrees the budgetary loss must be prevented and asks how many cases apply the compartmentalisation rule and how transitional cases are handled.
These members ask the government in how many cases the compartmentalisation is applied and the compartmentalisation reserve is used?
Genoemde leden vragen de regering in hoeveel gevallen de compartimentering wordt toegepast en van de compartimenteringsreserve wordt gebruikgemaakt?
Asks why the compartmentalisation reserve is not fixed in an appealable decision, which would give legal certainty to taxpayers.
Why, these members ask, from the standpoint of legal certainty, is the compartmentalisation reserve not established by an appealable decision?
Waarom wordt, vragen deze leden, uit oogpunt van rechtszekerheid, de compartimenteringsreserve niet bij een voor bezwaarvatbare beschikking vastgesteld?
Worries about abuse of the transition rules and asks for general principles on transitional measures to reduce reliance on Supreme Court rulings.
Is the government willing to further consider general principles for transitional measures, so that there is more certainty in the future?
Is de regering bereid nader na te denken over algemene uitgangspunten voor overgangsmaatregelen, zodat er in de toekomst meer houvast is?
Criticises retroactive effect that forces businesses to reconstruct old files, asks for motivation of material retroactivity, and supports optional direct settlement.
Can the government further motivate why it chose to have the bill take effect not only with formal retroactive effect but also with material retroactive effect?
Kan de regering nader motiveren waarom zij ervoor gekozen heeft om het wetsvoorstel niet alleen met formeel terugwerkende kracht, maar ook met materieel terugwerkende kracht in werking te laten gaan?

Doubts about the very extensive material retroactive effect of the bill; asks whether a previously exempt dividend would effectively be taxed when the stake is sold, and how far back the retroactivity reaches.
These members have doubts about the very extensive material retroactive effect that the bill appears to have.
Deze leden hebben hun twijfels bij de zeer uitvoerige materieel terugwerkende kracht die het wetsvoorstel lijkt te hebben.
Asks how the Hoge Raad's compartmentalisation doctrine, which applies only to factual compartmentalisation, is incorporated into the statutory text and whether discrepancies remain.
Is this doctrine now fully incorporated into the statutory article? Or are there still discrepancies between the doctrine and the statutory article?
Is deze leer thans geheel in het wetsartikel geïncorporeerd? Of zijn er nog discrepanties tussen leer en wetsartikel?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill introducing a statutory compartmentalisation reserve in corporate tax but advises that the retroactive effect be expressly justified in the explanatory memorandum, since tax burden-increasing measures should generally not be retroactive. The government replied that the explanatory memorandum has been amended to substantively justify the retroactive effect.
concerns: Retroactive effect of a tax measure that increases the tax burden requires substantive justification in the explanatory memorandum, which the government has added.

33740.s: The bill makes the social internship in secondary education optional rather than mandatory, renames the classical languages subjects to 'language and culture', and removes the compulsory general natural sciences subject from the vwo profile common part. It also amends the Dutch Caribbean secondary education law and sets transitional and commencement rules, with details to be fixed by general administrative order and ministerial regulation.
33740.j: The memorandum explains that the subject details of the new classical language subjects and the curriculum content will be set separately by ministerial regulation and general administrative order, as is usual for subject development.
q: The elaboration will be further regulated in subordinate legislation, in particular by general administrative order.
De uitwerking hiervan zal nader worden geregeld in lagere regelgeving, in het bijzonder bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: transitional rules for phasing out classical cultural education exams
commencement date set by royal decree, possibly differing per article
inclusion of social internship in learning-work track as part of curriculum
rules on social internship hours, exemptions and individual exemption powers

parties: Asks about the use of the maatschappelijke stage funding, the costs for schools, and experience with dropping anw in havo.
The VVD members have noted the bill with approval.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Welcomes school autonomy over the curriculum but asks about the funding remaining in education, the stage requirements and the basis for the 50 million euro saving on anw.
These members regard this as a positive development that enables schools to build a clear profile of their own.
Deze leden beschouwen dit als een positieve ontwikkeling, die scholen in staat stelt om een duidelijk eigen profiel op te bouwen.
Supports making the stage optional so schools can decide, and questions the extra workload from renaming the classical subjects.
The PVV members favour the optional character that the maatschappelijke stage receives within the education programme.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zijn voorstander van het facultatieve karakter dat de maatschappelijke stage binnen het onderwijsprogramma krijgt.
Opposes dropping the stage and anw as budget cuts that undervalue their contribution, doubting that optional stages will be offered.
According to these members this once again shows that the government disregards the importance of the maatschappelijke stages and the good implementation many schools have given them.
Volgens deze leden wordt hiermee eens temeer aangetoond dat de regering het belang miskent van de maatschappelijke stages en de goede uitwerking die veel scholen daaraan hebben gegeven.
Cannot agree with abolishing the stage, citing lack of policy continuity and the loss of schools' investments; asks whether funding will be compensated.
It will therefore not surprise that these members cannot agree with abolishing the maatschappelijke stage.
Het zal dan ook niet verbazen dat deze leden niet kunnen instemmen met afschaffen van de maatschappelijke stage.
Opposes dropping anw as a compulsory vwo subject but supports abolishing the mandatory stage while allowing schools to offer it optionally.
They disagree with dropping the compulsory anw subject from the common part of the vwo profiles and ask the government to revise the bill on this point.
Zij zijn het niet eens met het schrappen van het verplichte vak anw uit het gemeenschappelijk deel van de vwo-profielen en vragen de regering het wetsvoorstel op dit punt te herzien.
Disagrees with abolishing the stage after a few years, arguing it harms government credibility and may be lost in schools; questions whether anw removal fits the Techniekpact.
The ChristenUnie members disagree with the proposal to abolish the maatschappelijke stage again after a few years.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie zijn het oneens met het voorstel om de maatschappelijke stage na enkele jaren weer af te schaffen.
Asks the government to reflect on the policy trajectory of introducing and then withdrawing a compulsory stage within two years.

What lessons does the government draw from this process, specifically where obligations are concerned that after two years are said to be a domain belonging to schools' responsibility, these members wish to know.

Welke lessen trekt de regering uit dit proces, specifiek wanneer het verplichtingen betreft waarvan na twee jaar gezegd wordt dat het een domein is dat tot de verantwoordelijkheid van scholen behoort, zo willen deze leden weten.

33902.s: The bill amends article 11.7a of the Telecommunicatiewet on storing or accessing information on users' devices, widening the exemption from the consent requirement to cases with no or minor privacy impact. It authorises the government, in agreement with the Minister of Justice and Security, to set further rules by general administrative order, including on the exemption, and allows subdelegation.
33902.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying the rules are technical and detailed and may need to be set quickly, so subdelegation is allowed.
q: Because these further rules will often be technical and detailed, or need to be set quickly, it was chosen to also allow subdelegation.
Omdat deze nadere regels veelal technisch en gedetailleerd zullen zijn, dan wel op korte termijn zouden moeten worden vastgesteld, is ervoor gekozen ook subdelegatie toe te staan.
d: further rules on consent requirements and exemptions for storing or accessing device information
p: The exemption from the consent requirement for storage or access with no or minor privacy impact relies on an open norm left to the regulator's assessment, widening discretion over citizens' privacy protection.

parties: Worries that the undefined 'negligible privacy consequences' test may create uncertainty and asks whether a list of minimum requirements or further specification is possible.
Could it, for example, publish a list of minimum requirements that providers must meet regarding the different types of cookies?
Kan zij bijvoorbeeld een lijst met minimale eisen publiceren waaraan aanbieders moeten voldoen ten aanzien van de verschillende soorten cookies?
Supports the bill but asks for clarification of when cookie walls are permissible, stressing that free choice must be protected.
The rule is also set that such a blockade cannot apply if it hinders freedom of choice.
Ook wordt de regel gesteld dat een dergelijke blokkade niet aan de orde kan zijn als het de keuzevrijheid belemmert.
Asks what 'negligible consequences' means and warns the term could be interpreted too broadly, allowing website owners to collect personal data without explicit consent.
Is this not a concept that can be interpreted too broadly, so that website owners could still collect personal data via cookies without explicit consent?
Is dit niet een begrip dat te ruim geïnterpreteerd kan worden, waardoor website-eigenaren middels cookies zonder expliciete toestemming toch persoonsgegevens kunnen vergaren?
Values privacy and usability together; questions whether cookie walls on public-task websites should be prohibited and notes tension with the ACM's expected workload.
These members consider it very important that websites with a public task are accessible to everyone.
Deze leden vinden het van groot belang dat websites met een publieke taak voor iedereen toegankelijk zijn.
Asks whether consent is truly free given cookie walls and whether public-task websites should be barred from using them.
Furthermore, the PVV members believe that websites for public tasks must at all times be barred from using cookie walls.
Verder vinden de leden van de PVV-fractie dat voor websites voor publieke taken te allen tijde moet gelden dat zij geen gebruik mogen maken van cookie-walls.
Questions the absence of a parliamentary pre- or post-review procedure for the AMvB determining which cookies fall under the exception, and asks how misuse will be enforced.
No pre- or post-review procedure for parliament is provided for this AMvB.
Bij deze AmvB wordt is geen voor- of nahangprocedure voor het parlement voorzien.
Worries that guidance via policy rules applied by the ACM will create more unclarity for users and whether users are adequately informed.
These members ask the government whether more uncertainty will actually arise for users, since these policy rules will mainly be applied by the ACM in implementing the law?

Deze leden vragen de regering of er voor de gebruiker niet juist meer onduidelijkheid zal ontstaan, aangezien deze beleidsregels vooral in de uitvoering van de wet door de ACM zullen worden gehanteerd?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the aim of the bill adding a third exception to the cookie rule in the Telecommunicatiewet, but warns that the open norm 'no or minor consequences for privacy' may create uncertainty and undermine effectiveness, and asks for a fuller explanation of the relation to Article 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive and the motivation for a subdelegation basis. The government's nader rapport responds by pointing to criteria in the explanatory memorandum, promising monitoring with the regulator and possible policy rules, and confirming that the amendments requested were added.
concerns: The open norm 'no or minor consequences for privacy' may create uncertainty for website operators, who might keep asking consent, undermining the bill's effectiveness; the government points to criteria in the memorandum and promises monitoring and possible policy rules.

The explanatory memorandum should address the relation to Article 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive specifically, and recital 66 could support the notification to the European Commission; the memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
The proposed subdelegation basis in the fifth paragraph of Article 11.7a should be motivated in the explanatory memorandum, which was done.

33911.s: The bill moves adult education funding out of the Participatiebudget into a specific grant under the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs, allocated to contact municipalities in regions instead of requiring spending at regional training centres (roc's). It removes the mandatory spending obligation and the cursusgeld rules for most education, and sets transitional spending percentages for 2015-2017.
33911.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly on practical and administrative grounds, such as using existing regional structures and avoiding extra administrative burden, and says the grant rules will follow the earlier allocation method.
q: By general administrative order, rules will be set on the method of calculation and the payment of the grant.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld over de berekeningswijze en de betaalbaarstelling van de uitkering.
d: transitional mandatory spending arrangement lifted by general administrative order
calculation method and payment of the education grant
further conditions on costs chargeable to the grant
rules on clawback and distribution of recovered funds, including non-recovery of part of unspent grant
designation of regions for municipal cooperation
designation of contact municipality for each region
rules on provision of data and withholding of grant payment for poor data
rules on provision of data by municipalities
admission to adult secondary education limited to adults
p: The minister receives a grant allocated by uniform criteria to contact municipalities, with the calculation method left to general administrative order rather than the statute.
