The minister may claw back unspent or improperly spent grant funds, with the clawback and retention rules set by general administrative order and the minister deciding on reduced amounts for reasons of unfairness.
Municipalities must supply data to the minister free of charge, and the minister may withhold grant payments by ministerial regulation if data are late or of poor quality.

parties: Asks why a temporary transitional rule for education funds keeps a separate regime and whether it can be extended, and asks how quality of non-diploma courses is guaranteed and by whom monitored.
Do these members understand correctly that the bill provides that after the three-year evaluation there is no automatic transfer to the social domain?
Begrijpen deze leden goed dat in het wetsvoorstel is opgenomen dat na de evaluatie over drie jaar niet automatisch alsnog tot een overheveling naar het sociaal domein komt?

Doubts that market mechanisms will reduce functional illiteracy and asks for stronger justification, while warning that non-recognised cheap courses could undermine recognised ones and that quality must be guaranteed.
The members are not yet convinced that abolishing the municipalities' compulsory purchasing from the roc's brings this goal closer.
De leden zijn er nog niet van overtuigd dat de afschaffing van de gedwongen winkelnering van de gemeenten bij de roc's dit doel naderbij brengt.

Asks how much policy variation between municipalities and labour regions is allowed, whether access is equal regardless of residence, and who ensures teacher qualifications and quality of non-formal education.
Whether one can take part in adult education must not depend on one's place of residence in a particular region, the members state.
Het wel of niet kunnen deelnemen aan volwasseneneducatie mag niet afhankelijk zijn van iemands woonplaats in een bepaalde regio, zo stellen de leden.

Supports abolishing the mandatory channelling via roc's but asks why earmarking is kept rather than further decentralising, and asks about the role and powers of contact municipalities and national coordination.
Why the government nevertheless holds on to earmarking and does not proceed with further removal of silos.</evidence_en>
Waarom de regering toch vasthoudt aan het oormerken en niet doorgaat met verdere ontschotting.

Objects that a specific grant clashes with decentralisation and de-earmarking policy, questions how contact municipalities are controlled and how municipal councils of neighbouring municipalities can exercise oversight.
These members also ask whether the specific grant via coordinating municipalities does not put municipalities' spending freedom under pressure.</evidence_en>
Tevens vragen deze leden of de specifieke uitkering via coördinerende gemeenten niet de bestedingsvrijheid van gemeenten onder druk zet.
Asks why a specific grant is chosen against the trend toward general-grant financing and spending freedom, and how municipalities can integrate education and participation with separate budgets.
Yet the bill opts for a specific grant.</evidence_en>
Toch wordt in het wetsvoorstel gekozen voor een specifieke uitkering.
Asks how quality and eligibility are assured for non-diploma courses, how learners are informed about the difference, and on what criteria municipalities select providers.
How is it guaranteed that participants follow the right course for their situation and do not later realise they should have taken a course with diploma recognition, they ask.</evidence_en>

Hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat deelnemers aan het onderwijs de juiste opleiding voor hun situatie volgen en zich niet achteraf realiseren dat zij toch een opleiding met diploma-erkenning hadden moeten volgen, zo vragen zij.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised against maintaining earmarking of adult education funds through a permanent specific grant, given the decentralisation of social domain tasks, and recommended a sunset clause aligned with the Tijdelijke wet deelfonds sociaal domein. The government's nader rapport rejected the main objection, retaining the specific grant, but accepted removing the phased-entry option and several drafting corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling objected to reintroducing earmarking of education funds in a specific grant, which runs against the policy of greater municipal discretion and the social domain decentralisations; the government kept the specific grant as the most responsible choice for now.

The Afdeling noted the proposal has no temporary character despite government policy that specific grants should be temporary, and advised a sunset date of 1 January 2018; the government made the expiry conditional on a royal decree after evaluation rather than fixing the date.
The Afdeling asked for justification of phased entry into force; the government removed the option of phased commencement for laws published after 31 December 2014.
The Afdeling made redactional corrections to cross-references and wording, which the government adopted except for one note based on the text in force from 1 August 2014.
The government deleted the provision on overlap with the proposed Tijdelijke wet deelfonds sociaal domein, which is expected to be submitted later.

34073.s: The bill removes several employment-law obstacles to working after the AOW (state pension) age, including shorter notice periods, a six-week sick-pay and dismissal regime, and exemptions from re-integration duties for workers who have reached that age. It also lets collective agreements deviate from the fixed-term contract chain rule for these workers and extends similar rules to civil servants via the Ambtenarenwet.
34073.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as removing barriers to older workers' labour participation and limiting displacement of younger workers, and says the differential treatment is objectively justified under EU equal-treatment law.
q: A collective agreement may also determine that, for calculating the 48-month period and number of contracts, only employment contracts concluded after reaching the AOW age are taken into account.

Bij die cao kan tevens worden bepaald dat voor de vaststelling van de periode van 48 maanden en het aantal contracten, alleen arbeidsovereenkomsten in aanmerking worden genomen die zijn aangegaan na het bereiken van de AOW-gerechtigde leeftijd.
d: deviations from civil-servant rules for workers past AOW age via public-law employment regulation
ARTIKEL I, art. 7:668a lid 5 onderdeel c (BW)
collective agreement may set contract-chain limits for workers past AOW age
rules for recovery of sickness benefit from employers of workers past AOW age
p: Introduces a recovery claim against employers for sickness benefit paid to workers past AOW age, with a privileged claim status for the implementing body.
Allows dismissal of civil servants past AOW age for illness after six weeks, with the competent authority able to request a work-capacity assessment.

parties: Supports longer working after the pension age, while noting the risk of displacement of younger workers and asking detailed questions about the bill.
They support the importance of working longer.
Zij ondersteunen het belang van het langer doorwerken.
Asks why the sick-pay obligation is limited to six weeks and how displacement effects will be evaluated, citing the Council of State and CPB warnings.
The PvdA members note that the Council of State points to possible displacement effects of the very limited sick-pay obligation for AOW-plussers.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie lezen dat de Raad van State in haar advies wijst op de mogelijk verdringingseffecten van de zeer beperkte loondoorbetalingsverplichting bij ziekte voor AOW-plussers.
Objects to the bill as incompatible with the priority of reducing unemployment and asks whether the displacement measures are exhaustive.
The SP members have read this bill with indignation.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met verontwaardiging kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.
Warns of displacement of younger staff and asks whether the age distinction is justified and compatible with European anti-age-discrimination law.
Under European legislation this distinction is only justified if it is appropriate and necessary.
Op grond van Europese wetgeving is dit onderscheid alleen gerechtvaardigd als dit passend en noodzakelijk is.
Asks to what extent the bill may cause displacement on the labour market.
The PVV has read the bill and asks to what extent it may cause displacement on the labour market.
De PVV heeft kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en vraagt in welke mate dit kan zorgen voor verdringing op de arbeidsmarkt.
Asks which changes were made in response to the critical Council of State advice and why cao derogation from the fixed-term rule is not set in law.
They ask the Minister to indicate which changes were made to the bill following the advice of the Council of State.
Zij vragen de Minister om aan te geven welke wijzigingen naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad van State zijn doorgevoerd in het wetsvoorstel.
Asks for justification that the bill does not go beyond what is necessary and does not excessively harm workers' interests, per the Council of State.
These members ask the government to give further justification of how the balance between the measures is guaranteed.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering om een nadere onderbouwing te geven hoe het evenwicht tussen de maatregelen gewaarborgd is.
Urges caution, objects strongly to nearly abolishing the sick-pay obligation, and asks for an integral assessment covering all workers.
In particular, the almost complete removal of the sick-pay obligation meets strong objections from these members.
Met name het bijna volledig schrappen van de loondoorbetalingsverplichting stuit bij deze leden op forse bezwaren.
Finds no good balance between encouraging AOW workers and preventing displacement, and asks why the bill is proposed now and whether it is needed.

In summary, the member is of the opinion that with this bill the government has not succeeded in striking a good balance between measures to encourage AOW workers to work on and measures to prevent displacement of non-AOW recipients.

Samenvattend is het genoemde lid van mening dat de regering er met dit wetsvoorstel niet in is geslaagd een goede balans treffen tussen enerzijds maatregelen om het (door)werken van AOW-werknemers te stimuleren en anderzijds om verdringing van niet AOW-gerechtigden tegen te gaan.
Argues that the right to end employment should not be reserved solely to the employer and questions the automatic dismissal at AOW age.
The Klein member believes that encouraging work after the AOW age would only truly be realized if the possibility to end employment were no longer reserved unilaterally to the employer.

Het lid van de Klein-fractie is van mening dat het stimuleren van werken na de AOW-leeftijd... pas echt gerealiseerd zou worden als de mogelijkheid tot beëindiging van het dienstverband niet meer eenzijdig aan de werkgever wordt voorbehouden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised in July 2012 that the bill easing work rules after the AOW (state pension) age was insufficiently justified on necessity and effectiveness, and that the automatic termination of open-ended contracts, the exclusion of the chain-contract rule and the dismissal order for AOW-recipients needed reconsideration. The government's reply (November 2014) accepted several points, moving the termination rule to the Wwz, narrowing the chain-rule exemption to collective agreements and adjusting sick-pay and civil-servant provisions, while maintaining the core of the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling found the need and necessity of the bill insufficiently demonstrated; the government provided data and a CPB analysis but maintained its position.
Automatic termination of open-ended contracts at AOW age was considered disproportionate and was moved to the Wwz with a dismissal-based approach.
Uncertainty about the legal basis of continued employment after automatic termination was addressed by a one-time option and rules for new contracts.
Full exclusion of the chain-contract rule was considered in tension with Directive 1999/70/EC; the government opted for a narrower variant via collective agreement.
Concern about age discrimination and the reduced sick-pay period was accepted as justified, with sick-pay and reinsurance points addressed in the reply.
The reference to 'het gebruik' was removed from Article 7:667 BW and provisions for judicial officials were adjusted.
Ordering of dismissals of AOW-recipients in the Ambtenarenwet was defended by the government, with the Afdeling's suggestion to leave it to sectors not fully adopted.

34082.s: The bill broadens victims' and relatives' right to speak in criminal trials, including allowing relatives of deceased victims and parents or caregivers of minors to speak, and lets the presiding judge restrict speech only where it conflicts with the minor's interest. It also extends the Schadefonds geweldsmisdrijven to relatives of persons killed by traffic offences and extends the claim period from three to ten years.
34082.j: The memorandum justifies the broadened speaking right by evaluation findings that victims often comment on sentencing and that the current limits are unevenly applied, and it rejects a two-phase trial structure.
q: The victim may make a statement at the hearing.
Het slachtoffer kan op de terechtzitting een verklaring afleggen.
d: judge may restrict or deny speaking right of minor victim's representative
presiding judge decides which three relatives may speak
p: Expands the speaking rights of victims and relatives in court, giving citizens a wider voice in criminal proceedings.

parties: Asks how victims can be protected from being unexpectedly questioned as witnesses after making a statement, and how courts will handle statements about sentencing and facts.

However, these members ask how it can be prevented that a victim who uses the speaking right, without having been informed about this, is needlessly made vulnerable, for example by questioning as a witness.

Wel vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden op welke wijze kan worden voorkomen dat een slachtoffer bij gebruikmaking van zijn spreekrecht zonder dat hij hierover is voorgelicht, onnodig kwetsbaar wordt gemaakt door bijvoorbeeld ondervraging als getuige
Supports the bill but asks whether broader victim statements will lead to victims being sworn in as witnesses and whether judges can be influenced on sentencing.
They further ask to what extent the extension of the speaking right to sentencing may lead victims to believe they can actually influence the judge's considerations on sentencing.

Verder vragen zij in hoeverre de uitbreiding van het spreekrecht ook naar de straftoemeting, voor slachtoffers tot gevolg kan hebben dat zij de indruk krijgen dat zij daadwerkelijk de rechter kunnen beïnvloeden
Critical that the government rejected a two-phase trial without adequately weighing the presumption of innocence and judicial impartiality; asks for clarity on when judges may use victim statements.
They lack a clearer vision regarding the presumption of innocence, the independence and impartiality of the judge, as well as the supporting arguments.
Zij missen een duidelijkere visie als het gaat om de onschuldpresumptie, de onafhankelijkheid en de onbevangenheid van de rechter als wel de voorargumenten.
Supports the victim-position aim but asks whether judges must motivate how they took victim statements into account, and whether the bill risks secondary victimisation.

Does the government share the view that precisely because victims can speak about the whole process, judges must take their remarks seriously and can do so by explicitly addressing them in the judgment?

Deelt de regering de mening dat juist omdat slachtoffers zich kunnen uitlaten over het geheel van het proces, de rechter de opmerkingen daarover serieus moeten nemen en dat kan doen door hier expliciet aandacht aan te besteden in zijn vonnis?
Asks whether judges must explain how they took a victim's statement into account, and raises the issue of victims speaking to an absent defendant.
These members ask whether the judge does not have to justify how he took account of the statement of a person entitled to speak.
Deze leden vragen of de rechter niet hoeft te motiveren op welke wijze hij rekening heeft gehouden met de verklaring van een spreekgerechtigde
Questions whether the far-reaching extension serves victims and the trial, and whether risks such as secondary victimisation and prejudice to the defence are adequately addressed.
How can it be prevented that far-reaching statements by the victim at the hearing disproportionately prejudice the defence position of the suspect whose guilt has not yet been established?
Hoe kan worden voorkomen dat vergaande uitspraken van het slachtoffer ter zitting de verdedigingspositie van de verdachte wiens schuld nog niet is komen vast te staan, onevenredig nadelig beïnvloedt?
Asks how disadvantages of broadening the speaking right, including the risk of cross-examination by the defence, were weighed.
These members further ask how the disadvantages of extending the speaking right were weighed.
Voornoemde leden vragen voorts op welke manier de nadelen gewogen zijn, die uitbreiding van het spreekrecht met zich mee brengt.
Asks whether the broader statements raise risks of rough treatment of victims, unrealistic expectations, and victims being called as sworn witnesses.
To what extent is the risk real that the process becomes coarser or that victims are treated discourteously?
In hoeverre is het risico reëel dat het proces verruwt of dat slachtoffers onheus worden bejegend?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against introducing a new advisory right for victims in criminal proceedings, arguing it would create a de facto three-party trial, lacked adequate justification and risked secondary victimisation, and suggested instead extending the existing victim speaking right and widening the Schadefonds geweldsmisdrijven to relatives in traffic cases and extending the filing deadline. The government's reply accepts the advice to drop the advisory right, extends the speaking right, and clarifies the explanatory memorandum on the Schadefonds changes while maintaining the extension to traffic-related and general dood-door-schuld cases and the ten-year deadline.
concerns: The advisory division held that giving victims advisory rights on guilt and sentence would unduly suggest the prosecution and judges cannot weigh victims' interests, and the government accepted this by dropping the advisory right.
The advisory division warned the proposal risked secondary victimisation and placing victims in a vulnerable position, and the government withdrew the advisory right in response.

The advisory division found the justification for the proposal inadequate and its effectiveness doubtful; the government dropped the proposal but kept its own reasoning that the speaking right should be broadened.

The advisory division considered the limitation of Schadefonds compensation to traffic-related deaths unequal treatment versus dood door schuld outside traffic, which the government did not accept but clarified in the memorandum.

The advisory division found the extension of the Schadefonds filing deadline from three to ten years insufficiently motivated, and the government supplemented the explanation without changing the period.

34109.s: The bill consolidates Dutch cultural heritage law into a single Erfgoedwet, covering management of the state art collection, protection designations for monuments, cultural goods and collections, archaeology certification, international restitution, subsidies, and enforcement. It replaces the archaeological excavation permit with a certification system run by accredited bodies and gives the Minister of OCW oversight and direct enforcement powers over anyone holding state collections.
34109.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for a single, clear and modernised heritage framework and for sector self-regulation in archaeology.
d: Minister may entrust an institution with managing museum collections
rules on management of state museum collections
rules on certification, professional excavation and certifying bodies
rules for subsidy grants for heritage
p: The Minister may take over management of state collections from holders and issue binding directions when preservation is at risk.
Owners of protected cultural goods must notify before moving, selling or lending them, subjecting transactions to ministerial consent.
The Minister may designate monuments as national monuments on his own initiative after consulting municipalities and owners.
Excavation is prohibited without a certificate, with certification delegated to accredited private bodies under ministerial oversight.
Inspectors may enter homes without the occupant's consent and require production of protected goods.

parties: Asks whether the bill reduces rules and bureaucracy and how the Archiefwet interacts with the new act.
Does this bill also lead to fewer rules, unclarities and bureaucracy?
Zorgt dit wetsvoorstel ook voor minder regels, onduidelijkheden en bureaucratie?
Supports the single act but asks whether the Raad voor Cultuur will assess collection management against presentation plans and whether regional heritage is protected.
These members do see an important link between presentation policy and collection management.
Wel zien deze leden een belangrijke samenhang tussen presentatiebeleid en collectiebeheer.
Asks who is ultimately responsible for protecting monuments now decided at municipal level and how fragmentation is prevented.
How is fragmentation and unclarity about responsibilities and tasks prevented?
Op welke wijze wordt versnippering en onduidelijkheid over verantwoordelijkheden en taken voorkomen?
Asks why the Raad voor Cultuur's advisory role on individual designations is dropped and whether appeal against RCE advice is possible.
Is there a possibility to appeal against the RCE's advice, or decisions based on it, they want to know.
Is er een mogelijkheid om tegen het advies van de RCE, of besluiten die daarop gebaseerd zijn, in beroep te gaan, zo willen zij weten.
Questions the removal of independent advice from the Raad and whether the commission for divestment is sufficiently independent and binding.
Does this not remove advice from an independent body, these members want to know.
Valt op deze manier niet de advisering van een onafhankelijke instantie weg, zo willen deze leden weten.
Worries that intangible heritage, cultural landscapes and interiors receive no full protection and may be lost.
Is there a danger that these protection categories will be neglected and thereby disappear?
Bestaat het gevaar dat deze beschermingscategorieën blijven liggen en daarmee verdwijnen?
Asks whether taking over management of state collections is an administrative decision under the Awb and calls for clearer owner duties.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the Erfgoedwet but flags that the proposed advisory procedure for disposing of heritage objects by the state or municipalities lacks sufficient procedural safeguards, since the Minister cannot be informed or appeal the decision. The government reply adds a notification duty in a new article 4.20 and explains why the procedure is limited to public bodies, accepting most redactional remarks while keeping some terms.
concerns: Without procedural safeguards, the disposal of heritage objects may not be sufficiently controlled, and the Minister cannot be informed or appeal; the government added a notification duty in new article 4.20.
The Afdeling asked to explain why the advisory obligation covers only state, provincial and municipal owners; the government explained this in the explanatory memorandum but did not extend the scope.
Redactional remarks were largely adopted, but the term 'college van staat' was kept and some other suggestions were not taken over.

34118.s: The bill allows spouses and registered partners without minor children, who agree on divorce or dissolution, to have it pronounced by a civil registrar instead of a judge, removing mandatory court involvement and mandatory legal assistance. It amends Book 1 and Book 10 of the Civil Code, the Rights of Civil Status Act, the pension equalisation act and the Code of Civil Procedure accordingly.
34118.j: The memorandum justifies the change by arguing that where spouses agree, mandatory judicial involvement is unnecessary and costs citizens time and money, and that a lighter state fits citizens' own responsibility.
q: Where spouses agree on their divorce, mandatory court involvement is in fact not necessary and moreover court involvement costs citizens time and money.

In situaties dat echtgenoten het eens zijn over hun echtscheiding, is die verplichte tussenkomst van de rechter feitelijk niet nodig en bovendien kost tussenkomst van de rechter de burger tijd en geld.
d: Artikel VIII / Artikel 1:152 lid 2 BW (via Artikel I K)
documents to accompany the divorce request before the civil registrar
Artikel IV (Wet rechten burgerlijke stand, lid 3)
fee payable for processing a civil-registrar divorce request
p: Artikel I J and K (1:150, 1:152 BW)
Divorce by mutual agreement without children is moved from judicial pronouncement to a civil registrar, bypassing judicial review of the dissolution of marriage.
The civil registrar decides whether statutory conditions are met and may refuse; the only remedy is an appeal to a court under article 1:27 BW, with no administrative-law appeal.

parties: Asks whether the civil registrar is adequately equipped and whether safeguards such as individual interviews, notary or advocate involvement are needed for complex asset situations.
They ask whether this civil servant is sufficiently equipped to carry out this far-reaching and important legal act properly.
Zij vragen of deze ambtenaar voldoende geëquipeerd is om deze toch verstrekkende en belangrijke rechtshandeling naar behoren uit te voeren.
Supports the simplified procedure but asks for broad public support, good information, and protection of especially vulnerable citizens.

These members also ask for extra attention to the group of particularly vulnerable citizens who, due to various circumstances such as illness, language problems or limited mental capacity, may face greater risks.

Voornoemde leden vragen in dit kader ook extra aandacht voor de groep extra kwetsbare burgers die vanwege allerlei mogelijke omstandigheden, zoals ziekte, taalproblemen of beperkte geestelijke bagage wellicht extra grote risico's lopen.
Warns that without legal advice people may overlook consequences such as housing rights, alimony and survivor pensions, and asks how these risks will be prevented.
What reason does the government have to trust that everyone who needs expert advice for the divorce will themselves recognise this in time?
Welke aanleiding heeft de regering om erop te vertrouwen dat eenieder die bij de echtscheiding deskundig advies nodig heeft, dat zelf ook tijdig zal inzien?
Questions the need and effectiveness of the scheme, fears more later disputes and court workload, and asks about risks to the weaker spouse and children.
Does the government not fear an increase in legal conflicts, especially now that legal intervention will no longer be mandatory for the proposed divorce?
Vreest de regering niet een toename van het aantal juridische conflicten, zeker nu een juridisch interventie bij de voorgestelde echtscheiding niet meer verplicht zal plaatsvinden?
Asks how the civil registrar will perform the advisory role without a convenant, and warns of legal inequality.
Does the government share the view of these members that this creates a risk of legal inequality?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat hierdoor rechtsongelijkheid op de loer ligt?
Supports reducing burden and cost but asks how the registrar can verify voluntariness and whether coerced or weak parties are protected.
This raises the question for these members of how a civil registrar, who is currently not specifically trained for this, will be enabled to test the voluntariness of the declared wish.

Dat roept bij deze leden de vraag op hoe een ambtenaar van de burgerlijke stand, die daartoe momenteel niet specifiek toe is opgeleid, straks in staat gesteld worden om de vrijwilligheid van de verklaarde wens te toetsen.
Worries the weaker partner will be disadvantaged, notes no obligation to show consideration of consequences, and asks about enforceability and pregnancy cases.

Doubts that the bill improves family law, questions whether making divorce easier is desirable, and asks about the registrar's ability to establish voluntariness and about consequences such as alimony and pensions.
Simplifying rules does not automatically mean the rules become better.
Vereenvoudiging van regels betekent niet automatisch dat de regels beter worden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Wet scheiden zonder rechter, which would let civil registrars grant divorces by mutual agreement of spouses without children, and found the proposal should be reconsidered in key respects, notably safeguards over the financial consequences and the registrar's role. The government's reply largely rejected the safeguard demand and the registrar-grants-divorce objection, while adjusting the explanatory memorandum and accepting the redactional comments.
concerns: Vulnerable spouses could lose out in a divorce by the registrar because no safeguard shows whether the financial consequences were considered; the Afdeling advised a safeguard such as a submitted settlement agreement.
Cost and time savings for citizens are insufficient to justify introducing registrar divorce, and the Afdeling advised a sound motivation for it.

The registrar's role in pronouncing the divorce does not fit the registrar's traditional function; the Afdeling advised a ratification model instead, which the government rejected while strengthening the justification.
The statutory requirements for registrar divorce were unclear and the required documents should be set in law or explained; the memorandum was clarified.
Redactional comments on articles 152 of the bill were incorporated into the proposal.

34145.s: The bill shifts the costs of supervision and disciplinary adjudication for notaries, bailiffs and lawyers from the state to their professional bodies, and requires the bodies' budgets and annual reports to be submitted to and approved by the Minister of Security and Justice. It also introduces filing fees for disciplinary complaints and allows disciplinary courts to order complainants' and proceedings' costs against the professional who is found in breach.
34145.j: The memorandum justifies the cost-shifting by the professional groups' primary benefit from supervision and disciplinary law and the need for fiscal restraint, and says the Minister's approval of budgets keeps the courts independent.
q: Responsibility for enforcing and promoting the quality of professional practice by these professional groups lies primarily with those groups themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de handhaving van en het bevorderen van de kwaliteit van de beroepsuitoefening door deze beroepsgroepen ligt immers primair bij deze beroepsgroepen.
d: rules on budget structure and annual report content for disciplinary bodies
rules on budget structure and annual report content for chamber of bailiffs
rules on enforcement of fines and cost orders against bailiffs
Artikel III C (Wet op het notarisambt art. 94a lid 8)
rules on budget structure and annual report content for notarial chambers
Artikel III F (Wet op het notarisambt art. 103c lid 2)
rules on enforcement of fines and cost orders against notaries
Artikel VII A (Wet registermediator art. 26a lid 2)
rules on how registered mediators reimburse disciplinary costs
p: The Minister may change the amount of the complaint filing fee in line with the consumer price index without a legislative amendment.

The Minister approves the disciplinary bodies' budgets and may withhold approval on grounds of legality or the public interest, giving the executive financial leverage over the independent disciplinary courts.

parties: Asks how the professions can influence supervision and whether the professional bodies' informal rights to information and recommendation over supervision can be secured.
Is the government prepared to investigate with the relevant professional organisations how this can be given shape?
Is zij bereid om met de desbetreffende beroepsorganisaties te onderzoeken op welke wijze hier een invulling aan kan worden gegeven?
Questions whether the 50-euro filing fee will deter complaints from citizens and whether it is an effective incentive for informal resolution of disputes.
Will the filing fee not mean that the complaint is not filed at all?
Zal het griffierecht er niet toe leiden dat de klacht helemaal niet meer wordt ingediend?
Argues the state and society benefit from independent professionals, so costs should be shared fairly, and worries the filing fee creates too high a barrier for people with small means.
Does she not fear that by levying a filing fee, mainly for people with small means, it creates too high a threshold to file a complaint, whether founded or not?

Vreest zij niet dat hij met het heffen van een griffierecht voor voornamelijk mensen met een kleine portemonnee een te hoge drempel opwerpt om een klacht in te dienen, of deze nu gegrond of ongegrond is?
Asks for information on the rationale for the cost allocation and on how the parliament will be informed of budget developments in disciplinary adjudication.
Whether it remains guaranteed that through the annual budget statements the government continues to account to the House for the financial state of disciplinary adjudication

Of gewaarborgd blijft dat middels de jaarlijkse begrotingsstaten van Veiligheid en Justitie de regering ook verantwoording naar de Kamer blijft afleggen over de financiële staat van de tuchtrechtspraak
Asks for clarification of the reasons for the change and of plans to extend cost recovery to other professions.
Does the government have plans to harmonise this and also arrive at passing on costs of supervision and disciplinary adjudication to non-legal professions?
Heeft de regering plannen om een en ander te harmoniseren en ook te komen tot het doorberekenen van kosten voor toezicht en tuchtrechtspraak bij de niet juridische beroepsbeoefenaren?
Questions the government's withdrawal from shared responsibility for access to law and the justification based on public finances, and notes the Council of State's criticism.
How does the government justify unilaterally withdrawing from the shared responsibility for honest and high-quality legal services to citizens and businesses?
Hoe rechtvaardigt de regering dat zij zich eenzijdig onttrekt uit de gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid voor een integer en kwalitatieve juridische dienstverlening aan burgers en bedrijven?
Asks for justification for departing from the general principle that enforcement is funded from general revenue and for analysis of the effects of the filing fee on access to justice.

They also ask how it will become clear that any decline in the number of cases is indeed the result of improved quality and not, for example, the contribution of filing fees or another barrier faced by complainants.

Deze leden vragen bovendien hoe duidelijk zal worden dat een eventuele daling van het aantal zaken inderdaad het gevolg is van de verbetering van de kwaliteit en bijvoorbeeld niet door de bijdrage in de griffierechten of een andere drempel die de klager ondervindt.
Asks whether refund of the filing fee should be regulated in the same provision as other costs and about the logic of setting the fee amount in statute.
These members ask why the refund of the filing fee is then included in a different statutory article.
Deze leden vragen waarom de terugbetaling van het griffierecht dan in een ander wetsartikel wordt opgenomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised reconsidering the full pass-through of supervision and disciplinary costs to the legal professions (notaries, bailiffs, lawyers), citing shared public interest, proportionality of the cost levels, unclear scope of 'other costs' in tuchtrecht cost orders, and missing exemptions for the court fee. The government's nader rapport largely defends the pass-through under the Maat houden 2014 framework, clarifies 'other costs', adds a deken/professional-body route to avoid the court fee, and makes technical adjustments.
concerns: Full pass-through of costs to professional groups may be disproportionate given their size and shared public interest; government argues costs are modest relative to turnover and defends the approach.
Advice to reconsider full pass-through of supervision and disciplinary costs; government maintains the profit principle justifies full cost recovery under Maat houden 2014.
The meaning of 'overige kosten' in disciplinary cost orders was unclear; government clarified its scope and the forfait approach.
No exemption from the EUR 50 court fee for complainants facing financial hardship; government points to deken or professional-body referral as an alternative route, and the memorie was supplemented.
Conflicts between the bill and the Wet positie en toezicht advocatuur and redactional points were addressed with samenloop provisions and textual corrections.

34190.s: The bill doubles the absolute administrative fine ceilings (from €450,000 to €900,000) for the Autoriteit Consument en Markt and several sector regulators across numerous statutes, and doubles the ceiling for repeat violations within five years. It also changes the ACM's merger-control thresholds for pension funds and expands the basis for fining with relative percentages of turnover.
34190.j: The memorandum justifies higher fine ceilings by the need for effective, deterrent market supervision and by the erosion of the absolute ceilings through inflation since 2002.
q: The objective is to increase the preventive deterrent effect of ACM supervision and thereby the willingness to comply with the rules.
Doelstelling is wel het vergroten van de preventieve afschrikwekkende werking van het ACM-toezicht en daarmee van de bereidheid tot naleving van de regels.
p: Raises maximum administrative fines that regulators such as the ACM may impose, expanding the executive's sanctioning discretion, while the memorandum states fines must remain proportionate.
Expands the ACM's power to fine market organisations for failing to take sufficient measures to prevent circumvention of seals.

parties: Asks whether a system of relative fine maxima was considered and why higher maxima would not raise fine revenue, and how the ACM applies the principle of not bankrupting offenders in practice.
However, these members ask whether a system with only relative fine maxima was also considered.
Wel vragen deze leden of ook een systeem met alleen relatieve boetemaxima is overwogen?

Asks how the ACM's new approach of norm-transferring talks relates to fining, why the cartel duration cap is four years, and how fines are collected and whether they can be recovered from board members.
Can the fine also be recovered from members of the management board?
Is de boete ook te verhalen op leden van de raad van bestuur?

Notes complaints that the ACM responds slowly to consumer complaints and gives little insight into complaint handling, and proposes raising the relative fine maximum for serious offences to 15 percent.
Through various channels these members have heard that the ACM responds slowly or not at all to consumer complaints and acts on them slowly
Langs verschillende wegen is deze leden ter oren gekomen dat de ACM naar aanleiding niet of traag reageert en handelt op klachten van consumenten

Wants to avoid heavy fines on small entrepreneurs who err while large deliberate fraudsters escape, questions the emphasis on sanction severity over detection probability, and asks about enforceability and capacity.
They wish however to prevent high fines being imposed on small entrepreneurs who act against the law through clumsiness or ignorance
Zij willen echter voorkomen dat er wel hoge boetes worden opgelegd aan kleine ondernemers die door onhandigheid of onwetendheid in strijd met de wet handelen
Welcomes the doubling of the maximum but questions why it was not done earlier, questions the 900,000 euro cap and the four-year limit, and asks whether fines can exceed gains from cartels.
Furthermore these members think it fine that the cartel fine can be multiplied by the number of years, but why is this limited to a maximum period of four years?
Verder vinden deze leden het prima dat de kartelboete verdubbeld kan worden met het aantal jaren, maar waarom wordt dit beperkt tot een maximale periode van vier jaar?
Asks why the absolute maximum is set at 900,000 euro rather than one million, what the added value of a maximum is given proportionality rules, and why the four-year cap exists.
What objection does the government have to removing the four-year maximum?
Welk bezwaar heeft de regering tegen het schrappen van het maximum van vier jaar?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised submitting the bill raising ACM fine maxima, but asked for a substantive justification of the increase for minor infringements (or abandoning it) and for a reasoned defence of the cartel fine increase, which departs from the EU and most Member State maxima. The government reply dropped the increase in the relative maximum for minor infringements, justified the absolute increase by reference to financial supervision and inflation, and defended the cartel increase by arguing that Member States are responsible for their own sanctions.
concerns: The Afdeling found the justification for raising the fine maxima for minor infringements insufficient, since the cited studies do not address whether the current deterrent effect is inadequate.
The comparison with criminal and financial supervision maxima does not hold for minor ACM infringements, so the proposed maxima may not be proportionate.
The proposed cartel fine maximum departs substantially from the EU and most Member State maxima, requiring further justification and possible adjustment.
The Afdeling considered that a higher cartel maximum sits uneasily with the EU aim of convergence, and that the explanatory memorandum hardly addresses this or cross-border enforcement effects.
Technical corrections were made to article 25ma of the Competition Act, a reference in the Railways Act, and article 12m of the ACM Establishment Act.

34200-III.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (Slotwet 2014) that amends the 2014 budget appropriations for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie. It adjusts appropriated amounts to the realised figures and does not create or transfer executive powers.
q: the need has arisen to amend the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet van de Koning en de Commissie van Toezicht

34208.s: The bill implements EU directive 2014/59/EU and regulation (EU) 806/2014 on bank recovery and resolution by amending the Wet op het financieel toezicht and inserting a new Part 3A on resolution of banks and certain investment firms. It creates resolution powers for DNB, early intervention and special administrator powers, and provisions on bail-in, funding via resolution funds, and administrative appeal against curators and special administrators.
34208.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to implement EU requirements for effective bank resolution while preserving legal protection through administrative appeal and expedited court review.
d: ARTIKEL I, Q (Artikel 1:75a, Artikel 3A:8, Artikel 3A:17 etc.)
detailed rules on early intervention and resolution procedures
further rules on write-down and conversion of capital instruments
further rules on issuance of capital or equity instruments
rules on processing personal data for insurer resolution
p: DNB or the ECB may appoint special administrators to replace bank boards and impose structural changes on institutions without prior judicial involvement.

DNB may decide on resolution and write-down of capital instruments with overriding effect over shareholder and corporate-law procedures, subject to a rebuttable presumption that suspension is against the public interest.
Resolution decisions are exempt from shareholder approval and procedural requirements under corporate and financial supervision law.
Contractual termination or enforcement rights of counterparties are suspended in response to supervisory measures.

parties: Asks whether the expedited appeal procedure adequately safeguards legal certainty for shareholders when capital instruments are written down or converted.
Questions why the administrative objection phase is excluded for write-down decisions and why different judicial routes apply to banks and insurers.

The VVD members ask why, for a decision by the resolution authority to write down or convert capital instruments, the administrative objection phase is excluded and only a single-instance appeal is available.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom bij een besluit van de afwikkelautoriteit tot afschrijving of omzetting van de kapitaalsinstrumenten de bestuursrechtelijke bezwaarfase is uitgesloten en staat alleen beroep in één instantie (bij het College van Beroep van het bedrijfsleven)?
Asks the government to explain how parliament will be kept informed of macroprudential risks shared by DNB with the Minister of Finance.
The members stress that for the parliament's controlling role it is important that the House stays as informed as possible about macroprudential risks in the Dutch banking landscape.

De leden benadrukken dat het voor de controlerende rol van de Tweede Kamer van belang is dat de Kamer zoveel mogelijk op de hoogte blijft van de macro-prudentiële risico's in het Nederlandse bankenlandschap.
Asks whether applying bail-in to selected creditors risks becoming too political and asks for all scenarios in which a bail-out could still occur.
Does this not make the whole bail-in too political?
Wordt de hele bail-in op deze wijze niet te politiek?
Asks how the European Court of Auditors can check whether resolution decisions are adequately justified and compliant with regulation.
Can the government clarify how the (European) Court of Auditors can check whether resolution decisions are sufficiently substantiated and comply with the applicable regulation?
Kan de regering duidelijk maken hoe de (Europese) Rekenkamer kan controleren of de besluiten tot afwikkeling voldoende zijn onderbouwd en voldoen aan de daartoe gestelde regelgeving?
Questions the broad discretion of the resolution authority to exclude liabilities from bail-in and asks for clarification of 'widespread contagion'.
These members ask about the discretionary room of the resolution authority and in particular the possibility to exclude liabilities from bail-in when deemed necessary to prevent widespread contagion.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen naar de discretionaire ruimte van de afwikkelingsautoriteit en met name de mogelijkheid om passiva uit te sluiten van bail-in indien dit nodig wordt geacht om een wijdverbreide besmetting te voorkomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Implementation Act for the EU bank recovery and resolution framework (BRRD and SRM Regulation), recommending the bill proceed with changes on Wft transparency, a handbook, Deel 6 scope, MREL, transposition gaps, appeal routes and the Awb. The Minister's nader rapport accepted most points, adding provisions, rewording articles and removing administrative appeal against curators and special administrators while defending some points (e.g., structural Wft review deferred).
concerns: The Wft has become hard to read due to dynamic references and EU regulation; the Afdeling asks for a structural review and a handbook, which the government only partly accepts by deferring a review and adding article headings.

Several transposition gaps and omissions (art. 19(5)(a), 34 employee information, 38(6) consent, 41(1)(g) state aid enforcement, 55 third-country clause) were identified and largely corrected in the bill.

Administrative appeal against curator, special administrator and DNB decisions was questioned as inappropriate for civil-law-type decisions; the government removed or redirected these routes to the civil or administrative judge as advised.

Concerns about the 14-day deadline for decisions and the lex silencio positivo mechanism were addressed by rewording the procedure, though the deadline in the bill was not fully aligned with the Afdeling's wish.

34217.s: The bill moves supervision of compliance with the Metrologiewet and the Waarborgwet 1986 from the private company Verispect BV back to the central government, with officials designated by the Minister and the Agentschap Telecom. It also lets the state pass on inspection costs to the party concerned and reinstates periodic re-verification of measuring instruments.
34217.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for efficient supervision, consistent government policy on public tasks, and fairness in charging costs to the party causing re-inspections.
q: This bill brings supervision of compliance with the Metrologiewet and the Waarborgwet 1986 back into public hands.
Dit wetsvoorstel brengt het toezicht op de naleving van de Metrologiewet en de Waarborgwet 1986 terug in publieke handen
d: period after which periodic re-verification of measuring instruments is required
rules on charging costs of supervisory work to beneficiaries
p: Supervision is taken back into government hands and officials of other ministries may be designated, with additional inspection powers including use of force and reliance on outside experts.
The Minister, instead of the supervisory body, may impose administrative enforcement orders and issue a payment order (dwangbevel) to collect penalty payments without going to court.
Supervisory officials under the Waarborgwet are designated by ministerial decision in place of employees of a designated legal person.
Costs of supervisory work may be charged to the party for whose benefit it is done, with the cost categories to be set in a general administrative order and tariffs in a ministerial regulation.
Artikel I.F en I.G (art. 36 lid 2 en art. 40 lid 2 Metrologiewet)
The obligation to notify the minister of violations and the four-yearly report to parliament on the supervisory body's effectiveness are removed, since the body is no longer separate.

34253.s: The bill strengthens the bankruptcy trustee's (curator's) position to detect and combat bankruptcy fraud, by requiring trustees to report irregularities confidentially to the judge-commissioner and, where needed, to file reports or complaints with competent authorities. It also expands and clarifies the bankrupt's and third parties' duties to provide information, cooperation and access to administrative records, including directors' duties for bankrupt legal entities.
34253.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to combat bankruptcy fraud and social harm, and the subordinate rules on trustee financing by the need for flexibility in practice.
q: If the trustee has identified possible irregularities, he has not only the task of trying to undo their harmful effects on the estate as far as possible, but also an information duty towards the judge-commissioner.

Heeft de curator eventuele onregelmatigheden gesignaleerd, dan heeft hij niet alleen tot taak om te trachten de schadelijke gevolgen hiervan voor de boedel zoveel mogelijk ongedaan te maken, maar geldt tevens een informatieplicht tegenover de rechter-commissaris.
d: Artikel I, D (art. 71, derde lid Fw)
rules on financing of trustee's work
p: Artikel I, B (art. 68, tweede lid Fw)

Trustees must investigate irregularities and report them confidentially to the judge-commissioner and may be required to file reports or complaints with authorities, expanding fraud-detection duties over the bankrupt's affairs.
Artikel I, C (art. 69, eerste lid Fw)
No appeal is available against the trustee's decision whether to report or file a complaint about irregularities.

Bankrupts and their spouses or partners must provide information, cooperation and access to foreign assets and records; third parties must surrender administration and cannot invoke a retention right, with disputes subject to court supervision.

parties: Supports the bill but asks for a reasonableness test so the curator must exhaust other means before requesting information from third parties, and asks for compensation for costs.
They are of the view that it is good to include a reasonableness test in the bill.
Zij zijn van mening dat het goed is als een redelijkheidstoets wordt opgenomen in het wetsvoorstel.
Asks whether the duty on the bankrupt to inform the curator conflicts with the nemo tenetur principle and the right to remain silent, and whether it deters disclosure.
They ask whether, even if there are no legal obstacles, in practice the risk of criminal prosecution could lead the bankrupt to evade the duty to inform the curator of irregularities.

Voornoemde leden vragen of – ook al zouden daar geen juridische belemmeringen toe bestaan – het in de praktijk niet kan betekenen dat de kans op strafrechtelijke vervolging er toe gaat leiden dat de gefailleerde zich gaat onttrekken aan zijn plicht om de curator uit eigen beweging te informeren over onregelmatigheden.
Asks what the curator's added fraud-signalling role adds, how the bankrupt's cooperation is monitored and by whom, and how the costs and workload are financed.
Who checks this, is it also the curator? Or ultimately (also) the rechter-commissaris?
Wie controleert dit, is dit ook de curator? Of uiteindelijk (ook) de rechter-commissaris?

Supports the aim of fighting fraud but doubts the changes will be effective without capacity at OM and police, questions the transitional law's breadth for former directors, and asks about risks to the curator-judge relationship when the rechter-commissaris can order reports.

These members ask whether the government has not proposed too broad a transitional period (Article II) by making this law apply to everyone who was a director or commissioner from entry into force onward, given legal certainty for former directors.

In dat kader vragen deze leden of de regering niet een te ruime periode van overgangsrecht (artikel II) heeft voorgesteld door – vanwege de rechtszekerheid voor voormalig bestuurders – deze wet van toepassing te laten zijn op een ieder die vanaf inwerkingtreding bestuurder of commissaris was.
Asks whether curators currently report too few irregularities and whether the police can handle additional cases.
Is the new information duty towards the rechter-commissaris expected to lead to more reports of crime?
Gaat de nieuwe informatieplicht tegenover de rechter-commissaris naar verwachting leiden tot meer aangiftes?

Asks how the bankrupt and others are protected against undue pressure from the curator, whether the rechter-commissaris has the time and will to supervise critically, and how the nemo tenetur principle is safeguarded.
How is it ensured that the curator's reporting to the authorities, driven by creditors' interests, is not used to exert pressure on the bankrupt and other parties involved in the bankruptcy?

Hoe wordt er bijvoorbeeld voor gezorgd dat het doen van aangifte door de curator vanuit het schuldeisersbelang niet wordt gebruikt om druk uit te oefenen op de gefailleerde en andere betrokkenen bij het faillissement?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill strengthening the curator's fraud-reporting role be sent to parliament, but asked the government to explain why the rechter-commissaris needs a power to order the curator to report or file a complaint, since he can already ask the court to dismiss an uncooperative curator. The minister's reply adds that the new procedure gives legal certainty and transparency and clarifies this in the explanatory memorandum, and the Raad's advice is thus addressed.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether the rechter-commissaris's power to order the curator to report irregularities is necessary given the existing dismissal power under article 73 Fw, and asks for justification.
The explanatory memorandum should explain the procedure under article 68(2) Fw more clearly, which the government did in its reply.

34262.s: The bill inserts a new article 19a into the Handelsregisterwet 2007 allowing an algemene maatregel van bestuur to require that specified documents, such as annual accounts, be deposited with the trade register exclusively electronically, with SBR as the standard. It also replaces 'neerleggen ten kantore van het handelsregister' with 'deponeren bij het handelsregister' across Book 2 BW and the Wet op de formeel buitenlandse vennootschappen.
34262.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying the electronic channel has technical requirements that may change over time and new documents may need designating, so the matter is regulated at amvb level.
q: Because the electronic channel must meet described (technical) requirements and new documents may over time need to be designated, it is proposed to regulate this at the level of an algemene maatregel van bestuur.

Doordat de te gebruiken elektronische weg aan omschreven (technische) eisen dient te voldoen en er voorts in de loop van de tijd behoefte kan ontstaan om nieuwe bescheiden aan te wijzen, wordt voorgesteld dit op het niveau van algemene maatregel van bestuur te regelen.
d: designating entities and documents for exclusive electronic deposit and deposit rules
fixing the first financial year from which electronic deposit applies
whether the Kamer provides support facilities for electronic deposit
entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article

parties: Asks about current deposit percentages by company size, the timing of the free online service for small entities, and whether the cost calculations (zero costs against 68.8 million euro benefits) are correct.
The PvdA members cannot fully follow the calculations on page 11 of the explanatory memorandum.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie kunnen de berekeningen op blz. 11 van de MvT niet helemaal volgen.

Questions the government's criteria for when mandatory SBR use is 'verantwoord', why SBR should be made mandatory at short notice despite low adoption, and why issuing institutions are exempted, and asks for the reasons behind the mandate.
These members ask the government to explain which criteria will be used to assess what is and is not justified.
Deze leden vragen de regering toe te lichten welke criteria gehanteerd zullen worden voor de beoordeling van wat wel en niet verantwoord is.

Asks whether low uptake signals that SBR is the wrong system and whether it should be critically reviewed before making it mandatory, and questions the stated phase-in dates and the legal consequences of refusal.
These members ask whether the low uptake is not precisely a signal to take a critical look at whether this is the right system, rather than proceeding straight to making it mandatory.
Deze leden vragen of het lage gebruik niet juist een signaal is om nog een kritisch te kijken of dit wel het juiste systeem is in plaats van het gelijk overgaan tot het verplicht stellen?
Asks how the online service for small entities will work, whether software is developed or still to be tendered and at what budget, and about innovation and public access to the trade register.
Can the government explain how this online service will work?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe deze online service gaat werken?

34271.s: The bill amends the Telecommunicatiewet to strengthen subscriber protection during network outages (compensation duty), lower switching barriers for small-business subscribers via contract terms, secure continuity of broadcast distribution from antenna sites, and adjust frequency allocation, numbering, cable relocation and supervision rules. It also introduces transitional frequency licences and ministerial powers to temporarily allocate frequencies for public tasks.
34271.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need for practical, technical rules and to ensure continuity of services and broadcasting in a fast-changing market.
q: To avoid imposing disproportionate burdens on providers of electronic communication networks and services, the law allows the ministerial regulation to set how long an outage must minimally last before a compensation duty arises.

Om geen onevenredige lasten op te leggen aan de aanbieders van elektronische communicatienetwerken en diensten voorziet de wet in de mogelijkheid om bij ministeriële regeling aan te geven hoe lang een storing minimaal moet duren voordat er een plicht bestaat tot compensatie.
d: I, onderdeel S (art. 7.1, eerste lid, sub i)
criteria and minimum duration/amount for outage compensation
short-term frequency allocation to public task holders
further rules on transitional frequency licences
security audits, mandatory measures and joint continuity plans for antenna sites
further rules on antenna site continuity
I, onderdeel K (art. 3.17, tweede lid, sub b)
designation of licence uses and durations exempt from automatic renewal
p: The Minister may allocate frequencies for short periods without the usual procedure, subject to a necessity test and conditions set by the Minister.
Provisional frequency allocation before a needs plan is received, lapsing if no plan follows within six weeks, bypassing the normal allocation procedure.
The Minister may impose technical or organisational measures on antenna site providers where the continuity plan is insufficient.
The Minister may compel licence holders to conclude transition agreements and impose additional obligations for service continuity.
Certain frequency licences no longer renew automatically, letting the Minister decide on their extension.

parties: Asks whether the compensation scheme is administratively feasible, how force majeure and DDoS attacks are treated, and whether the minister would keep the scheme for outages caused by WION excavation delays.
Has the government given sufficient consideration to this?
Heeft de regering zich hier voldoende rekenschap van gegeven?
Asks why the outage threshold is 12 hours, whether the compensation rules will be set by ministerial regulation rather than an AMvB, and asks that the regulation be submitted to parliament first.
Can it be assumed that this ministerial regulation or AMvB will first be submitted to the House?
Kan er vanuit worden gegaan dat deze ministeriële regeling of AMvB eerst wordt voorgehangen bij de Kamer?
Asks whether the government will assess the quality of continuity plans for broadcast antenna sites and how regional limits on compensation are verified.
These members would like to know from the government whether it will assess the plans on quality to determine whether continuity is sufficiently guaranteed.
Deze leden vernemen graag van de regering of zij de plannen gaat beoordelen op kwaliteit om vast te stellen of de continuïteit voldoende gegarandeerd wordt.
Asks why a statutory compensation right is needed given earlier ministerial statements, whether regional limits are fair, and whether the business-small-customer exception could be abused.
Why does the current government now consider a statutory right to compensation necessary?
Waarom acht de huidige regering nu een wettelijke recht op compensatie noodzakelijk?
Considers the 12-hour threshold and the one-euro-per-day minimum compensation too lenient, asks for a four-hour threshold, and asks that the polluter-pays principle be enshrined in the law.
Furthermore, as the members previously indicated through the Klever/Gesthuizen motion, they find a 12-hour period far too generous.
Verder vinden de leden zoals al eerder aangegeven middels de motie Klever/Gesthuizen (TK 24 095, nr. 346 ) dat een termijn van 12 uur veel te ruim is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on a draft Telecommunicatiewet amendment bundling cable relocation extension, compensation for outages, switching barriers, internet service suspension, licence extension and spoofing ban, recommending separate bills for the first three and several substantive revisions. The government reply largely accepts the remarks, revising the text on cable relocation, compensation, overmacht, delegation, switching, spoofing and EU law, while declining some points such as statutory licence-extension criteria and a separate bill for spoofing.
concerns: The delegation basis for compensation rules by AMvB was too broad and facultative; the government narrowed it and made it imperative.
Compensation conditions and overmacht relationship needed clarification; the government clarified the text but the overmacht interplay was reworked.
Scope of cable relocation extension exceeded the problem described; the government kept the broader wording with limited justification changes.
Suspension of internet access for threatening subscribers and broad security ground needed justification; the government rewrote the provisions and added proportionality reasoning.
Need for spoofing ban and its addressees was insufficiently motivated; government clarified addressees but did not split the bill.
Discretion for the minister on licence extension lacked statutory clausulation; government kept it in ministerial regulation.
Anticipating a draft EU regulation on switching notice periods was questioned; the government acknowledged changes and justified the early measure.
Various redactional comments on definitions, article structure and transposition tables were largely adopted.

34406.s: The bill extends from seven to nine years the period during which existing designations of military airfields under the Aviation Act keep their validity. It is a transitional extension to allow the new airfield decrees for Eindhoven-area and Woensdrecht sites to be completed.
34406.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by the time needed to complete the new airfield decree procedure, including consultation, environmental impact assessment and Raad van State advice.
q: the present bill aims to extend the transitional period once again
het nu voorliggende voorstel van wet heeft ten doel de overgangstermijn andermaal te verlengen

parties: Asks the government to explain the capacity constraints behind the delays and why a second extension of the transitional period is needed, and what risks and fallback exist.

How realistic does the government consider it that this time all aviation decisions will indeed be established within this new period, given that the intention was also there at the previous extension but was nevertheless not realised?

Hoe realistisch acht de regering het dat ditmaal alle luchtvaartbesluiten wel tot stand gebracht zullen zijn binnen deze nieuwe termijn, gezien dat bij de vorige verlenging ook de bedoeling was maar desalniettemin niet gerealiseerd is?
Asks for concrete explanation of capacity bottlenecks at the Ministry of Defence, whether budget cuts caused them, and whether this is the last extension, noting inconsistency in the memorandum.
The government is not clear on this point.
De regering is op dit punt niet duidelijk.
Asks when the F-35 compatibility with existing noise zoning will be examined, what happens if zoning is insufficient, and asks the government to inform the Chamber.
it must be examined whether the use of the F-35 fits within the existing zoning for air- and ground-based noise.
er moet worden onderzocht of het gebruik van de F-35 past binnen de bestaande zoneringen voor lucht- en grondgebonden geluid.

34424.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2015 tax treaty with Malawi on avoiding double taxation and preventing fiscal evasion on income taxes. It sets the entry-into-force rule and orders publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The Treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Republic of Malawi for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income, concluded in Washington on 19 April 2015, is approved for the European part of the Netherlands.

Artikel 1 Het op 19 april 2015 te Washington tot stand gekomen Verdrag tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Republiek Malawi tot het vermijden van dubbele belasting en het voorkomen van het ontgaan van belasting met betrekking tot belastingen naar het inkomen, waarvan de Engelse tekst is geplaatst in Tractatenblad 2015, 75 , en de vertaling in het Nederlands in Tractatenblad 2016, 16 , wordt goedgekeurd voor het Europese deel van Nederland.

parties: Asks how the treaty differs from OECD and UN model treaties, what changed after the Council of State's remarks, and the budgetary effects for Malawi and the Netherlands.
Which matters in the treaty with Malawi appear neither in the OECD model treaty nor in the UN model treaty, ask the VVD members.
Welke zaken uit het verdrag met Malawi staan noch in het OESO-modelverdrag, noch in het VN-modelverdrag, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Supports the new treaty and anti-abuse clauses but asks about the treaty-less period, tax refunds, and whether a binding arrangement would be preferable to a consultation procedure under BEPS.
The PvdA members ask why the Protocol, Article I, second paragraph, chose a consultation procedure for hybrid entities.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom in artikel I, tweede lid, van het Protocol is gekozen voor een overlegprocedure met betrekking tot hybride entiteiten.

Doubts the revision yields a fairer treaty, questions the choice of main purpose test, asks for regular evaluation and annual reporting, and criticises the absence of parliamentary approval in Malawi.
These members are concerned whether the revision actually leads to a fairer tax treaty.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen of de herziening ook daadwerkelijk leidt tot een eerlijker belastingverdrag.
Asks whether information exchange is automatic and with which countries, and how the treaty provides investment protection.
The CDA members ask the government whether data is exchanged automatically under this treaty or only more extensive exchange on request.

De leden van de fractie van het CDA vragen de regering of op basis van dit verdrag automatisch gegevens worden uitgewisseld of dat slechts verdergaande informatie-uitwisseling dan op verzoek mogelijk is.
Asks what concrete benefit the treaty brings, whether alternatives exist, and whether the treaty creates tax avoidance risks and what the budgetary effects are.
The PVV members ask what concrete advantage concluding a tax treaty with a country like Malawi has for the Netherlands.
Dc leden van de fractie van de PVV vragen welk concreet voordeel heeft het sluiten van een belastingverdrag met een land als Malawi voor Nederland?

Asks why Malawi terminated the old treaty, whether the ActionAid case was addressed, why a main purpose test was chosen over LOB, and calls for civil society input and transparency in future negotiations.
The D66 members refer to the improvement points raised by ActionAid, including greater transparency.
De leden van de D66-fractie verwijzen naar de genoemde verbeterpunten door ActionAid, waaronder meer transparantie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised submitting the bill approving the Netherlands–Malawi double taxation treaty to parliament, but raised remarks on the generic anti-abuse (main purpose test) provisions and on the missing justification for three deviations from the OECD Model. The government's reply accepted the advice, expanded the commentary on the anti-abuse provisions and the three deviations, and corrected the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The generic main purpose anti-abuse provisions lack a stated justification for not using the preferred targeted limitation-on-benefits approach, which the government addressed by supplementing the commentary on article 10(10) and the related interest and royalty articles.

The explanatory memorandum does not explain three deviations from the OECD Model (article 8(3), article 13(4) on recognised stock exchange, and article 26(5)), which the government addressed by supplementing the commentary and agreeing a note exchange defining recognised stock exchange.

The Afdeling asked for consistency between the anti-abuse wording in the treaty and the EU parent-subsidiary directive and the OECD BEPS work, which the commentary did not address; the government did not explicitly respond on this point beyond the general update.

34442.s: The bill inserts new consumer credit provisions (afdeling 2 of title 2A), a new title 2B on goods credit including hire-purchase of movables and immovables, and a new title 2C on loans into Book 7 of the Civil Code, moving rules from the Wet op het consumentenkrediet and the Tijdelijke wet huurkoop onroerende zaken into the Civil Code. It also makes conforming amendments to the Wft, the Wet op de economische delicten, the Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering and the Onteigeningswet.
34442.j: The memorandum justifies the general delegation of maximum credit charges by saying that the Wft already provides for an AMvB on this subject and that consumers benefit from keeping that possibility without a limit.
q: It is not in the interest of the consumer that this possibility be withheld from him.
Het is niet in het belang van de consument dat deze mogelijkheid hem wordt onthouden.
d: maximum permitted credit charge and timing rules
designation of services for service credit
p: Artikel I, D (art. 77 lid 1 onder c, 80, 81)
The bill limits the creditor's ability to demand early repayment and surrender of goods, with exceptions for defaults and a threshold above which some protections do not apply.

parties: Supports reducing and simplifying regulation while asking whether the proposal keeps a reasonable level of consumer protection and whether rules such as spousal consent for instalment purchases would create legal uncertainty.
Besides supporting fewer, simpler and better-aligned rules on this subject, these members also favour maintaining the reasonable level of consumer protection that the Netherlands currently has.

Naast het feit dat de leden van de VVD-fractie voorstander zijn om op dit onderwerp het aantal regels te verminderen, versoepelen en beter op elkaar af te stemmen, zijn deze leden ook voorstander van het handhaven van het redelijke niveau van consumentenbescherming.

Questions whether annual caps on credit charges sufficiently limit long-term revolving credit with bullet repayment, asks for total-cost caps, maximum terms, clarity on incasso costs and early-termination grounds, and disclosure of pledge and retention-of-title risks.
They therefore ask why the maximum credit charge is expressed as an annual amount and why a total maximum charge is not also prescribed by general administrative order.

Zij vragen dan ook waarom de maximale kredietvergoeding een vergoeding op jaarbasis betreft en waarom niet tevens een totale maximale vergoeding per algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt voorgeschreven.

Asks why mandatory law is retained only for consumer credit and whether SMEs face unequal bargaining power, and asks how the safeguards of the former Tijdelijke wet huurkoop and the court's power to modify instalment contracts were weighed against legal uncertainty.
These members ask the government to clearly explain what justification it has for not including this form of mandatory law in the bill.
Deze leden vragen de regering helder uiteen te zetten welke rechtvaardiging zij heeft om deze vorm van dwingend recht niet in het wetsvoorstel over te nemen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised submitting the bill on consumer credit rules to Parliament, but asked the government to give a fuller justification for keeping the €40,000 credit limit for goods credit, or to adapt the bill. The government's reply states that the limit is retained for certain provisions, supplements the explanatory memorandum, and adjusts article 129b.
concerns: The Council found the justification for keeping the €40,000 credit limit insufficient and asked for a fuller reasoned justification or adaptation of the scheme.
The explanatory memorandum was supplemented with a provision-by-provision account of the effects of dropping the limit, and article 129b was adjusted.

34460.s: The bill converts the private foundation Stichting NIWO, which carries out publicly mandated road freight transport tasks, into a statutory public-law independent administrative body with a board and an advisory council, both appointed, suspended and dismissed by the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment. It also gives the Minister approval powers over the regulations and budget, a six-week deadline for approvals, rules on interim budget spending, and powers to take measures if NIWO fails its tasks.
34460.j: The memorandum justifies the new governance and ministerial powers by the aim of improved central government supervision of independent bodies and a balance between autonomy and political steering, citing an Algemene Rekenkamer recommendation.
q: The cabinet therefore considers it desirable and responsible to establish an advisory council which, staffed with expert and experienced persons, ensures balance within the NIWO organisation.
Het kabinet acht het daarom wenselijk en verantwoord om een raad van advies in te stellen die, mits bemenst door deskundige en ervaren personen, voor balans zorgt binnen de organisatie van de NIWO.
d: NIWO internal working regulations, subject to minister approval
Minister taking necessary provisions if NIWO fails a statutory task
Ministerial policy rules on NIWO tasks set under other laws
Minister setting remuneration of advisory council members
p: The Minister may take necessary measures without parliamentary involvement if the minister judges NIWO no longer performs a task properly, after consulting the other responsible minister only.
The Minister alone appoints, suspends and dismisses advisory council members, and the chair is appointed without hearing the council in the first composition.
Ministerial approvals are deemed granted if the Minister does not respond within six weeks.
Until the budget is approved, the board may spend up to 115% of one-twelfth of the prior year's budget per month for up to six months.

parties: The VVD is not yet convinced of the need to convert the NIWO to a public-law zbo, asks what this means for ministerial responsibility, and questions how the change improves governance and efficiency.
What is the difference in ministerial responsibility between a private-law and a public-law zbo?
Wat is het verschil in ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid tussen een privaatrechtelijk en een publiekrechtelijk zbo?
