The CDA questions how results-oriented the government is in reducing the number of zbo's, given the exception made for the NIWO, and finds the motivation for keeping employment conditions unchanged insufficient.
Since an exception is already being made for the NIWO, these members ask how results-oriented the government is regarding reducing the number of zbo's.
Nu voor de NIWO al een uitzondering wordt gemaakt, vragen deze leden hoe resultaatgericht de regering is ten aanzien van de afname van het aantal zbo’s.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises proceeding with the bill converting the private-law Stichting NIWO into a public-law autonomous administrative body, but asks for reasoning on why the status is kept rather than an agency, a clear choice between an advisory council and a supervisory board, a better justification for sector-organisation participation, statutory regulation of the bodies' tasks and powers, and a fixed term for directors. The minister's reply largely accepts these points, adding provisions on tasks of the directorate and advisory council, clarifying that the sector council involves rather than participates, and setting a four-year directorial term with one possible extension.
concerns: The Council asks for a fuller explanation of why NIWO keeps autonomous administrative body status instead of becoming an agency; the reply restates the reasons (sector involvement, cost, turnover threshold) without a full instellingscriteria analysis.

Tasks and powers of the directorate, advisory council and sector council were left to the internal regulation; the Council asks that they be set out in the bill, and the reply adds articles 4.3a and 4.3b.

The Council asks for a clear choice between an advisory council and an independent supervisory board; the reply keeps the advisory council and explains why its advisory tasks include supervisory elements.
The Council says participation of civil-society organisations in the sector council sits uneasily with the Kaderwet's general rule; the reply reframes it as involvement rather than participation.
The Council asks that the bill fix a maximum term for directors; the reply sets a four-year term with one possible extension, in line with the aanwijzingen.

34514.s: The bill streamlines wage-cost subsidy under the Participatiewet by giving municipalities discretion to set wage value and subsidy levels, and makes several related changes to the wage-domain, premium discount, and disability benefit schemes for people with reduced work capacity. It also extends subsidy eligibility to school-leavers with health-related learning barriers and revises transitional rules for young disabled people's income support.
34514.j: The memorandum justifies the new wage-value reassessment mechanism as extra assurance that subsidies reflect actual worker productivity, and states that the removal of residual-capacity assessment is needed because UWV cannot make it.
q: Because it is not possible for UWV to establish the residual earning capacity, this article lapses.
Omdat het voor UWV niet mogelijk is om de resterende verdiencapaciteit vast te stellen, vervalt dit artikel.
d: fixed compensation for employer labour costs
amount of employer labour cost compensation as percentage
p: The municipality (college) decides on wage value reassessment timing in consultation with the employee and employer and adjusts subsidy levels accordingly, expanding administrative discretion over benefit amounts.
ARTIKEL IV (artikel 2:41 and 2:41a, Wet arbeidsongeschiktheidsvoorziening jonggehandicapten)

Removes the UWV assessment of residual earning capacity as a condition for continued income support, replacing it with an objective 20 percent of minimum wage threshold, and removes the five-year application route.

parties: Asks for the motivation behind the 50% flat rate, how municipal-employer agreements are guaranteed, and for a detailed financial account of the Wajong changes.
This flat-rate wage-cost subsidy is set at 50% of the statutory minimum wage (WML). What is the motivation behind this 50%?
Deze forfaitaire loonkostensubsidie is vastgesteld op 50% van het Wettelijk Minimum Loon (WML). Wat is de motivatie achter deze 50%?
Asks how the government will monitor the effect of the flat-rate subsidy and how the instruments of municipalities and UWV will be harmonised.
How will the government monitor the effect of this measure?
Op welke wijze gaat de regering het effect van deze maatregel monitoren?
Worries that financial incentives may lower the recorded wage value of disabled workers and asks who decides on wage value and what role the worker has.
Does the government agree that this measure may lead to a lower wage value for persons with a disability because it is more advantageous for the employer?
Deelt de regering dat deze maatregel kan leiden tot een lagere loonwaarde van personen met een arbeidsbeperking omdat dit voordeliger is voor de werkgever?
Welcomes the reduction of employer burdens and the extension of subsidies to school leavers already in work, asking whether bottlenecks are solved.
They have repeatedly urged the government to reduce the regulatory burden and administrative costs employers face when hiring workers with a disability

Zij hebben er bij de regering meerdere malen op aangedrongen om de regeldruk en de administratieve lasten die werkgevers ervaren bij het in dienst nemen van werknemers met een beperking te verminderen

34523.s: The bill consolidates and modernises the rules on rent prices and the rent commission (huurcommissie) in the Caribbean Netherlands, creating a new Wet maatregelen huurwoningmarkt Caribisch Nederland and amending Book 7a of the Civil Code BES accordingly. It sets up island rent commissions with a chair, members and secretary, gives them binding decision-making power on rent reasonableness, eviction and related disputes, and allows island ordinances to set the quality-rating rules and maximum rent increases.
34523.j: The memorandum justifies island-level ordinances as furthering decentralisation and the practice that evictions need an enforceable title, and says the commission's discretion for atypical dwellings responds to practical needs.
q: In practice it has proven desirable that an irrevocable decision of the rent commission, permitting termination and setting the eviction date, constitutes a title for eviction.

In de praktijk is de wenselijkheid gebleken dat een onherroepelijke beslissing van de huurcommissie, inhoudende toestemming voor opzegging en bepaling van de datum van ontruiming, een titel voor ontruiming oplevert.
d: rules for rating dwelling quality and rent reasonableness per category, and maximum rent increase percentage
rent commission remuneration, rules on rent-setting factors and forms by island ordinance
setting the rent threshold amount and annual indexation by island ordinance
rules on the commission's register and specific rent-setting regulation by island ordinance
p: The rent commission may depart from the published quality-rating rules where the nature of a dwelling warrants it, widening its discretion over tenants and landlords.

An irrevocable commission decision authorising eviction creates an enforceable title without a court judgment, bypassing ordinary judicial enforcement, though an appeal to the Court of First Instance remains open for eight weeks.
The chair and members may enter any dwelling and compel landlords to produce records, using the sterke arm if needed, for investigations within the commission's remit.
Appointment, suspension and dismissal of commission chair and secretary require approval by the Rijksvertegenwoordiger, which may be withheld only for conflict with law or the public interest.

parties: Supports the aim of a sound rental market but is critical of implementation and wants restraint on sending more money and civil servants, insisting responsibility lies with the islands themselves.
Responsibility for good rental housing must lie with the islands themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor goede huurwoningen moet liggen op de eilanden zelf.
Asks how rent commissions can test housing quality and rights of tenants, whether the bill ensures the intended effects, and whether Sint Eustatius agrees, while supporting local tailoring.
These members argue that social tenants should have the right to live in a good-quality home and that this right should be laid down in law.</br>
Deze leden pleiten ervoor dat sociale huurders het recht hebben om in een kwalitatief goed huis te wonen en dat dit recht vastgelegd wordt.

Asks whether the government keeps sufficient responsibility for housing on the BES islands despite subsidiarity, and warns against disproportionate financial effects for tenants, asking for restraint in legislation.
The D66 members ask whether the government, despite the subsidiarity principle, sufficiently keeps in view its responsibility for housing on the BES islands.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of de regering, ondanks het subsidiariteitsbeginsel, voldoende oog houdt voor haar verantwoordelijkheid voor de volkshuisvesting op de BES-eilanden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet maatregelen huurwoningmarkt Caribisch Nederland, raising major concerns about the need for separate rental committees per island, the four-year temporary lease exception, the open-ended termination ground for the rental committee, and the justification of notice periods and commercial property rules. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, revising the committee structure, dropping the open-ended termination ground, fixing notice periods in law, and adding explanation, but kept the temporary lease and port/airport exception with added justification.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether a separate rental committee per public body is necessary and efficient; the government kept a committee per island but staffed by a Dutch chair initially, with local takeover later.
The Afdeling asked that the notice period be set in law rather than left to local custom; the government adopted fixed notice periods in the act.
The open-ended ground allowing the rental committee to end tenancies in special cases conflicted with the limitative termination grounds; the government removed it.
The wide exception for temporary leases up to four years weakens tenant protection; the government added justification but retained the exception.
The Afdeling asked for justification for applying the same termination rules to commercial premises as to housing; the explanatory memorandum was expanded.
The Afdeling asked for clearer reasoning on legislative restraint and on the division between central and local regulation in the medebewind structure; the memorandum was supplemented.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of the broadened delegation basis for island housing ordinances covering purchase of homes; the memorandum was amended to explain it.
The Afdeling made several redactional comments on structure and cross-references, largely adopted by the government.

34532.s: The bill introduces a phosphate rights system (fosfaatrechten) capping phosphate production by dairy cattle at farm level, with new prohibitions on exceeding those rights and on keeping excess dairy cows. It also lets the Minister assign alternative calculation methods, impose a generic cut of phosphate rights by general administrative order (AMvB), and grant exemptions by ministerial regulation.
34532.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to meet nitrate directive targets and the derogation conditions, and to allow case-specific adjustment while the sector's compliance systems are not yet secured.
q: For that reason, phosphate rights are allocated on the basis of the number of dairy cattle held on the reference date of 2 July 2015.
Om die reden toegekend op basis van het aantal gehouden stuks melkvee op de peildatum van 2 juli 2015.
d: alternative method for calculating manure production by dairy cattle
setting daily herd-size ceilings for farms exceeding phosphate rights
determining initial phosphate rights, adjustments for takeovers and exceptional circumstances
rules for converting pig, poultry and phosphate rights
generic percentage reduction of production rights to meet international obligations
exemptions from the phosphate rights prohibition under conditions
p: The Minister may approve an alternative method for determining farms' manure production, subject to conditions set by ministerial regulation and a compliance-with-international-obligations test.
The Minister may set binding daily cow-number ceilings for individual farms that exceed their phosphate rights, with objection and appeal to the administrative court available.
The Minister determines each farm's phosphate rights based on the 2 July 2015 herd and may decide on hardship adjustments, with appeal open to the Business Appeals Tribunal.
An AMvB may impose a generic percentage cut on pig, poultry and phosphate rights, with the percentage fixed later by a separate administrative decision and no parliamentary approval required.
The Minister may grant exemptions from the phosphate rights prohibition for land-bound, sustainable or young farmers under conditions set by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks the government to justify the production-limiting measures, provide impact analysis and clear evidence, and clarify the sanction and the Kringloopwijzer conditions.
Can the government explain why production-limiting measures must contribute to achieving environmental targets for groundwater and surface water?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom productie begrenzende maatregelen een bijdrage moeten leveren aan de realisatie van milieudoelen voor het grond- en oppervlaktewater?
Has further questions and remarks for the government without stating a clear position.
The said members have some further questions and remarks and request the government to respond to them.
De genoemde leden hebben nog enkele vragen en opmerkingen en verzoeken de regering daarop in te gaan.
Objects to the tradability of phosphate rights and says the bill fails to respect two adopted motions protecting grondgebonden and organic farmers.
Furthermore, these members object to the tradability of the phosphate rights.
Voorts maken deze leden bezwaar tegen de verhandelbaarheid van de fosfaatrechten.
Asks for an end date or evaluation moment, openness in negotiations with the Commission, and questions the legal sustainability of the generic cut and state takeover of rights.

However, they still have many questions about whether the generic reduction and deduction on transfer can be less intrusive, about the legal sustainability of the way ownership passes to the government, and about the absence of an end date or evaluation moment.

Zij hebben echter nog veel vragen over of de wijze van generiek korten en afromen bij overdracht en of dit niet minder ingrijpend kan, over de juridische houdbaarheid van de wijze waarop eigendom in handen overgaat van de overheid en over het ontbreken van een einddatum of evaluatiemoment.
Sees the need for legislation but questions how the bill is elaborated and asks whether the wet verantwoorde groei remains justifiable.
These members see the need for legislation but still have some questions about the way this is worked out in the proposal.
Deze leden zien de noodzaak om tot wetgeving te komen, maar hebben nog enige vragen over deze wijze waarop dit in het voorstel tot uitwerking komt.
Finds the bill painful but necessary, asks about guarantees for the derogation, an end date, and consolidating the manure laws into one bill.
They find the present bill painful but also necessary to bring phosphate production under the ceiling and preserve the derogation after the abolition of milk quotas in 2015.
Zij vinden voorliggende wet pijnlijk, maar ook noodzakelijk om de fosfaatproductie onder het plafond te krijgen en de derogatie te behouden, na het wegvallen van de melkquotering in 2015.
Regrets that the government again uses patchwork measures and keeps dairy farmers in uncertainty, and questions raising the phosphate ceiling in Europe.
These members regret that the government has once again missed the opportunity to make a shift towards sustainable dairy farming.
Deze leden betreuren het dat de regering wederom de kans heeft laten liggen om een omslag te maken naar een duurzame melkveehouderij.
Says property rights of dairy farmers and the Raad van State criticism are not respected, and asks for a concrete end date and fair allocation of rights.
They find that the property rights of dairy farmers and the criticism of the Raad van State on this point are not respected.
Deze leden vinden ook dat geen recht wordt gedaan aan de eigendomsrechten van melkveehouders en de kritiek van Raad van State hieromtrent.
Argues the bill is an ad hoc repair that will not solve the fundamental problems and calls for halving the livestock stock and mandatory grazing.
This is yet another bill aimed at ad hoc repair of manure policy to address the consequences of the large manure surplus.
Dit is het zoveelste wetsvoorstel gericht op ad hoc reparatie van het mestbeleid om de gevolgen van het grote mestoverschot het hoofd te bieden.

Asks whether the amended bill must go back to the Council of State and questions the notification procedure, while stressing that parliament needs a voorhang procedure to exercise oversight over the AMvB setting the generic cut.
By excluding a pre- or post-hang procedure, parliament cannot adequately perform its oversight task and is unable to act on a possible infringement by the generic cut.

Door het uitsluiten van een voorhang- of nahangprocedure kan het parlement haar controlerende taak onvoldoende uitvoeren en is zij niet in staat op mogelijke inbreuk van de generieke korting te acteren.
Asks for a timeline on the regulation of the phosphate bank and whether parliament will be involved further.
These members ask the government whether it can estimate when the regulations on the phosphate bank will be sufficiently developed for these questions to be answered.

De genoemde leden vragen de regering of zij een inschatting kan geven wanneer er in zoverre invulling aan de regelgeving omtrent de fosfaatbank is gegeven dat deze vragen wel beantwoord kunnen worden.
Expresses concern about long-standing uncertainty for dairy farmers and the layering of regulation.
These members deplore the uncertainty that has existed for dairy farmers for so long and the impenetrable layering of regulation that has arisen in recent years.
Deze leden betreuren de onduidelijkheid die nu al zo lang voor melkveehouders bestaat en de onnavolgbare stapeling van regelgeving die de afgelopen jaren is ontstaan.
Asks whether the proposed approach for livestock rights will lead to lawsuits and burden the legal system, and requests disclosure of Landsadvocaat advice.
The approach now proposed will lead to various lawsuits and burden the legal system.
De nu voorgestelde werkwijze gaat leiden tot diverse rechtszaken en belasting van het rechtsapparaat.
Expresses surprise at the amendment note and the accompanying letter and asks questions about it.
They wish to ask questions about this.
Questions the government's confidence in the derogation and the Commission position, and presses for protection of hardship cases such as young farmers with a sound business.
It is surely not explainable that sound businesses of mostly young dairy farmers are financially threatened with collapse, while they have no part in the situation that arose.
Het is toch niet uit te leggen dat gezonde bedrijven van – veelal jonge – melkveehouders financieel dreigen om te vallen, terwijl ze part noch deel hebben aan de ontstane situatie.
Expresses surprise that the proposed system is now seen as unlawful state aid and regrets the resulting delay until 2018.
Moreover, these members regret that the bill is again delayed as a result and the system will not take effect until 2018.
Daarnaast betreuren deze leden dat hierdoor het wetsvoorstel wederom vertraging oploopt en het stelsel pas in 2018 in werking zal treden.

Criticises the narrowness of the hardship regulation, argues the government should itself determine individual and disproportionate burdens rather than refer farmers to the courts, and asks for an end date and disclosure of the Landsadvocaat advice.
Does the government share the view of the SGP members that simply referring these businesses to the courts amounts to 'sort it out yourself'?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de SGP-fractie dat het simpelweg doorverwijzen van deze bedrijven naar de rechter neerkomt op «zoek het zelf maar uit».

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises sending the bill introducing a phosphate rights system (fosfaatrechten) in the Meststoffenwet to parliament, but asks for further justification and amendments on several property-protection points (renovated barns, melkveefosfaatruimte differentiation, generic and transfer deductions, delegation scope, livestock for meat, dagplafond). The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adding justification, amending the delegation provision and the dagplafond wording, but maintains its position on the unused production space, the transfer deduction, and the differentiation by grassland-bound status.
concerns: Property protection under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR requires a fair-balance test for the phosphate rights regime, including exclusion of latent space and expansion after the reference date; the government added renovation-related hardship provisions but rejected counting unused production space.

The differentiated generic deduction favouring farms with melkveefosfaatruimte may violate fair balance toward intensive farms; the government maintains the difference is justified by environmental and animal welfare grounds, to be assessed in the implementing decree.

The 10% transfer deduction without time limit after generic deduction needs its own fair-balance justification and alternatives; the government argues phosphate rights carry no independent ECHR property protection and later justifies the fosfaatbank under EU law.
Guarantee that already-held dairy cattle need not be culled under generic deduction was unexplained; the government will address it in the implementing decree, considering typical herd turnover.

The delegation for converting production rights into pig, poultry or phosphate rights lacked limits; the bill now limits conversion to consent of the holder and no increase in nitrogen, phosphate or particulate emissions.

The definition of dairy cattle may cover young stock for beef, which the Council found unintended; the government explains the definition deliberately follows the Meststoffenwet to capture young stock replacing dairy cows.
The dagplafond provision was broader than the explanatory memorandum, which referred to repeated violations; the memorandum was aligned with the text to allow a first-time ceiling.
The explanatory memorandum did not justify choosing a phosphate rights system over dairy or animal rights; a short justification was added in paragraph 4.1.

34550-IIA.s: This bill adopts the 2017 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Staten-Generaal, setting appropriations and receipts for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer, interparliamentary activities and the non-policy article in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force rule tied to 1 January 2017 and the Minister of Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties as responsible for the budget.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for the year 2017 attached to this law is hereby adopted.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34622.s: The bill amends Book 8 of the Dutch Civil Code to implement the 2012 Strasbourg Convention on limitation of liability in inland navigation, including excluding house-boats classed as buildings under the Housing Act and adding a definition of dangerous substance. It also provides that the new rules apply only to accidents after entry into force and that the entry-into-force date is set by royal decree.
34622.j: The memorandum justifies the dangerous-substance delegation by saying the list of substances is subject to change, so it is placed in an general administrative order rather than the statute.
q: This choice was made because the list of dangerous substances is subject to change.
Hier is voor gekozen omdat de lijst met gevaarlijke stoffen voor wijziging vatbaar is.

34730-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the States General (IIA), adjusting appropriations for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and related items by a first supplementary budget, effective from 1 June 2017. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift power between the executive and the checks on it.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2017.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2017.

34775-J.s: The bill establishes the 2018 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, setting planned expenditure and revenue of about EUR 1.119 billion in thousands of euros. It also sets out the multi-year budget tables and annexes for the fund's investment articles, including the experimentation article under the Deltawet.
34775-J.j: The memorandum justifies the experimentation article as enabling integrated implementation of the Delta Programme and integrated financing, conditional on additional funding from other budgets or third parties.
q: The condition, however, is that these measures are linked to measures for water safety or fresh water supply and that there is additional financing from other budgets of the Treasury or third parties.
Voorwaarde is wel dat deze maatregelen samenhangen met maatregelen ten behoeve van waterveiligheid of zoetwatervoorziening en dat er sprake is van additionele financiering
d: use of Deltafonds money for measures in other policy fields

34802.s: The bill inserts a new title 8.2A into the Aviation Act setting out tariff and condition rules for non-Schiphol airports handling more than five million passenger movements a year, including reasonableness, non-discrimination and consultation duties and a complaint procedure before the Authority for Consumers and Markets. It also lets the Minister designate airport networks and allow common tariff systems, and extends existing enforcement provisions to these airports.
34802.j: The memorandum justifies the new title as implementing an EU airport charges directive for airports above five million passengers and aligning with the Council of State's advice.
q: For that reason it is proposed to include the implementation of the airport charges directive for other airports exceeding five million passengers per year in a separate title.

Om die reden wordt voorgesteld de implementatie van de richtlijn luchthavengelden voor overige luchthavens die de grens van vijf miljoen passagiers per jaar overschrijden op te nemen in een aparte titel
d: activities subject to tariffs, notice timing, tariff set-up and effective dates
notice and consultation procedure, quality indicators, data required in tariff proposals
tariff complaint request to the regulator and tariff setting after decision
airport operator sets criteria for tailored services and dedicated terminal requests
Minister designates airport networks and permits common tariff systems
p: The Minister may designate airport networks and authorise common tariff systems for airports serving the same city or agglomeration, with few stated criteria.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets reviews airport operator decisions on user requests and can require a new decision within four weeks.

parties: Asks when Eindhoven Airport will exceed the 5 million passenger threshold, whether the directive actually creates a level playing field, how charges compare with Belgium and Germany, and how many FTE the measure requires.
Wanneer valt die overschrijding te verwachten?
Asks for a breakdown of the concrete financial effects of the bill per airport, covering airport charges, tariffs and administrative costs, and whether these pass through to ticket prices.
They would like to see a breakdown of both the effects on airport charges and tariffs and the administrative costs.
Zij zien daarbij graag een uitsplitsing van zowel de gevolgen voor de luchthavengelden en -tarieven als de administratieve kosten.

Questions the government's reasoning on competitiveness effects, the unexplained absence of a tariff-setting title, the scope of tariff differentiation, and the omission of cost-orientation for security activities, asking the government to clarify these points.
Can the government clear up this lack of clarity by explaining why no additional title for setting the tariffs has been included in the bill?
Kan de regering deze onduidelijkheid wegnemen door toe te lichten waarom voor het vaststellen van de tarieven geen aanvullende titel is opgenomen in het wetsvoorstel?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill completing the implementation of the airport charges directive for airports other than Schiphol, but objects to the form chosen, which treats generally applicable rules as transitional law and relies on references to repealed provisions, and advises an accessible general title and rapid entry into force. The government's reply largely adopts this, inserting a new title 8.2a in the Wet luchtvaart, while not following the advice to combine all airports in one title because of coherence with Schiphol-specific rules, and promising quick entry into force after the Besluit exploitatie luchthaven Schiphol 2017 is amended.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the rules for non-Schiphol airports are framed as transitional law via references to repealed provisions, which undermines accessible legislation; the government adds a new title 8.2a but does not restructure into a single general title with an additional Schiphol title.

The Afdeling advises that the conditional entry into force tied to actual passenger numbers at Eindhoven is inappropriate and that the repair should enter into force as soon as possible after promulgation; the government accepts prompt entry into force, tied to the amended Schiphol decree.

34901.s: This incidental supplementary budget bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, adding amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the budget figures, states the entry-into-force rules, and is accompanied by a brief memorandum on extra oversight funding for geothermal activities.
34901.j: The memorandum justifies the extra budget for State Supervision of the Mines (SodM) by the additional oversight demands of geothermal energy activities.
q: The extra activities in the field of geothermal energy (see explanation under article 4) require extra supervision by the supervisory body State Supervision of the Mines (SodM).
De extra activiteiten op het gebied van aardwarmte (zie toelichting onder artikel 4) vragen om extra toezicht door de toezichthouder Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM).

34910.s: The bill replaces the Wet toezicht trustkantoren to tighten integrity and sound business conduct rules for trust offices, strengthen client due diligence, and expand the Nederlandsche Bank's supervisory and enforcement powers. It sets out licensing, client investigation duties, record-keeping, and new sanctions including a temporary ban on holding policy-making positions.
34910.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the new powers by pointing to supervisory experience, FATF recommendations and EU anti-money-laundering directive requirements.
q: The norms trust offices must meet are being tightened and the instruments De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. (DNB) can deploy as supervisor are being expanded.
De normen waaraan trustkantoren moeten voldoen worden aangescherpt en het instrumentarium dat De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. (DNB) als toezichthouder kan inzetten wordt uitgebreid.
d: designating states whose trust office supervision is adequate
rules on establishing reliability of persons and relevant offences
detailed rules on integrity and sound business operations
designating additional services as trust services
special measures for high-risk third countries
amounts of administrative fines by category
p: The Nederlandsche Bank is given broad risk-based discretion and policy rules on how it assesses trust offices' compliance and reputational risk.
The Nederlandsche Bank gains power to impose fines, including turnover- and gain-based fines, and penalty payments, enlarging its sanctioning discretion.
The Nederlandsche Bank may demand information from anyone and share it with domestic and foreign authorities.
A temporary ban on holding policy-making positions can be imposed on individuals by the supervisor.

parties: Asks whether open norms in the bill will create legal uncertainty when DNB fills them in via policy rules, and whether the internal compliance requirement is proportionate.
The VVD members fear the legal uncertainty this will bring and understand that the government wants to address it by having DNB draft procedural policy rules.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vrezen de rechtsonzekerheid die dit mee zal brengen en begrijpen dat de regering die wil ondervangen door DNB procedurele beleidsregels op te laten stellen.
Asks technical questions on penalty levels, the one-year ban on policymaking roles, and the exclusion of tax return filing from the advice ban.
The PVV members want to know why it was not chosen to make the ban on holding a policymaking function last longer than one year.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten waarom er niet voor gekozen is om het verbod om een beleidsbepalende functie te bekleden langer dan voor een jaar te laten gelden.
Supports the tougher approach and asks how DNB's publication balancing and the inspanningsverplichting in due diligence will be checked and evaluated.
The CDA members support the extension of DNB's publication powers.
De leden van de CDA-fractie steunen de uitbreiding van de publicatiebevoegdheid van DNB.
Welcomes stricter rules but questions the risk-based approach to due diligence, the scope of information sharing and the proportionality of expanded PEP definitions.
Why is a risk-based approach chosen, given the recent integrity issues and the importance of restoring trust in this sector?
Waarom wordt een risicogebaseerde benadering verkozen, gezien de recente integriteitskwesties en het belang van het terugbrengen van vertrouwen in deze sector?
Fears the bill will only patch symptoms, asks for many delegated rules to be pre-published, questions DNB's supervisory capacity and calls for permanent bans and automatic publication of violations.
They fear, however, that tightening certain rules and expanding DNB's supervisory instruments will prove to be mopping with the tap running.
Zij vrezen echter dat het aanscherpen van bepaalde regels en het uitbreiden van het toezichtinstrumentarium van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) dweilen met de kraan open zal blijken te zijn.
Strongly supports the bill as overdue, stressing the gatekeeper role and asking how the two-policymaker and compliance requirements work in practice rather than on paper.
This bill therefore certainly does not come too early and can count on the hearty support of the PvdA members.
Onderhavig wetsvoorstel komt daarom zeker niet te vroeg, en kan rekenen op hartelijke steun van de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Asks whether DNB policy rules on the open norms already exist, how compliance with the inspanningsverplichting will be checked, and whether a specific evaluation is planned.
The DENK members ask whether there are currently policy rules for filling in the open norms in the Wtt 2018.
De leden van de DENK-fractie vragen of er momenteel al beleidsregels zijn voor de invulling van de open normstelling in de Wtt 2018.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, which tightens norms for trust offices and expands DNB's supervisory tools, flagging open norms, lack of a reporting duty to Parliament, missing legal basis for sharing criminal data, and EU free-services concerns. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adding a duty to issue policy rules, a criminal-data legal basis, a tax-advice ban clarification, and an evaluation clause, while defending the existing Kaderwet reporting regime and rejecting a mandatory pre-enforcement concretisation procedure.
concerns: Open norms such as maatschappelijke betamelijkheid create uncertainty; the government added a duty for DNB to issue policy rules but did not adopt a mandatory pre-enforcement concretisation procedure.

The Afdeling asked for adequate public reporting and accountability by DNB to Parliament; the government relied on the Kaderwet reporting duty and rejected reinstating the Wtt article 18 annual report.
Legal protection requires advance clarity before punitive sanctions for open norms; the government pointed to lex certa and proportionality rather than a statutory procedure.
Legal basis for exchanging criminal-law personal data between trust offices was missing and has been added in article 68.
The tax-advice ban lacked analysis of effectiveness and enforceability; the government narrowed the provision and expanded the explanatory memorandum.

Free movement of services and the Dienstenrichtlijn required justification of extra rules for foreign trust offices; an exemption for equivalent licences was added while the financial-services exclusion was explained.
The Afdeling recommended a statutory evaluation after some years, given the open norms and evolving international tax practice; an evaluation clause was added.

35009.s: The bill adds a legal basis to the Kaderwet subsidies Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken allowing subsidies to be conditional on non-purpose criteria such as remuneration policy, integrity, human rights and environmental impact, with further criteria to be set by general administrative order. It also deletes a provision in article 5, paragraph 3 of that law.
35009.j: The memorandum justifies the new criteria by the wish to anchor previously used criteria in law after a Council of State ruling on misuse of power, and the general administrative order allows flexibility for future public interests.
q: In addition, the bill offers, for reasons of flexibility, a basis to set threshold criteria by general administrative order to protect public interests.
Daarnaast biedt het wetsvoorstel uit oogpunt van flexibiliteit een grondslag om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur drempelcriteria vast te stellen ter bescherming van publieke belangen
d: further assessment criteria for subsidy grants in the public interest
p: Allows the minister to make subsidy conditional on non-purpose criteria, partly set by general administrative order, expanding discretion beyond the subsidy purpose.
Deletes a provision of article 5 of the subsidy law, removing one statutory rule on the subsidy framework.

parties: The VVD wants parliament to be actively informed about and involved in changes to subsidy criteria set by ministerial decree, since this reduces parliament's role compared with setting criteria by statute.
However, this does limit the room for the House of Representatives, as co-legislator, to be involved to the same degree as if the relevant criteria were fully laid down by statute.
Dit beperkt echter wel de ruimte voor de Tweede Kamer, de medewetgever, om in dezelfde mate betrokken te zijn als wanneer de desbetreffende criteria volledig bij wet zouden worden vastgelegd.
The D66 fractie supports the bill's aim and the measures the government will take and raises no further questions.
The said members support the aim of this bill and the measures the government will take as a result of the amendment.
De genoemde leden steunen het doel van dit wetsvoorstel en de maatregelen die zullen worden genomen door de regering als gevolg van de wetswijziging.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill introducing non-goal-related subsidy criteria in the Kaderwet subsidies Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is acceptable only after the delegation basis is narrowed, since the phrase on assessment criteria not serving the subsidy purpose is unbounded. The minister's reply reports that the bill was amended as advised, with the delegation narrowed and the memorie van toelichting brought into line.
concerns: The delegation basis for assessment criteria not serving the subsidy goal is unbounded and must be narrowed to the criteria stated in the explanatory memorandum and similar essential public interests set by amvb.

35027.s: This bill makes technical amendments to several Dutch tax and related laws for 2019, including ministry name updates, extending the pleegvergoeding exemption horizon to 2020, adding a legal basis for the tax authority to process licence-plate data for motor vehicle tax enforcement, and introducing new collection powers against liquidated companies and beneficiaries of detrimental transactions. The explanatory memorandum justifies these as necessary to close enforcement gaps, with safeguards such as an AMvB subject to parliamentary veto and judicial review of assessments.
35027.j: The memorandum justifies the new collection and camera powers by citing enforcement gaps, the need for legal certainty after court rulings, and the need to prevent misuse of tax facilities, while noting the appeal rights available against assessments.
q: To remove any ambiguity and create legal certainty, the cabinet explicitly provides in this proposal that the Tax Administration may process licence-plate data for supervising and enforcing the Motor Vehicle Tax Act 1994.

5 Om iedere onduidelijkheid te voorkomen en zekerheid te scheppen regelt het kabinet met dit voorstel expliciet dat de Belastingdienst 6 voor het toezicht op en de handhaving van de Wet MRB 1994 de kentekengegevens kan verwerken.
d: rules on use of technical devices and processing of licence-plate data
procedure, content and submission of permit applications and decisions under the waste shipment levy
detailed implementing rules for the waste shipment levy
detailed implementing rules on the applicable lowest tariff
p: Authorises the tax inspector to capture and process licence-plate data with cameras for monitoring motor vehicle tax compliance, with deletion within seven working days and rules set by AMvB.
Artikel XII.A en XII.C (artikelen 8 en 33a IW 1990)

Allows publication of assessments against dissolved companies via the public prosecutor and extends joint liability to beneficiaries of detrimental transactions, subject to a rebuttable presumption and appeal rights.
Gives the Minister power to issue decisions ex officio and impose penalty payments on waste shipment permit holders, with general administrative law applying.
Extends the collection limitation period interruption to presumed dissolved taxpayers via written notice.

parties: Asks detailed questions on the legal basis, proportionality, storage, purpose limitation and costs of ANPR camera use, and on whether good-faith heirs will be worse off.
Why is the use of automatic number plate recognition (ANPR) regulated in this law?
Waarom wordt het gebruik van automatische kentekenplaatherkenning (ANPR) in deze wet geregeld?
Supports ANPR as effective but questions whether the 24-hour deletion rule is adequate, asks how parliament can check GDPR compliance, and asks about safeguards against wrongful heir liability.
These members ask the government, however, how the House can verify whether a scheme meets the requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Deze leden vragen de regering echter hoe de Kamer kan controleren of een regeling voldoet aan de eisen van de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (AVG).
Worries that collection measures may affect legal certainty, legal protection and privacy of taxpayers and asks how proportionality is monitored, including retention periods for ANPR data.
At the same time, they ask how the government monitors that these collection measures will be proportionate.
Tegelijkertijd vragen zij hoe de regering monitort dat deze invorderingsmaatregelen proportioneel zullen zijn.
Supports tackling tax-avoidance constructions but asks about the number of cases, the revenue at stake, the retroactivity limitation and the extent of heirs' liability.
It is important that taxes owed can be collected more efficiently and more often.
Het is belangrijk dat verschuldigde belasting efficiënter en vaker geïnd kan worden.
Questions the necessity and proportionality of ANPR data collection while the Tax Authority does not yet comply with GDPR, and asks for the Privacy Barometer's objections to be addressed.
The SP members note that through this measure the Tax Authority will collect privacy-sensitive information while the service itself does not yet comply with the GDPR.
De leden van de SP-fractie merken op dat de Belastingdienst door deze maatregel privacygevoelige informatie gaat vergaren terwijl de dienst zelf nog niet voldoet aan de AVG.
Asks how long ANPR data is retained and how other European countries regulate this.
The PvdA members ask how long the data are retained.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen hoe lang de gegevens bewaard worden.
Asks whether a single violation suffices for a back-assessment or whether a combination of facts is required, and whether the 180-day rule for gifts can lead to hardship.
The SGP members ask whether finding a single violation in the suspension, dealer and oldtimer transitional schemes is sufficient to impose a back-assessment.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of het constateren van één enkele overtreding bij schorsing, de handelaarsregeling en de overgangsregeling voor oldtimers voldoende is voor het opleggen van een naheffingsaanslag.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised against retroactive effect back to 20 July 2017 for the Invorderingswet 1990 collection measures against asset-stripping structures, and raised concerns about the broad scope of beneficiary liability and the delegation of the presumption criteria to a ministerial regulation. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport largely accepted these points: retroactivity was moved to the date of submission to the Tweede Kamer, the criteria were moved into the law, and a conditional delegation with parliamentary approval was introduced.
concerns: Retroactive effect to 20 July 2017, tied only to an internet consultation not meant as notice, was not adequately justified and was not publicly announced; retroactivity was reduced to the date of submission to the Tweede Kamer and a press release was promised.

Beneficiary liability may reach ordinary gifts and not only tax-avoidance structures; the government argued the objective-circumstances test protects good-faith parties but expanded the explanatory note rather than narrowing the provision.

Setting by ministerial regulation the objective circumstances that trigger a reversed burden of proof warrants parliamentary involvement; the government adopted a conditional delegation subject to parliamentary approval, and listed the circumstances in the law.
Explanatory note and bill text on the number of circumstances needed for a presumption (two or more) were brought into line, and the wording of the note was clarified.

35036.s: The bill amends the Huisvestingswet 2014 to remove the word 'goedkoop' so that municipalities can regulate allocation of all scarce housing, including middle-rent housing. It also amends article 44c of the Woningwet to replace the zienswijze of the guarantee fund with a ministerial approval procedure for new non-DAEB activities of housing associations, with a ministerial refusal ground and delegation of further criteria by AMvB.
35036.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need to stimulate investment in middle-rent housing and shorten procedures, and it notes the government expects municipalities to use the broadened power carefully.
q: This bill therefore proposes that in articles 2, 4 and 7 of the Huisvestingswet 2014 the notion 'goedkoop' is dropped, so that scarcity leading to unbalanced and unjust effects remains as the only criterion.

Daarom wordt in dit wetsvoorstel voorgesteld dat in de artikelen 2, 4 en 7 van de Huisvestingswet 2014 het begrip «goedkoop» vervalt waardoor als criterium alleen overblijft: schaarste die leidt tot onevenwichtige en onrechtvaardige effecten.
d: categories of non-DAEB works exempt from ministerial approval
documents required with approval request and grounds for refusal
p: Removing 'goedkoop' lets municipalities regulate allocation of a wider housing stock on a broader scarcity criterion, expanding local executive discretion over residents' freedom to choose residence.
The minister gains a discretionary approval power over non-DAEB activities of housing associations, with grounds for refusal listed in the statute.

parties: Asks whether the broadened 'schaarste' basis is proportionate and how the Aw and the government will control municipal misuse and fair treatment between associations and market parties.
It must be prevented that municipalities misuse this legislative change to regulate a disproportionate part of the rental market.
Het moet voorkomen worden dat gemeenten deze wetswijziging misbruiken om een disproportioneel deel van de huurmarkt te reguleren.
Asks whether replacing 'goedkoop' with 'schaarste' is strictly necessary given existing powers, and supports transparent competition between associations and market parties.
They believe that this is sufficiently safeguarded with the intended amendment.
Zij menen dat dit met de beoogde wijziging voldoende is geborgd.
Questions whether the Raad van State's concern about distorted market ordering, given association proximity to municipalities, is adequately answered, and asks about the status of market exploration.
Can the government further explain why it does not consider this to be the case?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom zij dit niet het geval acht?
Doubts the bill will deliver enough affordable rentals, questions the legal status of market exploration results and the continued role of market-conformity controls.
However, they strongly doubt whether the present bill will actually ensure that sufficient affordable rental homes are built.
Zij vragen zich echter sterk af of het voorliggende wetsvoorstel er daadwerkelijk voor gaat zorgen dat er voldoende betaalbare huurwoningen gerealiseerd worden.
Asks whether dropping the WSW consultation requirement and the 'noodknop' against rent spikes is consistent with the parliamentary enquiry findings and whether municipal steering safeguards exist.
In particular, the removal of the required opinion of the guarantee fund (Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw) on the effects of new non-DAEB activities on financial ratios raises that question.

Met name het schrappen van de vereiste zienswijze van de borgingsvoorziening (Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw) over de effecten van nieuwe niet-DAEB-werkzaamheden op de financiële ratio's roept die vraag op.
Asks whether the bill gives municipalities enough room to steer on price, indexation and duration of mid-rent homes, and seeks clarity on the legal status of market exploration.
Does this bill offer room for this?
Biedt dit wetsvoorstel hiervoor de ruimte?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises against the proposed amendment of the Huisvestingswet 2014 as overbodig and as unduly broadening the law's scope beyond cheap housing, and asks for demonstration that a transparent, fair competition safeguard exists for non-DAEB housing activities of housing associations under the Woningwet. The government's nader rapport partly accepts these points by clarifying the explanatory memorandum and adding a national digital platform publication requirement, while maintaining the change to 'schaarse woningen' and the simplified approval procedure.
concerns: The Afdeling considers the removal of 'goedkope' as criterion a significant extension of the Huisvestingswet's scope, disproportionate to the intended clarification and an infringement of freedom of residence, and advises deleting the amendment; the government justifies the change and clarifies the memorandum.

The Afdeling considers the amendment of the Huisvestingswet unnecessary as it merely clarifies existing law; the government argues the term 'goedkoop' no longer fits the market and the change is needed for future-proofing.

The Afdeling notes the Huisvestingswet's restriction to cheap housing was chosen to justify interference with freedom of residence under the ECHR and the public housing duty of Article 22 Grondwet; the government adds a justification for the interference in the memorandum.
The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum clarify the transparency and fair competition safeguards for the simplified non-DAEB approval procedure; the government adds this clarification.

The Afdeling finds that publication only via a municipal digital platform does not sufficiently ensure fair competition between housing associations and market parties, which the government addresses by requiring a national digital platform and maintaining the four-week publication and outcome-notification requirements.

35054.s: The bill supplements the Omgevingswet with rules on controlling noise from roads, railways and industrial estates, by introducing noise production ceilings as environmental value standards set by councils, provinces and the national minister, and repeals the Wet geluidhinder. It also lets the Crown set detailed rules by general administrative order, allows noise-reducing building measures to be imposed by administrative decision, and provides transitional law.
35054.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to keep detailed noise rules flexible and avoid procedural burdens of statute-level ceilings, while preserving parliamentary involvement through voorhang procedures.
q: In its advice on the draft Omgevingswet, the Council of State drew attention to parliament's co-legislative role.
In zijn advies over het ontwerp van de Omgevingswet heeft de Raad van State aandacht gevraagd voor de medewetgevende rol van het parlement
d: nature and term of noise production ceiling obligations
designation of industrial activities causing significant noise
provincial states delegate ceiling-setting power to executive council
provincial states delegate ceiling-setting power for provincial roads and local railways to executive council
minister designates national roads and main railways for noise ceilings
cases where noise-reducing building measures apply and withdrawal grounds
replacing programme duty with duty to take measures; designating other bodies to adopt programmes
cases where general administrative law consultation procedure applies to noise ceilings
monitoring method and monitoring body for noise ceilings
transitional rules for provisions replaced by general administrative order
p: Noise ceilings for provincial roads, local railways and industrial estates are set by executive or provincial decision rather than in statute, with the municipal council able to request provincial action.
Expands provincial, municipal and water board tasks to control noise from roads, railways and industrial estates, including instruction powers over water boards.

Administrative bodies may decide by individual decision to impose noise-reducing measures on buildings, replacing the former civil-law consent route with administrative authority, with the consent mechanism left to general administrative order.
Noise ceiling decisions take effect after four weeks, with earlier entry into force allowed for urgent circumstances, and appeal lies in a single instance before the Council of State.
2.2, 2.4 (repeal of Wet geluidhinder and Wet milieubeheer titles)

Repeals the Wet geluidhinder and existing noise titles of the Wet milieubeheer, moving noise regulation into the Omgevingswet and general administrative orders; judicial review is kept via the Council of State..
Excludes appeal against first noise ceilings based on historic noise plus 1.5 dB, on the ground that appeal would be pointless.

parties: Asks why the competence for noise ceilings on regionally significant industrial estates is transferred from the province to municipalities, and whether the new system's cumulative and summed noise assessments were supported by research.
These members ask why it was chosen not to keep this competence with the province and thereby safeguard the status of regional interest.
Deze leden vragen waarom er voor gekozen is deze bevoegdheid niet bij de provincie te houden en daarmee de status van regionaal belang te borgen.

Asks how the wider discretion given to decentralised authorities still ensures equivalent protection of citizens, what participation, objection and appeal rights apply, and how the procedure for noise ceilings works in practice.
These members ask to what extent participation, objection and appeal apply in situations where exceeding the maximum value is allowed because of weighty economic or other societal interests.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen in hoeverre inspraak, bezwaar en beroep van toepassing is bij situaties waar een overschrijving van de maximale waarde toegestaan wordt omdat sprake is van zwaarwegende economische of zwaarwegende andere maatschappelijke belangen.
Asks how citizens can influence the setting and application of noise norms and whether they can hold decentralised authorities to account and request reconsideration of norms.
Will citizens soon be able to hold decentralised authorities accountable for the norm frameworks they have set and request a reconsideration of the norm framework?
Kunnen burgers straks decentrale overheden aanspreken op de door hun vastgestelde normenkaders en verzoeken om een heroverweging van het normenkader?

Worries that the discretion and landscape of local choices undermine the general duty to protect citizens' health, and that the bill does not clearly protect against cumulative noise from several sources and authorities.
These members point to the recent WHO report, which calls for much better protection against environmental noise than what current legislation provides.
Deze leden willen daarbij wijzen op het onlangs verschenen rapport van de WHO, dat vraagt om een veel betere bescherming tegen omgevingsgeluid dan wat er in de huidige wetgeving is vastgelegd.

Warns that the new norm framework gives much room for interpretation and weighing of administrative interests, that residents are not protected before health effects occur, and that dropping civil-law elements may prevent residents from going to appeal.
The SP members note that the new norm framework leaves much room for interpretation and for weighing administrative interests.
De leden van de SP-fractie merken op dat het nieuwe normenkader veel ruimte voor interpretatie en afwegen van bestuurlijke belangen biedt.

Asks why the bill excludes many other noise sources such as aviation, shipping and events, why night rules apply only to industry, and how health objectives will be given priority over economic weighing in administrative decisions.
How will the government ensure that the health objectives are given priority?
Hoe gaat de regering ervoor zorgen dat de gezondheidsdoelstellingen prioriteit krijgen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Aanvullingswet geluid Omgevingswet, which brings noise from roads, railways and industrial estates into the Omgevingswet, and advised sending it to the Tweede Kamer while asking for a fuller justification of the geluidproductieplafond instrument, clarification of how equivalent protection is guaranteed, and attention to the relation with decentralised planning. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adds omgevingswaarde treatment for geluidproductieplafonds, clarifies the instructieregels and reserves, and makes the requested supplements to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a substantiated justification of why a separate geluidproductieplafond instrument is needed alongside the Omgevingswet toolkit, which the government addressed by re-examining the omgevingswaarde option and amending the law.

The Afdeling flagged that geluidproductieplafonds would fall outside the omgevingsplan, threatening integral knowability of rules, and asked the memorandum to explain this relation, which the government addressed with supplements.

The Afdeling asked to clarify whether the voorkeurswaarde, maximumwaarde and binnenwaarde are omgevingswaarden, and the government clarified they are not, with the explanatory memorandum supplemented.

The Afdeling asked for a clearer explanation of how equivalent protection of health against noise is guaranteed given decentralised discretion to deviate from the noise values, and the government responded by describing the afwegingsruimte and comparison with the old system, while maintaining that equivalence is assured through implementing rules to be elaborated later.

The Afdeling noted that mandatory Rijk instructieregels on geluidproductieplafonds would narrow decentralised discretion against the principle 'decentraal, tenzij', and the government answered that the narrowing does not exceed the current regime.

35072.s: The bill amends several statutes governing allowances and pensions of members and former members of the Dutch parliament so that references to civil service pay (sector Rijk / burgerlijk rijkspersoneel) are replaced by references to collective labour agreements for civil servants at the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations. It is a technical companion to the Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren and is intended to have no substantive effect.
35072.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as purely technical alignment needed for the new civil service law, keeping existing delegation grounds for adjusting allowances by ministerial regulation without substantive change.
q: The main principle of implementing amendment legislation is that it is technical in nature and has no substantive consequences.
Het belangrijkste uitgangspunt van invoerings- aanpassingswetgeving is dat zij technisch van aard is en geen inhoudelijke gevolgen heeft.
d: ARTIKEL I A (art. 53, derde lid Algemene pensioenwet politieke ambtsdragers)
adjusting pension calculation basis to salary changes under collective labour agreement

35108.s: The bill implements the EU Prospectus Regulation (2017/1129) in Dutch law by replacing the old prospectus chapter 5.1 of the Wft and aligning cross-references in related statutes. It gives the Autoriteit Financiële Markten new powers to suspend or prohibit offers and trading, refuse prospectus approval for up to five years, order disclosure, and publish non-compliance, and it adds a delegation for ministerial exemptions from the prospectus obligation.
35108.j: The memorandum justifies the new AFM powers as implementation of Article 32(1) of the directly applicable EU regulation, which requires national competent authorities to hold these powers.
q: These powers are included in articles 1:77g et seq. and regulate, among other things, that the AFM can suspend or prohibit an offer of securities if there are reasonable grounds to suspect that the prospectus regulation has been infringed.

Deze bevoegdheden zijn opgenomen in de artikelen 1:77g e.v. en regelen onder andere dat de AFM een aanbieding van effecten kan opschorten of verbieden indien er gegronde redenen zijn om aan te nemen dat inbreuk is gepleegd op de prospectusverordening.
d: manner of stating national regime for exempt offers, set by AFM
information to include in prospectus for investment institutions
p: AFM may suspend or prohibit public offers and admission to trading for up to ten working days or indefinitely when it has reasonable grounds to suspect infringement, subject to conditions set in the EU regulation.
AFM may suspend or prohibit trading on trading platforms and order platform operators to suspend trading in financial instruments.
AFM may prohibit or suspend advertising for offers where there are reasonable grounds to suspect infringement.
AFM may refuse approval of a prospectus for up to five years for issuers that repeatedly and seriously infringed the regulation.
AFM may order disclosure of essential information affecting investors' assessment of securities.
AFM is empowered to publicly announce non-compliance by issuers, offerors or applicants for admission to trading.
Direct appeal to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven is retained for prospectus approval decisions, but other AFM sanctions under the regulation are excluded from that route.

parties: Asks why the 5 million euro exemption threshold and its amendment are set by ministerial regulation rather than in the statute itself, and asks for a comparison of issuances between 5 and 8 million euro.
The VVD members ask, regarding proposed article 5:4(1), why the 5 million euro exemption threshold is set and amended by ministerial regulation rather than in the statute itself.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen bij het voorgestelde artikel 5:4 lid 1 waarom de vrijstellingsdrempel van 5 miljoen euro wordt vastgesteld en gewijzigd bij ministeriële regeling en niet in de wet zelf.

Supports the bill and the higher threshold but asks for better justification of the 5 million choice and whether issuers could split issues to avoid the prospectus duty, which would weaken investor protection.
The CDA members ask whether issuers of shares could split their issues, for example issuing twice 3 million euro, to stay under the exemption threshold.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of het mogelijk is dat uitgevers van aandelen hun uitgiftes gesplitst doen, door bijvoorbeeld twee keer voor 3 miljoen euro uit te geven om zo onder de vrijstellingsdrempel te blijven.
Supports harmonisation but asks how the prospectus information will adequately inform all types of investors, given earlier research showing consumer information was too technical.
How is it ensured that the information in the prospectus adequately informs all types of investors so they can make a well-considered choice?
Hoe wordt geborgd dat de informatie uit de prospectus alle typen beleggers voldoende informeert om een goed overwogen keuze te kunnen maken?
Questions why the 5 million threshold was chosen over the 1 million minimum, whose interest it serves, and the need for uniform thresholds given the reduced national leeway.
The SP members ask the government why 5 million euro was chosen as the exemption threshold rather than 1 million euro, which is the minimum under the regulation.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering waarom voor 5 miljoen euro is gekozen als vrijstellingsdrempel, en niet voor 1 miljoen euro, wat het minimum is volgens de verordening.

35117.s: The bill amends the Wft, Wwft and Wab to allow the Bureau Financieel Toezicht to share supervisory information with the AFM, removes ministerial pre-approval of accountancy regulations in favour of ex post annulment, and transfers the competence to issue certificates of professional competence from the CEA to the NBA. It also makes several technical amendments to financial market rules.
35117.j: The memorandum justifies the removal of pre-approval as a reduction of administrative burden, retaining ex post annulment, and justifies the transfer of certificate competence as better fitting the NBA's role.
q: Annulment after the fact remains possible, and Article 22 of the Wab requires the professional body to make drafts of regulations on statutory audits publicly available electronically at least two months before adoption.

Vernietiging achteraf blijft mogelijk en in artikel 22 van de Wab wordt bepaald dat de beroepsorganisatie alle ontwerpen van verordeningen en nadere voorschriften die betrekking hebben op de wettelijke controle ten minste twee maanden voorafgaand aan de datum waarop deze worden vastgesteld op elektronische wijze ter inzage moet leggen.
d: Wab art. 34 (as amended by Art. III B)
accountancy regulations and nadere voorschriften on statutory audits
p: Ministerial pre-approval of NBA regulations is removed, leaving only publication and ex post annulment, which reduces ex ante oversight by the minister.
Competence to issue certificates of professional competence moves from the CEA to the NBA board, a self-regulatory professional body rather than a state-affiliated commission.
The BFT may share confidential supervisory information with the AFM, subject to the purpose and confidentiality conditions of existing Wwft art. 22.

parties: Asks how the Wwft confidentiality regime and the GDPR apply to information exchange, and questions the minister's responsibility for autonomous NBA tasks that parliament could hold him to account for.
Asks what safeguards prevent the sharing of data falling outside the scope of the bill.
How is it prevented that data are shared that fall outside the scope of this bill?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat gegevens worden gedeeld die buiten de reikwijdte van dit wetsvoorstel vallen?
Notes the positive opinion of the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens on the information sharing and asks about the low number of consultation responses and how to improve public dialogue.
They have also taken note of the positive advice of the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) on this point.
Zij hebben ook kennisgenomen van het positieve advies van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) op dit punt.
Asks whether customers' privacy is sufficiently guaranteed, who will review whether shared data are proportionate, and whether the BFT-AFM cooperation protocol will be made public.
These members ask whether the cooperation protocol between the BFT and AFM will be made public.
Deze leden vragen of het samenwerkingsprotocol tussen BFT en AFM openbaar zal worden gemaakt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no remarks on the draft Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2019 and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes technical implementation changes to the Wet op het financieel toezicht made in response to the Solvency II directive and market abuse rules.

35153.s: The bill adds a new chapter 14A to the Telecommunicatiewet that lets the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate prohibit acquiring or holding decisive control over telecom parties where this threatens public interest. It also requires prior notification, investigations into shareholder identity, forced sale orders, and appointment of designated persons to take over management of targeted parties.
35153.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by protecting public interest in secure, continuous telecom networks against foreign or undesirable control, and notes that appeal to the Rotterdam court and the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven is available.
q: In the proposed Article 14a.4 of the Telecommunications Act, the Minister is given the power to prohibit acquiring or holding decisive control in a telecom party if, in his judgment, that control leads to a threat to public interest.

In het voorgestelde artikel 14a.4 van de Telecommunicatiewet krijgt de Minister de bevoegdheid het verkrijgen of houden van overwegende zeggenschap in een telecommunicatiepartij te verbieden indien het verkrijgen of houden van deze zeggenschap naar zijn oordeel leidt tot een bedreiging van het publiek belang.
d: manner of giving effect to suspension
manner and period for executing forced-sale order
rules on authorisation for sale requests and custodian duties
rules on prohibition of certain telecom agreements
designating additional categories of networks or services
p: The Minister may prohibit acquisition or holding of decisive control in telecom parties on a broad public-interest test, subject to listed grounds and appeal to court.

The Minister may appoint designated persons who give binding instructions to the targeted company, including replacing its board, with instructions open to administrative appeal to the Minister himself.
The Minister orders forced reduction or termination of control, with no sunset or parliamentary approval required.
If the order is not complied with, the company is irrevocably authorised and obliged to sell the shares on behalf of the owner, bypassing owner consent.
The Minister may require telecom parties and intermediaries to investigate and disclose shareholder identities and ties.
Where shareholder identity is uncertain, the last person identified in a custody chain is deemed the owner and holder for prohibition and suspension purposes.
Certain telecom contracts require prior ministerial consent, which may be attached to conditions and withdrawn later with contracts becoming void.

parties: Asks whether an independent body, like the TIB under the WIV 2017, should review the Minister's decisions to ensure objectivity and proportionality, and whether criteria can be sharpened.
These members therefore ask why it was not considered to have the review carried out by an independent body, as is the case in comparable legislation in the financial sector.
Deze leden vragen daarom waarom niet is overwogen de toetsing door een onafhankelijk orgaan te laten plaatsvinden, zoals in de vergelijkbare wetgeving in de financiële sector het geval is.

Supports the goal but asks whether the law is sufficient, questions why review is by the Minister rather than an independent body, and asks about sharpening criteria and the broad delegation to an AMvB.
What is the reason that this was not chosen? In what way is objectivity in the procedure and in the review now guaranteed?
Wat is de reden dat hiervoor niet is gekozen? Op welke wijze(n) is nu objectiviteit in de procedure en in de toetsing gewaarborgd?
Worried about proportionality, effectiveness and support; asks why the Minister rather than another body decides, and why the ban on contracts was not subject to Raad van State advice.
The decision should as far as possible be kept free of political considerations.
Het besluit dient zo veel als mogelijk verschoond te blijven van politieke overwegingen.
Asks whether the law will effectively address the risk of foreign takeover and whether alternatives such as renationalisation were explored; also questions the claim of strong competition.

These members ask the government whether this bill, on balance an additional form of regulation, will adequately solve the problem that both the House and the government identified in 2013, namely that a network can be taken over by a foreign party with less regard for the public interest.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of dit wetsvoorstel, per saldo een aanvullende vorm van regulering, het probleem dat zowel de Kamer als de regering constateerden in 2013, namelijk dat een netwerk kan worden overgenomen door een buitenlandse partij die het maatschappelijk belang minder in het oog heeft, afdoende zal oplossen.

Concerned that vague criteria and broad definitions let the Minister ban takeovers on unclear grounds, creating legal uncertainty and risk of external political pressure; suggests an independent body may be better.
Does the government consider it possible that a Minister, under external pressure, bans a takeover while there may be insufficient grounds for it?
Acht de regering het mogelijk dat een Minister onder externe druk een overname verbiedt terwijl daar mogelijk onvoldoende gronden voor zijn?
Supports the bill's aim but asks whether the Minister can be pressured, whether an independent decision body could be involved, and asks for clarity on the grounds for suspecting state influence.
These members ask whether another decision-making structure is also conceivable in which an independent body has decision-making authority, or is at least involved in final decision-making.
Deze leden vragen daarom of ook een andere beslisconstructie denkbaar is waarbij een onafhankelijk orgaan beslisbevoegdheid heeft, of in elk geval bij definitieve besluitvorming betrokken is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against submitting the bill on Minister's power to prohibit acquisition or holding of decisive control in telecom parties, citing legal uncertainty, weak effectiveness, and tension with property rights and EU free movement, and recommended a more direct alternative. The government's reply largely rejects the objections, maintains the instrument, but makes some adjustments such as sharpened criteria, a new consent requirement for long-term management agreements, and clarifying the appointed person's powers and legal protection.
concerns: Vague and broad criteria for notification and prohibition create uncertainty for parties and the Minister; government sharpened criteria and committed to objective thresholds by AMvB.
The indirect approach of regulating acquisition of control is ineffective in protecting the infrastructure itself; government maintains the instrument is effective for its aim.
The prohibition on acquiring control may be disproportionate to the aim, given the limited contribution to protecting critical infrastructure; government disagrees.
Interference with the property right under Article 1 First Protocol ECHR is questionable in foreseeability; government sharpened criteria but maintains a fair balance.
Restrictions on EU free movement of capital, services and establishment are insufficiently justified; government argues the grounds are adequately specified.

Enforcement against foreign holders and the Minister's exposure to political pressure and liability are unclear; government added a consent regime for management agreements and referred to existing enforcement provisions.
The appointed person's powers were unclear; government revised article 14a.9 to describe these powers and legal protection more precisely.
Article 14a.8 refers to giving effect to a prohibition that the telecom party cannot implement; government clarified the wording to refer to suspension.

35180.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Protocol of 6 February 2019 on the accession of the Republic of North Macedonia to the North Atlantic Treaty, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.

parties: Asks what enforcement tools exist under the treaty to keep North Macedonia's reforms going if it slows or stops reforming.
However, these members ask what enforcement tools exist under the treaty to keep encouraging these reforms.
Wel vragen deze leden welke drukmiddelen er bestaan onder het verdrag om deze hervormingen aan te blijven moedigen.
Expresses support for accession but is concerned about growing Chinese influence in the Balkans.
The CDA members are concerned about China's growing influence in the Balkans, including in North Macedonia.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn bezorgd over de groeiende invloed van China op de Balkan, waaronder in Noord-Macedonië.
Supports accession but asks how progress on rule of law, judicial independence, corruption and media freedom will be monitored.
