These members believe it must be carefully examined whether progress on the necessary reforms in democracy, media freedom, minority rights, rule of law and anti-corruption continues.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat goed moet worden gekeken of de voortgang van de noodzakelijke hervormingen die Noord-Macedonië op het gebied van de democratie, mediavrijheid, de positie van minderheden, de rechtstaat en het gevecht tegen corruptie doorgaan.
Questions the security benefit to the Netherlands and raises concerns about respect for human rights, refugees and press freedom in North Macedonia.
These members, following reports from human rights organisations, have concerns about respect for human rights in North Macedonia, not least regarding the treatment of refugees and press freedom.

Deze leden hebben, naar aanleiding van rapportages van mensenrechtenorganisaties, zorgen over het respect voor mensenrechten in Noord-Macedonië, niet in de laatste plaats wat betreft de omgang met vluchtelingen en de persvrijheid.

35216.s: The bill introduces a national minimum CO2 price on electricity generation, levied annually on operators of installations via a new chapter in the Environmental Taxes Act, with the tax rate set by ministerial regulation and emissions monitored and assessed by the Dutch Emissions Authority (NEa). It amends the Environmental Management Act to add electricity emission monitoring, reporting, ex officio determination of emissions by the NEa, and enforcement powers.
35216.j: The memorandum justifies the NEa's ex officio powers and delegated rules by the need for expert, objective, technically based monitoring and the administrative efficiency of aligning with EU ETS systems.
q: The board of the NEa is, in certain cases, authorised to determine ex officio the annual electricity emissions.
Het bestuur van de NEa is, in bepaalde gevallen, bevoegd om ambtshalve de elektriciteitsjaarvracht vast te stellen.
d: annual CO2 tax rate per ton
reporting and approval of changes to electricity monitoring plan
rules on determining electricity emissions for CHP and residual gases
monitoring rules for emergency generators and emissions verification
p: Artikel II B, art. 16a.7 and 16a.8 lid 4
The NEa board may declare emissions reports non-compliant and set emissions ex officio on a conservative estimate, with a ten-year window to do so and appeal available.
Artikel I B, art. 71g lid 2 and 4
Limitation periods for additional assessments and fines are extended where ex officio determinations become final late, and tax data may be shared between the tax service and the NEa.','

parties: Asks about monitoring reliability, legal remedies for taxpayers, and whether the NEa rather than the Tax Administration should levy the tax.
Has the government considered assigning the levy and collection to the Tax Administration, for example the unit dealing with environmental taxes?
Heeft de regering overwogen om de heffing en invordering te beleggen bij de Belastingdienst, bijvoorbeeld bij het onderdeel welke zich bezig houdt met milieubelastingen?
Asks whether the NEa is equipped for formal tax procedures such as objections, appeals and fines, and about state aid risks.

Nevertheless, these members ask whether the NEa is also sufficiently equipped for the formal legal aspects of levying and collecting a tax, such as amending a return, objection and appeal, and imposing fines, etc.?

Desondanks vragen deze leden of de NEa ook voldoende is ingericht op de formele juridische aspecten die komen kijken bij het heffen en innen van een belasting, zoals het wijzigen van een aangifte, bezwaar en beroep, het opleggen van boetes etc.?
Welcomes the bill and asks about the asymmetry of downward and upward price adjustments and the risk criteria triggering them.
The D66 members welcome this bill and the support of all parties at the electricity table for the proposed price path.
De leden van de D66-fractie verwelkomen deze wet en de steun van alle partijen aan de elektriciteitstafel voor het voorgestelde prijspad.
Doubts the bill's effect on decarbonisation, questions the NEa collecting the levy, and asks whether the price is too low per PBL analysis.
The GroenLinks members have doubts about the choice to have the NEa collect the tax.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks hebben twijfels bij de keuze om de NEa de belasting te laten innen.
Asks about supply security, state guarantees of sufficient energy for citizens, and public-ownership alternatives.
People have a right to energy. How does the government now determine that enough electricity is generated?
Mensen hebben recht op energie. Hoe bepaalt de regering nu dat er voldoende elektriciteit op wordt gewekt?
Notes the price path was weakened compared to the coalition agreement and asks about effectiveness and the ETS market effects.
These members further note that the bill has been weakened on precisely this crucial point compared to the coalition agreement.
Deze leden constateren voorts dat het wetsvoorstel op juist dit cruciale onderdeel is afgezwakt ten opzichte van het regeerakkoord.
Argues the minimum price below market price will have no volume effect and asks for an impact study and justification of the lowered price.
The PvdD members noted this bill with astonishment.
De leden van de PvdD-fractie hebben met verbazing kennisgenomen van deze wet.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Wet minimum CO2-prijs elektriciteitsopwekking, raising concerns about why only the electricity sector is covered, whether the price path meaningfully reduces CO2, EU ETS and state aid compatibility, and assigning collection to the NEa rather than the Tax Administration. The government's reply accepts some points and adds explanations, but keeps the NEa as collection body and defends the limited scope.
concerns: The Afdeling asked how the minimum CO2 price, which is expected to sit below the EU ETS price, actually contributes to the 49% reduction target; the government added explanation that it creates investment certainty but PBL attributed no direct reduction.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of the effects on the functioning of the EU ETS and the internal market; the government added that the measure does not impair the ETS and is comparable to other national levies.

The Afdeling asked for objective justification under state aid rules for limiting the measure to electricity producers; the government explained that the Commission practice leads to the conclusion there is no state aid.

The Afdeling advised that the Tax Administration rather than the NEa should levy and collect the tax, since the NEa lacks tax collection expertise; the government kept the NEa, citing one-stop service and the fact that the tax is new.
The Afdeling's redactional and technical remarks were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35225.s: The bill modernises Dutch civil enforcement rules by protecting debtors' subsistence minimum, including a fixed monthly bank-attachment exemption amount, tightening attachment and sale procedures, and allowing online sales and digital declarations. It also gives the kantonrechter jurisdiction over enforcement disputes and lets the executive set further attachment-exemption categories by general administrative order (AMvB).
35225.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB powers as allowing rules to be adapted quickly to future developments and practical implementation.
q: By general administrative order, categories of goods can be added to the attachment prohibition so the regime can be adjusted quickly to future developments if needed.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen (categorieën van) zaken aan het beslagverbod worden toegevoegd zodat de regeling zo nodig relatief snel aan toekomstige ontwikkelingen kan worden aangepast.
d: additional goods exempt from attachment, overbulky goods
technical rules for online auction websites
implementing rules for bank attachment exemption
costs third-party bank may charge for declaration
p: Executive may by AMvB designate further goods as overbulky or exempt, shifting attachment-scope decisions from the statute to administrative rule-making.
Procedural details of the bank-attachment exemption are left to an AMvB.

parties: Asks how the prohibition on attachment that serves mainly as pressure will be assessed and whether it will create uncertainty and legal proceedings.
Doesn't this measure create a lot of uncertainty and legal proceedings?
Zorgt deze maatregel niet voor veel onduidelijkheid en juridische procedures?
Asks whether the fixed exempt amount for bank attachment adequately protects debtors with families and whether the AVG allows banks to delay informing debtors.
These members however ask the government to address the lack of distinction in the attachment-free amount for bank attachment where there are more children.
Deze leden vragen de regering echter wel in te gaan op het gebrek aan onderscheid dat gemaakt wordt qua beslagvrij bedrag bij bankverslag in het geval sprake is van meer kinderen.
Asks how the bill complies with AVG Article 23 safeguards on informing debtors about bank information requests, as flagged by the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Is the government willing to still incorporate these?
Is de regering bereid deze alsnog te verwerken?
Asks for clearer definition of subsistence minimum, protection of vulnerable debtors, and whether creditors must contact debtors personally before attachment.
Is the government willing to include in the law that creditors must always maintain personal contact (not by letter) with the debtor before proceeding to attachment?

Is de regering bereid voor deze personen in de wet op te nemen dat schuldeisers steeds persoonlijk contact (niet per brief) dienen te onderhouden met de schuldenaar voordat kan worden overgegaan tot het leggen van beslag?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill revising the Dutch civil enforcement and attachment law, mainly raising one point: the explanatory memorandum should clarify that the AMvB on attachment of a bank account can set rules on the amount, including indexation before the Wvbv takes effect. The government's nader rapport accepts this, amends the delegation provision and the explanatory memorandum, and adopts the redactional remark.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify whether the AMvB on enforcement may set rules on the amount of the protected sum, including indexation in the interim period before the Wvbv.
The Afdeling proposed a redactional change to the explanatory memorandum on article I, part V ('De bepaling kent geen sanctie'), which the government adopted.

35234.s: The bill amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations by a supplementary budget of EUR 35 million for energy-saving measures in response to the Urgenda climate ruling. It sets the amendment to take effect from 1 July 2019, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35243.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2017 Framework Agreement between the EU, its member states and Australia, as required by Article 91 of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
35243.j: The memorandum justifies the approval by explaining the division of competences between the EU and member states and provisional application, and states the agreement contains no provisions directly binding on individuals.
q: In the government's view, the Partnership Agreement contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat de Partnerschapsovereenkomst geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet.

35252.s: The bill creates a mandatory student support fund (mbo-studentenfonds) in vocational education so that students facing financial hardship or study delays can receive support, and requires institutions to issue an mbo-verklaring to students who leave without a diploma. It also renames 'deelnemer' to 'student', extends rights for pregnant students, and makes entry prerequisites optional for institutions.
35252.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulations on personal circumstances and admission requirements by the need for detailed, adjustable rules that may change several times, and the flexibility of institutions to set their own support categories.
d: model for the mbo-verklaring and technical safety requirements
personal circumstances considered in binding study advice
nadere vooropleidingseisen designated by ministerial regulation
Artikel I, R (8.1.5 lid 3 onderdeel e)
other special circumstances set by the institution's governing body
institutional rules on procedure and amount of support
p: Institutions may grant support for other special circumstances on grounds of overriding unfairness, setting aside the statutory conditions.
Students who leave without a diploma are entitled to a verification statement, a protection rather than a power shift.

parties: Asks how schools will be made to ensure the student fund money reaches the intended group and how financial risks are controlled.
they ask which instruments mbo schools have to guarantee that the funds are actually provided to the target group
vragen zij welke instrumenten de mbo-scholen hebben om te garanderen dat de middelen ook daadwerkelijk verstrekt worden aan de doelgroep
Asks detailed questions on eligibility, amounts, bandwidth of awards and evaluation of the student fund, raising concern about uncertainty for students.
They also want to know whether the provisional award procedure will create too much uncertainty for students
Ook willen deze leden graag weten of de werkwijze met een voorlopige toekenning niet voor teveel onzekerheid gaat zorgen bij de studenten
Asks whether adult students, and students themselves, should have access to and a say over the fund, and how eligibility is guaranteed when funds run out.
They also ask whether students themselves have co-decision rights over how the fund is implemented.
Ook vragen zij of de studenten zelf eveneens medezeggenschap hebben over hoe er invulling gegeven wordt aan dit fonds.
Warns of unequal treatment across schools and asks how the government will guarantee the EUR 10 million reaches the fund and enforce it.
The members see the risk that students with comparable problems will be treated differently at different schools.
De leden zien hierin het risico dat studenten met vergelijkbare problematiek op verschillende scholen een andere behandeling krijgen.
Objects to narrow eligibility (under-18 limit, exclusion of bbl students and study abroad) and asks for clearer rationale and equal access across institutions.
They would like to see this age limit removed from the bill.
Graag zien zij dat deze leeftijdsbegrenzing uit het wetsvoorstel wordt gehaald.
Asks why the fund's eligibility list is much shorter than the profileringsfonds for higher education and why access is limited to minors, and questions the need for the strict cut-off.
These members ask why the government, in regulating the mbo student fund, uses a considerably shorter list than the profileringsfonds does.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering bij het regelen van het mbo-studentenfonds uitgaat van een aanmerkelijk kortere lijst dan bij het profileringsfonds het geval is.

35261.s: The bill modernises Dutch administrative law on electronic communication with government by rewriting Afdeling 2.3 of the Algemene wet bestuursrecht. Electronic and paper channels are placed on equal footing, with the executive gaining room to set channels, verification and temporary deviations, and to require electronic filing where specific laws provide.
35261.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary deviation power by the need to apply new technical developments in electronic government communication, and says it must be reported to parliament before expiry.
q: By general administrative order, temporary deviation from the provisions of this section may be made, insofar as necessary due to new technical developments.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kan tijdelijk worden afgeweken van het bepaalde bij of krachtens deze afdeling, voor zover dat nodig is wegens nieuwe technische ontwikkelingen.
d: temporary deviation from Afdeling 2.3 for new technical developments
rules on retention and destruction of electronic messages
designation of secure transmission channels and further requirements by law or administrative decision
cases requiring electronic filing via national facility and exceptions to Awb
electronic notification of investments in deviation of Awb
p: Allows temporary departure from statutory safeguards in Afdeling 2.3 by general administrative order, subject to a substitute safeguard and a report to parliament before expiry.
Lets a general administrative order designate cases where electronic-only filing applies, deviating from the Awb default of choice between channels.
Artikel XVIII, XXI, XXVI, XXVII, XXVIII (education acts)
Excludes parents and students from the Awb default right to send messages on paper to competent education authorities.

parties: Asks whether citizens keep an explicit right to paper communication and whether the no-repair rule for wrongly used channels is justified.
The VVD members would like a response from the government.
Gaarne krijgen de leden van de VVD-fractie een reactie van de regering.
Wants safeguards so that other laws cannot quietly set aside the Awb principle of a paper alternative, and asks how the general duty of support is concretely enforceable for citizens.
These members ask how it can be prevented that this provision in the Awb is set aside.
Deze leden vragen op welke wijze voorkomen kan worden dat deze bepaling in de Awb terzijde wordt geschoven.
Asks how citizens can prove a fault lay with the authority, how the criteria for the support duty are defined, and whether reduced coulance is safeguarded.
Is it guaranteed in this law that tailored treatment and coulance remain possible where the electronic route is chosen?
Wordt in deze wet gewaarborgd dat maatwerk en coulance toch mogelijk blijven waar voor de elektronische weg gekozen wordt?

Worries that digital communication is treated as the ideal default, that the threshold for mandating electronic communication for businesses is lowered, and that inbox and DigiD failures leave citizens without timely post.
The starting point for digital message traffic must always be: yes if people want it themselves, otherwise no.
Het uitgangspunt voor digitaal berichtenverkeer zal dus altijd moeten zijn: als mensen dat zelf willen dan ja, anders niet.
Argues that risks of channel errors, notifications and non-delivery are placed on citizens, and asks for a fallback to paper post and a general internal forwarding duty.
The risk of this is for a large part placed on the citizen in the bill.
Het risico daarvan wordt in het wetsvoor-stel voor een belangrijk deel bij de burger neergelegd.
Welcomes the paper-channel safeguard but insists that derogations in special laws need thorough motivation and that human contact must remain available.
Does the government agree with the ChristenUnie members that such bills deviating from the Awb must take into account the various arguments raised?
Is de regering het met de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie eens dat bij dergelijke wetsvoorstellen in afwijking van de Awb de verschillende argumenten ... betrokken moeten worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in March 2018 that the bill modernising electronic administrative communication (Awb section 2.3) should not proceed to parliament until its fundamental objections were addressed, notably the need to preserve a paper route for citizens, strengthen the duty to assist, standardise submission methods, reduce e-mail risks, and integrate the rules systematically into the Awb. The government's reply of July 2019 accepted most points in substance, for example by granting a right to paper communication, a general duty to assist, and a tempering of the mandatory-electronic approach, while declining a few (such as limiting notification refusals to a fixed period and narrowing transitional rules).
concerns: Citizens must retain a right to communicate with government on paper, as petition rights under Article 5 of the Constitution would otherwise be undermined; the government now provides for parallel paper and digital routes.
The duty to assist citizens who cannot cope with electronic communication is weakly formulated and should be made more concrete and enforceable; the government adds a general duty to assist.

Lack of standardisation across administrative bodies in how electronic messages must be submitted leaves citizens exposed to unforeseeable differences; the government keeps organisational discretion but adds safeguards and clarity on channels.

Risks of e-mail communication are placed too one-sidedly on citizens (outdated addresses, full mailboxes, spam filtering); the government adds measures such as re-notification and steps to reach citizens.

Electronic communication for decisions with serious consequences, and for decisions arising from administrative silence, needs additional safeguards; the government adds acknowledgement-of-receipt rules and more specific notification obligations.

The bill is abstract yet built on current technology, creating interpretation uncertainty; the Afdeling recommends concrete rules for existing technologies plus a temporary-deviation power, which the government adopts in part.
The new rules cut across the Awb's chapter structure and their interaction with chapters 3 onward is unclear; the government reorganises and clarifies section 2.3 and its numbering.
Scope term 'bestuurlijke aangelegenheid', the undefined term 'voorgeschreven melding', and the 'zonder nadere bewerking' criterion are unclear and are revised or removed.

The Afdeling asks for narrower transitional and ministerial exemption powers; the government drops the temporary ministerial exemption and reframes transitional arrangements as a phased entry into force.

35270.s: The bill amends the Wet langdurige zorg so that the CIZ (Centrum indicatiestelling zorg) keeps its legal personality, by excluding its staff from article 15 of the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen and deleting article 11.3.5. The changes take effect on different dates, the first linked to the entry into force of the Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren.
35270.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the desirability of the CIZ keeping its legal personality and notes new tasks for the CIZ, without justifying any delegation of power.
q: that it is desirable that the CIZ retains its legal personality
dat het wenselijk is dat het CIZ zijn rechtspersoonlijkheid behoudt

parties: The VVD expresses understanding for the government's choice and raises no questions.
The VVD members have understanding for the government's choice and therefore see no reason to ask questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben begrip voor de keuze van de regering en zien daarom geen aanleiding om vragen te stellen.
D66 asks for a fuller account of pros and cons, cost estimates, and the reasons for departing from advisory recommendations, and questions the late submission of the bill.
Can the government also address the advice on the CIZ in the report 'Herpositionering ZBO's' and state for each partial advice why the government believes it should nevertheless deviate from it?

Kan de regering daarnaast ingaan op de adviezen omtrent CIZ zoals verwoord in het rapport «Herpositionering ZBO’s» en per deeladvies aangeven waarom de regering van mening is dat hier toch van afgeweken dient te worden.
The SP asks who investigated the pros and cons, questions the cost basis of the roughly 5 million euro estimate, and argues the CIZ should fall under the ministry for better ministerial oversight.

Can the government give a further justification of who or which body investigated the pros and cons, and explain in more detail the pros and cons of the choice not to abolish the CIZ's own legal personality?

Kan de regering een nadere onderbouwing geven wie of welke instantie de voor- en nadelen heeft onderzocht en kan uitgebreider toegelicht worden wat de voor- en nadelen zijn voor de keuze om de eigen rechtspersoonlijkheid van het CIZ niet op te heffen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Wet langdurige zorg to revise the loss of legal personality of the CIZ, and raised no remarks and advised submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's covering letter forwards the advice and notes only a textual improvement to article II, part 1, without a substantive reply to any point.

35306.s: The bill abolishes the income tax deduction for training expenses in the Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 and converts it into a non-fiscal expenditure scheme, with a transitional provision for refunds received on expenses already deducted. It also sets the entry-into-force date by royal decree and provides for a 2031 start for one repealed article.
35306.j: The memorandum justifies abolishing the deduction as enabling more effective and efficient use of budgetary resources, and the transitional rule as continuing existing law for a defined group.
q: abolishing the tax deduction for training expenses and converting it into a non-fiscal expenditure scheme makes possible a more effective and efficient deployment of budgetary resources
afschaffing van de fiscale aftrek van scholingsuitgaven en omzetting hiervan in een niet-fiscale uitgavenregeling een effectievere en doelmatigere inzet van budgettaire middelen mogelijk maakt

parties: Asks when the subsidy scheme will be settled, whether it can first be submitted to the Chamber via voorhang, and raises concern about the lack of transitional rules for multi-year training costs.
Can the subsidy scheme first be submitted to the Chamber for prior consultation (voorhang)?
Kan de subsidieregeling via een voorhang eerst nog worden voorgelegd aan de Kamer?
Finds it odd the bill is tabled before the scheme's details and implementation are settled, and questions how entry into force by royal decree at an unknown date serves citizens' planning.
They prefer to regulate the abolition of the tax deduction only once not just the outlines of the new scheme but also its details, and especially its implementation, are well arranged.

Zij geven er de voorkeur aan de afschaffing van de fiscale aftrekpost pas te regelen als niet alleen de contouren van de nieuwe regeling bekend zijn, maar ook de details en met name ook de uitvoering goed geregeld is.
Supports replacing the tax deduction with a subsidy scheme and asks about timing and communication to reach the target group.
The D66 members endorse the proposal to replace the tax deduction with a subsidy scheme.
De leden van de D66-fractie onderschrijven het voorstel om de fiscale aftrek te vervangen door een subsidieregeling.

Asks what basis the government has for claiming the subsidy will reach people in vulnerable labour-market positions, and asks about transitional rules and whether the subsidy will be capped or stopped if demand exceeds budget.
The GroenLinks members ask the government on what basis it claims the replacement subsidy will reach people in a vulnerable position on the labour market.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen de regering waarop zij baseert dat de vervangende subsidieregeling wél de mensen met een kwetsbare positie op de arbeidsmarkt gaat bereiken.
Has no further questions on the bill itself but reserves comment for the STAP-budget debate.
The bill in itself does not currently prompt further questions, but the PvdA members will comment further when the STAP-budget is debated.
Het wetsvoorstel an sich noopt op dit moment niet tot verdere vragen, maar de leden van de PvdA-fractie zullen bij de behandeling van het STAP-budget nog nader commentaar leveren.

Asks why the current deduction is used mainly by higher-educated people, whether this relates to income inequality, and whether students under the loan system without deductibility are treated fairly.
These members ask the government about the cause of the dominant use by higher-educated people.
Deze leden vragen de regering naar de oorzaak van het dominante gebruik door hoogopgeleiden
Asks whether the abolition is sufficiently linked to the announced subsidy scheme and whether a draft scheme should be available so the Chamber can judge the decision.
Is a draft subsidy scheme available for the Chamber, so it can assess whether deciding now on abolishing the training deduction is wise?
Is er een concept-subsidieregeling voor de Kamer beschikbaar, om te kunnen beoordelen of nu besluiten tot afschaffing van de aftrek scholingsuitgaven verstandig is?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill abolishing the tax deduction for training and education expenses under the Income Tax Act 2001, raising no remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport merely notes the swift advice and that minor redactional and technical improvements were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35350-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement for the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, adjusting expenditure and commitments for the second supplementary budget. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2019.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council for the year 2019
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad voor het jaar 2019

35414.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, adding a supplementary budget of 10,000 thousand euro to article 11 as an emergency package for jobs and the economy. It sets the entry into force as 18 March 2020 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad publication is later.
q: Is amended, as appears from the corresponding budget schedule attached to this act.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35423.s: The bill amends the Postwet 2009 to reshape access to the national postal network, require a minimum share of postal deliverers to be on employment contracts with limited exceptions for disabled workers, tighten continuity and financing requirements for the universal postal service provider including Dutch establishment and an independent supervisory board, and delegate the number of collection and delivery days and related rules to lower regulation. It also replaces the ex-ante market-analysis regime with statutory access obligations and reference offers, and allows a royal decree to repeal the access rules later.
35423.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies delegation to lower regulation by the need to act quickly and flexibly as postal volumes decline, while keeping technical detail out of the statute.
q: Delegating provisions on the quality and scope of the universal service to a general administrative order allows the regulator to act quickly without harming justified public interests, legal certainty and equal treatment.

Het delegeren van bepalingen ten aanzien van (de kwaliteit en de reikwijdte van) de UPD naar algemene maatregel van bestuur stelt de regelgever in staat snel te kunnen acteren zonder hierbij afbreuk te doen aan gerechtvaardigde publieke belangen, de rechtszekerheid en de rechtsgelijkheid.
d: services and volumes subject to network access obligation
minimum percentage of postal deliverers on employment contracts
Artikel I, H (art. 16, vijfde en zesde lid)
number of collection and delivery days per week
capital and resources for continuity of universal service
financeability requirements for parent company liability statement
Artikel I, J (art. 20, eerste en vierde lid)
accessibility of letterboxes and alternative facilities; consent procedure
Artikel I, Q (art. 36a, eerste en tweede lid)
maximum rate of return and reporting for postal services
royal decree repealing access regulation articles 9-9b
p: Artikel I, A/E (art. 9, 9a, 9b) and F (repeal of ex-ante market analysis, chapter 3a)

Replaces the regulator's ex-ante market analysis discretion with statutory access obligations whose detailed terms are set by general administrative order and ministerial regulation, narrowing the regulator's role to dispute resolution and reports.
Allows a royal decree to repeal the access regulation, subject only to a voorhang procedure before parliament.
Adds reporting duties on future developments affecting universal service continuity.

parties: Asks how the minimum number of delivery days will be set in lower regulation and what objective criteria will apply, questioning the shift away from statute.
For this reason these members ask the government to make clear which assessment framework will be used for such a decision
Om deze reden vragen deze leden of de regering inzichtelijk kan maken welk afwegingskader gehanteerd zal worden bij een dergelijk besluit
Asks for a political-societal assessment framework before any downgrading of universal service and questions ACM versus Inspectie SZW enforcement of the 80% rule.
several parties in response to the bill point to the need for a political-societal assessment framework for any downgrading of the UPD
verschillende partijen in reactie op het wetsvoorstel wijzen op de noodzaak van een politiek-maatschappelijk afwegingskader bij een eventuele versobering van de UPD
Argues that reducing service quality through lower regulation is a political choice and asks why the Staten-Generaal has no role.
They consider this an essentially political choice and ask the government why no role for the States General has been foreseen.
Zij vinden dit bij uitstek een politieke afweging en vragen de regering waarom hierbij geen rol voor de Staten-Generaal is voorzien.
Opposes moving essential service guarantees out of statute against the Council of State's advice and asks the government to reconsider.
They ask the government to reconsider this amendment proposal.
Zij vragen de regering dit wijzigingsvoorstel in heroverweging te nemen.
Questions delegation of delivery and collection days to a general administrative order, saying it insufficiently respects the essential interests involved.

The SGP members place large question marks next to the proposal to shift statutory provisions on, among other things, the number of delivery and collection days to the level of a general administrative order.

De leden van de SGP-fractie zetten grote vraagtekens bij het voorstel om de wettelijke bepalingen omtrent onder meer het aantal bezorg- en ophaaldagen te verschuiven naar het niveau van een algemene maatregel van bestuur.
Asks how the balance of interests in downgrading universal service will be made and by whom, and asks for safeguards of workers' conditions.
Who decides this and which precise criteria are used to reach such a value judgment?
Wie bepaalt dit en welke precieze maatstaven worden hiervoor gehanteerd om tot een dergelijk waardeoordeel te komen?
Argues that downgrading universal service is fundamental and should require a deliberate public decision by parliament rather than lower regulation, and doubts ACM can enforce labour rules.
in these members' view a decision to downgrade the UPD, which may affect employment or vulnerable groups, should only be taken after a deliberate and public assessment by the people's representatives

naar de mening van deze leden dient een besluit tot versobering van de UPD, waarbij er bijvoorbeeld ook gevolgen kunnen zijn voor de werkgelegenheid of de impact op kwetsbare groepen, alleen maar genomen te worden na een bewuste en publieke afweging door de volksvertegenwoordiging
Worries that release of misdelivered mail to the sender may breach the constitutional letter secrecy when the sender is an intermediary.
They therefore ask the government whether it would not be more desirable for an opened mail item to go straight to the sender
Zij vragen daarom de regering of het niet wenselijker is dat een poststuk eenmaal geopend linea recta naar de afzender gaat
Asks how a broader societal vision for the postal market will be developed and how a deregulated private monopoly and quality norms will be assessed.
The D66 members ask how the government intends to develop a broader societal vision of the postal market, looking not only at economic returns but also at social impact, employment and innovation.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen op welke wijze de regering een bredere maatschappelijke visie op de postmarkt wil ontwikkelen, waarbij niet alleen gekeken wordt naar economisch rendement, maar waar meer nog gekeken wordt naar sociale impact, werkgelegenheid en innovatie.
Questions whether the ACM has enough resources to control PostNL's financial administration and asks for the ACM's role to be strengthened in law, and whether access protection is sufficient.
The PVV members further note that the ACM currently does not have enough resources to properly check PostNL's financial administration.
De leden van de PVV-fractie merken voorts op dat de ACM op dit moment niet genoeg middelen heeft om de financiële administratie van PostNL goed te controleren.
Has no additional questions after earlier written questions were answered.
These members currently have no additional questions.
Deze leden hebben op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen.
Asks about the administrative burden of annual UPD reporting, the effectiveness of ACM tariff regulation, and consistency with the EU Postal Directive and earlier motions.
The CDA members ask how the reporting obligation for the UPD operator is shaped in this bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen hoe de rapportageverplichting voor de uitvoerder van de UPD in dit wetsvoorstel wordt vormgegeven.
Objects to delegation of UPD scope to lower regulation contrary to Raad van State advice, and asks how flexibility will not erode statutory safeguards and regional access.
These members point out that the Council of State's advisory division has earlier stated that essential features of the UPD must be laid down at statutory level.
Deze ledenwijzen erop dat de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State eerder heeft aangegeven dat essentiële kenmerken van de UPD op wetsniveau moeten worden vastgelegd.
Asks about the feasibility of a consortium taking over the UPD, effects of a court ruling on the Sandd takeover, and new entrant access.
The VVD members understand that a consortium wants to take over PostNL's statutory delivery task.
De leden van de VVD-fractie begrijpen dat een consortium de wettelijke bezorgtaak van PostNL wil overnemen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Postwet 2009 covering access regulation, continuity of the universal postal service, flexibilisation of its requirements, and rules on foreign takeover, raising objections on market analysis, delegation of delivery days, access regulation by the Minister instead of ACM, the legal-form requirement under the Services Directive, and the ban on transactions contrary to the UPD. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, amending the bill and explanatory memorandum, though it did not adopt the advice to assign access regulation to ACM directly, instead giving the Minister power to request an ACM report.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that market developments and the Sandd/PostNL analyses be discussed in the explanatory memorandum, which the government added in section 2.2.
The Afdeling advised regulating the number of collection and delivery days in the law rather than by AMvB; the government kept the delegation but justified it in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked that the law set out how the consumer benefits of cost savings are secured, given the tariff system; the government said it will examine whether the current cost-allocation system suffices.
The Afdeling asked that the conditions for delivery to alternative facilities be legally secured; the government added consent requirements and assessment criteria.
The Afdeling advised assigning access regulation to ACM as sector regulator; the government instead gave the Minister power to request an ACM report on technical aspects.

The requirement that the UPD provider be an NV or BV with statutory seat in the Netherlands conflicts with Article 14 of the Services Directive; the government amended the bill to allow other company forms and EU seats.
The ban on UPD-incompatible transactions may restrict free movement of services and capital; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum with a justification.
Technical and drafting points from the Afdeling's redactional annex were incorporated, and the bill was amended in several technical respects.

35441.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by adding a supplementary allocation of 300 million euros for additional support to the cultural and creative sector in response to the Covid-19 crisis. It takes effect retroactively from 20 April 2020 and is accompanied by no explanatory memorandum text in the document provided.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2020

35450-IIA.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of the Dutch States General (parliament) through a first supplementary budget, raising appropriations for the Senate, House of Representatives and chamber apparatus by about 19.6 million euros. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 May 2020.
35450-IIA.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by citing postponed renovation of the Binnenhof and the need to move in 2020, with no new powers claimed.
q: This item concerns funds for audiovisual equipment to enable the primary meeting process, mainly in the temporary accommodation of the Senate on the Lange Voorhout.
Deze post betreft middelen voor audiovisuele apparatuur om het primaire vergaderproces voornamelijk in de tijdelijke huisvesting van de Eerste Kamer op het Lange Voorhout mogelijk maken.

35504.s: The bill tightens rules on tobacco and related product advertising by removing the 'speciaalzaak' concept and limiting permitted point-of-sale advertising to designated retail outlets, with conditions set by ministerial regulation. It also clarifies in the explanatory memorandum that provinces and municipalities may still set smoking bans in the public outdoor space through their autonomous regulatory powers.
35504.j: The memorandum justifies leaving the detailed advertising conditions to ministerial regulation by pointing to the link with the exceptions in the sales-display ban at amvb level.
d: Artikel 5, zesde lid, onderdeel b (as amended)
rules that point-of-sale advertising must meet
Artikel 5, derde lid (designated outlets, via amvb)
designation of permitted retail outlets for advertising, via reference to sales-ban exceptions

parties: Asks whether the government should have submitted an explicit bill on payments to shops instead of stretching the legal definition of advertising, and whether a small-business test and later start date are warranted.
Why does the government not choose to submit such a ban on payments explicitly as a bill to the House, instead of stretching the concept of 'advertising'?
Waarom kiest de regering er niet voor een dergelijk verbod op vergoedingen expliciet in een wetsvoorstel aan de Kamer voor te leggen, in plaats van hiertoe het begrip «reclame» op te rekken?
Questions the effectiveness of measures, asks whether municipalities could ultimately ban smoking in private homes and gardens, and questions the evidence base for extending the ban to e-cigarettes.
Could municipalities with this amendment ultimately go so far as to prohibit people from smoking in their own home, garden or balcony?
Kunnen gemeenten met deze wetswijziging uiteindelijk zo ver gaan dat zij mensen kunnen verbieden om in hun eigen huis, eigen tuin of op hun eigen balkon mogen roken?
Supports the prevention goals but asks why the NVWA was not given sanction powers such as a compliance order and penalty payments that it said would speed enforcement, and why exceptions were kept.
These members ask why the government has not included this power in this bill.
Genoemde leden vragen waarom de regering deze bevoegdheid niet heeft opgenomen in dit wetsvoorstel.

Supports a smoke-free generation but questions the net effect of the bill, the financial impact on shops, the rationale for including e-cigarettes, and whether decentralised smoking rules add excessive complexity.
Can the government again explain the usefulness and necessity of decentralised powers? Does this not make implementation too complex?
Kan de regering wederom toelichten wat de nut en noodzaak is van decentrale bevoegdheden? Maakt dit de uitvoering niet te complex?

Supports the amendments to limit tobacco exposure, but asks how municipal enforcement differences will be handled, whether a municipality could ban smoking in all public outdoor space, and whether the NVWA needs extra capacity.
Do the proposed amendments require additional capacity from the NVWA?
Vereisen de voorgestelde wijzigingen extra capaciteit van de NVWA?

Asks whether the government intends the parliament to decide the broadened definition of advertising through a formal law change rather than an explanatory remark, and asks for the income loss to specialist shops.
Does the government intend, with the explanatory memorandum, that the House pronounces itself on this definition?
Beoogt de regering met de memorie van toelichting dat de Kamer zich uitspreekt over deze definitie?

Argues that the broadened advertising definition covering payments to retailers has far-reaching effects and should be settled by formal legislation after parliamentary debate, not by a passing remark in the explanatory memorandum; also questions the evidence used against e-cigarettes.

Would it not be preferable, given the very far-reaching consequences for retail in general, to regulate this through a formal law change after a parliamentary debate, rather than through an offhand remark in the explanatory memorandum?

zou het dan niet de voorkeur genieten, mede gelet op de zeer verstrekkende gevolgen voor de detail handel in het algemeen, om dit te regelen middels een formele wetswijziging, na een debat in het parlement en niet door een terloopse opmerking in de Memorie van Toelichting?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill tightening the tobacco advertising ban under the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act, questioning the proportionality of the extended ban, the wholesale delegation of exemptions to a decree, and the proposed clause confirming municipal and provincial smoking-ban powers. The government's reply largely accepted the advice: it substantiated effectiveness and proportionality, kept the delegation with a justification, and removed the proposed clause on local powers while retaining the explanatory memorandum on that point.
concerns: The advisory division questioned whether the extended advertising ban adds effect beyond existing measures and whether less far-reaching alternatives and transitional arrangements were considered; the government added justification on effectiveness and alternatives but rejected compensation or a transition period.

The advisory division considered the wholesale delegation of exemptions to a decree, and the omission of the statutory definition of speciaalzaak, not a technical matter suitable for delegation; the government explained the rationale and removed the definition from the law.
The advisory division asked for the explanatory memorandum to address the specific effect of the advertising ban alongside other tobacco control measures, which the government supplemented.

The advisory division questioned the necessity and desirability of statutorily confirming municipal and provincial powers to adopt smoking bans in public space, and advised deleting the proposed clause, which the government did.

35513.s: The bill amends the Wet gemeenschappelijke regelingen and related laws to strengthen democratic legitimacy of joint arrangements by giving municipal councils, provincial councils and water board general boards written opinion rights before arrangements are established and before budgets are adopted, an information right, an advisory committee, a joint right of inquiry into arrangements, and a function-related allowance. It also expands room for differentiated arrangement design and extends the deadlines for budget submission.
35513.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as restoring the democratic legitimacy of joint arrangements under the principle of extended local governance, by giving councils better information and control instruments.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 9, lid 1 Wgr)
content of joint arrangement on amendment, termination and withdrawal
Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 10, leden 5-7 Wgr)
which board decisions councils may comment on and public participation in arrangements
powers, tasks and procedure of joint advisory committee set by general board
p: Creates a joint advisory committee of councillors that can prepare council decisions and advise the general board, strengthening councils' oversight role.
Introduces a joint right of inquiry allowing participating councils to investigate the management of joint arrangements.

parties: Asks whether the bill actually improves democratic legitimacy, warns of role confusion, and raises workload and slowdown concerns from wider objection procedures.
Does the bill actually solve the identified problems?
Lost het wetsvoorstel de geconstateerde problemen daadwerkelijk op?
Welcomes the bill as a step in the right direction for council oversight of joint arrangements, while asking about provincial differentiation and the federatiegemeente experiment.

These members recognise that the legitimacy of joint arrangements is directly linked to the powers councils have to exercise control and set frameworks for partnerships in which the municipality participates.

Deze leden onderkennen dat de legitima-tie van gemeenschappelijke regelingen direct gekoppeld is aan de mogelijk-heden die de raden hebben tot het uitoefenen van controle en het stellen van kaders bij samenwerkingsverbanden waaraan de gemeente deelneemt.
Supports strengthening democratic accountability of joint arrangements but worries about extra workload, fragmented council positions and the political status of the advisory committee.
The D66 members support the idea that the democratic legitimacy of, and political accountability for, municipal cooperation should be improved.
De leden van de D66-fractie ondersteunen de gedachte dat de democratische legitimatie van, en politieke verantwoording over, gemeentelijke samenwerking verbeterd moet worden.
Doubts the bill tackles the lack of time of councillors to oversee joint arrangements and asks how effective oversight of funds and convenants can be ensured.
With this bill that problem does not really seem to be tackled effectively.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt dat probleem niet echt effectief aangepakt zo lijkt het.
Sees serious erosion of local control and poor democratic oversight by joint arrangements and doubts the bill will remedy it, questioning the creation of a new governance layer.
The SP members see a serious erosion of local and regional control due to the huge number of joint arrangements and poor democratic oversight.
De leden van de fractie van de SP zien een ernstige uitholling van de lokale en regionale zeggenschap door de enorme hoeveelheid gemeenschappelijke regelingen en de slechte democratische controle.
Recognises the need to strengthen local representation but calls for a fundamental debate on democratic legitimacy of regional cooperation and asks about burden on councils.
These members recognise the need to better position local representation with respect to joint arrangements.
Genoemde leden herkennen de noodzaak om de lokale volksvertegenwoordiging beter in positie te brengen waar het de gemeenschappelijke regelingen betreft.
Doubts the proposals will help unless root causes are addressed, and warns that wider objection rights could cause role confusion between college and council.

In these members' assessment there is a distinction between strengthening councils' information position and research capacity on the one hand, and expanding councils' opportunities to actively intervene through objections on the other.

Naar de inschatting van deze leden bestaat een onderscheid tussen enerzijds het versterken van de informatiepositie en de onderzoeks-mogelijkheden van gemeenteraden en anderzijds de uitbreiding van mogelijk-heden voor gemeenteraden om zich door zienswijzen actief te mengen in het proces van besluitvorming.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft bill strengthening democratic legitimacy of joint arrangements (gemeenschappelijke regelingen) under the Wgr, raising concerns about role confusion for municipal councils, possible delays in decision-making, practical feasibility, the need for evaluation, and a broader need for fundamental discussion on local democracy. The Minister's reply largely rejects the concerns on role confusion and delay, accepts the evaluation and clarifies the memorandum, and acknowledges the need for a fundamental discussion while stating it should not delay short-term improvements.
concerns: The proposed zienswijze procedure and advisory committee risk blurring roles between municipal council, college and joint arrangement bodies, contrary to verlengd lokaal bestuur; the minister disagrees and sees no role confusion.

The instruments are doubtfully effective in improving democratic control, and the bill may only bring marginal change; the minister states the bill improves conditions but its effect depends on practice.

The new consultation and information duties may delay decision-making and reduce the executive board's capacity; the minister argues the instruments are optional and agreed in advance, so delay is manageable, and supplements the memorandum.

Councils' limited capacity, political fragmentation and majority voting may make the instruments hard to use in practice; the minister points to support measures and the evaluation, with the memorandum supplemented.
The Council of State recommends an adequate evaluation of the new instruments; the minister adopts this and proposes evaluation after four years.

The Council of State calls for a fundamental discussion on the design and scale of local and regional government and structural solutions for democratic legitimacy; the minister agrees it is needed but says it should not delay short-term improvements.

35522.s: The bill inserts a new Article 10 into the Winkeltijdenwet declaring unilateral changes to a shop's opening hours void against the owner or manager unless they expressly consented at the time. It applies to changes already notified before the act takes effect, and its commencement is set by royal decree.
35522.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as protecting shopkeepers from unilateral changes to opening hours by landlords and owners' associations, citing the Paddepoel case.
q: It is desirable that the decision-making power on this rests explicitly with the shopkeeper.
Het is wenselijk dat de beslissingsbevoegdheid hierover uitdrukkelijk bij de winkelier komt te liggen.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree
p: Shifts decision power over opening hours from third parties such as landlords and owners' associations to the individual shop owner, enforceable through civil courts.

parties: Asks about the size of the problem and whether the change may reduce coordination of opening hours and make shopping areas less attractive.
These members consider it positive that this law is aimed at determining when shops may be open, not when they must be open.
Deze leden vinden het positief dat deze wet erop is gericht om te bepalen wanneer winkels open mogen zijn, niet wanneer zij open moeten zijn.
Asks about court rulings on similar cases, fines imposed and collected, and whether the bill leads to more juridification of landlord-tenant relations.
Is it known how many lawsuits over comparable situations have taken place in the Netherlands in recent years?
Is bekend hoeveel rechtszaken over vergelijkbare situaties er in de afgelopen jaren in Nederland hebben plaatsgevonden?
Supports protecting small entrepreneurs against landlords and franchisors and against unilateral changes to opening hours, and asks whether other means exist.
These members consider it important that small entrepreneurs are protected against landlords and franchisors.
Zij vinden het belangrijk dat kleine ondernemers worden beschermd tegen verhuurders en franchisegevers.
Welcomes better protection of small entrepreneurs but asks about guarantees against disadvantage in contract renewal and the competitive effects of the change.
The SP members ask the government whether this amendment guarantees that an entrepreneur may not suffer disadvantage from his decision in contract renewal negotiations?

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of deze wijziging de garantie geeft dat een ondernemer geen nadeel van zijn of haar beslissing kan of mag ondervinden bij onderhandelingen over een contractverlenging?
Holds that shopkeepers must not be forced to open and asks why existing agreements and association decisions are not declared void.
Why is it not proposed that such existing agreements or decisions also be declared void?
Waarom wordt niet voorgesteld dat dergelijke bestaande overeenkomsten of besluiten ook nietig worden verklaard?
Asks how undue pressure on shopkeepers to accept longer hours can be prevented and whether market traders are covered.
These members ask the government how it can be prevented that shopkeepers feel forced or experience great pressure to agree against their will to changes in opening hours.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe kan worden voorkomen dat winkeliers zich gedwongen voelen, of grote druk ervaren om tegen hun wil in te stemmen met wijziging van de openingstijden.
Considers the bill does not go far enough, asks for retroactive correction of fines and a statutory limit on opening hours, and raises equal-treatment concerns over religion-based refusal.
These members have considerable questions about the proposal, mainly because in their view it does not go far enough.
Deze leden hebben de nodige vragen bij het voorliggende voorstel, met name omdat dit voorstel in hun ogen niet ver genoeg gaat.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill's added value is uncertain, because the explanatory memorandum does not show how large the problem is and does not adequately address the unequal bargaining position of small shopkeepers toward landlords and franchisors. The government's reply (nader rapport) argues that bargaining power falls outside the bill's scope, that the bill still strengthens the shopkeeper's legal position, and that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented and corrected.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the bill will be of great added value because the scale of the problem is unclear and shopkeepers may be pressured into accepting unilateral changes; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum but maintains the bill still strengthens the shopkeeper's position.

The Afdeling notes that the bill does not cover opening-hour clauses agreed in lease and franchise contracts; the government acknowledges bargaining power matters but says it lies outside the bill's scope.

35531.s: The bill amends the Mining Act to replace the existing geothermal permit regime with a three-stage system: a search-area allocation (toewijzing zoekgebied), a start permit (startvergunning) for exploration and extraction, and a follow-on extraction permit (vervolgvergunning), each with ministerial decision-making, advisory rounds for provinces and municipalities, and conditions. It also adds an obligation for EBN to participate in geothermal projects through a later decree and includes transitional rules for existing permits.
35531.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the detailed rules (ranking, refusal grounds, operator requirements) are technical and better set by general administrative order, and that the wide advisory rounds require a longer decision period.
q: The grounds for refusal may be further elaborated by general administrative order.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen de afwijzingsgronden nader worden uitgewerkt.
d: ranking procedure and criteria for competing applications
appointment and approval of extraction operators
splitting and merging of start permits
transfer of start permits with ministerial consent
obligation to cooperate on co-produced minerals agreement
retribution amounts for geothermal permit processing
p: The minister may attach conditions to start permits on safety, environment and financial grounds, with further rules by decree.
The minister may amend or revoke start permits on grounds including changed circumstances and insights, with the grounds left partly to later decree.
The minister may amend or revoke follow-on extraction permits on grounds of changed circumstances and environmental effects.
Mandatory EBN participation in geothermal projects, with the minister able to waive it, and the general rules to be set by decree.
The minister may withdraw approval of an operator who can no longer carry out work responsibly.

parties: Welcomes the bill to speed up geothermal energy but insists that all safety rules are complied with and asks how safety is guaranteed in the faster permit process.
At the same time, these members consider it important that all safety regulations are complied with.
Daarbij vinden deze leden het wel belangrijk dat alle veiligheidsvoorschriften worden nageleefd.
Stresses safety and the involvement of local residents, asks when residents will be involved, and questions how safety is balanced against promoting extraction.

With this specific legislation for the exploration and extraction of geothermal energy, it is very important to these members that sufficient attention is paid to safety and to the involvement of residents.
Bij deze specifieke wetgeving voor de opsporing en winning van aardwarmte is het voor deze leden van groot belang dat er voldoende aandacht is voor de veiligheid en de betrokkenheid van omwonenden.
Welcomes faster geothermal development and asks for a statutory assessment framework for permits, which would improve the reliability and checkability of advice.
These members note that with a clear assessment framework the advisory bodies have better guidance on which aspects must be tested and how testing should take place.
Deze leden constateren dat met een duidelijk beoordelingskader de adviesorganen een betere handreiking hebben op welke aspecten getoetst dient te worden en op welke wijze toetsing moet plaatsvinden.
Wants municipalities and provinces to have a strong steering role and not to be dependent on the market or the central government, and questions whether environmental safeguards are sufficient.
It must be prevented that subnational authorities become totally dependent on the market or the central government with regard to geothermal energy.
Voorkomen moet worden dat medeoverheden met betrekking tot geothermie totaal afhankelijk zijn van de markt of het Rijk.
Draws lessons from the Groningen gas-extraction disaster, argues the state supervision body SodM should be involved earlier, and asks who conducts risk research and whether it is independent.
Therefore these members once again plead for SodM to be involved as early as possible in the permit procedure.
Daarom pleiten deze leden nogmaals voor inmenging van de SodM zo vroeg mogelijk in de procedure van vergunningen.
Asks whether the bill is sharp enough on safety and drinking-water protection, including involvement of water companies and provincial rules on well design and groundwater monitoring.
Is the involvement of drinking water companies in the advice on permit applications by provinces adequately secured?
Is de betrokkenheid van drinkwaterbedrijven bij de advisering over vergunningaanvragen door provincies goed geborgd?

Supports facilitating geothermal energy with good safeguards, but asks for justification of the choice for a single-doublet start permit and how municipal advice can be made relevant at the early stage.
It is important to facilitate the extraction of geothermal energy and surround it with good safeguards.
Het is van belang de winning van aardwarmte te faciliteren en met goede waarborgen te omgeven.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on the draft amendment to the Mining Act creating a separate permit regime for geothermal energy, raising points on coordination with environmental permits, mandatory EBN participation, competition law and the Services Directive. The Minister's reply accepted several remarks (Services Directive scope, justification, competition guidance) but kept the coordination choice and mandatory EBN participation, while adding explanation and clarifications.
concerns: The Afdeling advised reconsidering the choice not to coordinate the start permit with environmental permits; the government kept the choice but added justification to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling questioned the necessity of EBN's significant mandatory financial participation and advised explaining why less intrusive alternatives would not suffice; the government added justification but kept the obligation.

The Afdeling flagged competition-law risks from coordination duties and EBN's knowledge-sharing role and advised clarifying safeguards; the government expanded the explanatory notes and guidance references.

The Afdeling noted the Services Directive applicability was not justified and that the justification of permit conditions was insufficient; the government revised the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
The Afdeling made several editorial remarks on the draft bill, which the government implemented.

35540.s: This seventh supplementary budget amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance, with effect from 1 October 2020, to extend lower BIR tariffs and fund support measures for subnational governments. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2020 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35603.s: The bill amends the Temporary Groningen Act to create a publicly run reinforcement regime for buildings affected by gas extraction from the Groningen field, including risk profiles, a municipal programme of approach, building assessments, reinforcement decisions and enforcement powers. It also gives the Minister of Interior power to enter buildings without consent, shortens appeal procedures to a single instance before the Council of State, and adds funding and reporting provisions.
35603.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers and delegations by the need for a faster, owner-centred reinforcement operation and by the practicality of rules best set by ministerial or administrative regulation.
q: The restriction to buildings means that infrastructure such as bridges and dikes falls outside the scope of the proposal.
De beperking tot gebouwen maakt dat infrastructuur, zoals bruggen en dijken, niet onder de reikwijdte van het voorstel vallen.
d: risk profiles and rules on assessing building safety
programme of approach rules and safety assessment methods
rules on the compensation claim for reinforcement costs
coordination of reinforcement and damage handling between ministry and Instituut
rules on specific grant for batch 1588 municipalities
rules on grant for Groningen province sustainability activities
p: Allows the Minister to authorise persons to enter homes without owner consent and to impose a duty to tolerate works on neighbouring property, subject to general appeal rights.
The Minister may decide not to reinforce a building or attach additional conditions to reinforcement decisions, with the owner's objections considered before decision.
Removes the ordinary two-instance appeal route for reinforcement decisions, making the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division the sole instance, with a six-month decision deadline.
ARTIKEL I, E (13e) and ARTIKEL I, F (13j(6))
Owners' private damage claims are restricted in favour of a public reinforcement route, with the owner required to assign claims to the State.

parties: Asks whether lower regulation (AMvB/ministerial rules) will be shared with parliament and why no evaluation clause is included.
The VVD members ask whether the government can provide an overview of the lower-level regulation flowing from this amendment, such as an AMvB or ministerial regulation.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of er een totaaloverzicht van lagere regelgeving die voortvloeit uit deze wetswijziging kan worden gegeven door de regering, bijvoorbeeld een algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) of ministeriële regeling.
Asks why no independent statutory body was chosen for strengthening decisions and why the Council of State's advice on a municipal advisory right and SodM's crisis approach were not followed.
These members ask the government to clarify why no advisory right was chosen for the municipalities.
Deze leden vragen de regering om te verduidelijken waarom er niet gekozen is voor een adviesrecht voor de gemeenten.
Questions whether the execution will be generous and adequate, asks whether the scope should be broadened beyond fatality risk, and whether residents' positions can be legally secured.

Argues the weakened statutory duty of care on NAM and the single-track approach undermine Groningers' legal position and trust in the rule of law, and demands a crisis approach with a single point of responsibility.
The SP members note that the 2018 amendment of article 52g(3) of the Mining Act weakened NAM's duty of care, making the legal position of Groningers weaker.

De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat de wijziging van artikel 52g, derde lid, van de Mijnbouwwet in 2018 maakte dat de zorgplicht van de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) werd afgezwakt, waarmee de rechtspositie van de Groninger zwakker werd.
Asks why no independent body decides on building safety, as the Council of State advised, and questions whether the narrow fatality-risk criterion excludes residents who suffered damage.
The PvdA members note that no independent body was chosen to assess building (un)safety, despite the Council of State's recommendation.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie merken op dat er niet is gekozen voor een onafhankelijke instantie om te beoordelen over de (on)veiligheid van een gebouw, ondanks de aanbeveling van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State.
Questions the complexity and dispersed responsibilities across bodies, and whether independence in strengthening decisions is sufficiently guaranteed, as the Council of State also asked.
These members, like the Council of State, also ask whether independence in taking strengthening decisions is sufficiently guaranteed.
Ook vragen deze leden, net als de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State, of de onafhankelijkheid bij het nemen van versterkingsbeslissingen wel voldoende gewaarborgd is.
Welcomes greater owner self-direction and asks about practical capacity to carry out agreements.
These members ask the government for a response to this.
Deze leden vragen een reactie hierop van de regering.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Temporary Groningen Act to create a public-law procedure for strengthening buildings against earthquake risk from gas extraction, raising concerns about the owner's position relative to damage compensation, the complexity of the decision procedure, delegation of decisions to municipalities, and the removal of supervisory powers of the mining inspector. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted several points, including merging decisions into one integrated decision and clarifying the Instituut's competences, while rejecting others such as a five-year limit on claims and the advice to make municipalities merely advisory.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that other administrative and societal considerations ranked above the safety of buildings, which conflicts with the purpose of strengthening; the government kept municipal roles but simplified the procedure.

The Afdeling found the multi-stage decision procedure with many actors complex and slow, and advised integrating the norm, strengthening and financing decisions into one decision; the government merged them into one integral decision.

The Afdeling asked for clearer demarcation between the Instituut's damage competences and the strengthening procedure and for preventing parallel or sequential procedures; the government added clarifying provisions and exclusion of switching between routes.

The Afdeling asked that the owner's position relative to damage settlement be secured, including independence of the body deciding on building safety; the government stressed ministerial responsibility and the advisory college rather than full independence.
The Afdeling advised against a general, open-ended power in the Crisis- en herstelwet to deviate from laws without safeguards; the government dropped that amendment.

The Afdeling advised that the owner's claim for a strengthening decision lapse after five years by analogy with civil limitation; the government rejected this as ill-suited to urgency and tailored work.

The Afdeling raised that the zorgplicht of the ministers in the Mijnbouwwet was moved in a way that narrowed the mining inspector's supervision; the government adjusted the provisions and clarified the inspector's advisory role.

35621.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Heerhugowaard and Langedijk into a new municipality called Dijk en Waard, with effect from the date of reorganisation. It also updates references to the two former municipalities in several other statutes (housing market, judicial districts, safety regions) and sets entry into force by royal decree.
q: This act enters into force at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: setting date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Questions whether joining Alkmaar for Sint Pancras and Koedijk was seriously examined and whether lacking local support was adequately weighed.
Was the option of having Sint Pancras and Koedijk join the municipality of Alkmaar seriously examined?
Is de optie om Sint Pancras en Koedijk aan te laten sluiten bij de gemeente Alkmaar serieus onderzocht?
Asks that the merger advice and provincial opinion be attached as annexes so parliament can review the basis of the bill.
These members request that the government add the merger advice with its accompanying documents and the provincial opinion as annexes to the response to the report.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering het herindelingsadvies met de bijbehorende documenten en de zienswijze van de provincie alsnog als bijlagen op te nemen bij de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag.
Questions how the bill fits the requirement that mergers come from below, given strong opposition, and why no referendum was held in all municipalities.
These members ask whether the government can further explain why no referendum was held in all participating municipalities.
Genoemde leden vragen of er nader kan er worden ingegaan op de vraag waarom er geen referendum in alle deelnemende gemeenten is gehouden.
Accepts the unified merger as addressing residents' concerns and hopes for successful cooperation with Alkmaar.

Together with the provincial executive of North Holland, the ChristenUnie members believe the reasons for an undivided merger, combined with the additions and changes made to the merger advice, address the concerns of residents of Sint Pancras and Koedijk.

Met de leden van de gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Noord-Holland, zijn de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie van mening dat de redenen voor een ongedeelde samenvoeging, in combinatie met de aanvullingen en wijzigingen die zijn doorgevoerd in het herindelingsadvies, tegemoet komen aan de zorgen en wensen voor de inwoners van Sint Pancras en Koedijk.

Asks the government to substantiate the claim that the merged municipality would be less robust without these villages, given their limited size, and whether a separate transfer of Koedijk to Alkmaar was discussed.
These members ask whether the government would substantiate this claim given the limited scale and weight of these villages.
Deze leden vragen of de regering deze stelling nader zou willen onderbouwen gelet op de beperkte schaal en het gewicht van deze kernen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a government bill to merge the municipalities of Heerhugowaard and Langedijk and found no remarks, advising the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties forwarded the advice and confirmed no substantive remarks required any change.

35711.s: The bill approves the Council decision of 14 December 2020 on the EU own resources system, which the Kingdom must endorse under Article 91 of the Constitution before being bound. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
35711.j: The memorandum justifies the approval by noting that Article 91 of the Constitution requires parliamentary approval of the treaty-level decision, and that the decision creates only obligations between member states, not rules binding individuals.
q: In the government's view, the Own Resources Decision contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat het Eigenmiddelenbesluit geen eenieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet

parties: Asks for parliamentary information on debt management, guarantees and the budgetary right of the Tweede Kamer, and insists the recovery fund stay temporary with a emergency brake.
The VVD members consider it necessary that the House of Representatives be informed about the debt management strategy of the European Union, as the Council of State also indicates.
