De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden het noodzakelijk dat de Tweede Kamer wordt geïnformeerd over (de strategie van) het schuldenbeheer van de Europese Unie, zoals de Raad van State ook aangeeft.
Asks for clarity on additional annual payments of about 1 billion euro, the headroom mechanism, and the planned introduction of new own resources.
Can the government explain which new own resources are being considered and state its position on them?
Kan de regering vertellen aan welke nieuwe eigen middelen hierbij wordt gedacht en aangeven hoe zij hier tegenover staat?
Asks for legal advice to be shared, a clear analysis of consistency with Article 311 TFEU, and a separate letter on the worst-case budgetary consequences of Dutch guarantees.
The CDA members request that the government share with the House all legal advice obtained on the EMB, internal, external and from the State Advocate.
De leden van de CDA-fractie verzoeken de regering alle juridische adviezen (intern, extern, landsadvocaat) die zijn ingewonnen over het EMB met de Kamer te delen.
Supports the recovery instrument as a historic step but asks how headroom spending decisions are made and how budgetary accountability toward parliaments is ensured.
In what way is the trade-off made between providing sufficient security and budgetary accountability of spending toward the parliaments?
Op welke manier wordt hierbij de afweging gemaakt tussen het bieden van voldoende zekerheid en de budgettaire verantwoording van bestedingen jegens de parlementen?
Opposes the bill as irresponsible borrowing for unclear goals with unclear repayment, and asks what happens if a member state cannot repay and why precedent is not addressed.
Why does the Council of State state clearly that precisely there lies a risk of having to pay off the share of another member state?
Hoe verklaart de regering dat de Raad van State klip en klaar zegt dat juist daar een risico ligt voor het moeten betalen van het aflossen van het deel van een andere lidstaat?
Questions the legal basis under Article 310 TFEU, which prohibits borrowing to finance policy spending, and echoes Council of State concerns about guarantees and precedent.
They believe a solid legal basis is lacking in the EU Treaty provisions and refer in particular to Article 310 TFEU.
Zij zijn van mening dat een solide rechtsgrondslag hiervoor ontbreekt in de Verdragsbepalingen van de EU, en verwijzen daarbij in het bijzonder naar artikel 310 VwEU.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill approving the EU Own Resources Decision, which funds the Next Generation EU recovery instrument through borrowing and member-state guarantees, and asked for a fuller explanation of the guarantee's fiscal consequences, possible precedent effects against Article 125 TFEU, and parliamentary information on debt management. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted all three points and expanded the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacked a qualitative and quantitative assessment of the consequences of Dutch guarantee liability for the Recovery Instrument, which the government addressed by adding budgetary detail.

Borrowing by the Commission to finance spending and mutual member-state guarantees raise questions under Articles 310, 311 and 125 TFEU, and the memorandum needed to address them and their precedent effects, which the government did by expanding paragraph 3.
The explanatory memorandum needed to explain how the Staten-Generaal is informed about the Commission's debt management strategy, which the government addressed in the expanded text.

35720.s: The bill amends the Pilotage Act to update market supervision of registered pilots, replacing the fixed benchmark and FLP/FLO financing rules with a cost-plus tariff system including an efficiency discount, a quality reporting duty and new pilot disciplinary procedures. It also introduces a pilot-on-distance experimentation power and repeals the earlier 2008 market supervision act.
35720.j: The memorandum justifies the efficiency discount and experimentation power by citing the evaluation finding that the ACM lacked tools for effective supervision and that pilot technology may change.
q: Supervision is experienced by both the pilots and the ACM as ineffective and suboptimal.
Het toezicht wordt zowel door de loodsen als ACM ervaren als niet effectief en suboptimaal.
d: temporary experiments deviating from pilot on-board advisory role
first adoption of regulations under art. 15 by ministerial regulation
method of alternative tariff calculation with efficiency discount
ACM sets method and parameters for cost of capital
appointment of disciplinary college members by minister
minister may demand information and conduct investigation
p: Allows temporary deviation by general administrative order from the statutory on-board pilot advisory role for up to five years in experiments.
Shifts tariff setting toward cost-plus and an ACM-determined efficiency discount calculated via ministerial regulation, with pilot and stakeholder consultation.
Expands the minister's power to demand information and order investigations of the pilot corporations.
Allows the minister to adopt first-time regulations by ministerial regulation rather than by statute or decree.

parties: Asks who is liable in incidents, how experiments are approved and what role harbour masters and users play, and how the Chamber will be informed about quality reports and experiments.
To what extent is the Chamber informed about this and what is its influence on it?
In hoeverre wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd en wat is haar invloed hierop?
Doubts the effectiveness of the bill for cost efficiency and market oversight, and worries the experiment clause could be repeated indefinitely without legal certainty or parliamentary role.
Is it correct that despite this warning, under the current provision it would still technically be possible to repeat the maximum experiment period of five years indefinitely?
Klopt het dat ondanks deze waarschuwing het onder de huidige bepaling nog steeds technisch gezien mogelijk zou zijn om de maximale experimenteerduur van vijf jaar oneindig te herhalen?
Asks for a sunset clause limiting experimental deviation from the law to five years and questions the limits of ministerial responsibility over pilotage quality.
Does the government share the view that without such a limit on deviating from the law, the role of the States General as co-legislator would be undermined?
Deelt de regering de opvatting dat zonder een dergelijke grens aan het afwijken van de wet, de rol van de Staten-Generaal als medewetgever te kort zou worden gedaan?
Fears that introducing efficiency incentives in a service with major safety risks could encourage unnecessary risks, and questions the government's justification for incentives.
that stimulating further efficiency incentives may induce taking unnecessary risks.
dat het stimuleren van verdere efficiencyprikkels het nemen van onnodige risico's kan uitlokken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet actualisatie markttoezicht registerloodsen, raising doubts about effectiveness of the tariff and oversight changes, the efficiency discount, the integral hourly rate, the experimentation clause, disciplinary procedure, and delegation. The minister's reply largely accepted several points (added ACM investigation power, revised efficiency discount, deleted secretary-assistance clause, deleted sunset/parliamentary provisions, added artikelsgewijze toelichting) while rejecting or only partly addressing others such as the alternative regulatory model and the integral hourly rate's efficiency rationale.
concerns: Doubts whether the bill sufficiently achieves policy goals; more far-reaching changes to tariff regulation and oversight seem warranted but were not justified; government added an ACM investigation power and a supplementary tariff-justification requirement but kept the cost-plus model.

Doubts that the generic efficiency discount will work, since it only applies in growth scenarios; government changed the discount to 1 percent per 1000 trips capped at 2.5 percent but declined a discount for declining trips.
Integral hourly rate's contribution to smoother tariff development and efficiency was insufficiently explained; government gave a further explanation without changing the rule.

The experimentation clause is unnecessary and its stated purpose is too vague; government narrowed the purpose and added specific fields, and removed the automatic withdrawal mechanism in favour of evaluation provisions in implementing decisions.
Ministerial power to change the efficiency discount, with a limit of once every three years and a parliamentary pre-submission requirement, was insufficiently justified; these limits were removed.
Secretary assistance for the complainant but not the registerloods raises equality-of-arms concerns under Article 6 ECHR; the provision was deleted.
Relationship between the disciplinary procedure and the complaint procedure under the EU Port Services Regulation needed clarification; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
Missing artikelsgewijze toelichting and a redactional annex with drafting corrections; government added the article-by-article commentary and made the corrections.

35801.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, adding a one-off supplementary budget of about 230 million euro (mainly 230,000 thousand euro in the general article) to write off public debts from childcare allowance (toeslagen) arrears. It sets the budget unit as thousands of euro and makes the law effective from 12 April 2021.

35900.s: The bill gives statutory footing to internationalisation tasks in education by adding Article 3a (tasks for Stichting Nuffic, including recognition advice and information) and Article 3b (allowing the minister to designate a legal entity to inform the education field about EU policy) to the Wet subsidiëring landelijke onderwijsondersteunende activiteiten 2013. It also lets the minister give general directions to Nuffic, intervene if tasks are seriously neglected (with notice to Parliament), set annual subsidy ceilings, and requires an evaluation report to Parliament within five years.
35900.j: The memorandum justifies the subsidy and designation powers by the need to secure information and expertise for national education goals, and justifies the intervention power by the Court of Audit's point that financial sanctions alone may not get neglected tasks performed.
q: In response to this point from the Court of Audit, a power to give directions to Nuffic has been included, together with a regulation on neglect of tasks.
Derhalve is naar aanleiding van dit aandachtspunt van de Algemene Rekenkamer een bevoegdheid opgenomen om aanwijzingen te geven aan Nuffic en is er een taakverwaarlozingsregeling opgenomen.
d: designation of a legal entity to inform the education field on EU policy
general directions (aanwijzingen) to Stichting Nuffic on performing its tasks
annual ceiling and distribution of available funds for internationalisation activities
p: If Nuffic seriously neglects its tasks and ignores ministerial directions, the minister may take necessary measures after giving Nuffic a chance to comply, and must immediately inform both chambers of Parliament.
The minister may withdraw the designation of the designated entity for listed grounds, including failure to meet accountability conditions set in the designation.
The minister must report to Parliament within five years on the effectiveness and effects of the law in practice.

parties: Asks whether other organisations could have taken the national information centre task and how the separate supervisory arrangement will be set, including timing relative to plenary debate.
When will this arrangement be established? Will it be at the same time as the plenary debate of the bill, the members ask.
Wanneer wordt dit arrangement vastgesteld? Is dat gelijktijdig met de plenaire wetsbehandeling, zo vragen de leden.
Questions whether state-aid risks flagged by the Council of State advisory division are adequately covered and whether prior review of unlawful state aid is possible.
Are the state-aid risks, in view of the advice of the Council of State advisory division, sufficiently addressed by the bill?
Zijn de staatssteunrisico’s – gelet op het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State – met het wetsvoorstel voldoende ondervangen?
Asks whether tendering was considered for tasks that could be offered by market parties, and how a legal-entity designation avoids overlap with the foundation proposal.

Furthermore the members note that, regarding the bill's legal entity to be designated to inform the Dutch knowledge field about EU education, research and innovation policy, they refer to the remarks and questions already raised at the prior consultation on founding a foundation, to avoid overlap.

Voorts merken de leden op dat, voor wat betreft het wetsvoorstel gaat over de aan te wijzen rechtspersoon die als taak krijgt om het Nederlandse kennisveld te informeren over het beleid van de Europese Unie op het gebied van onderwijs, onderzoek en innovatie, zij – om overlapping te voorkomen – verwijzen naar de opmerkingen en vragen die reeds gesteld zijn bij de voorhang voor het oprichten van een stichting.

Finds the open-ended mandate to promote internationalisation undefined and asks for binding guidelines and the ministry's directing role, including what counts as serious neglect of tasks and where students can turn.

The members find unbridled internationalisation of higher education undesirable. They therefore ask the government for further guidelines within which Nuffic can operate and what directing or task-setting role the Minister and the ministry have themselves, the members ask.

De leden vinden ongebreidelde internationalisering van het hoger onderwijs ongewenst. Zij vragen de regering daarom om nadere richtlijnen waarbinnen Nuffic kan opereren en welke sturende of taakstellende rol de Minister en het ministerie daarin zelf heeft, zo vragen de leden.
Asks whether a statutory basis is needed for Nuffic's embedding in national and European networks.
Can Nuffic's embedding in the national network be regulated by law? If so, how?
Kan de inbedding van Nuffic in het nationale netwerk wettelijk geregeld worden? Zo ja, hoe?

Objects that the 'other activities' mandate is unbounded and that the government is taking on information provision that may be a private responsibility, warning of expanding public tasks; asks about the timetable given the rule that execution should follow adoption.

These members believe that Nuffic's task to develop other activities is very undefined, so that activities could be carried out that do not strictly belong to the public task, and activities that also belong to the domain of other parties in the market and education field.

Deze leden menen dat de taak van Nuffic om overige activiteiten te ontwikkelen erg onbepaald is en dat daardoor zowel activiteiten kunnen worden uitgevoerd die niet strikt tot de publieke taak behoren en activiteiten die ook tot het domein behoren van andere partijen in de markt en het onderwijsveld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet wettelijke taken internationalisering onderwijs, which legally anchors tasks of the foundation Nuffic and asks for the explanatory memorandum to address the background, state aid risks, the relation to the Erasmus implementation act, and ministerial steering. The minister's reply states that the memorandum and the bill were amended on these points, including removing the separate research task and clarifying the statutory and financial separation of Nuffic's activities.
concerns: Tasks that may be economic services risk state aid and procurement violations, requiring justification of the exclusive designation of Nuffic under EU rules.
The explanatory memorandum insufficiently explains the reason for the bill, including the state aid risks and the 2019 reconsideration of the subsidy.
The relation between this bill and the Erasmus implementation act, and Nuffic's status as rwt versus zbo, was left unexplained and has been clarified.
Ministerial steering of Nuffic and its internal organisation and bookkeeping separation were not described and have been added to the memorandum.

36035.s: The bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) through a fourth supplementary budget for the IPCEI hydrogen project, adding €35 million in commitments and expenditure to the energy and climate policy article. It also sets the effective date of the amended budget as 16 February 2022, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2022

36053.s: The bill approves the 1 June 2021 tax treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Republic of Cyprus on avoiding double taxation and preventing tax evasion and avoidance, with its protocol, for the European and Caribbean parts of the Netherlands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The Treaty concluded at Nicosia on 1 June 2021 ... is approved for the European and Caribbean parts of the Netherlands.
Het op 1 juni 2021 te Nicosia tot stand gekomen Verdrag ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het Europese deel en het Caribische deel van Nederland.

parties: Asks that its contribution to the written consultation be included in the legislative history of the treaty; otherwise has no questions.
These members ask whether their contribution to the written consultation on this Treaty can be included in the legislative history of this Treaty.
Deze leden vragen of de inbreng van deze leden bij het schriftelijk overleg 1 over dit Verdrag mee kan worden genomen bij de wetsgeschiedenis van dit Verdrag.
Supports the government's ambition to conclude tax treaties with all other EU member states; has no further questions.
These members endorse the government's ambition for cooperation through concluding tax treaties with all other EU member states.
Deze leden onderschrijven de ambitie van de regering voor samenwerking in de vorm van het afsluiten van belastingverdragen met alle andere EU-lidstaten.
Has taken note of the bill with interest and has no questions.
The CDA members have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions.
De leden van het CDA hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben verder geen vragen.

Asks whether Cyprus would appear on the non-cooperative jurisdictions list without EU membership, what other EU criteria apply, how Cyprus implements EU Russia sanctions, and what is known about tax constructions via Cyprus.
The SP members therefore ask the government whether Cyprus, if the same criteria were applied, would be on this list if it were not an EU member state.
De leden vragen de regering daarom of Cyprus, wanneer dezelfde criteria worden gehanteerd, op deze lijst zou staan wanneer het geen EU-lidstaat was geweest.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the tax treaty between the Netherlands and Cyprus, advising that it be submitted to parliament, but made four drafting remarks on the explanatory note (updating to the 2020 tax treaty policy note, explaining data protection compliance for information exchange, and clarifying protocol provisions). The minister's reply states all four remarks were followed by amending the explanatory note and asks authorisation to submit the treaty for tacit approval.
concerns: The explanatory note should be updated from the 2011 to the 2020 Dutch fiscal treaty policy note; the minister clarified the treaty was negotiated before the 2020 note and kept the 2011 basis.

The explanatory note should explain and justify compliance with data protection law for the processing of personal data in information exchange; the minister added that the GDPR applies in Cyprus as an EU member state.
The explanation of article 3 of the protocol should be added to the explanatory note on article 13 of the treaty; the minister added this.
The explanation of article 2(1) of the protocol should be added to the explanatory note on article 20 of the treaty; the minister added a cross-reference.

36071.s: The bill creates an electoral college for Dutch non-residents in The Hague, whose members will elect Eerste Kamer members representing non-residents, and sets its composition, procedures, remuneration and electoral rules. It amends the Kieswet to add a chapter for electing the college and the Eerste Kamer by the college, largely by reference to existing provincial-council rules, with online procedures and ministerial/AMvB rule-making powers.
36071.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to adapt the existing provincial-council rules to a fully remote, non-resident electorate and to allow practical technical details to be set later.
q: Article 8:4(4)(a) of the General Administrative Law Act is amended to add the electoral college for the Eerste Kamer for Dutch non-residents to the list of elections where no appeal to the administrative court is open.

Artikel 8:4, vierde lid, onderdeel a, van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht wordt na «van provinciale staten,» ingevoegd «van het kiescollege voor de Eerste Kamer voor Nederlanders die geen ingezetenen zijn,».
d: Artikel 5 lid 2 / Artikel 27 lid 2 / Artikel 19 lid 4
online session rules, remuneration details, college procedures
fixing amount of member allowances and travel costs
Artikel Pa 15 lid 1 / Artikel Pa 26 / Artikel Pa 16 lid 3 / Artikel Pa 27 lid 3
publication of session time and digital location, digital meeting rules
postal ballot dispatch details and ministerial model forms
model form for proxy notification by college members
electronic delivery of appointment notices and authentication
rules on deliberation and voting in the digital environment
p: Chair may bar a college member from the meeting or from attending for up to three months for disruptive conduct, with a vote on the proposal.
The college sets its own instruction governing the clerk's tasks and powers.
Rules on digital meeting environment and voting may be set by general administrative order, limiting physical public scrutiny of the college's proceedings.
Decisions admitting new college members are excluded from appeal to the administrative court, narrowing judicial review of membership decisions.

parties: Welcomes the bill and wants it in force in time for 2023; asks about electronic voting security and proxy voting logistics without challenging executive checks.
These members consider it a good thing that Dutch citizens abroad also gain influence over the composition of the Eerste Kamer.
Deze leden achten het een goede zaak dat ook Nederlanders in het buitenland invloed krijgen op de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer.
Supports the bill and asks for clarification on seat allocation and keeping the registry current, urging swift handling.
They therefore underline the importance of handling the implementing act as quickly and carefully as possible and have a number of critical questions for the government.
Zij onderstrepen dan ook het belang om de uitvoeringswet zo snel en zorgvuldig mogelijk te behandelen en hebben nog een aantal kritische vragen die zij willen voorleggen aan de regering.
Supports the principle but asks about the basis for the seat threshold guaranteeing secrecy and how to increase registration of voters abroad.
These members find it desirable that Dutch citizens living abroad will henceforth have influence over the composition of the Eerste Kamer.
Deze leden vinden het wenselijk dat Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen voortaan invloed hebben op de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer.

Opposes the electoral college in principle, arguing the Constitution's residence requirement is not honoured, and objects that vote weighting based on registered voters is arbitrary and may rest on unreliable data.
Does the government agree with the SP members that the choice to count registered voters abroad is in that respect arbitrary?
Is de regering het met de leden van de SP-fractie eens dat de keuze voor het meetellen van geregistreerde kiezers in het buitenland in dat opzicht willekeurig is?
Asks for justification of the non-resident eligibility rule and worries that the government lacks clear sight of non-resident voters, which could impair their voting rights.
Does the government currently have a good view of Dutch non-residents with regard to the aspects relevant to exercising their voting right?
Heeft de regering op dit moment goed zicht op Nederlandse niet-ingezetenen met het oog op de aspecten die relevant zijn voor hun uitvoering van hun stemrecht?
Asks the government to motivate the eligibility requirement and the vote weighting, citing Raad van State doubts about the registry and possibly deceased persons counting.
These members ask whether it is correct that deceased persons can count toward the voting weight because death notifications do not necessarily reach the voter register.
Deze leden vragen of het juist is dat personen die zijn overleden kunnen meetellen in de stemwaarde omdat meldingen van overlijden niet per definitie bij het register kiesgerechtigden terecht komen.

Questions whether the second reading of the constitutional amendment should proceed given Kiesraad advice on impracticality, and asks for fuller reasoning on vote weight not tied to a geographic area.
Does this finding not call for a fundamental reconsideration of the plan to introduce this electoral college?
Noopt deze constatering niet tot een fundamentele heroverweging van het voornemen om dit kiescollege in te voeren?
Asks whether abroad voters' votes would count disproportionately heavily if turnout is much lower than in provincial elections, and whether the bill will be adjusted.
Is the government willing to adjust the proposal in this respect and if not, why not?
Is de regering bereid om het voorstel hierop aan te passen en zo nee, waarom niet?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in February 2022 that the bill creating a non-resident electoral college for the Eerste Kamer needs revision, raising concerns about the vote weight calculation based on registered voters, the restriction of membership to non-residents (risking too few candidates and limiting passive voting rights), and the lack of a statutory evaluation. The government's reply in April 2022 rejects most objections, defends the permanent registration system and non-resident membership requirement, and adds only minor clarifications, including a calculation example and a planned evaluation.
concerns: The vote weight based on registered non-resident voters could give disproportionate influence if turnout is much lower than for provincial elections, and periodic cleaning of the register should be considered.
Restricting electoral college membership to non-residents may narrow the pool of candidates and thereby restrict passive voting rights, and its necessity should be reconsidered.
The requirement to physically assemble in the Netherlands may deter candidacy and service, and the government agreed to investigate such obstacles, with the evaluation to address them.
The Afdeling questions whether the constitutional provision necessarily implies the non-residence requirement for membership, suggesting it may be open to a different reading.

The explanatory memorandum should be supplemented with a worked example of the vote weight and the evaluation should be addressed, which the government did by adding an example and clarifying the evaluation.

36080.s: The bill inserts a new article 23a into the Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018 prohibiting trust offices from providing trust services to clients, target companies, or ultimate beneficial owners resident or established in Russia or Belarus, with exceptions for sanctioned persons and EU/EEA/Swiss nationals or residence permit holders. It also adds the new article to the Wet op de economische delicten and requires existing licensed trust offices to comply within four weeks of entry into force.
36080.j: The memorandum justifies the immediate prohibition as an urgent measure in response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine, which is why it is entering into force the day after publication.
q: With this bill an urgent measure is taken in light of Russia's invasion of Ukraine and the serious violation of international law.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt een spoedmaatregel getroffen in het licht van de inval van Rusland in Oekraïne en de ernstige schending van het internationaal recht.

parties: Supports the urgent sanctions measure and has no further questions.
These members emphasise the importance of sanctions and endorse the need for the urgent measure prohibiting trust services to clients established or resident in the Russian Federation or Belarus.

Deze leden benadrukken het belang van sancties en onderschrijven de noodzaak van de spoedmaatregel om het verlenen van trustdiensten aan cliënten gevestigd of woonachtig in de Russische Federatie of de Republiek Belarus te verbieden.
Asks about leakage to other EU countries, circumvention through golden passports and UBO constructions, and DNB's enforcement capacity.
These members ask about the consequences for European capital markets if clients who may not receive trust services in the Netherlands can still receive them in another (European) country.

Deze leden vragen daarbij naar de gevolgen voor de Europese kapitaalmarkten als cliënten waar in Nederland geen trustdienstverlening voor mag worden uitgevoerd deze trustdienstverlening nog wel in een ander (Europees) land kunnen ontvangen.
Asks whether the prohibition merely displaces the problem to other service providers and how dual nationals will be treated.
For example, they may find another service provider that takes over part of the services that do not qualify as trust services.
Zo kan het zijn dat zij een andere dienstverlener vinden die een deel van de diensten, die niet kwalificeren als trustdiensten, overneemt.
Supports the measure but raises concerns about enforceability given DNB's capacity burden and asks how the measure will be monitored and reported to parliament.
The CDA members are somewhat concerned about the enforceability of this bill, partly because DNB has indicated that enforcing the ban will place a considerable capacity burden in the short term.

De leden van de CDA-fractie maken zich enige zorgen over de handhaafbaarheid van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel, onder andere vanwege het feit dat DNB heeft aangegeven dat handhaving van het verbod op korte termijn een flinke capaciteitsbelasting met zich meebrengt.
Questions whether client files are complete, how DNB supervises them, and whether DNB receives extra capacity.
The SP members ask the government how this will be provided for. Will DNB receive more FTEs?
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering hoe hierin wordt voorzien? Krijgt DNB meer fte tot zijn beschikking?
Supports the aim but doubts effectiveness, citing the UBO residence criterion, golden passport loophole, splitting of services and enforcement difficulties.
These members ask whether this emergency measure leaves an avoidance route open for wealthy Russians holding a so-called golden passport.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen of deze spoedmaatregel een ontwijkingsmogelijkheid open laat voor vermogende Russen met een zogenaamd «gouden paspoort».
Supports the bill in principle but argues it does not reach Putin or oligarchs and calls for ending the Netherlands' role as a tax haven.
Does the government agree that money laundering and tax avoidance by Russian oligarchs are a logical consequence of the political choice to let the Netherlands function as a tax haven?
Is de regering het ermee eens dat witwassen en belastingontwijking door Russische oligarchen een logisch gevolg is van de politieke keuze om Nederland als belastingparadijs te laten fungeren?
Asks for clarification on the time limit of the ban and on how enforcement and sanctions for non-compliance will work.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government to clarify how the ban will be enforced and what sanctions will apply in case of non-compliance.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie verzoeken de regering te verhelderen hoe het onderhavige verbod gehandhaafd wordt en van welke sancties sprake zal zijn bij eventuele niet-naleving van het verbod.
Asks about alternative service providers, enforcement capacity at DNB and AFM, and the criteria for residence.
Can the government elaborate on the enforceability of the criterion for determining residence or establishment, now that DNB indicates that criteria assessed case by case are not easy to enforce?

Kan de regering nader ingaan op de handhaafbaarheid van het criterium om de woonplaats of vestigingsplaats vast te stellen, nu DNB aangeeft dat criteria die steeds naar de omstandigheden worden beoordeeld, niet eenvoudig handhaafbaar zijn?

Criticises the government for slow action and for dropping two measures from the Raad van State-advised bill; questions the residence and nationality criteria, UBO verification, and asks for disclosure of lobby contacts.
Member Omtzigt notes that he has observed that two of the three measures in the bill as submitted to the Council of State for advice have been removed.
Het lid Omtzigt merkt op dat het hem is opgevallen dat twee van de drie maatregelen uit het wetsvoorstel zoals dat aan de Raad van State ter advisering was voorgelegd, zijn gesloopt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised splitting the urgent trust-service ban on Russia and Belarus from the non-urgent parts of the bill and justifying the proportionality of the ban for EU citizens. The Minister of Finance followed the advice by submitting only the urgent part, added an exception for EU nationals and residents, and expanded the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The bundling of urgent sanctions measures with non-urgent provisions risks compromising careful parliamentary scrutiny, so the urgent part should be submitted as a separate bill.
The ban also affects EU citizens residing in Russia or Belarus, raising the question of proportionality, which the explanatory memorandum did not address.
The advice asks whether less far-reaching alternatives were considered; the government responded that no suitable lighter measure exists.
Compatibility of the ban on pass-through companies with the proposed EU directive on shell companies and the Commission's findings should be examined.

36107.s: This omnibus tax bill (Fiscale verzamelwet 2023) makes many technical amendments across tax laws, including the Wet IB 2001, Wet DB 1965, Wet LB 1964, Wet Vpb and AWR, mainly on pensions, dividends, objection procedures and interest. It also changes the ministerial powers on payment claims, interest-stop rules and a new hardship payment deferral, and moves certain foreign tax-treaty refusal decisions into the tax court's jurisdiction.
36107.j: The memorandum justifies the technical changes as simplifying legal remedies and reducing procedural risk for taxpayers, and the ministerial regulation powers as needed for efficient execution and case-by-case tailoring.
q: It is proposed to apply the reciprocal system in all situations, so that all objectionable decisions whose amounts are shown on the assessment notice alongside the tax assessment are deemed part of the tax assessment for objection and appeal.

Voorgesteld wordt voor alle situaties het wederkerige systeem te laten gelden en derhalve te regelen dat alle voor bezwaar vatbare beschikkingen waarvan de bedragen naast de bedragen van de belastingaanslag op het aanslagbiljet zijn vermeld, voor de toepassing van de wettelijke bepalingen inzake bezwaar en beroep geacht worden onderdeel uit te maken van de belastingaanslag.
d: situations where tax deemed already paid; exceptions and procedural rules for interest reduction
Artikel XII, onderdeel B (artikel 25, eenentwintigste lid Invorderingswet 1990)
rules for deferred payment of at least five years in cases of undue hardship for individuals
Artikel II, onderdeel C (artikel 28, eerste lid Wet LB 1964)
rules on how payroll data is to be provided to the tax administration and UWV
p: Refusals of requests for mutual agreement procedures under tax treaties become appealable objection decisions reviewable by the fiscal court instead of the general administrative court, a change in the forum for review of executive decisions.

parties: Asks whether the amended dividend-stripping rule has retroactive effect and whether fiscal law should apply retroactively at all.
Asks about budgetary effects and procedural disruption from the discretionary tax-interest measure, without taking a firm position.
These members ask what kind of process disruptions are risked by introducing the tailored tax-interest measure.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen welk type procesverstoringen geriskeerd worden door de invoering van de maatregel maatwerk belastingrente.
Worries that discretionary tailoring of tax interest could lead to arbitrary, unequal treatment and asks how this is prevented.
These members would like to know from the government how it can be prevented that justified tailoring slides into potential arbitrariness.
Deze leden zouden graag van de regering vernemen hoe voorkomen kan worden dat terecht maatwerk doorschiet in potentiële willekeur.
Questions the Raad van State's criticism that inconsistent policy-decision procedures hamper parliamentary control, and asks for a framework on exceptions.
Asks how equal treatment of similar cases is guaranteed under discretionary tax-interest rules and whether this creates legal inequality.
Can the government rule out that tailoring leads to legal inequality?
Kan de regering uitsluiten dat maatwerk betekent dat er rechtsongelijkheid ontstaat?
Welcomes the possibility of payment deferral in distressing cases but asks for detail on the lower regulation defining such situations.
These members ask the government to explain by when this lower regulation will be implemented.
Deze leden vragen de regering om toe te lichten op welke termijn deze lagere regelgeving geïmplementeerd zal worden.
Criticises policy adopted with retroactive effect and use of exception rules that sideline parliament, and asks for a published framework limiting such exceptions.
In all these procedures, in this member's view, the States General are in effect sidelined.
Bij al deze procedures worden de Staten-Generaal in de ogen van dit lid de facto buiten spel gezet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Fiscale verzamelwet 2023, raising concerns about tax-interest rules, the codification of goedkeurende beleidsregels with retroactive gaps, binding of appealable decisions to the tax assessment, abolition of the payment discount on provisional corporate tax, and retroactivity for local tax payment claims. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport accepts most points, adjusts the bill and memorie van toelichting, drops retroactivity for local taxes and the IACK codification, but keeps the tax-interest system largely unchanged.
concerns: Retroactive or non-codified goedkeurende beleidsregels (lifetime annuities, pension, tax credit, inheritance deferral) lack an adequate statutory basis for the gap periods; government moves codification to 1 January 2023 and clarifies the inheritance deferral in a ministerial regulation.

Retroactive effect for the local tax payment claim (betalingsvordering) raises legal certainty concerns; government dropped retroactivity for the Gemeentewet, Provinciewet and Waterschapswet amendments.

Tax-interest reduction (maatwerk) and interest stop for supplementary assessments need clearer explanation of ambtshalve application, discretionary 'kan' wording and the burden on taxpayers; memorie van toelichting was supplemented.

The overall tax-interest system (high statutory minimum rates, interest running through the full payment term) appears unreasonable and fragmented; government says it will re-examine the system in this cabinet term but makes no change now.

Binding appealable decisions to the assessment adds about 26.5 FTE in Belastingdienst costs and procedural complexity; government justifies it as improved legal protection and adds explicit exclusions for other levies.

Abolition of the payment discount for provisional corporate tax lacks a substantive motivation beyond the augustus 2019 decision-making; government supplements the memorie van toelichting but keeps the discount for income tax.

36120-X.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence through a first supplementary budget, adding about EUR 45.5 million net via interdepartmental budget transfers and other adjustments. It also sets the budget to be expressed in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 June 2022.
36120-X.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to interdepartmental budget transfers, underspending in 2021, and rising costs for the Nationaal Fonds Ereschuld, without any delegation of power.
q: On balance, the Defence budget rises as a result of the interdepartmental budget transfers by EUR 45.5 million.
Per saldo stijgt de begroting van Defensie als gevolg van de interdepartementale budgetoverhevelingen met € 45,5 miljoen.

36143.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Defence through a second supplementary budget, adjusting obligations, expenditure and receipts across operational and non-operational articles. It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and makes it effective from 1 May 2022 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2022

36152.s: The bill sets out implementing rules for the EU Service of Documents Regulation (2020/1784), designating bailiffs and courts as sending and receiving authorities, a central body, and service fees and procedures. It amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure and replaces the earlier implementing act.
36152.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to implement the EU Regulation's technical and digital service procedures and fee setting.
q: By general administrative order additional conditions may be set under which electronic service or notification by e-mail is accepted.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen aanvullende voorwaarden worden gesteld waaronder elektronische betekening of kennisgeving per e-mail wordt aanvaard
d: further rules for sending by bailiffs or courts under the Regulation
how the central body performs its tasks
additional conditions for accepting electronic or e-mail service
adjustment of the fixed bailiff service fee every five years
p: Allows a judge to render a decision without a service certificate after a minimum six-month period where reasonable efforts failed, which is a discretionary departure from the Regulation's default rule.

parties: Asks about the delay in application, the status of EU e-Justice negotiations, the e-CODEX rollout, and unclear financial impacts, without raising a check concern.
What are the consequences in practice now that this deadline has not been met?
Welke gevolgen zijn er in de praktijk nu deze deadline niet is gehaald?

Asks whether the Data Protection Authority was consulted on the technical design and why it was not asked for advice, and questions the delegation clause and whether the Council of State's objections were properly addressed.
Can the government explain why the Dutch Data Protection Authority was not asked for advice in preparing this bill?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens niet om advies is gevraagd in de voorbereiding van dit wetsvoorstel?
Has taken note of the bill and has no further questions for now.
The CDA members have taken note of the bill and for now have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetvoorstel en hebben vooralsnog geen verdere vragen.
Raises concerns about enforcement bailiffs obtaining addresses, secret addresses, fees, possible printing costs, and translation quality, questioning whether citizens are adequately protected.
Do bailiffs comply with the Implementing Act when, for secret addresses, they only provide the municipality or place of residence instead of the precise address?
Voldoen gerechtsdeurwaarders aan de Uitvoeringswet wanneer zij bij geheime adressen slechts de gemeente of woonplaats verstrekken, in plaats van het precieze adres?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the draft Uitvoeringswet Betekeningsverordening be adjusted to clarify that the Service Regulation allows default judgments only under its conditions, and that the explanatory memorandum be supplemented so it is readable on its own. The government's reply accepted the explanatory-memorandum point and amended the bill, but argued the default-judgment provision is an unchanged one-to-one implementation of the earlier rule and needs no further explanation.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacked article-by-article explanation for several provisions and should be supplemented so it is independently readable; the government amended the bill and memorandum accordingly.

The bill's power to refuse default judgment beyond the conditions of Article 22(2) may exceed the Regulation and conflicts with the prohibition on copying EU rules; the government held the provision is unchanged from the earlier implementation and needs no further explanation.

36170.s: The bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) through a seventh incidental supplementary budget, adding 1,385,000 thousand euros of commitments for the IPCEI hydrogen wave 2 and 3 under the energy supply and climate article. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 8 July of the budget year, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Changes from the seventh incidental supplementary budget
Mutaties 7 e incidentele suppletoire begroting

36206.s: The bill amends the Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag to adjust the CO2 levy on industry, splitting the taxable base into a part at a fixed rate of 41.75 euro per tonne and a part at the general rate, with the fixed-rate portion reduced by the EU ETS term price. It sets entry into force on 1 January 2023 and renames the act Wet minimum CO2-prijs industrie.
q: Above the exempt base, the rate is applied in full to this type of installation without deduction of the EU ETS term price.
Het tarief wordt, boven de vrijgestelde voet, onverkort toegepast op dit type installaties zonder aftrek van de EU ETS-termijnkoers.

parties: Asks whether the changes should wait until after the announced evaluation, citing the Council of State's advice and the NEa's concerns about effectiveness and administrative burden.
The VVD members ask whether the proposed changes should not only be implemented after the announced evaluation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de voorgestelde wijzigingen niet pas moeten worden doorgevoerd na de aangekondigde evaluatie.
Supports the bill as giving industry certainty on CO2 charges, asking mainly for an overview of ETS price developments.
They endorse the government's stated importance of giving industries certainty about CO2 charges by applying a minimum price.
Zij onderschrijven het door de regering omschreven belang van industrieën zekerheid te bieden over CO 2 -heffingen door een minimumprijs te hanteren.
Questions why the price is to be reviewed before introduction and how the NEa's finding of limited effectiveness will be addressed.
These members find it remarkable that the level of the industry minimum CO2 price is already being examined this year, before it takes effect on 1 January 2023.
Deze leden vinden het opmerkelijk dat de hoogte van de minimum CO 2 -prijs industrie al dit jaar wordt onderzocht, nog voordat deze met ingang van 1 januari 2023 is ingevoerd.
Questions the purpose, revenue and whether the polluter pays, calling the bill largely symbolic.
The members ask the government what the point of this law is, now that it consists entirely of symbolism.
De leden vragen de regering wat het nut van deze wet is nu het volledig bestaat uit symboliek.
Argues the minimum price of 16 euro is too low for Paris-consistent emission reduction and asks for justification, scenarios and updated analyses.
The GroenLinks and PvdA members are seriously concerned when a price that is too low is used in the calculations.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie en PvdA-fractie maken zich ernstige zorgen wanneer wordt gerekend met een te lage CO 2 -prijs.
Asks why aligning the industry price with the electricity price speeds introduction, and whether the minimum price can be raised.
Why can the introduction of a minimum CO2 price be faster if it is aligned with the price for electricity generation?
Waarom kan de invoering van een minimum CO 2 -prijs sneller indien wordt aangesloten bij de prijs voor elektriciteitsopwekking?
Questions the bill's added value and effectiveness, asking why the planned evaluation is not awaited, and notes the NEa advised against introducing it.
The SGP members ask why the government, given the current high CO2 price, does not choose to await the announced evaluation of the minimum price path and submit the bill afterwards.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen waarom de regering er niet voor kiest, gelet op de huidige hoge CO 2 -prijs, om de aangekondigde evaluatie van het minimumprijspad bij de Wet minimum CO 2 -prijs elektriciteitsopwekking af te wachten en het wetsvoorstel daarna in te dienen.
Has taken note of the bill and has no further questions.
The Volt members have taken note of the bill and have no further questions.
De leden van de Volt-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advises that the government justify why the planned mid-term evaluation this year is not awaited, and that the minimum CO2 price for industry should only take effect once meaningful, e.g. via postponement or entry into force by royal decree; it also notes concerns about administrative burden on the NEa and the relationship with the EU ETS directive. The government replies that the minimum price is needed for rapid decarbonisation, that the evaluation will start this year with a possible adjustment from 2024, that the NEa impact is limited, and that the ETS effectiveness is preserved, while adding clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Council questions the necessity and effectiveness of the minimum CO2 price given its low level and asks why the planned evaluation is not awaited; the government justifies early introduction and commits to evaluation starting this year.
The Council considers that the proposal adds regulatory layering and administrative burden for the NEa; the government states the impact is limited and technically implementable.

The Council asks for explanation of how the proposal relates to the ETS directive's objectives and the internal market; the government adds clarification in the explanatory memorandum that ETS effectiveness is preserved.

36250-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement for the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, via a second supplementary budget. It raises spending commitments and expenditure across several articles, with no statutory delegation of rule-making power.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council for the year 2022
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad voor het jaar 2022

36314.s: The bill aligns the legal protection regime for resolution of insurers with the banking framework, making DNB resolution decisions subject to a short 10-day appeal period and direct appeal to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven, and excluding objections. It also makes several smaller amendments to insurer recovery and resolution rules, including new DNB powers to dismiss boards and supervisory boards of insurers in resolution, to suspend trading, and to instruct the AFM and securities depositories.
36314.j: The memorandum justifies the new and streamlined powers by the need for speed and effectiveness in crisis interventions and the irreversibility of resolution decisions.
q: This special regime was chosen because the decision is far-reaching and quickly leads to irreversible consequences.
Voor deze bijzondere regeling is gekozen omdat het besluit een ingrijpend karakter heeft en bovendien snel leidt tot onomkeerbare gevolgen
d: DNB instructs AFM to suspend or halt trading in financial instruments
DNB dismisses and appoints board and supervisory board members of insurers in resolution
p: Removes objection and ordinary appeal routes against DNB resolution decisions, leaving only a short, expedited direct appeal to the CBb and no further appeal.
Allows DNB to dismiss insurer boards directly under public law, bypassing the civil-law route via the supervisory board.
Gives DNB direct power to order suspension of trading on platforms, with AFM only executing the instruction.

parties: Asks whether the CBB can annul a DNB resolution decision while leaving its legal effects partly intact, and what review standard applies.
Is it correct that the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBB) can decide to annul DNB's resolution decision but leave its legal effects (partly) in place?
Klopt het dat het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (CBB) kan besluiten het afwikkelbesluit van DNB te vernietigen, maar de rechtsgevolgen wel (gedeeltelijk) in stand kan laten?
Supports the update but asks how DNB's discretion to waive resolution plans is safeguarded so its judgments are comparable across insurers, and how too-big-to-fail insurers are handled.
these members ask what safeguards ensure that DNB's judgment is comparable across different insurers.
vragen deze leden welke waarborgen er zijn om ervoor te zorgen dat het oordeel van DNB vergelijkbaar is voor verschillende verzekeraars.
Has no further questions or comments.
These members have no further questions or comments.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks about the lessons of the Conservatrix failure, why the depositor guarantee was abolished, and whether the Whav may need amendment to meet future EU minimum requirements.
The GroenLinks and PvdA members ask the government again to address the possibility that the Whav must be adjusted because it appears not to be aligned with the IRRD.
De leden van de GroenLinks- en PvdA-fracties vragen de regering nogmaals in te gaan op de mogelijkheid dat de Whav aangepast moet worden omdat deze niet in lijn blijkt te zijn met de IRRD.
Takes note of the bill and has no further comments.
These members have no further comments on this.
Deze leden hebben hierbij geen nadere opmerkingen.
Asks the government to explain DNB's implementation assessment, including whether implementation problems exist.
These members ask the government to further explain this assessment, as specification of the implementation test is currently lacking.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering dit oordeel verder toe te lichten, daar specificering van de uitvoeringstoets momenteel ontbreekt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wijzigingswet herstel en afwikkeling van verzekeraars and made no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport reports that an obsolete provision, article 1:104a Wft, was removed as an additional improvement.

36332.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to implement the revised EU Blue Card directive, shortening decision deadlines for Blue Card, intra-company transfer, research and volunteering residence permits and for family members of former Blue Card holders. It adds a power to lay down further rules by algemene maatregel van bestuur on how this article applies.
36332.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as a way to speed up implementation of future EU rules that require changes to decision deadlines.
q: This delegation basis serves to speed up the implementation of future EU rules requiring adjustment of decision deadlines.
Deze delegatiegrondslag dient ertoe de implementatie van toekomstige Unieregelgeving die tot aanpassing van beslistermijnen noopt, sneller mogelijk te maken.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel 3 (nieuw elfde lid, Art. 25 Vw 2000)
further rules on application of the decision-deadline article

parties: Asks whether the loosened Blue Card conditions could be abused, create a pull effect, or enable onward migration within the EU, given the government's stated aim of gaining grip on migration.
Can the government explain how it is ensured that these relaxations are not abused?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat er geen misbruik wordt gemaakt van deze versoepelingen?
Welcomes the EU Blue Card harmonisation but asks why the government did not use simplified procedures for recognised employers and ethical recruitment options.
These members ask the government to reflect on this and explain why nothing on this is included in the present proposal.
Deze leden vragen de regering hierop te reflecteren en toe te lichten waarom hierover niets is opgenomen in het voorliggende voorstel.
Asks about the expected economic effect, intra-EU residence and work restrictions, and whether the change will reduce the use of the national recognised-sponsor route.
These members ask which restrictions apply to workers living and working in both countries and whether changes occur relative to the current Blue Card scheme.
Deze leden vragen welke beperkingen gelden voor werknemers om te wonen en werken in beide landen en of hier veranderingen optreden ten aanzien van de huidige Europese blauwe kaartregeling.
Questions whether the shortened six-month contract requirement could leave workers destitute or unemployed in the Netherlands and what protections exist.
What is the government doing to prevent people from ending up on the street or remaining unemployed in the Netherlands afterwards?
Wat doet de regering eraan om te voorkomen dat mensen hierna op straat komen te staan of werkeloos in Nederland blijven?
Asks for the rationale of the directive, how Dutch implementation choices depart from strict transposition, and how the state keeps its own competence to limit admissions under Article 79(5) TFEU.
Which options is the Netherlands currently using to give substance to this own competence?
Welke mogelijkheden worden door Nederland op dit moment benut om invulling te geven aan deze eigen bevoegdheid?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on a bill implementing the EU Blue Card recast directive, that the start of the decision period for family-member residence applications submitted later than the main applicant's application be reconsidered, since it could effectively double the decision period, contrary to the directive's aim of speeding up procedures. The government's reply accepts the advice and deletes the proposed ninth paragraph of article 25, aligning family-member decision periods with the main rule of 90 or 30 days from the application.
concerns: The proposed start of the decision period for later family-member applications could double the period, conflicting with the directive's aim to accelerate procedures, so it should be reconsidered.

36341.s: The bill establishes a Dutch qualifications framework (NLQF) linked to the European EQF, setting how formal education levels are assigned by ministerial regulation and how non-formal courses are placed by a designated national coordination point. It bans unauthorised use of NLQF/EQF level labels, backed by administrative fines and inspectorate supervision.
36341.j: The memorandum justifies ministerial regulation for formal programme levels by the need to add new categories quickly before a new school year, and keeps non-formal placement at arm's length through an independent body.
q: Formal programmes are placed via a ministerial regulation, and non-formal programmes by the NCP NLQF at the provider's request.
Formele opleidingen worden ingeschaald via een ministeriële regeling, en non-formele opleidingen door het NCP NLQF op verzoek van de aanbieder.
d: definition of NLQF levels and relation to EQF levels
designation of the national coordination point as legal person
NLQF levels for formal education programmes
rules for placing non-formal courses in the NLQF and the register
height of fees for placing non-formal courses
p: The Minister may impose administrative fines up to the sixth-category maximum or 10% of turnover for unauthorised use of NLQF or EQF levels, with objection and appeal available.
The Minister may designate supervisors for the national coordination point, which has no powers under the general administrative law inspection articles.

parties: Asks how the NLQF coordination point (Stichting CINOP) is supervised and whether its substantive decisions are subject to oversight, and whether the NLQF may be used as a quality label.
Furthermore, how will it be prevented that an NLQF classification is in practice used as a quality mark?
Hoe gaat daarnaast voorkomen worden dat een NLQF-inschaling in de praktijk gebruikt gaat worden als kwaliteitskeurmerk?
Worries that placing non-formal courses on the NLQF will confuse citizens and be read as a quality judgement, and asks for alternatives that protect citizens' understanding of what a level means.
They argue that classifying non-formal course offers will lead to misunderstandings and confusion in society about the nature and meaning of NLQF levels.
Zij stellen dat de inschaling van het non-formeel opleidingsaanbod in de samenleving zal leiden tot misverstanden en verwarring over de aard en betekenis van NLQF-niveaus.

Shares concerns of the Raad van State and Onderwijsraad about pseudo-accreditation and asks why the government should regulate non-formal education at all, questioning the scope of state responsibility.
They share the concerns voiced by both the Council of State and the Education Council, namely that the impression may arise that the NLQF implies a quality assessment for non-formal courses.

Zij delen de zorgen die geuit worden door zowel de Raad van State als de Onderwijsraad, namelijk dat de indruk kan ontstaan dat het NLQF een kwaliteitsbeoordeling inhoudt voor non-formele opleidingen.
Argues the government has not adequately addressed the Council of State's and Education Council's advice to adjust the bill, and asks for an alternative approach.
These members consider that this insufficiently addresses the objections.
Deze leden vinden dat hiermee onvoldoende wordt tegemoetgekomen aan de bezwaren.
Questions whether the state's responsibility is stretched too far into non-formal education and says the government has not reasoned through the risks flagged by the Onderwijsraad.

These members ask the government to still respond to the Education Council's considered reasoning that extending systemic responsibility into the sphere of non-formal education may lead to undesirable consequences for the system.

Deze leden vragen de regering alsnog in te gaan op de doordachte redenering van de Onderwijsraad dat het oprekken van de stelselverantwoordelijkheid naar de sfeer van non-formele opleidingen tot onwenselijke gevolgen voor het stelsel kan leiden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against submitting the Wet NLQF bill unless amended, mainly because applying the same qualification framework to formal and non-formal courses may wrongly suggest government quality assessment of non-formal courses; it also raised concerns on consultation, EU recommendation alignment, designation of CINOP, and the lack of an evaluation clause. The minister's reply largely accepts the points: an evaluation clause was added and clarifications were made, but the separate framework for non-formal courses and different labelling were rejected in favour of communication and rules in lower regulation.
concerns: The NLQF for non-formal courses risks creating the impression of a government quality assessment equal to formal courses; the Afdeling asked for a separate framework and clearer distinction, which the government only partly accepted through lower-regulation rules and communication.

The bill's definition and treatment of learning outcomes and studiepunten differ from the EU recommendation; the government explained the differences and added clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked that social partners and the Ministry of SZW be involved and that the bill be re-consulted; the reply reports renewed consultation without changes.

Designating CINOP as the exclusive NCP raises EU free movement and state aid concerns; the government justified an exclusive right under procurement rules and explained financing and private activities safeguards.
The bill lacked an evaluation clause; a five-year evaluation provision was added as advised.

36350-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget of the States General (Staten-Generaal), the Dutch parliament, by a first supplementary budget of about 37 million euros in expenditure. The increases fund items such as the Eerste Kamer's content management system, Tweede Kamer ICT and parliamentary enquiries, and take effect retroactively from 1 June 2023.
q: Amendment of the budget of the States General for the year 2023
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2023

36410-V.s: This bill fixes the 2024 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, setting expenditure and commitment figures in thousands of euros across policy and non-policy articles. The explanatory memorandum excerpts cover international law support, Europe policy coordination, information management, and parliamentary follow-up commitments, without new delegation of rule-making power.
q: Established departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2024
Vastgestelde departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2024

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 11 September 2023 on the draft Budget Act 2024 for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Buitenlandse Zaken), and has no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the House of Representatives. The text is the advisory opinion itself and contains no government reply or nader rapport on specific points.

36422.s: The bill amends the corporate income tax act's rules for the fiscal investment institution (fbi) so that fbi's may no longer invest directly in Dutch immovable property (with a 30% limit on improvements and related activities limited to foreign property). It also grants a temporary, conditional exemption from transfer tax for acquisitions of economic ownership in transparent entities by fbi-related parties until 31 December 2024.
36422.j: The memorandum justifies the tax-inspector and general-measure delegations as needed to tailor treatment for the small expected group of taxpayers claiming the temporary exemption.
q: This deviation is necessary to be able to provide tailored treatment for this specific temporary exemption for the expected small number of taxpayers who will invoke it.

Deze afwijking is noodzakelijk om voor deze specifieke tijdelijke vrijstelling maatwerk te kunnen leveren voor de naar verwachting geringe hoeveelheid belastingplichtigen die een beroep op deze tijdelijke vrijstelling zullen gaan doen.
d: further conditions for applying the transfer tax exemption
II, vijfde lid / II, zesde lid
inspector may set manner of filing tax return

parties: Asks whether all arbitrage and misuse possibilities of the transfer tax flanking policy have been mapped, and whether the delay to 2025 gives enough time for restructuring.
They do ask the government to indicate whether, with this flanking policy, all possibilities for arbitrage or abuse have been mapped out.
Zij vragen de regering hierbij wel of zij kan aangeven of bij dit flankerend beleid alle mogelijkheden tot arbitrage of misbruik in kaart zijn gebracht.
Asks why the government does not adopt SEO's recommendations to further improve effectiveness and efficiency of the fbi regime and reduce misuse.
Why does the government see insufficient reason to fully adopt these recommendations?
Waarom ziet regering onvoldoende aanleiding om deze aanbevelingen volledig over te nemen?
Asks for clarification of the advantage for investors of restructuring into a fiscally transparent entity and whether conditional withholding tax may arise.
These members ask what exactly the advantage is for investors of restructuring into a fiscally transparent entity.
Deze leden vragen wat precies het voordeel is voor beleggers van het herstructureren in een fiscaal transparante entiteit.
Has no additional questions at this stage.
have no additional questions on this at this moment.
hebben hierover op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen.
Questions the government's conclusion that the measure is not state aid because of its selectivity justification, and asks whether it will notify the Gedragscodegroep.
Why does the nature and design of the system justify this selectivity?
Waarom rechtvaardigt de aard en opzet van het stelsel deze selectiviteit?
Welcomes closing the tax loophole and has no additional questions for now.
They see the value in closing the tax loophole and are positive about it.
Deze leden zien het nut in van het dichten van het heffingslek en zijn hier positief over te spreken.
Asks the government to reflect on effects on Dutch housing investment by institutional investors and on implementation capacity of the Belastingdienst.
Member Omtzigt asks whether the government can create more clarity about the feasibility of this bill.
Het lid Omtzigt vraagt of de regering meer duidelijkheid kan scheppen rondom de uitvoerbaarheid van dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill introducing a real-estate measure for fiscal investment institutions (fbi's), noting the explanatory memorandum lacked EU law and state-aid reflection and questioning why the bill was bundled into the Belastingplan 2024. The government's reply accepts adding state-aid and EU law passages, defends the bundling as a spreading strategy and urgency, and states the amendments were made.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum failed to test the real-estate measure against higher law, particularly EU state-aid rules, and to reflect on notification to the EU Code of Conduct Group; the government added these passages.

The explanatory memorandum did not explain why the bill was included in the Belastingplan 2024 package rather than submitted at another time; the government defended its approach without fully reformulating the justification.

36431.s: The bill raises the kindgebonden budget amounts for 2024 in several provisions of Article 2 of the Wet op het kindgebonden budget, lowers the extra amount for single parents and the income reduction threshold for couples, and lowers the income threshold for the income reduction. It removes the one-time non-application rule for 2024 and deletes one subsection of Article 3 while renumbering the rest, with entry into force on 1 January 2024.
36431.j: The memorandum explains that the increase is funded by reducing the extra amount for single parents and the couples' income reduction threshold, which is why a statutory amendment rather than a general administrative order is used.
q: Because the funding for this increase comes from a reduction in the extra amount for parents without a partner, as well as from a reduction in the income reduction threshold for couples, a statutory amendment is required in this case and Article 3, second paragraph, of the Act is not applied.

Omdat de dekking van de onderhavige ophoging uit een verlaging komt van de extra toeslag voor ouders die geen partner hebben, alsmede uit een verlaging van de voor paren geldende inkomensafbouwgrens is een wetswijziging aangewezen in dit geval en wordt artikel 3, tweede lid, van de wet niet toegepast.
p: Deleting subsection a of Article 3 removes a limit on the executive's power to change the kindgebonden budget amounts, but the memorandum says the increase is made by statute rather than by general administrative order.

parties: Asks about the effect on poverty trap and marginal tax pressure, and about implementation uncertainty flagged by the SVB.
The VVD members read in the SVB implementation assessment that the additional work due to the change in the number of new beneficiaries is difficult to estimate and uncertain.

De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen in de uitvoeringstoets van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) bij dit wetsvoorstel dat «de extra werkzaamheden als gevolg van de wijziging in omvang van nieuwe gerechtigden, lastig in te schatten en onzeker zijn.»

Questions whether the government could have done more, such as raising taxes on high incomes, and asks why the broader Commissie sociaal minimum advice was not fully followed and why the toeslagen abolition was chosen over reform.
Is it not the case that the government could have taken further measures?
Is het niet zo dat de regering nog meer maatregelen had kunnen nemen?
Supports the aim of reducing child poverty but questions overlap with the huurtoeslag phase-out, the budget-neutral alternative, and the effect of higher amounts on abolishing toeslagen.
The ChristenUnie members note that the proposed amendments move the phase-out point of the kindgebonden budget forward.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie constateren dat met de door de regering voorgestelde aanpassingen van de Wet op het kindgebonden budget het afbouwpunt van het kindgebonden budget naar voren wordt verplaatst.
Broadly supportive but asks about the marginal tax pressure increase from lowering the phase-out threshold for couples and whether the government will reverse it.
Does the government agree that this measure causes an increase in marginal pressure of 6.75% for incomes around 40,000 euros?
Is de regering het eens dat deze maatregel zorgt voor een stijging van de marginale druk voor inkomens rond de 40.000 euro van 6,75%?
Asks why the extra benefit for single parents is reduced by 619 euros per year and what the effect on purchasing power is.
The SP members ask why the government chooses to reduce the extra kindgebonden budget for single parents by 619 euros per year.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom de regering ervoor kiest om het extra kindgebonden budget voor alleenstaande ouders met 619 euro per jaar te verlagen.
Asks whether the group receiving support is monitored periodically and where support is most needed, given changing external circumstances.
They ask whether this group is periodically monitored and where support is most needed.
Zij vragen of periodiek wordt gemonitord hoe deze groep ervoor staat en waar de ondersteuning het hards nodig is.
Asks about the size of the beneficiary expansion, non-take-up, frequency and size of reclaims, and measures to address them, and when the next evaluation is planned.

These members ask the government how large non-take-up of the kindgebonden budget is, how often reclaims occur, how large they are on average, and what measures the government intends to counter reclaims and non-take-up.

Deze leden vragen de regering hoe groot het niet-gebruik van het kindgebonden budget is, hoe vaak er sprake is van terugvorderingen, hoe groot die gemiddeld zijn en welke maatregelen de regering beoogt om terugvorderingen en niet-gebruik tegen te gaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on a bill intensifying the kindgebonden budget (child-related budget) for purchasing-power support, and found no remarks warranting substantive comment. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes minor adjustments to the budgetary figures and timing feasibility, and proposes submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer.

36440.s: The bill modernises the Dutch seafarers act (Wet zeevarenden) on manning of sea-going ships, certification of seafarers, working and living conditions and disciplinary law, to implement STCW, STCW-F, MLC and C188 and related EU directives. It moves detailed rules to lower-level regulation, adds experimentation exemptions and digitalisation of seafarer documents.
36440.j: The memorandum justifies flexibility and innovation through experiments, arguing that technological change and STCW/MLC revisions require faster adjustment of rules at lower regulatory levels.
q: It is proposed to improve existing scope for innovation and experiments linked to a specific ship where there is demonstrable technological innovation.

Voorgesteld wordt om bestaande ruimte voor innovatie en het doen van experimenten gekoppeld aan een specifiek zeeschip te verbeteren in het geval er sprake is van aantoonbare technologische innovatie.
d: exemptions from manning and certification rules for experiments on technological innovation
detailed manning, welfare and alcohol policy rules for shipowners
retention and content of seafarer training and service records
exemption from nationality requirement for ship captains
minimum safe manning levels and crew certificate content
minimum competence standards for certificates of competency
validity, renewal, suspension and revocation of certificates
medical fitness requirements and medical certificate rules
conditions for issuing and revoking maritime labour certificates
designation of private bodies to conduct certification inspections
appointment and qualification requirements for disciplinary tribunal members
p: Minister may grant time-limited exemptions from manning and certification rules for experiments, subject to safety conditions set by regulation.
Ministerial regulation may exempt non-national captains from the nationality requirement, with conditions and private-sector consent procedures.
Captain must report to the minister when the shipowner fails to provide requested resources.
Disciplinary jurisdiction over captains and officers is vested in a specialised tribunal with appeal to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.

parties: Asks why the mandatory seafarer's booklet is not abolished for all seafarers and whether the government adopts the regulatory-burden advice.
These members ask the government whether it adopts this advice.
Deze leden vragen aan de regering of zij dit advies overneemt.
Has read the bill with interest and has no further questions.
have no further questions on this.
Asks whether international rules requiring physical documents may change and how much burden reduction digital documents actually bring.
