These members wonder whether there is any prospect of change in these international rules.
Deze leden vragen zich af of er zicht is op verandering van deze internationale regelgeving?

Asks about the risks of removing flexibility on captain nationality and the criteria and process under which a ministerial regulation could change the nationality requirement, including for non-EU captains.
Can the government explain under which circumstances and after which process it could have adopted a ministerial regulation amending the nationality requirement?
Kan de regering toelichten onder welke omstandigheden en na welk proces de regering over had kunnen gaan op een ministeriële regeling die de nationaliteitseis aanpast?

Asks for the government to explain the 'very exceptional circumstances' and 'compelling reasons' for removing a captain from duty at sea, and why the booklet requirement is limited to certain seafarers and when it is preferred.
Can the government elaborate on which very exceptional circumstances it refers to, and what it means by compelling reasons?
Kan de regering nader ingaan over welke zeer uitzonderlijke omstandigheden zij spreekt, en wat zij bedoelt met klemmende redenen?

Asks how the bill ensures the labour market for seafarers remains future-proof and asks why the delegation principle is not applied to captain nationality, and what effect the bill has on the attractiveness of the Dutch register.
These members would like to know whether the government also wants the principle of future-proofing to apply to the provision on captain nationality.
Deze leden horen graag of de regering het genoemde principe van toekomstbestendigheid ook van toepassing wil laten zijn op de bepaling ten aanzien van de nationaliteit kapitein.

Objects that the statutory basis for designating third countries by general administrative order was dropped after a negative consultation, questions the basis for that decision, and asks the government to reassess the consultation responses on their merits; argues the Dutch flag should be more attractive.
These members are surprised that this was decided with a stroke of the pen.
Het verbaast deze leden dat met een pennenstreek hiertoe is besloten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the experimental clause in article 3 of the Wet bemanning zeeschepen be reformulated, because a temporary exemption for a specific ship is really an exemption rather than an experiment and experiments would need content, scope, evaluation criteria, a general administrative order and parliamentary involvement. The minister adopted the advice, turning article 3 into an exemption basis and making several technical corrections.
concerns: The experimental clause for a specific ship does not meet the requirements for an experiment (clear content, scope, criteria, general administrative order, parliamentary involvement) and should be reformulated as an exemption basis.
Missing references to the STCW convention and the medical certificate, a wrong article reference, and implementation tables were corrected.

36503.s: The bill amends the Warenwet and the Tabaks- en rookwarenwet to create a notification duty for raw milk and raw cream producers, allow recovery of inspection costs by dwangbevel, extend the ministerial power to designate product-safety norms, broaden the advertising ban for tattoos and piercings, and extend enforcement tools such as bestuursdwang and online sales bans. It also lets the minister issue certain amendments to implementing rules by ministerial regulation and allows the minister to designate norms or change cost amounts through regulation.
36503.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for risk-based supervision, efficient implementation of EU rules within deadlines, and the practical difficulties of enforcement.
q: It is necessary for enforceability that the relevant EU legal acts can be implemented and national regulation adjusted within the implementation period.

Het is in het belang van de handhaafbaarheid noodzakelijk dat de betreffende EU-rechtshandelingen uitgevoerd kunnen worden en de nationale regelgeving daartoe aangepast kan worden binnen de implementatietermijn.
d: notification duty for raw milk and cream producers
non-substantive amendments to EU-based implementing rules
designation of product-safety norms other than the EU-based ones
competence requirements for tattoo and piercing practitioners
amounts of inspection costs recoverable by dwangbevel
amounts of inspection costs recoverable by dwangbevel
rules on export declarations for tobacco products
rules on export declarations for other goods
p: The minister may impose an order under bestuursdwang for any violation of the Warenwet rather than only for health or safety breaches.
The removal of the limitation on administrative fines for serious or economically profitable violations widens the scope of administrative fining.
The ban extends to offering tobacco products for distance sale, so a violation no longer requires an actual sale to be established.
The minister may recover cost amounts directly by dwangbevel, which is an executory title enforceable without a court.

parties: Asks why the Minister needs a dwangbevel power to collect cost amounts without court involvement and how often this occurs.
why it is necessary that this amendment provides that the Minister can collect these amounts by dwangbevel after the payment deadline has expired.
waarom het nodig is dat onderhavige wijziging regelt dat de Minister deze bedragen (nadat de gestelde termijn voor betaling is verstreken) bij dwangbevel kan invorderen.
Supports the bill and asks whether extra enforcement staff are needed for distance-sale enforcement.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members are positive about the amendment in this bill.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie staan positief tegenover de wijziging van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Asks how supervision of the raw milk notification duty will work and why consumer information duties are not being met.
How is it prevented that this notification duty is not complied with in practice, as is also seen with the duty to inform consumers about boiling raw milk before consumption?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat aan deze meldplicht in de praktijk niet wordt voldaan zoals dat ook te zien is bij de verplichting om de consument te informeren over het voor consumptie koken van rauwe melk?
Asks why collection of costs without a judge was not arranged earlier and what the consequences of the new procedure are; asks about risk-based supervision and data on raw milk.
Can the government explain why this was not arranged earlier without the intervention of a judge?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom dit niet eerder zonder tussenkomst van de rechter is geregeld?
Asks for more detail on the cost-allocation (omslagstelsel) scheme, its affected groups and costs.
What costs are involved for an average operator of a food business?
Hoeveel kosten zijn hiermee gemoeid voor een gemiddelde exploitant van een levensmiddelenbedrijf?
Asks for a guarantee that the AMvB on raw milk notification will not impose disproportionate burdens on farmers.

Can the government guarantee the BBB members that this general administrative order will not place disproportionate regulatory burden on farmers, discouraging them from setting up local dispensing points?

Kan de regering de leden van de BBB-fractie garanderen dat deze algemene maatregel van bestuur boeren geen disproportionele regeldruk zal geven waardoor het boeren zal demotiveren om lokale tappunten op te zetten?
Argues the notification duty will lead to regulatory burden and demands a proper regulatory burden test before the bill is treated further; also asks about the distance-criterion for tobacco outlets.
These members consider it necessary to first receive a sound regulatory burden test before this proposal can be treated further, and ask the government to carry out a serious test on this.
Deze leden vinden het noodzakelijk om eerst een deugdelijke regeldruktoets ontvangen voordat dit voorstel verder kan worden behandeld en vragen de regering hierop een serieuze toets te doen.
Asks the government to explain in plain language how cost recovery is currently regulated, what changes and what effects are expected.
They ask the government to explain in clear language how this is currently regulated, what this amendment changes and what effects it is expected to have.
Zij vragen de regering of zij in duidelijke taal kunnen uitleggen hoe dit momenteel geregeld is, wat deze wijziging daaraan wijzigt en welke effecten dit naar verwachting heeft.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Warenwet and the Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, aimed mainly at improving supervision and enforcement, may be submitted to the House without remarks. The minister's nader rapport only adds minor editorial changes to the explanatory memorandum, since no substantive remarks were made.

36512.s: The bill strengthens national, provincial and municipal steering of housing supply by making Omgevingswet instruments explicitly applicable to housing, requiring a mandatory municipal housing programme, mandating an urgency scheme in housing ordinances, and widening housing-market regions and local performance agreements. It also accelerates appeals for projects of major public interest by allowing designation by general administrative order of categories with single-instance appeal before the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State and six-month rulings.
36512.j: The memorandum justifies the accelerated appeal designation by the acute housing shortage and the need for timely, irreversible permits, while limiting it to categories of major public interest with time limits and parliamentary pre-consultation.
q: Given the current housing market problems and the urgency of building more homes, there is a need to accelerate legal protection procedures, at least temporarily.

Gezien de huidige problematiek op de woningmarkt en de urgentie om meer woningen te kunnen bouwen, is er een noodzaak om in ieder geval tijdelijk te komen tot versnelling in rechtsbeschermingsprocedures.
d: designating project categories for accelerated appeal procedures
ARTIKEL III, D (Omgevingswet 3.6 municipal housing programme); ARTIKEL II, D (Huisvestingswet 6)
content of municipal housing programme and joint urgency allocation
ARTIKEL II, F (Huisvestingswet 12(4)); ARTIKEL II, G, H (Huisvestingswet 13(3), 14(6))
conditions for urgency categories, grounds for withdrawal, economic or social ties
ARTIKEL V, N (Woningwet 62a); ARTIKEL V, O (Woningwet 66)
designation of priority groups and data collection on housing needs
permitting housing associations to operate across provinces
rules on procedure for binding minister rulings on performance agreement disputes
rules on coordination between municipal bodies on care housing
p: Government may by general administrative order remove multi-instance appeal and impose six-month rulings for designated project categories, limited to ten years renewable once by five years, with parliamentary pre-consultation.
Municipal council may adopt housing allocation rules beyond scarcity-related justification, including for liveability, without that additional necessity being required.
ARTIKEL II, H (Huisvestingswet 14(6)); ARTIKEL II, I (Huisvestingswet 15(3)-(5))
Priority for urgency applicants in housing permits and refusal grounds are shaped by municipal rules and ministerial regulation, narrowing citizens' allocation position.
Disputes over local performance agreements are resolved by a binding ministerial decision rather than by the usual channels.

parties: Asks how the bill implements an adopted motion on liveability and whether affordable plots for self-builders are included.
The PVV members ask why the bill does not provide for designating affordable free plots for private commissioning.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen zich af waarom het wetsvoorstel niet voorziet in het aanwijzen van betaalbare vrije kavels voor particulier opdrachtgeverschap.
Supports the affordable-building minimums but worries that developers and the 40% middle-segment norm will reduce social rent and that provinces and municipalities lack bargaining power.
How will the government ensure that provinces and municipalities get enforcement power over market parties to build at least 300,000 affordable homes?
Hoe gaat de regering zorgdragen dat provincies en gemeenten doorzettingsmacht krijgen richting marktpartijen om tenminste 300.000 betaalbare woningen te bouwen?
Wants municipalities to keep discretion and regional differentiation, and worries that higher targets make projects unprofitable; also questions the discretion of the instruction powers.
The VVD members believe municipalities should keep deciding this themselves because tailored work is involved.
Deze leden zijn juist van mening dat gemeenten dit zelf moeten blijven bepalen, omdat er ook maatwerk bij komt kijken.
Asks how the Chamber can help define social and affordable and whether a pre-consultation procedure (voorhang) for the AMvB was considered.
Can the government indicate whether it has considered a pre-consultation procedure for this general administrative order (AMvB)?
Kan de regering aangeven of zij voorhangprocedure voor deze algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) heeft overwogen?
Supports the bill but asks how non-compliant municipalities will be held to regional agreements and how the 30% target fits with the national programme.
These members ask how municipalities that do not meet the agreement to deliver enough affordable owner-occupied, middle rent or social rent homes will be held to these regional agreements.

Deze leden vragen zich af hoe gemeenten die zich niet aan de afspraak houden in het realiseren van voldoende betaalbare koopwoningen, middenhuur, of sociale huurwoningen aan deze regioafspraken gehouden gaan worden.
Praises the bill but asks for safeguards so that municipalities with above-average social rent keep delivering their share and that the affordable target is not postponed.
They see a risk that, because the exact duration of the new-build task is not fixed, construction of affordable homes will slip back in the planning.
Zij zien een risico dat, ook omdat de precieze duur van de nieuwbouwopgave niet is vastgelegd, de bouw van betaalbare woningen naar achteren schuift in de planning.
Welcomes national steering but asks what guarantees exist that municipalities with high social rent shares keep delivering, and whether the 27% national average is the right threshold.
Can the government indicate what consideration led to choosing the national average of 27% rather than setting the threshold at 30% of the stock?
Kan de regering aangeven welke afweging er is gemaakt om te kiezen voor het landelijke gemiddelde van 27 procent en niet om de grens bij 30 procent in de voorraad te leggen?
Asks how regional and local differences are accommodated in the 30% obligation and why national percentages were chosen over local tailoring.
Why was more local tailoring not chosen?
Waarom is niet gekozen voor meer lokaal maatwerk?
Questions why the municipal executive rather than the council must adopt housing programmes, and why no structural financial support is guaranteed for the two-thirds affordability requirement.
These members believe housing is an important political theme on which the elected council should be able to decide.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat volkshuisvesting een belangrijk politiek thema is, waarover de gekozen volksvertegenwoordiging een besluit moet kunnen nemen.
Asks about criteria for designating energy transition projects as of major public interest and about the trade-offs between energy options.
Can the government indicate whether it favours a system in which the least disruptive options are considered first before, for example, wind farms are placed?

Kan de regering aangeven of ze positief staat tegenover een systematiek waarbij eerst de minst hinderlijke /schadelijke opties worden overwogen alvorens er wordt overgegaan op het plaatsen van bijvoorbeeld windmolenparken?
Asks whether the bill can prevent new homes becoming smaller than planned and whether municipalities will get enough budget to fund unprofitable parts of projects.

Argues the bill does not use available steering instruments fully and that obliging only some municipalities to build social rent, with exemptions and regional escalation, creates unclear responsibilities.
Asks how the national and provincial power of intervention will be enforced, how municipalities could circumvent affordable-housing rules, and what role provinces have in defining housing regions.
These members ask the government how the national and provincial override powers will be applied in practice after the Wet regie volkshuisvesting is introduced.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe de doorzettingsmacht van het Rijk en de provincie in de praktijk wordt toegepast na invoering van de Wet regie volkshuisvesting.
Worries the rules may reduce the absolute stock of social rental housing and asks whether municipalities may exceed the 30 percent threshold or deviate when locally needed.
They ask the government why municipalities are not given the option, in consultation with the region, to deviate from this instruction rule if necessary to safeguard a balanced housing stock.

Zij vragen tevens waarom gemeenten niet de mogelijkheid krijgen om, in overleg met de regio, af te wijken van deze instructieregel indien dit nodig is om een evenwichtige woningvoorraad te waarborgen.
Asks why the revised draft implementing decree was not shared with the House before the vote and which specific changes were made to the original draft.
Why was the new draft decree not shared directly with the House with this memorandum of amendment, and is this still being done before the vote on the bill in the House of Representatives?
Waarom is het nieuwe ontwerpbesluit niet direct gedeeld met de Kamer bij deze nota van wijziging en wordt dit nog gedaan voor de stemming over de wet in de Tweede Kamer?
Supports shorter objection and appeal procedures but asks whether the Council of State is equipped for the expected increase in cases.
However, these members wonder whether the Council of State is sufficiently equipped for an increase in the number of cases, now that cases will reach this body more quickly.
Wel vragen deze leden zich af of de Raad van State voldoende toegerust is op een toename van het aantal zaken, nu zaken sneller bij deze instantie terecht zullen komen.
Argues the bill does not use all options to tackle homelessness, for example by granting urgency to all homeless people under the ETHOS-Light definition, and asks why this was not chosen.
They are of the view that not all options in the present bill have been used to combat homelessness, for example by granting urgency to homeless persons.
Zij zijn van mening dat niet alle mogelijkheden in het voorliggend wetsvoorstel benut zijn om dakloosheid te bestrijden, bijvoorbeeld door urgentie te verlenen aan dakloze personen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in November 2023 on the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting, raising concerns about an integrated environmental vision, housing corporation local ties, the Wmo link, and especially the accelerated appeal procedure, which it advised splitting off. The minister's reply of March 2024 accepts several points with amendments but defends the accelerated single-instance appeal procedure and rejects the splitting advice.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the accelerated procedure lacks coherence with the housing goal and should be split off; the government disagreed on coherence but split off nothing and broadened the bill's title and explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling warned that single-instance appeal and abolition of pro forma appeals reduce legal protection and need solid justification; the government defended this with precedents and tightened the designation criteria and parliamentary pre-consultation.
The Afdeling found feasibility of accelerated appeals unsubstantiated given court staffing shortages; the government pointed to extra funding and narrowed the designation power with a ten-year limit.

The Afdeling advised that categories of projects for accelerated single-instance review be set in statute rather than by general administrative order; the government kept the delegation but added an enhanced pre-consultation procedure for both chambers.
The Afdeling asked for a stronger motivation for the acceleration needs; the government added explanation in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked for clearer safeguards on local ties of housing corporations when work areas are widened; the government added explanation on how corporations expand and on exemptions.
The Afdeling asked for a clearer link between the Wmo policy plan and housing policy; the government added explanation and amended the statutory provisions accordingly.

The Afdeling asked that the omgevingsvisie not gain a substantive housing requirement that undermines its integrated character; the government reworded the provision to apply to exercise of powers generally.

36530.s: The bill assigns the national support for education to chronically ill pupils and students, currently provided by school guidance services and university medical centres, to a legal person designated by the Minister, which will carry out the tasks under the Wet SLOA. It amends the education acts and the Wet subsidiëring landelijke onderwijsondersteunende activiteiten 2013 to give the Minister subsidy and framework-letter powers and to remove the old provisions.
36530.j: The memorandum justifies centralising the tasks in one legal person to secure continuity, nationwide coverage and equal access for schools regardless of location.
d: designation of legal person for support to schools on education of sick pupils
biennial framework letter (kaderbrief) on support for sick pupils
distinguishing rules for structural and incidental subsidies
p: The designated legal person may process sensitive personal data of sick pupils with parental consent, a power placed outside direct ministerial control.
The Minister designates the implementing body and subsidises it, with the statutory tasks left to the designation rather than fixed in the statute.[...]
The Minister must report to parliament on effectiveness within five years of entry into force.

parties: Asks that pupils' interests remain central and wants clarity on who pays and on responsibilities between school, partnership and foundation.
Can the government commit that the interests of the pupil remain paramount in implementing the bill?
Kan de regering toezeggen dat de belangen van de leerling voorop blijven staan bij de uitvoering het wetsvoorstel?
Questions whether centralisation is necessary and wants monitoring of effectiveness and satisfaction, with a clear response if the new structure performs worse.
These members also ask how the government intends to monitor the new structure, should it come, specifically its effectiveness and the satisfaction with it.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen ook hoe de regering voornemens is de nieuwe structuur, mocht die er komen, te monitoren en specifiek de effectiviteit daarvan en de tevredenheid daarover.
Doubts the bill's grounding in a Oberon report eight years old and the Raad van State's advice to first update data and consider less far-reaching alternatives.
The D66 members are surprised that the nader rapport did not respond in detail to the Raad van State's criticism that the data should first be updated.

Daarbij verbaast het de leden van de D66-fractie dat in het nader rapport niet uitvoerig gereageerd is door de regering op de kritiek van de Raad van State om eerst in te zetten op actualisering van de gegevens.
Supports a flexible national structure in principle but worries about dropping regional embedding and asks for better-examined alternatives involving stakeholders.
These members are concerned about the removal of this regional embedding and connection with hospital organisations.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen over het afbreken van deze regionale inbedding en verbinding met de ziekenhuisorganisaties
Asks why the government does not follow the Raad van State on regional implementation and sets no criteria for the foundation, and why evaluation is after five rather than three years.
It is not clear to these members why the government makes this choice and gives the foundation no criteria to soften the regional implementation.
Het is deze leden niet duidelijk waarom de regering hiervoor kiest en de stichting geen criteria meegeeft om de regionale uitvoering zachter te laten landen.
Asks for clarity on regional anchoring, data on pupils served, cost distribution, and why the foundation rather than an association was chosen.
Asks why the government overrides the Raad van State's advice on regional implementation and who supervises quality of the advisory bureaus.
Why does the government consider it so important that this centralisation goes ahead, despite the advice of the Raad van State?
Waarom vindt de regering het zo belangrijk dat deze centralisatie doorgang blijft vinden, ondanks het advies van de Raad van State?
Asks how the transition protects existing expertise, accessibility for parents and the role of parents and pupils in the new structure.
Do parents get a role in the national foundation and, if so, what role?
Krijgen ouders een rol bij de landelijke stichting en zo ja, wat wordt deze rol?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised, on a bill creating a national foundation with a statutory task for educational support to sick pupils, to reconsider the centralisation in view of less drastic alternatives, to anchor the regional structure and the duration of temporary support in the law, and to tighten privacy safeguards. The government's reply accepts most points: it defends centralisation as necessary for flexibility, declines to legally fix regions, explains the transition, and narrows and clarifies the data processing.
concerns: The Council questioned whether centralisation is necessary given less drastic alternatives such as amending subsidy rules or funding provisions; the government defended the national foundation as the only option achieving the intended flexibility and nationwide coverage, with the rationale elaborated in the explanatory memorandum.

The Council advised anchoring the regional working approach in the law, since regional coverage and fit with local circumstances depend on it; the government declined, arguing that legally fixed regions would hinder flexible organisation, though it clarified the explanatory memorandum.

The Council asked for clarity on the handover point from temporary support to school-based support, suggesting a fixed term or statutory criteria; the government explained there is no concrete switch moment and clarified this in the memorandum.

The Council raised privacy concerns about processing special personal data, including the scope of processing across all five tasks, the wording of consent, and additional safeguards; the government limited processing to the first three tasks, replaced consent with instemming, and added retention limits and confidentiality.

36602.s: The bill amends multiple tax laws for 2025 onward, mainly lowering income tax rates and adjusting thresholds, plus changes to motor vehicle, energy, excise, gambling and VAT taxes. It also introduces reforms to objection and appeal procedures for environmental investment deductions (MIA/Vamil), shifting first-instance review to RVO.
36602.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial rules on environmental investments as a way to specify criteria, and the shift of review to RVO as a streamlining that mirrors the existing EIA procedure.
q: With this measure, the objection and appeal procedures for the MIA and Vamil are integrated with the RVO application process, following the example of the EIA.
Met deze maatregel worden de bezwaar- en beroepsprocedure van de MIA en de Vamil geïntegreerd met het aanvraagproces van de RVO, naar voorbeeld van de EIA.
d: designation of environmental business assets (milieu-bedrijfsmiddelen) and rules on the declaration
Artikel I, I (art. 4.13 / 4.14a) and Artikel XXIX-XXXI (energy tax)
further rules on specific tax categories such as glasshouse horticulture and energy providers
Artikel XXIX Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag (art. 59 changes via ministerial rules)
adjustment of tax rates and thresholds by ministerial regulation
Artikel XLII Wet fiscale klimaatmaatregelen glastuinbouw (art. 71t(2))
nadere regels on glasshouse horticulture and energy companies
Artikel XXVII Wet uitwerking Autobrief II / Artikel XXVIIIA (art. 10.6a/10.6b Wet IB 2001 indexation)
annual adjustment of income limits and percentages for tax credits
correction factor for waste incineration emissions in CO2 levy
p: Artikel I, E(6) and Artikel I, H(9) (Wet IB 2001 environmental investment deductions)

Objection and appeal against RVO declarations for MIA/Vamil are routed to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven, with cassation to the Supreme Court, shifting first-instance review from the tax inspector to an executive agency.
Decisions of the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management under the environmental deductions are placed under specific Awb procedures, altering the route of legal protection.

parties: Asks for clarification on box 3 tax burden compared with box 2 and on the distribution of box 3 declarations.
Can the government indicate which cases these are?
Kan de regering aangeven welke gevallen dit zijn?
Asks for detailed breakdowns of box 3 compensation costs, funding and interest, and demands transparency on how amounts enter the budget baseline.
Can the government break down for all years which groups this amount has reached?
Kan de regering voor alle jaren uitsplitsen bij welke groepen dit bedrag is beland?
Criticises the accumulation of tax legislation in one bill that hinders the House from exercising its budget right properly.
Once again an undesirable accumulation of legislation has arisen, which the sheer volume of text prevents the House from properly exercising its budget right.
Nu is er weer een ongewenste cumulatie van wetgeving ontstaan, die de Kamer door de grote hoeveelheid tekst verhindert, om op een fatsoenlijke manier het budgetrecht uit te oefenen.
Worries about the very large package and asks how the criteria for placing changes in the Belastingplan rather than separate bills are applied.
These members ask how this relates to the intention to spread changes to the tax system better over the year.
Deze leden vragen hoe dit zich verhoudt ten opzichte van het voornemen om wijzigingen in het fiscale stelsel beter over het jaar te verspreiden.
Supports the plan's broad lines but argues contested measures such as VAT changes should perhaps be handled in a separate bill to ensure careful parliamentary treatment.
These members invite the government to consider whether contested parts, such as the VAT increase for accommodation and culture, could better be handled in a separate bill.

Deze leden willen de regering ter overweging meegeven om te overwegen of omstreden onderdelen, zoals de verhoging van het btw-tarief voor logies en cultuur, niet beter in een separaat wetsvoorstel behandeld kunnen worden.
Objects that lower incomes bear the cost of repairing the box 3 error while the wealthiest benefit, and asks about wealth inequality and tax avoidance.

These members ask the government why it considers it appropriate that everyone, including the lowest incomes and assets, must pay while those with the largest fortunes benefit from the reduced tax burden.

Deze leden vragen de regering waarom de regering het gepast acht dat iedereen en dus ook de laagste inkomens en vermogens, moet meebetalen, terwijl degenen met de grootste vermogens juist profiteren van de verminderde belastingdruk?
Asks why the transfer tax reduction is absent from the bill and what effect the measures have on the marginal tax burden and the complexity of the system.
These members ask why the government has not already made proposals in line with simplifying the system and reducing the shuffling of money via allowances.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering niet al voorstellen heeft gedaan in lijn met vereenvoudiging van het stelsel en minder rondpompen van geld via toeslagen.
Questions the sharp cut to the general tax credit that hurts lower incomes and asks for justification and koopkracht tables.
However, these members are surprised by the strong reduction of the general tax credit by 335 euro, as a result of which lower incomes in particular lose out.
Wel zijn deze leden verbaasd over de sterke verlaging van de AHK met 335 euro, waardoor met name de lagere inkomens erop achteruitgaan.
Asks the government to address the Raad van State's criticism that the Belastingplan is large and that the criteria for including legislation are too broad and subjective.

The VVD members further ask the government to consider the remarks of the Raad van State that the size of the Belastingplan is large and that the criteria for including legislation in the Belastingplan are too broad and subjective.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering verder stil te staan bij de opmerkingen van de Raad van State dat de omvang van het Belastingplan groot is en de criteria om wetgeving onder te brengen in het Belastingplan te ruim en subjectief.
Asks whether the broad criteria for including tax legislation in the Belastingplan leave nearly all legislation eligible and urges strict interpretation.
Does not the danger arise from these broad criteria that nearly all legislation will fall under one of the exceptions?
Ontstaat door deze ruime criteria niet het gevaar dat vrijwel alle wetgeving onder één van de uitzonderingen zal vallen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Belastingplan 2025 (tax bill) and raised no remarks, advising that it be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën transmitted the opinion with a reply noting only minor editorial changes added to the nota van wijziging.

The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises against the 8% general housing rate for transfer tax in the second amendment to Belastingplan 2025, arguing the measure is untargeted, adds complexity, lacks justification versus non-fiscal alternatives, and burdens enforcement and courts. The government's reply defends the choice of a generic tax instrument, explains the cost and targeting trade-offs, and adds explanatory notes but does not change the measure.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the justification for using the transfer tax rather than non-fiscal alternatives insufficient and asks for a convincing motivation; the government provides a reasoned explanation but keeps the fiscal instrument.

The Afdeling considers the measure too broad and untargeted, benefiting second homes and business premises; the government accepts a generic rate as the only workable option and rejects further targeting.

The Afdeling warns that the new rate increases legal uncertainty about the definition of 'woning' as in the 2011-2021 period; the government points to existing concepts and pre-transaction consultation.

The Afdeling notes increased enforcement, fraud and workload risks for the Belastingdienst and courts, and asks for advice from the Raad voor de rechtspraak; the government finds the Belastingdienst can implement it and sees no need to consult the judiciary.
The Afdeling asks for a more fundamental reflection on the function of transfer tax and its instrumental use; the government notes the broader tax reform task and the pending evaluation response.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Belastingplan 2025 package, criticising the overloading of the tax package with unrelated measures, the abolition of several reduced VAT rates, the box 2 top-rate reduction rationale, the single-earner fiscal solution, the use of policy decisions ahead of legislation, and the lack of internet consultation. The government reply largely accepted the criticisms on the procedure and the policy decision codification, but kept the VAT and other measures in the package, justifying this by budget and timing needs.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the Belastingplan package is overloaded with measures lacking budgetary connection, hindering parliamentary scrutiny, and advises separating major and politically contested measures; the government separated the minimum tax changes but kept the VAT measure in the package.

The Afdeling finds the justification for abolishing several reduced VAT rates and the differentiation between related posts insufficiently reasoned and advises an integral vision; the government defended the choices as political and budgetary, offering limited additional motivation.

The Afdeling notes that the VAT rate changes create boundary problems and fiscal neutrality disputes; the government responded that courts will resolve these and that the changes simplify the system overall.
The Afdeling advises internet consultation for the VAT and minimum tax measures; the government did not hold consultation, citing time constraints and budget linkage.
The Afdeling asks for a fuller justification of the box 2 top-rate reduction, including realistic dividend payout assumptions and comparison with box 3; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

The Afdeling asks why the single-earner solution uses a much larger target group than the temporary scheme and why benefits are claimed on request; the government explained and supplemented the memorandum.
The Afdeling advises assessing the effects of the VAT rise on freedom of expression and information and the social consequences; the government largely did not expand on these effects.

The Afdeling finds that the policy decisions anticipating legislation (energy tax, simplified sister merger, debt relief) lack adequate motivation under the framework; the government supplemented the explanations in several places.
The Afdeling asks why the DABES definition of passenger vehicles differs from the BPM definition; the government explained the historical reason and aligned some cross-references.

36611.s: The bill ends net metering (salderingsregeling) for small-connection end users from 1 January 2027 and requires a reasonable compensation for all renewable electricity fed back, from any market participant, while adjusting cross-references in the Energiewet, the Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag, the Wet gemeentelijke instrumenten warmtetransitie and the Wet op de accijns. It also removes the tax benefit tied to netting.
36611.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to alignment with the RED II requirements on reasonable compensation and to the financial incentive for self-consumption, and it rejects a ministerial minimum-compensation power because it would distort the market.
q: With regard to the feed-back of renewable electricity by an active consumer, the bill aligns with the relevant requirements for feed-back of self-generated renewable energy in the Renewable Energy Directive (RED II).

Het wetsvoorstel sluit ten aanzien van het terugleveren van hernieuwbare elektriciteit door een actieve afnemer ... aan bij de relevante eisen voor de teruglevering van zelfopgewekte hernieuwbare energie in de Richtlijn hernieuwbare energie
d: costs, conditions and reasonable compensation for feed-back of self-generated renewable electricity
p: ARTIKEL I, B (vervallen art. 2.31 Energiewet) and ARTIKEL II, A

Removes the statutory netting protection and the statutory reasonable-compensation protection for non-renewable electricity, leaving end users with less legal protection against the state and suppliers, with ACM supervision as the remaining check.

parties: Criticises the bill for lacking a definition of reasonable feed-in compensation, leaving the ACM unable to enforce consumer protection, and asks whether the regulator will be given enforcement powers.
The ACM indicates it cannot enforce in this way.
De ACM geeft aan hier op deze manier ook niet op te kunnen handhaven.
Supports the abolition but asks whether the ACM has enough capacity to supervise the reasonable compensation and whether a minimum feed-in compensation should be introduced for consumer protection.
The VVD also asks whether the ACM has sufficient capacity to supervise the reasonable compensation for fed-back self-generated renewable energy.
Daarnaast vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie of er voldoende capaciteit is bij de ACM om toezicht te houden op de redelijke vergoeding van teruggeleverde zelfopgewekte hernieuwbare energie.
Asks whether the bill can be amended to define reasonable compensation, give the ACM power to impose a minimum, and prevent consumers from paying net for feed-in.
The NSC asks whether the bill can be amended to include a definition of a reasonable feed-in compensation and a power for the ACM to impose a minimum compensation.

De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen of het wetsvoorstel kan worden aangepast met: − een definitie van een «redelijke» terugleververgoeding; − een bevoegdheid voor ACM om een minimale terugleververgoeding op te leggen;
Asks why an abrupt abolition is preferred over a gradual phase-out and why no fixed feed-in percentage was chosen, focusing on factual questions about payback periods and the sector.
They ask the government why abolishing net-metering in one step in 2027 would be a better plan than the gradual phase-out between 2025 and 2031 previously before parliament.

Zij vragen de regering waarom het in één keer afschaffen van de salderingsregeling in 2027 een beter plan zou zijn dan de geleidelijke afbouw tussen 2025 en 2031, zoals eerder voorlag in het parlement.
Questions the abrupt abolition, notes the Eerste Kamer rejected a similar bill, and asks how concerns raised in both chambers were incorporated.
To what extent have the objections raised in both chambers been taken into account in this bill?
In hoeverre zijn de bezwaren die er leven in beide Kamers meegenomen in dit wetsvoorstel?

Regrets the stripped-down bill lacking the phase-out path and earlier adopted amendments, asks the government to explain why, and asks whether it will submit a nota van wijziging to honour amendments adopted by the House.
Is the government willing to do justice to the amendments adopted in the House with a nota van wijziging?
Is de regering bereid om met een nota van wijziging recht te doen aan de in de Kamer aangenomen amendementen?
Asks what instruments the ACM has against suppliers charging unreasonable feed-in compensation and why the ACM is not given the power to impose a minimum.
These members ask the government which measures are then taken to protect consumers against suppliers that charge unreasonable feed-in compensation.
Deze leden vragen de regering welke maatregelen er dan wel worden genomen om consumenten te beschermen tegen leveranciers die onredelijke terugleververgoedingen hanteren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised the bill (amending the law implementing the end of electricity netting) to proceed to parliament without substantive remarks. The minister's reply reports only minor redactional and technical corrections and supplementary explanations in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling made no substantive remarks; the government made two redactional corrections to the bill and several clarifying changes to the explanatory memorandum on its own initiative.

36701.s: The bill amends the Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet) and the Wft to implement EU Regulation 2024/886 on euro instant credit transfers, including changing definitions of participants in payment systems and the role of the Minister of Finance in designating systems. It also makes technical corrections and adjusts the Wft's rules on payment systems.
36701.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary implementation of the EU regulation and technical corrections, without separately justifying the ministerial delegation.
q: Each system designated by Our Minister of Finance shall set in its own rules the time of introduction and the time of irrevocability in that system.
Elk door Onze Minister van Financiën aangewezen systeem stelt in zijn eigen regels het tijdstip van invoering en het tijdstip van onherroepelijkheid in dat systeem vast.
d: setting introduction and irrevocability times for designated payment systems
p: The Minister of Finance is empowered to designate systems whose rules set timing of entry and irrevocability, a technical matter with no parliamentary or judicial safeguard stated.

parties: Asks why the implementation act was late, what the consequences of missing the deadline are, and whether shifting sanctions screening creates extra burden; also asks about retroactive reporting obligations.
Why was the implementation act not submitted to parliament on time?
Waarom is de implementatiewet niet tijdig bij het parlement ingediend?
Asks how sanctions screening works, who supervises it (DNB or AFM), and what sanctions apply to non-compliance by banks or payment providers.
Asks how the ECB justifies refusing accounts to non-bank payment providers and whether small players can realistically comply without a level playing field.
Can non-bank institutions reasonably be expected to comply with this legislation if they do not have a level playing field with larger banking institutions?
Kan van niet-bancaire instellingen redelijkerwijs wel verwacht worden dat zij aan deze wetgeving kunnen voldoen als zij geen gelijk speelveld hebben met grotere bancaire instellingen?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the draft bill implementing the EU Instant Payments Regulation (2024/886) and advised submitting it to parliament. The minister's reply reports only minor drafting changes, removing the term 'opdracht tot verrekening' and adding a consultation remark on ECB account policy for non-bank payment providers.

36710.s: The bill lowers the minimum public broadcasting contribution (rijksmediabijdrage) by 24.3 million euro from 2025 to cover a budget shortfall, by amending a figure in article 2.144 of the Mediawet 2008. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
36710.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the need to keep the Rijksbegroting and the Mediawet 2008 aligned and to introduce the change quickly.
q: To prevent the national budget and the Mediawet 2008 from diverging, rapid introduction of the proposed amendment is required.
Om te voorkomen dat Rijksbegroting en Mediawet 2008 onderling van elkaar afwijken is snelle invoering van de voorgestelde wijziging geboden.

parties: Concerned about how the public media mission funded by advertising revenue will be carried out, and whether this is the start of further advertising-driven financing.
These members endorse the principle that advertising revenue is there for the programmes and not the other way round.
Deze leden onderschrijven het uitgangspunt dat de reclame-inkomsten er voor de programma's zijn en niet andersom.

Supports stable financing but wants assurance that retaining advertising possibilities does not create unfair market pressure on commercial broadcasters, and asks how commercial interests will be weighed.
In that light, the members ask the government for clarity on how it is ensured that retaining the current advertising possibilities does not create undue market pressure on commercial broadcasters.
In dat licht vragen de leden de regering om helderheid over hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat het behouden van de huidige reclamemogelijkheden geen oneigenlijke marktdruk creëert voor commerciële omroepen.
Questions whether keeping advertising airtime is sufficient compensation for the reduced public funding, and whether more measures are needed.
If so, does the government agree that if compensation is appropriate and is the aim, this measure alone is not sufficient and more must be done?
Zo ja, is de regering het ermee eens dat als compensatie gepast is en compensatie het doel is, dat deze maatregel alleen niet voldoende is en dat er meer gedaan moet worden?
Critical of the cuts to public broadcasting and of repeated adjustments to its funding; asks for justification of the savings and whether the government will reconsider them.
These members have great concerns about this cabinet's cuts to the public broadcaster and ask the government for a justification of the savings.
Deze leden hebben grote zorgen over de bezuinigingen van dit kabinet op de publieke omroep en vragen de regering om een onderbouwing van de besparing op de publieke omroep.
Notes that no impact analysis on the wider media market was carried out and that parties were not consulted earlier; asks what the possible consequences of the planned impact analysis could be.
Can the government indicate what the possible consequences of this impact analysis could be, ask these members.
Kan de regering aangeven wat de mogelijke gevolgen van deze impactanalyse kunnen zijn, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises that the bill lowering the minimum national media contribution (rijksmediabijdrage) in the Mediawet 2008 should explain more fully how combining this cut with keeping advertising revenue at eight percent shifts the public broadcaster's financial dependence toward volatile advertising income. The government's reply accepts the remark and supplements the explanatory memorandum on stakeholder effects, the Ster revenue arrangement, and the planned impact analysis.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum insufficiently analyses the consequences of shifting the public broadcaster's financial dependence toward advertising income, which the government supplemented.
The description of the scope of the statutory minimum and the 2025/2026 budget figures should be corrected, which the government did.

36725-M.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the Climate Fund by reallocating funds across policy articles, reducing spending and commitments by about 610 million and 544 million euros respectively, with no new delegation of rule-making power. It also makes the amendment retroactive to 1 June 2025 and sets the budget unit at thousands of euros.

36800-IIA.s: This bill sets the 2026 budget of the Dutch parliament (Staten-Generaal, budget IIA) at thousands of euros, covering the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint interparliamentary spending. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, shifts no power to the executive, and is a routine annual appropriation.
q: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2026 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Staten-Generaal (IIA) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require changes, referring to attached annexes; the reply itself does not address specific advisory points.

36915-L.s: The bill amends the 2026 budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (National Growth Fund) through a first supplementary budget, shifting expenditure and commitment amounts across knowledge-development and research-and-innovation articles. It also reallocates funds between projects and ministries, moving amounts from Education (OCW) to Economic Affairs (EZK) and postponing unused commitments to later years.
36915-L.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need for supplementary appropriations and the reallocation of Growth Fund project money to later years, without a stated delegation of new powers.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the National Growth Fund (L) for the year 2026
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifonds (L) voor het jaar 2026

36945-I.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) that amends the departmental budget statement of the Crown (I) for 2025, adjusting appropriations and realisations across three policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We, Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.
